BS.label: Liabilities
BS.description: Amount of liability recognized for present obligation requiring transfer or otherwise providing economic benefit to others.

BS.label: Assets
BS.description: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

BS.label: Liabilities and Equity
BS.description: Amount of liabilities and equity items, including the portion of equity attributable to noncontrolling interests, if any.

BS.label: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Parent
BS.description: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent. Excludes temporary equity and equity attributable to noncontrolling interest.

BS.label: Deposits
BS.description: The aggregate of all deposit liabilities held by the entity, including foreign and domestic, interest and noninterest bearing; may include demand deposits, saving deposits, Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW) and time deposits among others.

BS.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

BS.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
BS.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated increase (decrease) in equity from transaction and other event and circumstance from nonowner source.

BS.label: Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit)
BS.description: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit).

BS.label: Common Stock, Shares Authorized
BS.description: The maximum number of common shares permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

BS.label: Common Stock, Shares, Issued
BS.description: Total number of common shares of an entity that have been sold or granted to shareholders (includes common shares that were issued, repurchased and remain in the treasury). These shares represent capital invested by the firm's shareholders and owners, and may be all or only a portion of the number of shares authorized. Shares issued include shares outstanding and shares held in the treasury.

BS.label: Time Deposits
BS.description: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit.

BS.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment
BS.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

BS.label: Cash and Due from Banks
BS.description: For banks and other depository institutions: Includes cash on hand (currency and coin), cash items in process of collection, noninterest bearing deposits due from other financial institutions (including corporate credit unions), and noninterest bearing balances with the Federal Reserve Banks, Federal Home Loan Banks and central banks.

BS.label: Common Stock, Value, Issued
BS.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable common stock (or common stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable common shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

BS.label: Operating Lease, Liability
BS.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease.

BS.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset
BS.description: Amount of lessee's right to use underlying asset under operating lease.

BS.label: Other Assets
BS.description: Amount of assets classified as other.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
BS.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

BS.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Allowance
BS.description: Amount of allowance to cover probable credit losses on loans and leases. Includes carryover of or adjustments to the allowance for loan losses in connection with business combinations. Excludes allowance for loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Amortized Cost
BS.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

BS.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Amount
BS.description: Amount after allowance and deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements and loans held for sale.

BS.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
BS.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

BS.label: Goodwill
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated impairment loss, of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

BS.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents
BS.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

BS.label: Interest-bearing Deposits in Banks and Other Financial Institutions
BS.description: For banks and other depository institutions (including Federal Reserve Banks, if applicable): Interest-bearing deposits in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits, which are presented separately from cash on the balance sheet.

BS.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Gross
BS.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

BS.label: Common Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
BS.description: Face amount or stated value per share of common stock.

BS.label: Common Stock, Shares, Outstanding
BS.description: Number of shares of common stock outstanding. Common stock represent the ownership interest in a corporation.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
BS.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes allowance for financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

BS.label: Noninterest-bearing Deposit Liabilities
BS.description: The aggregate amount of all domestic and foreign noninterest-bearing deposits liabilities held by the entity.

BS.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Declared
BS.description: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Fair Value
BS.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

BS.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity
BS.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized
BS.description: The maximum number of nonredeemable preferred shares (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws.

BS.label: Interest Receivable
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of interest earned but not received. Also called accrued interest or accrued interest receivable.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
BS.description: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

BS.label: Other Liabilities
BS.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other.

BS.label: Interest-bearing Deposit Liabilities
BS.description: The aggregate of all domestic and foreign interest-bearing deposit liabilities.

BS.label: Bank Owned Life Insurance
BS.description: The carrying amount of a life insurance policy on an officer, executive or employee for which the reporting entity (a bank) is entitled to proceeds from the policy upon death of the insured or surrender of the insurance policy.

BS.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Net
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

BS.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross
BS.description: Amount before allowance of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Includes deferred interest and fees, undisbursed portion of loan balance, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Issued
BS.description: Aggregate par or stated value of issued nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer). This item includes treasury stock repurchased by the entity. Note: elements for number of nonredeemable preferred shares, par value and other disclosure concepts are in another section within stockholders' equity.

BS.label: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterest
BS.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
BS.description: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Issued
BS.description: Number of shares issued for nonredeemable preferred shares and preferred shares redeemable solely at option of issuer. Includes, but is not limited to, preferred shares issued, repurchased, and held as treasury shares. Excludes preferred shares classified as debt.

BS.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
BS.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

BS.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
BS.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

BS.label: Time Deposits, $100,000 or More
BS.description: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit, in denominations of $100,000 or more.

BS.label: Additional Paid in Capital
BS.description: Amount of excess of issue price over par or stated value of stock and from other transaction involving stock or stockholder. Includes, but is not limited to, additional paid-in capital (APIC) for common and preferred stock.

BS.label: Deposits, Savings Deposits
BS.description: Amount of interest bearing deposits with no stated maturity, which may include passbook and statement savings accounts and money-market deposit accounts (MMDAs).

BS.label: Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
BS.description: Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock represents an equity interest in a FHLB. It does not have a readily determinable fair value because its ownership is restricted and it lacks a market (liquidity).

BS.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net of Deferred Income
BS.description: Amount before allowance and after deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

BS.label: Long-term Debt
BS.description: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt. Excludes lease obligation.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterest
BS.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

BS.label: Subordinated Debt
BS.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of subordinated debt (with initial maturities beyond one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer). Subordinated debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Shares Outstanding
BS.description: Aggregate share number for all nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by stockholders. Does not include preferred shares that have been repurchased.

BS.label: Advances from Federal Home Loan Banks
BS.description: Amount of borrowings as of the balance sheet date from the Federal Home Loan Bank, which are primarily used to cover shortages in the required reserve balance and liquidity shortages.

BS.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
BS.description: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

BS.label: Off-Balance Sheet, Credit Loss, Liability
BS.description: Amount of expected credit loss for credit exposure on off-balance-sheet commitment, including but not limited to, loan commitment, standby letter of credit, financial guarantee not accounted for as insurance. Excludes off-balance sheet credit exposure accounted for as insurance and instrument accounted for under derivatives and hedging.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share
BS.description: Face amount or stated value per share of preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

BS.label: Short-term Debt
BS.description: Reflects the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of debt having initial terms less than one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, after Valuation Allowance
BS.description: Amount, after valuation allowance, of financing receivable held for sale and not part of disposal group. Excludes loan covered under loss sharing agreement and loan classified as investment in debt security.

BS.label: Treasury Stock, Value
BS.description: The amount allocated to treasury stock. Treasury stock is common and preferred shares of an entity that were issued, repurchased by the entity, and are held in its treasury.

BS.label: Intangible Assets, Net (Excluding Goodwill)
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

BS.label: Time Deposits, at or Above FDIC Insurance Limit
BS.description: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit, in denominations that meet or exceed the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance limit.

BS.label: Treasury Stock, Common, Shares
BS.description: Number of previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

BS.label: Federal Funds Sold
BS.description: The amount outstanding of funds lent to other depository institutions, securities brokers, or securities dealers in the form of Federal Funds sold; for example, immediately available funds lent under agreements or contracts that mature in one business day or roll over under a continuing contract, regardless of the nature of the transaction or the collateral involved, excluding overnight lending for commercial and industrial purposes. Also include Federal Funds sold under agreements to resell on a gross basis, excluding (1) sales of term Federal Funds, (2) due bills representing purchases of securities or other assets by the reporting bank that have not yet been delivered and similar instruments, (3) resale agreements that mature in more than one business day involving assets other than securities, and (4) yield maintenance dollar repurchase agreements.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Allowance for Credit Loss
BS.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

BS.label: Other Real Estate
BS.description: Carrying amount of other real estate not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. This does not include real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
BS.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

BS.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Year One
BS.description: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

BS.label: Deferred Income Tax Assets, Net
BS.description: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, with jurisdictional netting.

BS.label: Loans Held-for-sale, Fair Value Disclosure
BS.description: Fair value portion of loans held-for-sale including, but not limited to, mortgage loans and finance receivables.

BS.label: Other Real Estate and Foreclosed Assets
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of other real estate and foreclosed assets. Other real estate may include real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. Foreclosed assets include all assets obtained in full or partial satisfaction of a debt arrangement through foreclosure proceedings.

BS.label: Long-term Federal Home Loan Bank Advances
BS.description: Including both current and noncurrent portions, Federal Home Loan Bank borrowings initially due beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

BS.label: Interest Payable
BS.description: Amount of interest payable on debt, including, but not limited to, trade payables.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, Held-for-Sale
BS.description: Amount, before valuation allowance, of financing receivable classified as held-for-sale.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterest
BS.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

BS.label: Derivative Asset
BS.description: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

BS.label: Real Estate Acquired Through Foreclosure
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of land and buildings obtained through foreclosure proceedings or defeasance in full or partial satisfaction of a debt arrangement.

BS.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Amount
BS.description: Fair value of an asset representing net future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues, in excess of future costs related to servicing arrangements.

BS.label: Derivative Liability
BS.description: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

BS.label: Additional Paid in Capital, Common Stock
BS.description: Value received from shareholders in common stock-related transactions that are in excess of par value or stated value and amounts received from other stock-related transactions. Includes only common stock transactions (excludes preferred stock transactions). May be called contributed capital, capital in excess of par, capital surplus, or paid-in capital.

BS.label: Deposits, Money Market Deposits
BS.description: Amount of deposits in accounts that offer many of the same services as checking accounts although transactions may be somewhat more limited, share some of the characteristics of a money market fund and are insured by the Federal government, also known as money market accounts.

BS.label: Loans Receivable, Fair Value Disclosure
BS.description: Fair value portion of loan receivable, including, but not limited to, mortgage loans held for investment, finance receivables held for investment, policy loans on insurance contracts.

BS.label: Stockholders' Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
BS.description: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to parent and noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

BS.label: AOCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Adjustment, after Tax
BS.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

BS.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Allowance for Credit Loss
BS.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss for debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
BS.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

BS.label: Federal Funds Purchased
BS.description: Amount of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank.

BS.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI
BS.description: Amount of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as current.

BS.label: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Brokered
BS.description: Amount of interest-bearing domestic third-party deposits placed by or through the assistance of a deposit broker, also known as brokered deposit liabilities.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
BS.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

BS.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Number
BS.description: The number of non-vested equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that validly exist and are outstanding as of the balance sheet date.

BS.label: Other Borrowings
BS.description: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date for the aggregate of other miscellaneous borrowings owed by the reporting entity.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterest
BS.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

BS.label: Long-term Line of Credit
BS.description: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the current and noncurrent portions of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms before, as of and after the date of drawdowns on the line. Includes short-term obligations that would normally be classified as current liabilities but for which (a) postbalance sheet date issuance of a long term obligation to refinance the short term obligation on a long term basis, or (b) the enterprise has entered into a financing agreement that clearly permits the enterprise to refinance the short-term obligation on a long term basis and the following conditions are met (1) the agreement does not expire within 1 year and is not cancelable by the lender except for violation of an objectively determinable provision, (2) no violation exists at the BS date, and (3) the lender has entered into the financing agreement is expected to be financially capable of honoring the agreement.

BS.label: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost
BS.description: Amortized amount of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

BS.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, and Federal Funds Sold
BS.description: The sum of cash and cash equivalents plus Federal Funds Sold. Cash and cash equivalents consist of short term, highly liquid investments that are readily convertible to known amounts of cash and are so near their maturity that they present negligible risk of changes in value due to changes in interest rates -- usually with an original maturity less than 90 days.

BS.label: Time Deposits, Less than $100,000
BS.description: Amount of time deposit liabilities, including certificates of deposit, in denominations of less than $100,000.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAmortizedCostAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

BS.label: Financing Receivable, Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accrued interest on financing receivable.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
BS.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

BS.label: Finance Lease, Liability
BS.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease.

BS.label: Servicing Asset
BS.description: Aggregate amount of servicing assets that are subsequently measured at fair value and servicing assets that are subsequently measured using the amortization method.

BS.label: Junior Subordinated Debenture Owed to Unconsolidated Subsidiary Trust
BS.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, the carrying value of junior subordinated long-term debt owed to unconsolidated subsidiary trusts as of the balance sheet date. Such debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets and was initially scheduled to be repaid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

BS.label: Amortization Method Qualified Affordable Housing Project Investments
BS.description: Amount of investment that generates income tax credit and other income tax benefit under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

BS.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax
BS.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

BS.label: Federal Reserve Bank Stock
BS.description: Federal Reserve Bank stock represents an equity interest in the Federal Reserve Bank. It does not have a readily determinable fair value because its ownership is restricted and it lacks a market (liquidity).

BS.label: Federal Home Loan Bank Stock and Federal Reserve Bank Stock
BS.description: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) and Federal Reserve Bank stock.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, Unamortized Loan Fee (Cost) and Purchase Premium (Discount)
BS.description: Amount of unamortized loan commitment, origination, and other costs (fees) and purchase premium (discount) on financing receivable recognized as adjustment to yield. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

BS.label: Marketable Securities
BS.description: Amount of investment in marketable security.

BS.label: Other Short-term Borrowings
BS.description: Amount of borrowings classified as other, maturing within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Treasury Stock, Common, Value
BS.description: Amount allocated to previously issued common shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

BS.label: Demand Deposit Accounts
BS.description: The amount of money in accounts that may bear interest and that the depositor is entitled to withdraw at any time without prior notice.

BS.label: Repossessed Assets
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of all assets obtained in full or partial satisfaction of a debt arrangement through foreclosure proceedings or defeasance; includes real and personal property; equity interests in corporations, partnerships, and joint ventures; and beneficial interests in trusts.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Liquidation Preference Per Share
BS.description: The per share liquidation preference (or restrictions) of nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) that has a preference in involuntary liquidation considerably in excess of the par or stated value of the shares. The liquidation preference is the difference between the preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the share.

BS.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Amortization
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Restricted
BS.description: Amount of restricted investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

BS.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Fair Value
BS.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date.

BS.label: Accrued Investment Income Receivable
BS.description: Interest, dividends, rents, ancillary and other revenues earned but not yet received by the entity on its investments.

BS.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation
BS.description: Amount of actuarial present value of benefits attributed to service rendered by employee for defined benefit plan.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI
BS.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading) and investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

BS.label: Preferred Stock, No Par Value
BS.description: Face amount per share of no-par value preferred stock nonredeemable or redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

BS.label: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Demand
BS.description: Amount of money in interest-bearing domestic accounts that entitle the depositor to withdraw funds at any time without prior notice, also known as demand deposits.

BS.label: Deposits, Fair Value Disclosure
BS.description: Fair value portion of deposit liabilities held by the entity, including, but not limited to, foreign and domestic, interest and noninterest bearing, demand deposits, saving deposits, negotiable orders of withdrawal (NOW) and time deposits.

BS.label: Intangible Assets, Net (Including Goodwill)
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets, goodwill, and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

BS.label: Stockholders' Equity Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
BS.description: Amount of equity (deficit) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Excludes temporary equity.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Dividend Rate, Percentage
BS.description: The percentage rate used to calculate dividend payments on preferred stock.

BS.label: Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
BS.description: Amount after offset of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank and securities that an entity sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price.

BS.label: Cash Surrender Value of Life Insurance
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts which could be received based on the terms of the insurance contract upon surrendering life policies owned by the entity.

BS.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents
BS.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

BS.label: Debt Instrument, Face Amount
BS.description: Face (par) amount of debt instrument at time of issuance.

BS.label: Interest-bearing Deposit Liabilities, Domestic
BS.description: Total amount of interest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities, which may include brokered, retail, demand, checking, notice of withdrawal, money market and other interest-bearing deposits.

BS.label: Junior Subordinated Notes
BS.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of long-term debt (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer) identified as Junior Subordinated Notes, which have a lower priority than senior instruments.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, Unamortized Loan Fee (Cost)
BS.description: Amount of unamortized loan commitment, origination, and other costs (fees) on financing receivable recognized as adjustment to yield. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

BS.label: Noninterest-bearing Deposit Liabilities, Domestic
BS.description: Amount of domestic noninterest-bearing deposits held by the entity, which may include demand deposits, checking, brokered and retail deposits.

BS.label: Deposits, Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW)
BS.description: Amount of deposits in interest-bearing transaction accounts at banks or savings and loans, that are restricted in regard to ownership and can usually only be held by individuals, nonprofit entities and governments. Negotiable order of withdrawal accounts differ from money market demand accounts as they typically have higher reserve requirements and no limit on the number of checks that can be written.

BS.label: Dividends Payable
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding.

BS.label: EquitySecuritiesFvNiCurrentAndNoncurrent
BS.description: Amount of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

BS.label: Financing Receivable, Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss
BS.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of accrued interest on financing receivable.

BS.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Including Disposal Group and Discontinued Operations
BS.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

BS.label: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Amount
BS.description: Amount of investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

BS.label: Common Stock, No Par Value
BS.description: Face amount per share of no-par value common stock.

BS.label: Equity Method Investments
BS.description: This item represents the carrying amount on the entity's balance sheet of its investment in common stock of an equity method investee. This is not an indicator of the fair value of the investment, rather it is the initial cost adjusted for the entity's share of earnings and losses of the investee, adjusted for any distributions (dividends) and other than temporary impairment (OTTI) losses recognized.

BS.label: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Savings
BS.description: Amount of interest-bearing domestic savings deposit liabilities. Saving deposits bear interest and have no stated maturity.

BS.label: Other Investments
BS.description: Amount of investments classified as other.

BS.label: Accrued Liabilities and Other Liabilities
BS.description: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid nor invoiced, and liabilities classified as other.

BS.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
BS.description: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes purchases of participations in pools of securities that are subject to a resale agreement, assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

BS.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Branch of FHLB Bank, Amount of Advances
BS.description: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

BS.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossFeeAndLoanInProcess
BS.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, fee, and loan in process, of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

BS.label: Other Long-term Debt
BS.description: Amount of long-term debt classified as other.

BS.label: Finite-Lived Core Deposits, Gross
BS.description: Bank deposits belonging to an acquired bank that can be counted on as a stable source of lending funds. These deposits have the following attributes: predictable costs and low sensitivity to interest rates. This intangible asset is usually amortized over its estimated useful life.

BS.label: Long-term Debt, Fair Value
BS.description: The fair value amount of long-term debt whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements. The element may be used in both the balance sheet and disclosure in the same submission.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss and Fee
BS.description: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, fee, and loan in process, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

BS.label: Other Intangible Assets, Net
BS.description: Amount after accumulated amortization of finite-lived and indefinite-lived intangible assets classified as other.

BS.label: Restricted Investments
BS.description: Investments which are not defined as or included in marketable (debt, equity, or other) securities whose use is restricted in whole or in part, generally by contractual agreements or regulatory requirements. For use in an unclassified balance sheet.

BS.label: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Money Market
BS.description: Amount of interest-bearing domestic money market demand account deposit liabilities.

BS.label: Investments
BS.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all investments.

BS.label: Noninterest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Demand
BS.description: Amount of money in noninterest-bearing domestic accounts that entitle the depositor to withdraw funds at any time without prior notice, also known as demand deposits.

BS.label: Short-term Debt, Fair Value
BS.description: This element represents the portion of the balance sheet assertion valued at fair value by the entity whether such amount is presented as a separate caption or as a parenthetical disclosure. Additionally, this element may be used in connection with the fair value disclosures required in the footnote disclosures to the financial statements. The element may be used in both the balance sheet and disclosure in the same submission. This item represents the amount of short-term debt existing as of the balance sheet date.

BS.label: Mortgages Held-for-sale, Fair Value Disclosure
BS.description: Fair value portion of mortgage loans held-for-sale.

BS.label: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Certificates of Deposits
BS.description: Amount of interest-bearing domestic certificate of deposit liabilities.

BS.label: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Time Deposits
BS.description: Amount of interest-bearing domestic time deposits. Time deposits bear interest for a fixed, stated period of time and include certificate of deposits and individual retirement accounts.

BS.label: Debt and Lease Obligation
BS.description: Amount of short-term and long-term debt and lease obligation.

BS.label: Long-term Debt, Gross
BS.description: Amount, before unamortized (discount) premium and debt issuance costs, of long-term debt. Includes, but is not limited to, notes payable, bonds payable, commercial loans, mortgage loans, convertible debt, subordinated debt and other types of debt.

BS.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Net
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

BS.label: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Checking
BS.description: Amount of interest-bearing domestic checking deposit liabilities.

BS.label: Restricted Cash
BS.description: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Trading
BS.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

BS.label: Federal Home Loan Bank Borrowings, Fair Value Disclosure
BS.description: Fair value portion of borrowing from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

BS.label: Certificates of Deposit, at Carrying Value
BS.description: A savings certificate entitling the Entity (that is, bearer) to receive interest at an established maturity date, based upon a fixed interest rate. A certificate of deposit may be issued in any denomination. Certificates of deposit are generally issued by commercial banks and, therefore, insured by the FDIC (up to the prescribed limit). Certificates of deposit generally restrict holders from withdrawing funds on demand without the incurrence of penalties. Generally, only certificates of deposit with original maturities of three months or less qualify as cash equivalents. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. As a related example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Liquidation Preference, Value
BS.description: Value of the difference between preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the preferred shares.

BS.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Assets
BS.description: Amount classified as assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

BS.label: Prepaid Expense
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of expenditures made in advance of when the economic benefit of the cost will be realized, and which will be expensed in future periods with the passage of time or when a triggering event occurs.

BS.label: Real Estate Owned, Valuation Allowance
BS.description: For each period for which an income statement is required, disclosure of the changes in the allowance, including balances at end of period.

BS.label: Interest Receivable and Other Assets
BS.description: Amount of interest receivable and assets classified as other.

BS.label: Commitments and Contingencies
BS.description: Represents the caption on the face of the balance sheet to indicate that the entity has entered into (1) purchase or supply arrangements that will require expending a portion of its resources to meet the terms thereof, and (2) is exposed to potential losses or, less frequently, gains, arising from (a) possible claims against a company's resources due to future performance under contract terms, and (b) possible losses or likely gains from uncertainties that will ultimately be resolved when one or more future events that are deemed likely to occur do occur or fail to occur.

BS.label: Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
BS.description: Includes: (1) the amount outstanding of funds lent to other depository institutions, securities brokers, or securities dealers in the form of Federal Funds sold; for example, immediately available funds lent under agreements or contracts that mature in one business day or roll over under a continuing contract, regardless of the nature of the transaction or the collateral involved, excluding overnight lending for commercial and industrial purposes. Also include Federal Funds sold under agreements to resell on a gross basis, excluding (1) sales of term Federal Funds, (2) due bills representing purchases of securities or other assets by the reporting bank that have not yet been delivered and similar instruments, (3) resale agreements that mature in more than one business day involving assets other than securities, and (4) yield maintenance dollar repurchase agreements (Federal Funds Sold) and (2) the dollar amount outstanding of funds lent in the form of security resale agreements regardless of maturity, if the agreement requires the bank to resell the identical security purchased or a security that meets the definition of substantially the same in the case of a dollar roll. Also include purchases of participations in pools of securities, regardless of maturity (Securities Purchased Under Agreements to Re-sell).

BS.label: Income Taxes Receivable
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of income taxes previously overpaid to tax authorities (such as U.S. Federal, state and local tax authorities) representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes. Also called income tax refund receivable.

BS.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Gross
BS.description: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

BS.label: Debt Securities
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

BS.label: Deferred Income Tax Liabilities, Net
BS.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences with jurisdictional netting.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, Deferred Commitment Fee
BS.description: Amount of fee received for commitment to originate or purchase financing receivable where likelihood of commitment being exercised is remote, to be recognized as service income.

BS.label: Notes Payable
BS.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, aggregate carrying amount of all types of notes payable, as of the balance sheet date, with initial maturities beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Secured Debt
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date, including the current and noncurrent portions, of collateralized debt obligations (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer). Such obligations include mortgage loans, chattel loans, and any other borrowings secured by assets of the borrower.

BS.label: Accrued Liabilities
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable, pertaining to costs that are statutory in nature, are incurred on contractual obligations, or accumulate over time and for which invoices have not yet been received or will not be rendered. Examples include taxes, interest, rent and utilities.

BS.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Cost
BS.description: Cost of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI). Excludes equity method investment and investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

BS.label: Other Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
BS.description: Fair value portion of other assets.

BS.label: Common Stock, Value, Outstanding
BS.description: Value of common shares held by shareholders. Excludes common shares repurchased and held as treasury shares.

BS.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan
BS.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

BS.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

BS.label: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
BS.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date, including liabilities incurred and payable to vendors for goods and services received, taxes, interest, rent and utilities, compensation costs, payroll taxes and fringe benefits (other than pension and postretirement obligations), contractual rights and obligations, and statutory obligations.

BS.label: Deferred Compensation Liability, Current and Noncurrent
BS.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for all deferred compensation arrangements. Represents currently earned compensation under compensation arrangements that is not actually paid until a later date.

BS.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Liabilities
BS.description: Amount classified as liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Outstanding
BS.description: Value of nonredeemable preferred shares and preferred shares redeemable solely at option of issuer, held by shareholders. Excludes preferred shares repurchased and held as treasury shares.

BS.label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets (Excluding Goodwill)
BS.description: Amount of indefinite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill.

BS.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Reported Amount, Covered and Not Covered
BS.description: Amount after allowance and deduction of deferred interest and fees, unamortized costs and premiums over and discounts from face amounts, of loans and leases held in portfolio, including but not limited to, commercial and consumer loans. Includes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

BS.label: Other Repossessed Assets
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of assets other than real property that were received in full or partial satisfaction of a debt arrangement through foreclosure proceedings or defeasance.

BS.label: Other Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
BS.description: Fair value portion of other liabilities.

BS.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
BS.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable.

BS.label: Contractual Obligation
BS.description: Amount of contractual obligation, including, but not limited to, long-term debt, lease obligation, purchase obligation, and other commitments.

BS.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Reported Amount, Covered
BS.description: Net carrying amount of loans and leases receivable covered by loss sharing agreements.

BS.label: Debt, Long-term and Short-term, Combined Amount
BS.description: Represents the aggregate of total long-term debt, including current maturities and short-term debt.

BS.label: Senior Notes
BS.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of Notes with the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer). Senior note holders are paid off in full before any payments are made to junior note holders.

BS.label: AOCI, Cash Flow Hedge, Cumulative Gain (Loss), after Tax
BS.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated gain (loss) on derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

BS.label: Assets Held-for-sale, Not Part of Disposal Group
BS.description: Amount of assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group.

BS.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
BS.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation and amortization from plant, property, and equipment and right-of-use asset from finance lease.

BS.label: Accounts Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business.

BS.label: Deposits, Money Market Deposits and Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW)
BS.description: Amount of deposits in accounts that offer many of the same services as checking accounts although transactions may be somewhat more limited, share some of the characteristics of a money market fund and are insured by the Federal government, also known as money market accounts. Also includes amount of deposits in interest-bearing transaction accounts at banks or savings and loans, that are restricted in regard to ownership and can usually only be held by individuals, nonprofit entities and governments. Negotiable order of withdrawal accounts differ from money market demand accounts as they typically have higher reserve requirements and no limit on the number of checks that can be written.

BS.label: Other Receivables
BS.description: Amount due from parties in nontrade transactions, classified as other.

BS.label: Unamortized Debt Issuance Expense
BS.description: The remaining balance of debt issuance expenses that were capitalized and are being amortized against income over the lives of the respective bond issues. This does not include the amounts capitalized as part of the cost of the utility plant or asset.

BS.label: AOCI Tax, Attributable to Parent
BS.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent.

BS.label: Assets Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Carrying Amount
BS.description: Carrying amount of assets sold under agreements to repurchase when the carrying amount (or market value, if higher than the carrying amount) of securities or other assets sold under repurchase agreements exceeds 10 percent of total assets.

BS.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Recorded Liability
BS.description: The carrying amount of the liability as of the balance sheet date to an individual under a deferred compensation arrangement. This amount may be the result of periodic accruals made over the period of active employment, or reflect termination benefits resulting contractual terms or a death benefit.

BS.label: Property Subject to or Available for Operating Lease, Net
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, of lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

BS.label: Retained Earnings, Unappropriated
BS.description: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit) available for dividend distribution. Includes, but is not limited to, retained earnings not appropriated for specific business purpose.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAndHeldToMaturityFairValue
BS.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

BS.label: Investments in and Advance to Affiliates, Subsidiaries, Associates, and Joint Ventures
BS.description: Amount of investment in equity method investee and investment in and advance to affiliate.

BS.label: Other Investments and Securities, at Cost
BS.description: Includes other investments and securities that are not at fair value as of the balance sheet date and those that are not accounted for under the equity method.

BS.label: Assets for Plan Benefits, Defined Benefit Plan
BS.description: Amount of asset, recognized in statement of financial position, for overfunded defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans.

BS.label: Net Investment in Lease
BS.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

BS.label: Cash
BS.description: Amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

BS.label: Cash Surrender Value, Fair Value Disclosure
BS.description: Fair value portion of the amount that could be realized under a life insurance contract or contracts owned by the entity, commonly known as corporate-owned life insurance (COLI) or bank-owned life insurance (BOLI).

BS.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant and Equipment
BS.description: Amount classified as property, plant, and equipment attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

BS.label: Long-term Debt, Excluding Current Maturities
BS.description: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as noncurrent. Excludes lease obligation.

BS.label: Property Subject to or Available for Operating Lease, Accumulated Depreciation
BS.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation of lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

BS.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Allowance, Covered
BS.description: Amount of allowance for loan and lease losses covered by loss sharing agreements.

BS.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Gross
BS.description: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

BS.label: Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
BS.description: Amount of short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

BS.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount (Premium) and Debt Issuance Costs, Net
BS.description: Amount of unamortized debt discount (premium) and debt issuance costs.

BS.label: Deposit Liabilities, Accrued Interest
BS.description: Amount of accrued but unpaid interest on deposit liabilities.

BS.label: Due from Customer Acceptances
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of receivable from customer for banker's acceptance.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Restricted
BS.description: Amount of restricted investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

BS.label: Other Short-term Investments
BS.description: Amount of short-term investments classified as other.

BS.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents, Current
BS.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

BS.label: Secured Debt, Repurchase Agreements
BS.description: Carrying value, as of the balance sheet date, of securities sold under agreements to repurchase where the transferor maintains effective control over the assets, accounting for them as secured debt.

BS.label: Accounts Payable and Other Accrued Liabilities
BS.description: Amount of liabilities incurred and payable to vendors for goods and services received, and accrued liabilities classified as other.

BS.label: Bank Acceptances Executed and Outstanding
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of drafts and bills of exchange that have been accepted by the reporting bank, or by others for its own account, as its liability to holders of the drafts.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
BS.description: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

BS.label: Due from Banks
BS.description: A bank's noninterest bearing demand deposits in other banks (such as correspondents).

BS.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI and without Readily Determinable Fair Value
BS.description: Amount of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI) and investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

BS.label: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Other Time Deposit
BS.description: Amount of interest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities classified as other. Excludes certificates of deposit.

BS.label: Life Insurance, Corporate or Bank Owned, Amount
BS.description: This item represents the amount that could be realized under a life insurance contract or contracts owned by the Entity as of the date of the statement of financial position. Such Entity-owned life insurance policies are commonly known as corporate-owned life insurance (COLI) or bank-owned life insurance (BOLI).

BS.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation
BS.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
BS.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Subordinated Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of collateralized/uncollateralized debt obligation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion. Subordinated debt places a lender in a lien position behind the primary lender of the company.

BS.label: Unearned ESOP Shares
BS.description: Fair value of unearned shares for all classes of common stock and nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) held by an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP). Includes the sale of shares or the issuance treasury shares to an ESOP.

BS.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Amount
BS.description: Amount of valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale and Held-to-maturity
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

BS.label: Deposits, Domestic
BS.description: The aggregate of all domestic interest-bearing and noninterest-bearing deposit liabilities.

BS.label: Interest-bearing Deposit Liabilities, Foreign
BS.description: Amount of foreign interest-bearing deposits held by the entity.

BS.label: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW)
BS.description: Amount of interest-bearing domestic negotiable order of withdrawal (NOW) demand deposit liabilities.

BS.label: Investment Owned, at Fair Value
BS.description: Fair value of investment in security owned.

BS.label: Money Market Funds, at Carrying Value
BS.description: Investment in short-term money-market instruments (such as commercial paper, banker's acceptances, repurchase agreements, government securities, certificates of deposit, and so forth) which are highly liquid (that is, readily convertible to known amounts of cash) and so near their maturity that they present an insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify as cash equivalents by definition. Original maturity means an original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

BS.label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
BS.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets.

BS.label: Receivables from Brokers-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
BS.description: Amount receivable from broker-dealers and clearing organizations, including, but not limited to, securities failed-to-deliver, certain deposits for securities borrowed, open transactions, good faith and margin deposits, commissions and floor brokerage receivables.

BS.label: Taxes Payable
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory income, sales, use, payroll, excise, real, property and other taxes.

BS.label: Trading Liabilities
BS.description: The carrying amount of liabilities as of the balance sheet date that pertain to principal and customer trading transactions, or which may be incurred with the objective of generating a profit from short-term fluctuations in price as part of an entity's market-making, hedging and proprietary trading. Examples include short positions in securities, derivatives and commodities, obligations under repurchase agreements, and securities borrowed arrangements.

BS.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense
BS.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowances, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences from reserves and accruals, compensation and benefit costs, and other provisions, reserves, and allowances.

BS.label: Deposits, Wholesale
BS.description: The aggregate amount of all wholesale deposit accounts including certificates of deposits.

BS.label: Retained Earnings, Appropriated
BS.description: Amount of accumulated undistributed earnings (deficit) not available for dividend distribution. Includes, but is not limited to, retained earnings appropriated for specific business purpose.

BS.label: Accounts Payable
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

BS.label: Accrued Income Taxes
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the unpaid sum of the known and estimated amounts payable to satisfy all domestic and foreign income tax obligations due. This amount is the total of current and noncurrent accrued income taxes.

BS.label: Advance Payments by Borrowers for Taxes and Insurance
BS.description: Carrying amount of accumulated prepayments received by financial institutions from borrowers for taxes (for example, property taxes) and insurance (for example, property and catastrophe) which will periodically be remitted to the appropriate governmental agency or vendor on behalf of the borrower.

BS.label: Commercial Paper
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of short-term borrowings using unsecured obligations issued by banks, corporations and other borrowers to investors. The maturities of these money market securities generally do not exceed 270 days.

BS.label: Long-term Federal Home Loan Bank Advances, Noncurrent
BS.description: The noncurrent portion of Federal Home Loan Bank borrowings initially due beyond one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

BS.label: Carrying Value of Federal Funds Purchased, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, and Deposits Received for Securities Loaned
BS.description: Carrying value of federal funds purchased and securities sold under repurchase agreements and deposits received for securities loaned.

BS.label: Common Stocks, Including Additional Paid in Capital
BS.description: Amount of par value plus amounts in excess of par value or issuance value for common stock issued.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
BS.description: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
BS.description: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

BS.label: Other Accrued Liabilities
BS.description: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other.

BS.label: Short-term Investments
BS.description: Amount of investments including trading securities, available-for-sale securities, held-to-maturity securities, and short-term investments classified as other and current.

BS.label: Time Deposits, at Carrying Value
BS.description: Any certificate of deposit or savings account held by a bank or other financial institution for a short-term specified period of time. Because of their short-term, time deposits are considered highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
BS.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as current.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Current
BS.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

BS.label: Common Stock Held in Trust
BS.description: Value of common stock held in trust.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAndHeldToMaturityAmortizedCostAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
BS.description: Amortized cost, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

BS.label: Deposit Assets
BS.description: The carrying amount of the asset transferred to a third party to serve as a deposit, which typically serves as security against failure by the transferor to perform under terms of an agreement.

BS.label: Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Loaned or Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Fair Value Disclosure
BS.description: Fair value portion of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank and securities that an entity sells and agrees to repurchase at a specified date for a specified price.

BS.label: Real Estate Held-for-sale
BS.description: Amount of investment in land and building held for sale. Excludes real estate considered inventory.

BS.label: Securities Borrowed
BS.description: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of securities borrowed from entities in exchange for collateral. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

BS.label: Statutory Accounting Practices, Statutory Amount Available for Dividend Payments with Regulatory Approval
BS.description: Amount of dividends that can be declared or paid with approval of regulatory agency.

BS.label: Deferred Compensation Equity
BS.description: Value of stock issued under share-based plans to employees or officers which is the unearned portion, accounted for under the fair value method.

BS.label: Federal Funds Sold and Securities Borrowed or Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Fair Value Disclosure
BS.description: Fair value portion of federal funds sold and securities borrowed or purchased under agreements to resell.

BS.label: Securities Loaned
BS.description: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

BS.label: Short-term Bank Loans and Notes Payable
BS.description: Amount of borrowings from a bank classified as other, maturing within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Accounts and Financing Receivables, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, after Valuation Allowance
BS.description: Amount, after valuation allowance, of accounts and financing receivables held for sale and not part of disposal group. Excludes loan covered under loss sharing agreement and loan classified as investment in debt security.

BS.label: Common Stock, Shares Held in Employee Trust, Shares
BS.description: Number of common stock held in a trust that has been set up specifically to accumulate stock for the sole purpose of distribution to participating employees but not yet earned.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Restricted
BS.description: Amount of restricted investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

BS.label: Equity Method Investments, Fair Value Disclosure
BS.description: Fair value portion of investments accounted under the equity method.

BS.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation, Including Current Maturities
BS.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, including portion classified as current.

BS.label: Noninterest-bearing Deposit Liabilities, Foreign
