BS.description: Amount of foreign noninterest-bearing deposits held by the entity which may include demand deposits, checking, brokered and retail deposits.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Amortized Cost
BS.description: Amortized cost of investments in debt securities classified as trading.

BS.label: Unsecured Debt
BS.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of uncollateralized debt obligations (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
BS.description: Fair value portion of trade and related party payables and accrued expenses.

BS.label: Affordable Housing Program Obligation
BS.description: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) obligation for Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessment required by Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

BS.label: Due to Correspondent Brokers
BS.description: Amount payable to correspondent broker-dealer.

BS.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
BS.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

BS.label: Temporary Equity, Carrying Amount, Attributable to Parent
BS.description: Carrying amount, attributable to parent, of an entity's issued and outstanding stock which is not included within permanent equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. Includes stock with a put option held by an ESOP and stock redeemable by a holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

BS.label: Assets Held-for-sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Current
BS.description: Amount of assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group, expected to be sold within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Dividends Payable, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Restricted
BS.description: Amount of restricted investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

BS.label: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Other
BS.description: Amount of other interest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities.

BS.label: Noninterest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Checking
BS.description: Amount of noninterest-bearing domestic checking deposit liabilities.

BS.label: Notes and Loans Payable
BS.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of all notes and loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Other Long-term Investments
BS.description: Amount of long-term investments classified as other.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital, Net of Discount
BS.description: Aggregate par value plus amounts in excess of par or issuance value (in cases of no-par value stock) for nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) issued and outstanding, net of discount on shares. Aggregate for preferred stock issued and outstanding.

BS.label: Prepaid Insurance
BS.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for insurance that provides economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Treasury Stock, Carrying Basis
BS.description: Cost basis for treasury stock acquired for purposes other than retirement.

BS.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
BS.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable, classified as current.

BS.label: Common Stock Issued, Employee Stock Trust
BS.description: Value of common stock issued to a trust (for example, a 'rabbi trust') set up specifically to accumulate stock for the sole purpose of distribution to participating employees. This trust does not allow employees to immediately or after a holding period diversify into nonemployer securities. The deferred compensation plan for which this trust is set up must be settled by the delivery of a fixed number of shares of employer stock.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAmortizedCostAfterAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.

BS.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Common Stock Reserved for Future Issuance
BS.description: Number of common shares reserved for future issuance related to deferred compensation arrangements with individuals.

BS.label: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, at Fair Value
BS.description: Fair value of obligations incurred from short sales.

BS.label: Interest Receivable, Current
BS.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of current interest earned but not received. Also called accrued interest or accrued interest receivable. For classified balance sheets, represents the current amount receivable, that is amounts expected to be collected within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: PropertyPlantAndEquipmentExcludingLessorAssetUnderOperatingLeaseAfterAccumulatedDepreciation
BS.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation and excluding lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease, of physical asset used in normal conduct of business to create and distribute product and service.

BS.label: Taxes Payable, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for statutory income, sales, use, payroll, excise, real, property and other taxes. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Transfers Accounted for as Secured Borrowings, Assets, Carrying Amount
BS.description: Carrying amount of financial assets accounted for as secured borrowings recognized in the transferor's statement of financial position at the end of each period presented.

BS.label: Accrued Liabilities, Current
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable, pertaining to costs that are statutory in nature, are incurred on contractual obligations, or accumulate over time and for which invoices have not yet been received or will not be rendered. Examples include taxes, interest, rent and utilities. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Beneficial Interest Liability
BS.description: Obligation reflecting another party's right to economic interests in another entity or trust under a contractual right. For example, an investor may purchase a beneficial interest in a securitization transaction.

BS.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, and Short-term Investments
BS.description: Cash includes currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. It also includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits in that the customer may deposit additional funds at any time and effectively may withdraw funds at any time without prior notice or penalty. Cash equivalents, excluding items classified as marketable securities, include short-term, highly liquid Investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash, and so near their maturity that they present minimal risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months. Short-term investments, exclusive of cash equivalents, generally consist of marketable securities intended to be sold within one year (or the normal operating cycle if longer) and may include trading securities, available-for-sale securities, or held-to-maturity securities (if maturing within one year), as applicable.

BS.label: Common Stock, Shares Held in Employee Trust
BS.description: Value of common stock issued to a trust (for example, but not limited to, rabbi trust) set up specifically to accumulate stock for the sole purpose of distribution to participating employees.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
BS.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

BS.label: Deposits Assets
BS.description: Carrying value of amounts transferred to third parties for security purposes that are expected to be returned or applied towards payment in the future.

BS.label: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterestCurrent
BS.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as current.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, Loan in Process
BS.description: Amount of undisbursed portion of financing receivable balance. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement.

BS.label: Investment Owned, Restricted, Cost
BS.description: The cost of the restricted investment.

BS.label: Junior Subordinated Notes, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of long-term debt (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer) identified as Junior Subordinated Notes, which have a lower priority than senior instruments, excluding current portion.

BS.label: Other Interest Earning Assets
BS.description: Amount of interest earning assets classified as other.

BS.label: Other Liabilities, Current
BS.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Restricted Cash, Current
BS.description: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage, classified as current. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

BS.label: Secured Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying amount of collateralized debt obligations with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer, excluding the current portion. Obligations include, but not limited to, mortgage loans, chattel loans, and other borrowings secured by assets.

BS.label: Assets Held-in-trust, Noncurrent
BS.description: The amount of cash, securities, or other assets held by a third-party trustee pursuant to the terms of an agreement which assets are available to be used by beneficiaries to that agreement only within the specific terms thereof and which agreement is expected to terminate more than one year from the balance sheet date (or operating cycle, if longer) at which time the assets held-in-trust will be released or forfeited.

BS.label: Carrying Value of Federal Funds Sold, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, and Deposits Paid for Securities Borrowed
BS.description: Carrying value of federal funds sold, securities purchased under agreements to resell, and deposits paid for securities borrowed.

BS.label: Common Stock Issued, Employee Trust, Deferred
BS.description: Aggregate value of common stock held in a trust that has been set up specifically to accumulate stock for the sole purpose of distribution to participating employees but not yet earned.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAmortizedCostAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterestCurrent
BS.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterestCurrent
BS.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

BS.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant and Equipment, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount classified as property, plant and equipment attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterestNoncurrent
BS.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, Covered and Not Covered, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Fee, Premium, and Discount
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss and unamortized deferred fee, premium, and discount, of financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and financing receivable not covered under loss sharing agreement.

BS.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
BS.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as current. Excludes net investment in lease.

BS.label: Liabilities, Current
BS.description: Total obligations incurred as part of normal operations that are expected to be paid during the following twelve months or within one business cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Other Assets, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of noncurrent assets classified as other.

BS.label: Preferred Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital
BS.description: Aggregate issuance value of nonredeemable preferred stock (or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer) issued and outstanding.

BS.label: Securities Borrowed, Fair Value Disclosure
BS.description: Fair value portion of securities borrowed from other entities.

BS.label: Senior Notes, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of Notes with the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion. Senior note holders are paid off in full before any payments are made to junior note holders.

BS.label: Statutory Accounting Practices, Statutory Capital and Surplus, Balance
BS.description: The amount of statutory capital and surplus (stockholders' equity) as of the balance sheet date using prescribed or permitted statutory accounting practices (rather than GAAP, if different) of the state or country.

BS.label: Stockholders' Equity before Treasury Stock
BS.description: Total amount of stockholders' equity (deficit) items including stock value, paid in capital, retained earnings and including equity attributable to noncontrolling interests and before deducting the carrying value of treasury stock.

BS.label: Supplemental Unemployment Benefits, Salary Continuation
BS.description: Liability for agreement to continue an employee's salary after termination of employment (but before retirement) including death, disability, or other event. For example, a company may agree to continue a disabled employee's salary for six months.

BS.label: Temporary Equity, Carrying Amount, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interests
BS.description: Carrying amount, attributable to parent and noncontrolling interests, of an entity's issued and outstanding stock which is not included within permanent equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. Includes stock with a put option held by an ESOP and stock redeemable by a holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

BS.label: Temporary Equity, Redemption Price Per Share
BS.description: Amount to be paid per share that is classified as temporary equity by entity upon redemption. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

BS.label: Unearned Premiums
BS.description: Carrying amount of premiums written on insurance contracts that have not been earned as of the balance sheet date.

BS.label: Compensation and Benefits Trust
BS.description: The value of a trust established to hold the stock of an employee compensation and benefits plan as of the balance sheet date.

BS.label: Customer's Liability for Acceptances, Net
BS.description: The aggregate of all customer's outstanding debt to the institution that resulted from short-term negotiable time drafts drawn on and accepted by an institution (also known as banker's acceptance transactions), net of allowance for uncollectible customer's liability for acceptances.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
BS.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.

BS.label: Deferred Compensation Liability, Classified, Noncurrent
BS.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for all deferred compensation arrangements payable beyond one year (or the operating cycle, if longer).

BS.label: Derivative Asset, Noncurrent
BS.description: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

BS.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
BS.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as noncurrent. Excludes net investment in lease.

BS.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Other Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
BS.description: Amount of liabilities incurred and payable to vendors for goods and services received classified as other, and expenses incurred but not yet paid, payable within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Other Restricted Assets
BS.description: Total assets that cannot be used for operating purposes because of contract or regulatory requirements that are in effect for a period that extends beyond one year.

BS.label: Prepaid Expense, Noncurrent
BS.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of amounts paid in advance for expenses which will be charged against earnings in periods after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Restricted Investments, Noncurrent
BS.description: This element represents the noncurrent portion of investments which are not defined as or included in marketable (debt, equity, or other) securities that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

BS.label: Separate Account Asset
BS.description: Amount of asset at fair value held for benefit of separate account policyholder.

BS.label: Separate Account, Liability
BS.description: Amount of liability for variable contract in which all or portion of contract holder's funds is allocated to specific separate account and supported by assets held in separate account.

BS.label: Temporary Equity, Shares Authorized
BS.description: The maximum number of securities classified as temporary equity that are permitted to be issued by an entity's charter and bylaws. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

BS.label: Temporary Equity, Shares Issued
BS.description: The number of securities classified as temporary equity that have been sold (or granted) to the entity's shareholders. Securities issued include securities outstanding and securities held in treasury. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

BS.label: Temporary Equity, Shares Outstanding
BS.description: The number of securities classified as temporary equity that have been issued and are held by the entity's shareholders. Securities outstanding equals securities issued minus securities held in treasury. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

BS.label: Deferred Employee Stock Ownership Plan, Issuance of Shares or Sale of Treasury Shares
BS.description: The issuance of shares or sale of treasury shares to an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

BS.label: Assets, Current
BS.description: Amount of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit, classified as current.

BS.label: Cash and Securities Segregated under Securities Exchange Commission Regulation
BS.description: Cash and securities deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers.

BS.label: Common Stock, Other Value, Outstanding
BS.description: Value of share of other common stock instruments held by shareholder. Includes, but is not limited to, exchangeable share.

BS.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss for right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterestCurrent
BS.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.

BS.label: Deferred Income Taxes and Other Assets, Current
BS.description: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and other assets expected to be realized or consumed within one year or normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Deposits Assets, Noncurrent
BS.description: Carrying value of amounts transferred to third parties for security purposes that are expected to be returned or applied towards payment after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
BS.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as noncurrent. Excludes net investment in lease.

BS.label: Interest and Dividends Payable, Current
BS.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of (a) interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred, and (b) dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding (also includes dividends collected on behalf of another owner of securities that are being held by the entity). Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

BS.label: Interest and Dividends Payable
BS.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of (a) interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred, and (b) dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding (also includes dividends collected on behalf of another owner of securities that are being held by the entity).

BS.label: Nonfinancial Liabilities Fair Value Disclosure
BS.description: Fair value of obligations not classified as financial liabilities. Includes, but is not limited to, accounts payable and accrued liabilities, commitments, obligations, and other liabilities.

BS.label: Nontrade Receivables
BS.description: Carrying amounts due as of the balance sheet date of the sum of amounts receivable other than from customers.

BS.label: Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
BS.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

BS.label: Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Current
BS.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

BS.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Common, Carrying Amount
BS.description: As of the reporting date, the carrying amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. The noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) may be in the form of common shares (regardless of class), limited partnership units (regardless of class), non-preferential membership interests, or any other form of common equity regardless of investee entity legal form.

BS.label: Temporary Equity, Par or Stated Value Per Share
BS.description: Per share amount of par value or stated value of stock classified as temporary equity. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable.

BS.label: Treasury Stock, Preferred, Shares
BS.description: Number of previously issued preferred shares repurchased by the issuing entity and held in treasury.

IS.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
IS.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

IS.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
IS.description: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

IS.label: Interest Income (Expense), Net
IS.description: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating.

IS.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income, attributable to parent entity. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

IS.label: Interest Income (Expense), after Provision for Loan Loss
IS.description: Amount of interest income or expense, including any amortization and accretion (as applicable) of discounts and premiums, including consideration of the provisions for loan, lease, credit, and other related losses.

IS.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic
IS.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

IS.label: Noninterest Expense
IS.description: Total aggregate amount of all noninterest expense.

IS.label: Noninterest Income
IS.description: The total amount of noninterest income which may be derived from: (1) fees and commissions; (2) premiums earned; (3) insurance policy charges; (4) the sale or disposal of assets; and (5) other sources not otherwise specified.

IS.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted
IS.description: The amount of net income (loss) for the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

IS.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
IS.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

IS.label: Other Noninterest Expense
IS.description: Amount of noninterest expense classified as other.

IS.label: Interest and Dividend Income, Operating
IS.description: Represents the total of interest and dividend income, including any amortization and accretion (as applicable) of discounts and premiums, earned from (1) loans and leases whether held-for-sale or held-in-portfolio; (2) investment securities; (3) federal funds sold; (4) securities purchased under agreements to resell; (5) investments in banker's acceptances, commercial paper, or certificates of deposit; (6) dividend income; or (7) other investments not otherwise specified herein.

IS.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
IS.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

IS.label: Interest Expense
IS.description: Amount of interest expense classified as operating and nonoperating. Includes, but is not limited to, cost of borrowing accounted for as interest expense.

IS.label: Labor and Related Expense
IS.description: Amount of expense for salary, wage, profit sharing; incentive and equity-based compensation; and other employee benefit.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, including income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit), and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

IS.label: InterestExpenseOperating
IS.description: Amount of interest expense classified as operating.

IS.label: Occupancy, Net
IS.description: Amount of net occupancy expense that may include items, such as depreciation of facilities and equipment, lease expenses, property taxes and property and casualty insurance expense.

IS.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans and Leases
IS.description: The aggregate interest and fee income generated by: (1) loans the Entity has positive intent and ability to hold for the foreseeable future, or until maturity or payoff, including commercial and consumer loans, whether domestic or foreign, which may consist of: (a) industrial and agricultural; (b) real estate; and (c) real estate construction loans; (d) trade financing; (e) lease financing; (f) home equity lines-of-credit; (g) automobile and other vehicle loans; and (h) credit card and other revolving-type loans and (2) loans and leases held-for-sale which may include mortgage loans, direct financing, and sales-type leases.

IS.label: Provision for Loan and Lease Losses
IS.description: Amount of expense related to estimated loss from loan and lease transactions.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Deposits
IS.description: Aggregate amount of interest expense on all deposits.

IS.label: Amortization of Intangible Assets
IS.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

IS.label: Professional Fees
IS.description: A fee charged for services from professionals such as doctors, lawyers and accountants. The term is often expanded to include other professions, for example, pharmacists charging to maintain a medicinal profile of a client or customer.

IS.label: Provision for Loan, Lease, and Other Losses
IS.description: Amount of expense related loan transactions, lease transactions, credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions, and other loss based on assessment of uncollectability from the counterparty to reduce the account to their net realizable value.

IS.label: Current Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
IS.description: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to taxable income (loss) from continuing operations.

IS.label: Financing Receivable, Credit Loss, Expense (Reversal)
IS.description: Amount of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) for financing receivable.

IS.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Declared
IS.description: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Equity Method Investments, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of income (loss) from equity method investments.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount after tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax
IS.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

IS.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
IS.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

IS.label: Bank Owned Life Insurance Income
IS.description: Earnings on or other increases in the value of the cash surrender value of bank owned life insurance policies.

IS.label: Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation Premium Expense
IS.description: Amount of expense for Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance.

IS.label: Noninterest Income, Other Operating Income
IS.description: Amount of revenue earned, classified as other, excluding interest income.

IS.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment and Tax
IS.description: Amount, before tax and adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

IS.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
IS.description: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

IS.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Realized Loss
IS.description: Amount of realized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

IS.label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Other Real Estate
IS.description: The net gain (loss) resulting from sales and other disposals of other real estate owned, increases (decreases) in the valuation allowance for foreclosed real estate, and write-downs of other real estate owned after acquisition or physical possession.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Sale of Securities, before Tax
IS.description: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

IS.label: Antidilutive Securities Excluded from Computation of Earnings Per Share, Amount
IS.description: Securities (including those issuable pursuant to contingent stock agreements) that could potentially dilute basic earnings per share (EPS) or earnings per unit (EPU) in the future that were not included in the computation of diluted EPS or EPU because to do so would increase EPS or EPU amounts or decrease loss per share or unit amounts for the period presented.

IS.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, Tax
IS.description: Amount, before adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

IS.label: Interest Income, Securities, Operating, Taxable
IS.description: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities subject to state, federal and other income tax.

IS.label: Interest Income, Securities, Operating, Tax Exempt
IS.description: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities exempt from state, federal and other income tax.

IS.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Realized Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

IS.label: Information Technology and Data Processing
IS.description: The amount of expenses incurred in the period for information technology and data processing products and services.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Loans, Net
IS.description: The net gain (loss) resulting from a sale of loans, including adjustments to record loans classified as held-for-sale at the lower-of-cost-or-market and fair value adjustments to loan held for investment purposes.

IS.label: Depreciation
IS.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Sale of Securities, Tax
IS.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

IS.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss
IS.description: Amount of impairment loss from asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, including oil and gas property and timber property.

IS.label: Lease, Cost
IS.description: Amount of lease cost recognized by lessee for lease contract.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Sale of Securities, Net of Tax
IS.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized gain (loss) realized upon the sale of available-for-sale securities.

IS.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

IS.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestCreditLossExpenseReversal
IS.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

IS.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Cash Paid
IS.description: Aggregate dividends paid during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

IS.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Share-based Payment Arrangements
IS.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of share based payment arrangements using the treasury stock method.

IS.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment and Tax
IS.description: Amount, after tax and adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

IS.label: Weighted Average Number Diluted Shares Outstanding Adjustment
IS.description: The sum of dilutive potential common shares or units used in the calculation of the diluted per-share or per-unit computation.

IS.label: Noninterest Income, Other
IS.description: Represents the total of noninterest income derived from certain activities and assets including (for example): (1) venture capital investments; (2) bank owned life insurance; (3) foreign currency transactions; and (4) mortgage servicing rights.

IS.label: Off-Balance Sheet, Credit Loss, Liability, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
IS.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss for off-balance sheet credit exposure. Excludes off-balance sheet credit exposure accounted for as insurance and instrument accounted for under derivatives and hedging.

IS.label: Equipment Expense
IS.description: This element represents equipment expense including depreciation, repairs, rentals, and service contract costs. This item also includes equipment purchases which do not qualify for capitalization in accordance with the entity's accounting policy. This item may also include furniture expenses.

IS.label: Business Combination, Acquisition Related Costs
IS.description: Amount of expense for acquisition-related cost incurred to effect business combination. Includes, but is not limited to, finder's fee; advisory, legal, accounting, valuation, and other professional and consulting fees; and general administrative cost, including cost of maintaining internal acquisition department.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax
IS.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss).

IS.label: Debt and Equity Securities, Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

IS.label: Other Interest and Dividend Income
IS.description: Amount, after discount, accretion and premium amortization, of interest income and dividend income classified as other.

IS.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Diluted
IS.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

IS.label: Interest Income, Deposits with Financial Institutions
IS.description: Interest income derived from funds deposited with both domestic and foreign financial institutions including funds in money market and other accounts.

IS.label: Marketing and Advertising Expense
IS.description: The total expense recognized in the period for promotion, public relations, and brand or product advertising.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Short-term Borrowings
IS.description: The aggregate interest expense incurred on short-term borrowings including commercial paper and Federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Long-term Debt
IS.description: Aggregate amount of interest paid or due on all long-term debt.

IS.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment, Tax
IS.description: Amount, after adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

IS.label: Operating Lease, Expense
IS.description: Amount of operating lease expense. Excludes sublease income.

IS.label: Foreclosed Real Estate Expense
IS.description: Amount of expense recognized during the period for the foreclosure on real estate assets.

IS.label: Advertising Expense
IS.description: Amount charged to advertising expense for the period, which are expenses incurred with the objective of increasing revenue for a specified brand, product or product line.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Investments
IS.description: The net realized gain (loss) on investments sold during the period, not including gains (losses) on securities separately or otherwise categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity, which, for cash flow reporting, is a component of proceeds from investing activities.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Borrowings
IS.description: Aggregate amount of interest expense on all borrowings.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Subordinated Notes and Debentures
IS.description: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on subordinated notes and debentures. Includes amortization of expenses incurred in the issuance of subordinated notes and debentures.

IS.label: Interest Income, Federal Funds Sold
IS.description: Interest income on federal funds sold. Federal funds sold represent the excess federal funds held by one commercial bank which it lends to another commercial bank, usually at an agreed-upon (federal funds) rate of interest. Such loans generally are of short-duration (overnight).

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Mortgage Loans
IS.description: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of loans made to finance real estate acquisitions. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt
IS.description: Difference between the fair value of payments made and the carrying amount of debt which is extinguished prior to maturity.

IS.label: Dividends, Preferred Stock
IS.description: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

IS.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, after Tax
IS.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan.

IS.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Nonproduction
IS.description: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

IS.label: Fees and Commissions, Mortgage Banking and Servicing
IS.description: Income from mortgage banking activities (fees and commissions) and servicing real estate mortgages, credit cards, and other financial assets held by others net of any related impairment of capitalized service costs. Also includes any premiums received in lieu of regular servicing fees on such loans only as earned over the life of the loans.

IS.label: Life Insurance, Corporate or Bank Owned, Change in Value
IS.description: The change in cash surrender or contract value during the period which adjusted the amount of premiums paid in determining the expense or income recognized under the contract for the period.

IS.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Loans and Leases
IS.description: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of loans and leases that were sold during the reporting period. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sales. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount before tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent entity.

IS.label: Preferred Stock Dividends, Income Statement Impact
IS.description: The amount of preferred stock dividends that is an adjustment to net income apportioned to common stockholders.

IS.label: Interest and Dividend Income, Securities, Operating
IS.description: Amount of operating dividend and interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities.

IS.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment, Excluding Oil and Gas Property and Timber Property
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, excluding oil and gas property and timber property.

IS.label: Communication
IS.description: The amount of expense incurred in the period for communication, which is the exchange of information by several methods.

IS.label: Preferred Stock Dividends and Other Adjustments
IS.description: The aggregate value of preferred stock dividends and other adjustments necessary to derive net income apportioned to common stockholders.

IS.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Assets
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of other assets.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.

IS.label: Provision for Other Credit Losses
IS.description: Amount of expense related to credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets, including but not limited to property plant and equipment, intangible assets and equity in securities of subsidiaries or equity method investee.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank Advances, Long-term
IS.description: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on long-term borrowings associated with Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank advances.

IS.label: Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
IS.description: Amount of current and deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current and deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification, after Tax
IS.description: Amount, after tax and before reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

IS.label: Asset Impairment Charges
IS.description: Amount of impairment loss for asset. Includes, but is not limited to, tangible and intangible assets and goodwill.

IS.label: Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Derivative, Net
IS.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

IS.label: Revenues
IS.description: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Investments
IS.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

IS.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Excluding Assessed Tax
IS.description: Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Time Deposits
IS.description: The aggregate interest expense incurred on time deposits, including certificates of deposits, in domestic offices.

IS.label: Insurance Commissions and Fees
IS.description: Income from agency and brokerage operations (includes sales of annuities and supplemental contracts); service charges, commissions, and fees from the sale of insurance and related services; and management fees from separate accounts, deferred annuities, and universal life products.

IS.label: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs
IS.description: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt issuance costs.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Other
IS.description: Amount of interest expense classified as other.

IS.label: Reclassification from AOCI, Current Period, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to parent.

IS.label: Depreciation, Nonproduction
IS.description: The expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of nonproduction tangible assets over their useful lives.

IS.label: Communications and Information Technology
IS.description: The amount of expense in the period for communications and data processing expense.

IS.label: Dividend Income, Operating
IS.description: Amount of operating dividend income on securities.

IS.label: Marketing Expense
IS.description: Expenditures for planning and executing the conception, pricing, promotion, and distribution of ideas, goods, and services. Costs of public relations and corporate promotions are typically considered to be marketing costs.

IS.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Business
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) from sale and disposal of integrated set of activities and assets capable of being conducted and managed for purpose of providing return in form of dividend, lower cost, or other economic benefit to investor, owner, member and participant.

IS.label: Business Combination, Bargain Purchase, Gain Recognized, Amount
IS.description: In a business combination in which the amount of net identifiable assets acquired and liabilities assumed exceeds the aggregate consideration transferred or to be transferred (as defined), this element represents the amount of gain recognized by the entity.

IS.label: Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR) Impairment (Recovery)
IS.description: The adjustment to the carrying value of the rights retained or purchased to service mortgages. These adjustments are made when the estimate of the fair value is changed. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

IS.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

IS.label: Interest Expense, Junior Subordinated Debentures
IS.description: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on junior subordinated debentures. Includes amortization of expenses incurred in the issuance of subordinated notes and debentures.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
IS.description: Gross expenses on securities sold coupled with an agreement to repurchase the same from the same counterparty at a fixed or determinable price within a fixed or variable time period.

IS.label: Finance Lease, Interest Expense
IS.description: Amount of interest expense on finance lease liability.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities, Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Other Long-term Debt
IS.description: Amount of interest expense incurred on long-term debt classified as other, including, but not limited to, interest on long-term notes and amortization of issuance costs.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Time Deposits, $100,000 or More
IS.description: Interest expense incurred on time deposits, including certificates of deposits, of $100,000 or more in domestic offices.

IS.label: Legal Fees
IS.description: The amount of expense provided in the period for legal costs incurred on or before the balance sheet date pertaining to resolved, pending or threatened litigation, including arbitration and mediation proceedings.

IS.label: Supplies Expense
IS.description: Amount of expense associated with supplies that were used during the current accounting period.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Domestic
IS.description: The portion of earnings or loss from continuing operations before income taxes that is attributable to domestic operations.

IS.label: Interest Income, Operating
IS.description: Amount of operating interest income, including, but not limited to, amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts on securities.

IS.label: Debt and Equity Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments
IS.description: Amount of income (loss) for proportionate share of equity method investee's income (loss).

IS.label: Other Income
IS.description: Amount of revenue and income classified as other.

IS.label: Brokerage Commissions Revenue
IS.description: Amount of commission revenue from buying and selling securities on behalf of customers.

IS.label: Debt Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

IS.label: Interest Expense, Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank Advances, Short-term
IS.description: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on short-term borrowings associated with Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank advances.

IS.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
IS.description: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
IS.description: The aggregate expense incurred on federal funds purchased and securities sold under agreements to repurchase. If amounts recognized as payables under repurchase agreements have been offset against amounts recognized as receivables under reverse repurchase agreements and reported as a net amount on the balance sheet, the income and expense from these agreements may be reported on a net basis.

IS.label: Other Real Estate, Valuation Adjustments
IS.description: Valuation adjustments made to other real estate not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. This excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Savings Deposits
IS.description: Interest expense incurred on all savings account deposits.

IS.label: Operating Lease, Lease Income
IS.description: Amount of operating lease income from lease payments and variable lease payments paid and payable to lessor. Includes, but is not limited to, variable lease payments not included in measurement of lease receivable.

IS.label: Other Expenses
IS.description: Amount of expense classified as other.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Federal Funds Purchased
IS.description: Gross expenses on the purchase of Federal funds at a specified price with a simultaneous agreement to sell the same to the same counterparty at a fixed or determinable price at a future date.

IS.label: Amortization of Debt Discount (Premium)
IS.description: Amount of noncash expense included in interest expense to amortize debt discount and premium associated with the related debt instruments. Excludes amortization of financing costs. Alternate captions include noncash interest expense.

IS.label: Business Combination, Integration Related Costs
IS.description: Amount of expense for integration-related cost incurred in connection with business combination. Includes system integration and conversion costs; severance and other employee-related costs; restructuring and other post-combination costs. Excludes acquisition-related cost incurred to effect business combination; cost to issue debt or equity securities; and cost related to acquisition of asset.

IS.label: Revenue from Contract with Customer, Including Assessed Tax
IS.description: Amount, including tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value-added and excise.

IS.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
IS.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

IS.label: Dividends, Cash
IS.description: Amount of paid and unpaid cash dividends declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

IS.label: Noninterest Expense Directors Fees
IS.description: Amount of expense for service provided by entity's director.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount, before tax and after reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.

IS.label: Other Depreciation and Amortization
IS.description: Amount of expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their remaining economic lives, classified as other.

IS.label: Taxes, Other
IS.description: Amount of tax expense classified as other.

IS.label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) Allocated to Participating Securities, Basic
IS.description: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the basic earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

IS.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans and Leases Held-in-portfolio
IS.description: Interest and fee income generated by loans the Entity intends and has the ability to hold for the foreseeable future, or until maturity or payoff, including commercial and consumer loans, whether domestic or foreign, which may consist of: (1) industrial and agricultural; (2) real estate; and (3) real estate construction loans; (4) trade financing; (5) lease financing; (6) home equity lines-of-credit; (7) automobile and other vehicle loans; and (8) credit card and other revolving-type loans. Also includes interest income for leases held by the Entity.

IS.label: Loan Processing Fee
IS.description: Expenses paid for obtaining loans which includes expenses such as application and origination fees.

IS.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit), Gain (Loss) Due to Settlement
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit from irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk related to obligation and assets used to effect settlement.

IS.label: Litigation Settlement, Expense
IS.description: Amount of litigation expense, including but not limited to legal, forensic, accounting, and investigative fees.

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, before Tax
IS.description: Amount, before tax and after reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

IS.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Issued, Basic
IS.description: This element represents the weighted average total number of shares issued throughout the period including the first (beginning balance outstanding) and last (ending balance outstanding) day of the period before considering any reductions (for instance, shares held in treasury) to arrive at the weighted average number of shares outstanding. Weighted average relates to the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares have been issued and outstanding to the total time in that period. Such concept is used in determining the weighted average number of shares outstanding for purposes of calculating earnings per share (basic).

IS.label: Interest Expense, Other Short-term Borrowings
IS.description: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on other short-term borrowings.

IS.label: Interest Income, Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
IS.description: The aggregate interest income earned from (1) the lending of excess federal funds to another commercial bank requiring such for its legal reserve requirements and (2) securities purchased under agreements to resell.

IS.label: Investment Banking, Advisory, Brokerage, and Underwriting Fees and Commissions
IS.description: Amount of fees and commissions from banking, advisory, brokerage, and securities underwriting activities. Activities include, but are not limited to, underwriting securities, private placements of securities, investment advisory and management services, merger and acquisition services, sale and servicing of mutual funds, and other related consulting fees.

IS.label: Impairment of Long-Lived Assets to be Disposed of
IS.description: The aggregate amount of write-downs for impairments recognized during the period for long-lived assets held for abandonment, exchange or sale.

IS.label: Realized Investment Gains (Losses)
IS.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment.

IS.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Unrealized Gain
IS.description: Amount of unrealized gain on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

IS.label: Gain on Sale of Investments
IS.description: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of an investment. A gain would be recognized when the sale price of the investment is greater than the carrying value of the investment. This element refers to the Gain included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale.

IS.label: Supplies and Postage Expense
IS.description: The aggregate amount of expenses directly related to the supplies and postage.

IS.label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Gain (Loss), Net
IS.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) of derivative instruments not designated or qualifying as hedging instruments.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets for Financial Service Operations
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets utilized in financial service operations.

IS.label: General Insurance Expense
IS.description: The expense in the period incurred with respect to protection provided by insurance entities against risks other than risks associated with production (which are allocated to cost of sales).

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the parent.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Basic Share
IS.description: The amount of net income (loss) from continuing operations per each share of common stock or unit outstanding during the reporting period.

IS.label: Employee Benefits and Share-based Compensation
IS.description: Amount of expense for employee benefit and equity-based compensation.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Diluted Share
IS.description: The amount of net income (loss) derived from continuing operations during the period available to each share of common stock or common unit outstanding during the reporting period and to each share or unit that would have been outstanding assuming the issuance of common shares or units for all dilutive potential common shares or units outstanding during the reporting period.

IS.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans and Leases Held-for-sale
IS.description: The amount of interest and fee income earned from loans held-for-sale, including mortgage loans, and interest earned from direct financing and sales-type leases held-for-sale.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Debt
IS.description: Amount of the cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest expense for debt.

IS.label: Restructuring Charges
IS.description: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

IS.label: Debt Securities, Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

IS.label: Gain (Loss) Related to Litigation Settlement
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in settlement of litigation and insurance claims. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

IS.label: Postage Expense
IS.description: Amount of expense associated with postage.

IS.label: Fair Value, Option, Changes in Fair Value, Gain (Loss)
IS.description: For each line item in the statement of financial position, the amounts of gains and losses from fair value changes included in earnings.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Financing Receivable
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) from sale of financing receivable, including, but not limited to, lease receivable.

IS.label: Interest Income, Other
IS.description: Amount of interest income earned from interest bearing assets classified as other.

IS.label: Loss on Sale of Investments
IS.description: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of an investment. A loss would be recognized when the sale price of the investment is less than the carrying value of the investment. This element refers to the Loss included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale.

IS.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
