IS.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

IS.label: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal
IS.description: Amount before tax of gain (loss) recognized on the sale or disposal of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

IS.label: Impairment of Intangible Assets (Excluding Goodwill)
IS.description: Amount of impairment loss for finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
IS.description: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

IS.label: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity
IS.description: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on held-to-maturity securities.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Money Market Deposits
IS.description: Interest expense incurred on all money market deposits.

IS.label: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits Cost (Reversal of Cost)
IS.description: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for pension and other postretirement benefits.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share
IS.description: Per basic share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation and gain (loss) from the disposal of the discontinued operation.

IS.label: Interest Expense, NOW Accounts, Money Market Accounts, and Savings Deposits
IS.description: The aggregate interest expense incurred on the following for deposits in domestic offices: (1) transaction accounts (NOW, and telephone and preauthorized transfer accounts), (2) money market deposits and (3) savings deposits.

IS.label: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Operating
IS.description: Amount of interest income, amortization of premium and accretion of discount on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale); classified as operating.

IS.label: Other Cost and Expense, Operating
IS.description: The total amount of other operating cost and expense items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

IS.label: Trading Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) resulting from the difference between the acquisition price and the selling price or fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities, conducted separately from customer trading activities. Includes, but is not limited to, changes in fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities.

IS.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestCreditLossExpenseReversal
IS.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

IS.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Discontinued Operation
IS.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) related to a discontinued operation. Includes, but is not limited to, tax expense (benefit) related to income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, tax expense (benefit) related to gain (loss) on disposal, tax expense (benefit) related to gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and tax expense (benefit) related to adjustments of a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments, Net, Pretax
IS.description: Aggregate net gain (loss) on all derivative instruments recognized in earnings during the period, before tax effects.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

IS.label: Investment Banking Revenue
IS.description: Includes (1) underwriting revenue (the spread between the resale price received and the cost of the securities and related expenses) generated through the purchasing, distributing and reselling of new issues of securities (alternatively, could be a secondary offering of a large block of previously issued securities); and (2) fees earned for mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, restructurings, and other types of financial advisory services.

IS.label: Current Federal, State and Local, Tax Expense (Benefit)
IS.description: Amount of current federal, state, and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current national, regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

IS.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, before Income Tax
IS.description: Amount before tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

IS.label: FDIC Indemnification Asset, Period Increase (Decrease)
IS.description: Change in carrying amount of the indemnification asset relating to loss sharing agreements with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC). The change includes for example, but is not limited to, acquisitions, additional estimated losses, disposals, cash payments, accretion of discount and write-offs, net of recoveries.

IS.label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Investment Real Estate
IS.description: The net gain (loss) resulting from sales and other disposals of real estate owned for investment purposes.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Demand Deposit Accounts
IS.description: Interest expense incurred on demand deposit accounts that represent borrowings rather than outstanding drafts.

IS.label: Sale and Leaseback Transaction, Gain (Loss), Net
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale and leaseback transaction from transfer of asset accounted for as sale.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Other Investments
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) included in earnings for investments classified as other.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
IS.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

IS.label: Lease Income
IS.description: Amount of lease income from operating, direct financing, and sales-type leases. Includes, but is not limited to, variable lease payments, interest income, profit (loss) recognized at commencement, and lease payments paid and payable to lessor.

IS.label: Reclassification from AOCI, Current Period, Tax
IS.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss).

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
IS.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation attributable to the parent. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

IS.label: Interest and Dividend Income, Securities, Operating, Other
IS.description: Amount of other operating dividend and interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Time Deposits, Less than $100,000
IS.description: Interest expense incurred on time deposits, including certificates of deposits, less than $100,000 in domestic offices.

IS.label: Loss Contingency, Loss in Period
IS.description: Amount of loss (reversal of loss) recognized for loss contingency liability. Includes, but is not limited to, effect of revision in previously reported estimate.

IS.label: Salary and Wage, Excluding Cost of Good and Service Sold
IS.description: Amount of expense for salary and wage arising from service rendered by nonofficer and officer employees. Excludes allocated cost, labor-related nonsalary expense, and direct and overhead labor cost included in cost of good and service sold.

IS.label: Operating Lease, Lease Income, Lease Payments
IS.description: Amount of operating lease income from lease payments paid and payable to lessor. Excludes variable lease payments not included in measurement of lease receivable.

IS.label: Contractually Specified Servicing Fee, Late Fee, and Ancillary Fee Earned in Exchange for Servicing Financial Asset
IS.description: Amount of contractually specified servicing fee, late fee, and ancillary fee recognized as income for servicing asset and servicing liability.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Derivatives
IS.description: The difference between the book value and the sale price of options, swaps, futures, forward contracts, and other derivative instruments. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings.

IS.label: Travel and Entertainment Expense
IS.description: Expenses incurred for travel and entertainment during the period.

IS.label: Loan Portfolio Expense
IS.description: The loan servicing fees paid to third parties that relate to loan expenses for a portfolio containing the entire group of loans owned by the company.

IS.label: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Depreciation Expense on Property Subject to or Held-for-lease
IS.description: Amount of depreciation expense for lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

IS.label: Other Labor-related Expenses
IS.description: Amount of labor-related expenses classified as other.

IS.label: Profit (Loss) from Real Estate Operations
IS.description: The net cost of operation of other real estate (including provisions for real estate losses, rental income, and gains and losses on sales of real estate).

IS.label: Taxes, Miscellaneous
IS.description: All taxes not related to income of the entity or excise or sales taxes levied on the revenue of the entity that are not reported elsewhere. These taxes could include production, real estate, personal property, and pump tax.

IS.label: Undistributed Earnings, Basic
IS.description: The earnings that is allocated to common stock and participating securities to the extent that each security may share in earnings as if all of the earnings for the period had been distributed.

IS.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
IS.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), excluding other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

IS.label: Equity Method Investment, Realized Gain (Loss) on Disposal
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of an equity method investment.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Assets and Asset Impairment Charges
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the sale price or salvage price and the book value of an asset that was sold or retired, and gain (loss) from the write down of assets from their carrying value to fair value.

IS.label: Interest Income, Securities, Mortgage Backed
IS.description: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securitized, pass-through debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans.

IS.label: Operating Expenses
IS.description: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Includes selling, general and administrative expense.

IS.label: Preferred Stock Redemption Premium
IS.description: The excess of (1) fair value of the consideration transferred to the holders of the preferred stock over (2) the carrying amount of the preferred stock in the registrant's balance sheet, during the accounting period.

IS.label: Equity Method Investment, Other than Temporary Impairment
IS.description: Amount of other-than-temporary decline in value that has been recognized against investment accounted for under equity method of accounting.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW) Deposits
IS.description: Interest expense incurred on the amount of Negotiable Order of Withdrawal (NOW). Interest-bearing transaction account that combines the payable on demand feature of checks and investment feature of savings accounts. A NOW account is functionally an interest paying checking account.

IS.label: Interest Income, Securities, State and Municipal
IS.description: Interest income, including any amortization and accretion (as applicable) of discounts and premiums, derived from debt securities issued by municipal governments, local taxing districts and US state government agencies.

IS.label: Other Operating Income
IS.description: The total amount of other operating income, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operation.

IS.label: Other Revenue (Expense) from Real Estate Operations
IS.description: Amount of other revenue (expense) derived from real estate investments partnerships.

IS.label: Professional and Contract Services Expense
IS.description: Amount of expense for professional and contracted services.

IS.label: Severance Costs
IS.description: Amount of expenses for special or contractual termination benefits provided to current employees involuntarily terminated under a benefit arrangement associated exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to one-time termination benefits, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Other Loans and Leases
IS.description: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of other loans and leases that were sold during the reporting period; excludes gains (losses) on sales of consumer and mortgage loans. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sales. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Consumer Loans
IS.description: The gains (losses) included in earning that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of consumer loans. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Trust Preferred Securities
IS.description: The amount of interest incurred to a trust which has issued trust-preferred securities. In order to issue trust preferred securities, a sponsor forms a trust by investing a nominal amount of cash to purchase all of the voting common stock of the trust. The trust issues nonvoting, mandatorily redeemable preferred securities to outside investors in exchange for cash. The proceeds received from the issuance of the preferred securities, together with the cash received for issuing the common stock to the sponsor, is then loaned to the sponsor in exchange for a note which has the same terms as the trust preferred securities. Trust preferred securities possesses characteristics of both equity and debt issues and are generally issued by bank holding companies.

IS.label: Investment Income, Interest
IS.description: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income on nonoperating securities.

IS.label: Marketable Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security.

IS.label: Accounts Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
IS.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on accounts receivable.

IS.label: Salary and Wage, NonOfficer, Excluding Cost of Good and Service Sold
IS.description: Amount of expense for salary and wage arising from service rendered by nonofficer employee. Excludes allocated cost, labor-related nonsalary expense, and direct and overhead labor cost included in cost of good and service sold.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments, Net of Dividends or Distributions
IS.description: This element represents the undistributed income (or loss) of equity method investments, net of dividends or other distributions received from unconsolidated subsidiaries, certain corporate joint ventures, and certain noncontrolled corporations; such investments are accounted for under the equity method of accounting. This element excludes distributions that constitute a return of investment, which are classified as investing activities.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Domestic Deposits
IS.description: The aggregate interest expense incurred on all domestic deposits.

IS.label: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Operating
IS.description: Amount of interest income, amortization of premium and accretion of discount, on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading); classified as operating.

IS.label: Interest Income, Debt Securities, Trading, Operating
IS.description: Amount of interest income, amortization of premium and accretion of discount, on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading); classified as operating.

IS.label: Marketable Securities, Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss
IS.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security.

IS.label: Assets, Fair Value Adjustment
IS.description: Amount of addition (reduction) to the amount at which an asset could be incurred (settled) in a current transaction between willing parties.

IS.label: Interest Income, Domestic Deposits
IS.description: Interest earned on deposits in United States money market accounts and other United States interest earning accounts.

IS.label: Interest Income, Securities, US Treasury and Other US Government
IS.description: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on U.S. Treasury securities and other U.S. government securities.

IS.label: Investment Income, Dividend
IS.description: Amount of dividend income on nonoperating securities.

IS.label: Debt Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

IS.label: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain (Loss), before Tax
IS.description: Amount, before tax, of realized and unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

IS.label: General and Administrative Expense
IS.description: The aggregate total of expenses of managing and administering the affairs of an entity, including affiliates of the reporting entity, which are not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

IS.label: Income (Loss) from Affordable Housing Projects, Equity Method Investments
IS.description: Amount of income tax credit and other income tax benefit generated by equity method investment under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Short-term Borrowings Excluding Federal Funds and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
IS.description: The aggregate interest expense incurred on short-term borrowings including commercial paper, Federal Home Loan Bank and Federal Reserve Bank advances and other short term borrowings.

IS.label: Interest Revenue (Expense), Net
IS.description: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as operating and nonoperating.

IS.label: Other Postretirement Benefits Cost (Reversal of Cost)
IS.description: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for other postretirement benefits. Excludes pension benefits.

IS.label: Other Preferred Stock Dividends and Adjustments
IS.description: Amount of preferred stock dividends and adjustments classified as other.

IS.label: Business Development
IS.description: Business development involves the development of products and services, their delivery, design and their implementation. Business development includes a number of techniques designed to grow an economic enterprise. Such techniques include, but are not limited to, assessments of marketing opportunities and target markets, intelligence gathering on customers and competitors, generating leads for possible sales, follow-up sales activity, formal proposal writing and business model design. Business development involves evaluating a business and then realizing its full potential, using such tools as marketing, sales, information management and customer service.

IS.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossNotPreviouslyRecorded
IS.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) with no credit loss previously recorded.

IS.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

IS.label: Operating Income (Loss)
IS.description: The net result for the period of deducting operating expenses from operating revenues.

IS.label: Other Nonoperating Income
IS.description: Amount of income related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

IS.label: Capitalized Computer Software, Amortization
IS.description: Amount of amortization expense for capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Stock in Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of equity in securities of subsidiaries or equity method investee.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Other Domestic Deposits
IS.description: Interest expense incurred on other deposits in domestic offices.

IS.label: Interest Income, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
IS.description: Interest income derived from securities purchased under agreements to resell. The difference in the price at which the institution buys the securities and resells the securities represents interest for the use of the funds by the other party. Most repurchase and sale agreements involve obligations of the federal government or its agencies, but other financial instruments, such as commercial paper, banker's acceptances and negotiable certificates of deposits are sometimes used in such transactions.

IS.label: Revenue Not from Contract with Customer, Excluding Interest Income
IS.description: Amount, excluding interest income, of revenue not accounted for under Topic 606.

IS.label: Expense Related to Distribution or Servicing and Underwriting Fees
IS.description: Expense related to distribution, servicing and underwriting fees.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Financial Assets
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) on disposal of other assets utilized in financial service operations.

IS.label: Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent, before Tax
IS.description: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) attributable to parent. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.

IS.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans Held-for-sale, Mortgages
IS.description: Interest and fee income from mortgage loans considered to be held-for-sale.

IS.label: Investment Income, Interest and Dividend
IS.description: Amount before accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) of interest income and dividend income on nonoperating securities.

IS.label: Other General and Administrative Expense
IS.description: Amount of general and administrative expense classified as other.

IS.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossPeriodIncreaseDecrease
IS.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

IS.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit), Gain (Loss) Due to Settlement and Curtailment
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit from settlement and curtailment.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Hedging Activity
IS.description: Gain (loss) incurred in hedging activities.

IS.label: Interest and Other Income
IS.description: The amount of interest income and other income recognized during the period. Included in this element is interest derived from investments in debt securities, cash and cash equivalents, and other investments which reflect the time value of money or transactions in which the payments are for the use or forbearance of money and other income from ancillary business-related activities (that is, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

IS.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Brokered
IS.description: Amount of interest expense on domestic brokered deposit liabilities.

IS.label: Principal Investment Gain (Loss)
IS.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss), from the firm's direct investment activity, conducted separately from customer trading activities, and includes, but is not limited to, investments in private equity, alternative investment products, real estate, and exchanges and memberships.

IS.label: Revenues, Net of Interest Expense
IS.description: Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income after deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss).

IS.label: Fair Value, Option, Credit Risk, Gains (Losses) on Assets
IS.description: This item represents the estimated amount of gains or losses included in earnings during the period attributable to changes in instrument-specific credit risk arising from loans and other receivables held as assets.

IS.label: Insurance Services Revenue
IS.description: Revenue from insurance services, including net premiums earned, gain on sale of insurance block, agency management fees and insurance contract fees and commissions.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Trading Liabilities
IS.description: Interest expense incurred on short positions arising from sales of securities and other assets, which the entity does not own, to other parties. Trading liabilities includes the fair value of derivative contracts held for trading that are in loss positions.

IS.label: Interest Income, Securities, US Treasury
IS.description: Interest income on US treasury securities. US treasury securities are negotiable debt obligations of the US government, secured by its full faith and credit and issued at various schedules and maturities. The income from treasury securities is exempt from state and local, but not federal, taxes. There are three types of securities issued by the US treasury (bonds, bills, and notes), which are distinguished by the amount of time from the initial sale of the bond to maturity.

IS.label: Other Nonoperating Expense
IS.description: Amount of expense related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

IS.label: Other Operating Income (Expense), Net
IS.description: The net amount of other operating income and expenses, the components of which are not separately disclosed on the income statement, from items that are associated with the entity's normal revenue producing operations.

IS.label: Repurchase Agreements, Interest Expense Amount
IS.description: This is the amount of interest expense incurred during the reporting period as a result of repurchase agreements.

IS.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities
IS.description: Aggregate amount of all interest expense on domestic deposit liabilities.

IS.label: Interest Income, Securities, Corporate Debt, Operating
IS.description: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on corporate debt securities.

IS.label: Net Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
IS.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) from continuing operations available to common shareholders.

IS.label: Noncash Contribution Expense
IS.description: Noncash charitable contributions made by the entity during the period.

IS.label: Dividend Income, Equity Securities, Operating
IS.description: Amount of dividend income on investment in equity security, classified as operating.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Leased Assets, Net, Operating Leases
IS.description: The net gain (loss) arising from the lessor's sale of assets held- or available-for-lease under contractual arrangements classified as operating leases.

IS.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Commercial
IS.description: Interest and fee income related to commercial loans including industrial and agricultural, real estate (commercial and residential, construction and development), trade financing, and lease financing.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Customer Deposits
IS.description: The interest expense recognized during the period on customer deposits or security deposits held in interest bearing accounts.

IS.label: Net Periodic Defined Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Excluding Service Cost Component
IS.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for net periodic benefit cost components, excluding service cost component, of defined benefit plan. Amount includes, but is not limited to, interest cost, expected (return) loss on plan asset, amortization of prior service cost (credit), amortization of (gain) loss, amortization of transition (asset) obligation, settlement (gain) loss, curtailment (gain) loss and certain termination benefits.

IS.label: Other Nonoperating Income (Expense)
IS.description: Amount of income (expense) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

IS.label: Other Nonrecurring Expense
IS.description: Amount of other expense that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

IS.label: Insurance Investment Income
IS.description: Investment income associated with the company's insurance services.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Loans from Other Federal Home Loan Banks
IS.description: Amount of interest expense on loans received from another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB).

IS.label: Interest Income, Money Market Deposits
IS.description: Interest earned on funds deposited in US domestic money market accounts.

IS.label: Investment Income, Net
IS.description: Amount after accretion (amortization) of discount (premium), and investment expense, of interest income and dividend income on nonoperating securities.

IS.label: Nonoperating Income (Expense)
IS.description: The aggregate amount of income or expense from ancillary business-related activities (that is to say, excluding major activities considered part of the normal operations of the business).

IS.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Investment Transferred from Available-for-sale to Equity Method, before Tax
IS.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for unrealized gain (loss) of investment classified as available-for-sale transferred to equity method.

IS.label: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Net
IS.description: Amount, after effects of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to the provision for policy benefits and costs incurred.

IS.label: Amortization of Acquisition Costs
IS.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of capitalized costs associated with acquisition of business. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

IS.label: Direct Costs of Leased and Rented Property or Equipment
IS.description: Amount of expense incurred and directly related to generating revenue by lessor from operating lease of rented property and equipment.

IS.label: FinancingReceivableTransferToHeldForSaleValuationAllowanceExpense
IS.description: Amount of expense for valuation allowance on financing receivable transferred to held-for-sale classification.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Long-term Debt and Capital Securities
IS.description: Total interest expense on long-term debt and capital securities.

IS.label: Interest Expense, Medium-term Notes
IS.description: Amount of interest expense incurred on medium-term note.

IS.label: Interest Income and Fees, Bankers Acceptances, Certificates of Deposit and Commercial Paper
IS.description: Interest and fee income derived from banker's acceptances, certificates of deposit and commercial paper.

IS.label: Payments of Loan Costs
IS.description: The cash outflow for loan origination associated cost which is usually collected through escrow.

IS.label: Compensation Expense, Excluding Cost of Good and Service Sold
IS.description: Amount of expense for salary, wage, profit sharing; incentive and equity-based compensation; and other employee benefit. Other employee benefit expense includes, but is not limited to, service component of net periodic benefit cost for defined benefit plan. Excludes compensation cost in cost of good and service sold.

IS.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period, Net of Tax
IS.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes gain (loss) on disposal and provision for gain (loss) until disposal.

IS.label: Excise and Sales Taxes
IS.description: The amount of excise and sales taxes included in sales and revenues, which are then deducted as a cost of sales. Includes excise taxes, which are applied to specific types of transactions or items (such as gasoline or alcohol); and sales, use and value added taxes, which are applied to a broad class of revenue-producing transactions involving a wide range of goods and services.

IS.label: Interest Income, Federal Home Loan Bank Advances
IS.description: Amount of interest income from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances to member financial institutions.

IS.label: Investment Income, Nonoperating
IS.description: The aggregate amount of income from investments (for example, dividends) not considered a component of the entity's core operations.

IS.label: Noninterest Expense Printing and Fulfillment
IS.description: Amounts expended for printing of marketing and compliance communications and fulfillment services.

IS.label: Noninterest Expense Transfer Agent and Custodian Fees
IS.description: Amount of expense for transfer agent and custodian services. Includes, but is not limited to, fee paid for maintaining investor record, account balance, and company's stock transaction and fee paid for holding and safeguarding assets of individual, mutual fund, and investment company.

IS.label: Other Expense from Real Estate Partnership Operations
IS.description: Amount of selling, general, and administrative expenses, and other expenses, related to investments in real estate partnerships.

IS.label: Other Nonoperating Gains (Losses)
IS.description: Amount of gain (loss) related to nonoperating activities, classified as other.

IS.label: Principal Transactions Revenue, Net
IS.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) resulting from the difference between acquisition price and selling price or fair value of trading assets and trading liabilities, and from the firm's direct investment activity, conducted separately from customer trading activities, including, but not limited to, investments in private equity, alternative investment products, real estate, and exchanges and memberships.

IS.label: Selling, General and Administrative Expense
IS.description: The aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services, as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example, credit, warranty, and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products, for example telephone expenses, Internet, and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel, rent, utilities, communication, etc.

IS.label: Dividend Income, Securities, Operating, Taxable
IS.description: Amount of operating dividend income on securities subject to state, federal and other income tax.

IS.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic, Undistributed
IS.description: The earnings attributable to each security on the basis that all of the earnings for the period had been distributed (to the extent that each security may share in earnings). This is the earnings amount which reflects the participation rights in undistributed earnings of each security.

IS.label: Floor Brokerage, Exchange and Clearance Fees
IS.description: The amount of expense during the period for floor brokerage fees paid to other broker-dealers to execute trades on their behalf, stock exchange fees, order flow fees, and clearance fees.

IS.label: Interest and Debt Expense
IS.description: Interest and debt related expenses associated with nonoperating financing activities of the entity.

IS.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer Installment, Credit Card
IS.description: Interest and fee income from credit card balances due from individuals. Such loans are considered revolving credit arrangements.

IS.label: Interest and Fee Income, Other Loans Held-for-sale
IS.description: Amount of interest and fee income from loans held-for-sale and classified as other.

IS.label: Interest Income, Deposits with Other Federal Home Loan Banks
IS.description: Amount of interest income from interest-bearing funds deposited into another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

IS.label: Management Fee Expense
IS.description: Amount of expense for investment management fee, including, but not limited to, expense in connection with research, selection, supervision, and custody of investment.

IS.label: Redeemable Preferred Stock Dividends
IS.description: Dividends paid to preferred stock holders that is redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

IS.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted, Undistributed
IS.description: The earnings attributable to each security on the basis that all of the earnings for the period had been distributed (to the extent that each security may share in earnings). This is the earnings amount which reflects the participation rights in undistributed earnings of each security, after giving effect to all dilutive potential common shares outstanding during the period.

IS.label: Extinguishment of Debt, Gain (Loss), Net of Tax
IS.description: The difference between the reacquisition price and the net carrying amount of the extinguished debt recognized currently as a component of income in the period of extinguishment, net of tax.

IS.label: Gain (Loss) from Price Risk Management Activity
IS.description: Gain (loss) incurred in risk management activities.

IS.label: Insurance Agency Management Fee
IS.description: Fees earned during the period for providing management services.

IS.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer, Real Estate
IS.description: Interest and fee income generated from loans secured by one- to four-family residential properties. This item excludes home equity lines-of-credit.

IS.label: Noninterest Expense Investment Advisory Fees
IS.description: Amount of expense for investment advisory service, including, but not limited to, managing money in fund.

IS.label: Salary and Wage, Officer, Excluding Cost of Good and Service Sold
IS.description: Amount of expense for salary and wage arising from service rendered by officer. Excludes allocated cost, labor-related nonsalary expense, and direct and overhead labor cost included in cost of good and service sold.

IS.label: Insurance Tax
IS.description: Represents total insurance tax expense reflected in the income statement for each period presented.

IS.label: InterestExpenseNonoperating
IS.description: Amount of interest expense classified as nonoperating.

IS.label: Interest Income, Purchased Receivables
IS.description: Interest earned from receivables purchased; for instance, receivables purchased through a factoring arrangement.

IS.label: InterestIncomeTaxableInvestmentSecuritiesIncreaseDecrease
IS.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in interest income on taxable investment security.

IS.label: Market Data Revenue
IS.description: Amount of revenue from market data services, including, but not limited to, information about current quotes and most recent prices for a specific security.

IS.label: Research and Development Expense, Software (Excluding Acquired in Process Cost)
IS.description: Research and development expense during the period related to the costs of developing and achieving technological feasibility of a computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed.

IS.label: Utilities Operating Expense, Other
IS.description: Amount of other operating expense of regulated operation.

CF.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

CF.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

CF.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

CF.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent
CF.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent.

CF.label: Deferred Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
CF.description: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations.

CF.label: Interest Paid, Excluding Capitalized Interest, Operating Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, excluding capitalized interest, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, payment to settle zero-coupon bond for accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount.

CF.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

CF.label: Cash and Due from Banks
CF.description: For banks and other depository institutions: Includes cash on hand (currency and coin), cash items in process of collection, noninterest bearing deposits due from other financial institutions (including corporate credit unions), and noninterest bearing balances with the Federal Reserve Banks, Federal Home Loan Banks and central banks.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

CF.label: Income Taxes Paid, Net
CF.description: Amount, after refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

CF.label: Payments for Repurchase of Common Stock
CF.description: The cash outflow to reacquire common stock during the period.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

CF.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
CF.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Deferred Federal Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
CF.description: Amount of deferred federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

CF.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents
CF.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Interest-bearing Deposits in Banks and Other Financial Institutions
CF.description: For banks and other depository institutions (including Federal Reserve Banks, if applicable): Interest-bearing deposits in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits, which are presented separately from cash on the balance sheet.

CF.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
CF.description: Amount of writeoff of financing receivable, charged against allowance for credit loss.

CF.label: Amortization of Intangible Assets
CF.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

CF.label: Provision for Loan, Lease, and Other Losses
CF.description: Amount of expense related loan transactions, lease transactions, credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions, and other loss based on assessment of uncollectability from the counterparty to reduce the account to their net realizable value.

CF.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash Expense
CF.description: Amount of noncash expense for share-based payment arrangement.

CF.label: Current Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
CF.description: Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to taxable income (loss) from continuing operations.

CF.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Including Exchange Rate Effect
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including effect from exchange rate change and including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans and Leases
CF.description: The net cash outflow or inflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period of loan and lease balances which are not originated or purchased specifically for resale. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period deposits balances.

CF.label: Financing Receivable, Credit Loss, Expense (Reversal)
CF.description: Amount of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) for financing receivable.

CF.label: Common Stock, Dividends, Per Share, Declared
CF.description: Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each share of common stock outstanding.

CF.label: Net Income (Loss) Available to Common Stockholders, Basic
CF.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) available to common shareholders.

CF.label: Bank Owned Life Insurance Income
CF.description: Earnings on or other increases in the value of the cash surrender value of bank owned life insurance policies.

CF.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Realized Gain
CF.description: Amount of realized gain on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

CF.label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
CF.description: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

CF.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment and Tax
CF.description: Amount, before tax and adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets classified as other.

CF.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
CF.description: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

CF.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Held-to-maturity Securities
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the maturity, prepayments and calls (requests for early payments) of debt securities designated as held-to-maturity.

CF.label: IncomeTaxPaidFederalAfterRefundReceived
CF.description: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to federal (national) tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

CF.label: Interest Paid, Including Capitalized Interest, Operating and Investing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash paid for interest, including, but not limited to, capitalized interest and payment to settle zero-coupon bond attributable to accreted interest of debt discount and debt instrument with insignificant coupon interest rate in relation to effective interest rate of borrowing attributable to accreted interest of debt discount; classified as operating and investing activities.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock
CF.description: The cash inflow from the additional capital contribution to the entity.

CF.label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Other Real Estate
CF.description: The net gain (loss) resulting from sales and other disposals of other real estate owned, increases (decreases) in the valuation allowance for foreclosed real estate, and write-downs of other real estate owned after acquisition or physical possession.

CF.label: Operating Lease, Cost
CF.description: Amount of single lease cost, calculated by allocation of remaining cost of lease over remaining lease term. Includes, but is not limited to, single lease cost, after impairment of right-of-use asset, calculated by amortization of remaining right-of-use asset and accretion of lease liability.

CF.label: Operating Lease, Payments
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow from operating lease, excluding payments to bring another asset to condition and location necessary for its intended use.

CF.label: Income Taxes Paid
CF.description: Amount, before refund, of cash paid to foreign, federal, state, and local jurisdictions as income tax.

CF.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, Tax
CF.description: Amount, before adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized holding gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale). Excludes tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

CF.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Common Stock
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders of the parent entity.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Held-to-maturity Securities
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow through purchase of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Property, Plant, and Equipment
CF.description: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

CF.label: Real Estate Owned, Transfer to Real Estate Owned
CF.description: Value transferred from mortgage loans to real estate owned (REO) in noncash transactions.

CF.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Operating Lease Liability
CF.description: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for operating lease liability.

CF.label: Accretion (Amortization) of Discounts and Premiums, Investments
CF.description: The sum of the periodic adjustments of the differences between securities' face values and purchase prices that are charged against earnings. This is called accretion if the security was purchased at a discount and amortization if it was purchased at premium. As a noncash item, this element is an adjustment to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

CF.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Realized Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

CF.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expense
CF.description: Amount of expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes amount capitalized.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Loans, Net
CF.description: The net gain (loss) resulting from a sale of loans, including adjustments to record loans classified as held-for-sale at the lower-of-cost-or-market and fair value adjustments to loan held for investment purposes.

CF.label: Depreciation
CF.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of the cost of tangible assets over the assets' useful lives. Includes production and non-production related depreciation.

CF.label: Goodwill, Impairment Loss
CF.description: Amount of impairment loss from asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

CF.label: Proceeds from Life Insurance Policy
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, including oil and gas property and timber property.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Net of Cash Acquired
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

CF.label: Proceeds from Stock Options Exercised
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

CF.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossWriteoff
CF.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of decrease in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from writeoff. Excludes net investment in lease.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Held-for-sale
CF.description: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of loans classified as held-for-sale, including proceeds from loans sold through mortgage securitization.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Liabilities
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating liabilities classified as other.

CF.label: Payment to Acquire Life Insurance Policy, Investing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for payment of premium on corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as investing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.

CF.label: Goodwill, Acquired During Period
CF.description: Amount of increase in asset representing future economic benefits arising from other assets acquired in a business combination that are not individually identified and separately recognized resulting from a business combination.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-term Debt
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow for borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Acquisitions
CF.description: Value of stock issued pursuant to acquisitions during the period.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Interest Receivable, Net
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from borrowers for interest payments.

CF.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities, Continuing Operations
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity attributable to continuing operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

CF.label: Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
CF.description: The consolidated profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

CF.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestCreditLossExpenseReversal
CF.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

CF.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment and Tax
CF.description: Amount, after tax and adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Real Estate
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of other real estate not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

CF.label: Cash Acquired from Acquisition
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the acquisition of business during the period (for example, cash that was held by the acquired business).

CF.label: Payments of FHLBank Borrowings, Financing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for repayment of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) borrowing, classified as financing activity.

CF.label: Repayments of Long-term Debt
CF.description: The cash outflow for debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Federal Funds Sold
CF.description: The amount outstanding of funds lent to other depository institutions, securities brokers, or securities dealers in the form of Federal Funds sold; for example, immediately available funds lent under agreements or contracts that mature in one business day or roll over under a continuing contract, regardless of the nature of the transaction or the collateral involved, excluding overnight lending for commercial and industrial purposes. Also include Federal Funds sold under agreements to resell on a gross basis, excluding (1) sales of term Federal Funds, (2) due bills representing purchases of securities or other assets by the reporting bank that have not yet been delivered and similar instruments, (3) resale agreements that mature in more than one business day involving assets other than securities, and (4) yield maintenance dollar repurchase agreements.

CF.label: Off-Balance Sheet, Credit Loss, Liability, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
CF.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss for off-balance sheet credit exposure. Excludes off-balance sheet credit exposure accounted for as insurance and instrument accounted for under derivatives and hedging.

CF.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Amount
CF.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to tax credits. Including, but not limited to, research credit, foreign tax credit, investment tax credit, and other tax credits.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-term Debt
CF.description: The cash inflow from a debt initially having maturity due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Transfer of Portfolio Loans and Leases to Held-for-sale
CF.description: Value of loans and leases held in the entity's portfolio transferred to loans and leases held-for-sale in noncash transactions.

CF.label: Debt and Equity Securities, Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

CF.label: Payments for Origination of Mortgage Loans Held-for-sale
CF.description: The amount of cash paid for the origination of mortgages that are held for sale.

CF.label: Payments of Dividends
CF.description: Cash outflow in the form of capital distributions and dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests.

CF.label: Real Estate Owned, Transfer from Real Estate Owned
CF.description: Value transferred out of real estate owned (REO) in noncash transactions.

CF.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to preferred shareholders of the parent entity.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Foreclosed Assets
CF.description: The cash inflow from the sale assets received in full or partial satisfaction of a receivable including real and personal property; equity interests in corporations, partnerships, and joint ventures; and beneficial interests in trusts. Foreclosed assets also include loans that are treated as if the underlying collateral had been foreclosed because the institution has taken possession of the collateral, even though legal foreclosure or repossession proceedings have not taken place.

CF.label: Proceeds from FHLBank Borrowings, Financing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) borrowing, classified as financing activity.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Subordinated Long-term Debt
CF.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing where a lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in liquidation of the entity's assets or underlying collateral.

CF.label: Repayments of Subordinated Debt
CF.description: The cash outflow from the repayment of long-term borrowing where a lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in case of liquidation of the entity's assets or underlying collateral.

CF.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment, Tax
CF.description: Amount, after adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Interest Payable, Net
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in interest payable, which represents the amount owed to note holders, bond holders, and other parties for interest earned on loans or credit extended to the reporting entity.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) from acquisition (sale) of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) stock.

CF.label: Operating Lease, Expense
CF.description: Amount of operating lease expense. Excludes sublease income.

CF.label: Payments for Origination and Purchases of Loans Held-for-sale
CF.description: The aggregate amount of cash outflow for loans purchased and created with the intention to resell them in the near future.

CF.label: Foreclosed Real Estate Expense
CF.description: Amount of expense recognized during the period for the foreclosure on real estate assets.

CF.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization
CF.description: The aggregate expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of tangible assets, intangible assets, or depleting assets to periods that benefit from use of the assets.

CF.label: IncomeTaxPaidStateAndLocalAfterRefundReceived
CF.description: Amount, after income tax refund received, of cash paid to state and local tax jurisdictions for tax on income.

CF.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Expense, Tax Benefit
CF.description: Amount of tax benefit for recognition of expense of award under share-based payment arrangement.

CF.label: Depreciation, Amortization and Accretion, Net
CF.description: The aggregate net amount of depreciation, amortization, and accretion recognized during an accounting period. As a noncash item, the net amount is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
CF.description: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholders and which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Investments
CF.description: The net realized gain (loss) on investments sold during the period, not including gains (losses) on securities separately or otherwise categorized as trading, available-for-sale, or held-to-maturity, which, for cash flow reporting, is a component of proceeds from investing activities.

CF.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Gain (Loss), after Adjustment, before Tax
CF.description: Amount, before tax and after adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to available-for-sale.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow to acquire Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Mortgage Loans
CF.description: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of loans made to finance real estate acquisitions. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt
CF.description: Difference between the fair value of payments made and the carrying amount of debt which is extinguished prior to maturity.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Debt Securities, Available-for-sale
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from sale, maturity, prepayment and call of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Mortgage Loans Held-for-sale
CF.description: The cash inflow from sales of loans that are secured with real estate mortgages and are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

CF.label: Transfer of Loans Held-for-sale to Portfolio Loans
CF.description: Value of loans held-for-sale transferred to loans held in the entity's portfolio in noncash transactions.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Federal Home Loan Bank Stock
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from sale of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) stock.

CF.label: Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Nonproduction
CF.description: The current period expense charged against earnings on long-lived, physical assets not used in production, and which are not intended for resale, to allocate or recognize the cost of such assets over their useful lives; or to record the reduction in book value of an intangible asset over the benefit period of such asset; or to reflect consumption during the period of an asset that is not used in production.

CF.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Excluding Exchange Rate Effect
CF.description: Amount, excluding effect from change in exchange rate, of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Payment, Tax Withholding, Share-based Payment Arrangement
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

CF.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit)
CF.description: Amount of net periodic benefit cost (credit) for defined benefit plan.

CF.label: Life Insurance, Corporate or Bank Owned, Change in Value
CF.description: The change in cash surrender or contract value during the period which adjusted the amount of premiums paid in determining the expense or income recognized under the contract for the period.

CF.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Loans and Leases
CF.description: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of loans and leases that were sold during the reporting period. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sales. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

CF.label: Amortization Method Qualified Affordable Housing Project Investments, Amortization
CF.description: Amount of amortization expense for investment that generates income tax credit and other income tax benefit under tax credit program accounted for using proportional amortization method.

CF.label: Payments for Repurchase of Preferred Stock and Preference Stock
CF.description: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stock during the period.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Income Taxes
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the account that represents the temporary difference that results from Income or Loss that is recognized for accounting purposes but not for tax purposes and vice versa.

CF.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment, Excluding Oil and Gas Property and Timber Property
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, excluding oil and gas property and timber property.

CF.label: Goodwill, Purchase Accounting Adjustments
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from measurement period adjustment of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Loans Held-for-sale
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in value of loan held with intention to sell or be securitized in near future.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) in Interest-bearing Deposits in Banks
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow in Interest-bearing Deposits by banks in other financial institutions for relatively short periods of time including, for example, certificates of deposits.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Held-to-maturity Securities
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of securities that had been designated as held-to-maturity. Excludes proceeds from maturities, prepayments and calls by the issuer.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Investing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash (inflow) outflow from investing activity, classified as other.

CF.label: Stock Issued
CF.description: The fair value of stock issued in noncash financing activities.

CF.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

CF.label: Fair Value of Assets Acquired
CF.description: The fair value of assets acquired in noncash investing or financing activities.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Assets
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of other assets.

CF.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
CF.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to parent.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Businesses, Gross
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of business during the period. The cash portion only of the acquisition price.

CF.label: Provision for Other Credit Losses
