CF.description: Amount of expense related to credit loss from transactions other than loan and lease transactions.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets, including but not limited to property plant and equipment, intangible assets and equity in securities of subsidiaries or equity method investee.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Liabilities Assumed
CF.description: The total amount of [all] liabilities that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Assets Acquired
CF.description: The value of an asset or business acquired in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification, after Tax
CF.description: Amount, after tax and before reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) in Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase
CF.description: The cash flow from investments sold under the agreement to repurchase such investment.

CF.label: Asset Impairment Charges
CF.description: Amount of impairment loss for asset. Includes, but is not limited to, tangible and intangible assets and goodwill.

CF.label: Derivative, Gain (Loss) on Derivative, Net
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Time Deposits
CF.description: Net cash inflow (outflow) of time deposits.

CF.label: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost, Amortization
CF.description: Amount of amortization of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Investments
CF.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Other Investments
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investments classified as other.

CF.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Amortization
CF.description: Amount of amortization expense attributable to right-of-use asset from finance lease.

CF.label: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Preferred Stock
CF.description: The cash outflow for reacquisition of callable preferred stock.

CF.label: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs
CF.description: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt issuance costs.

CF.label: Amortization of Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSRs)
CF.description: The periodic amortization (in proportion to and over the period of estimated net servicing income or loss) of capitalized servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

CF.label: Liabilities Assumed
CF.description: The fair value of liabilities assumed in noncash investing or financing activities.

CF.label: Impairment of Real Estate
CF.description: The charge against earnings in the period to reduce the carrying amount of real property to fair value.

CF.label: Depreciation, Nonproduction
CF.description: The expense recognized in the current period that allocates the cost of nonproduction tangible assets over their useful lives.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Held-for-investment
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from sale of loan held for investment.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Operating Assets and Liabilities, Net
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in operating assets after deduction of operating liabilities classified as other.

CF.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
CF.description: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

CF.label: ProceedsFromSaleOfEquitySecuritiesFvNi
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as investing activity.

CF.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Liabilities
CF.description: Amount of liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Business
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) from sale and disposal of integrated set of activities and assets capable of being conducted and managed for purpose of providing return in form of dividend, lower cost, or other economic benefit to investor, owner, member and participant.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Held-to-maturity Securities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale or maturity of long-term held-to-maturity securities.

CF.label: Business Combination, Bargain Purchase, Gain Recognized, Amount
CF.description: In a business combination in which the amount of net identifiable assets acquired and liabilities assumed exceeds the aggregate consideration transferred or to be transferred (as defined), this element represents the amount of gain recognized by the entity.

CF.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Assets
CF.description: Amount of asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

CF.label: Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR) Impairment (Recovery)
CF.description: The adjustment to the carrying value of the rights retained or purchased to service mortgages. These adjustments are made when the estimate of the fair value is changed. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

CF.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

CF.label: Finance Lease, Principal Payments
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for principal payment on finance lease.

CF.label: Goodwill, Period Increase (Decrease)
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Net
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund lent to other financial institution arising from the excess in reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest. Also include cash inflow or outflow from investment sold under the agreement to reacquire such investment.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Loans Receivable
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of loans receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

CF.label: Restricted Cash and Cash Equivalents
CF.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Additions
CF.description: The value of new servicing assets, subsequently measured at fair value, acquired or created during the current period through purchases or from transfers of financial assets.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Federal Reserve Bank Stock
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow to acquire Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Investments
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of investments classified as other.

CF.label: Finance Lease, Interest Expense
CF.description: Amount of interest expense on finance lease liability.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) for debt classified as other.

CF.label: Repayments of Short-term Debt
CF.description: The cash outflow for a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Proceeds from FHLBank Advance, Investing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from collection of advance by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), classified as investing activity.

CF.label: Dividends Payable
CF.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but unpaid on equity securities issued by the entity and outstanding.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Other Financing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity, classified as other.

CF.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Including Disposal Group and Discontinued Operations
CF.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Prior Service Cost (Credit)
CF.description: Amount of prior service cost (credit) recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

CF.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a portion of the company's business, for example a segment, division, branch or other business, during the period.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Federal Funds Purchased
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund borrowed from other financial institution arising from the insufficient reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in debt and equity securities, measured at fair value with changes in fair value recognized in net income.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Loans Receivable
CF.description: The cash outflow for the purchase of loan receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.

CF.label: Stock or Unit Option Plan Expense
CF.description: Amount of noncash expense for option under share-based payment arrangement.

CF.label: Amortization of Deferred Loan Origination Fees, Net
CF.description: The net increase(decrease) in interest income during the period representing the allocation of deferred loan origination fees less deferred loan origination costs using the effective interest method over the term of the debt arrangement to which they pertain taking into account the effect of prepayments.

CF.label: Proceeds from Short-term Debt
CF.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Repayments of Other Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other.

CF.label: Debt, Weighted Average Interest Rate
CF.description: Weighted average interest rate of debt outstanding.

CF.label: Operating Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Amortization Expense
CF.description: Amount of periodic reduction over lease term of carrying amount of right-of-use asset from operating lease.

CF.label: Payments for FHLBank Advance, Investing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for disbursement to borrower related to advance, made by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), classified as investing activity.

CF.label: Payments of Stock Issuance Costs
CF.description: The cash outflow for cost incurred directly with the issuance of an equity security.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Life Insurance Policies
CF.description: The net cash outflow or inflow for net proceeds and payments derived from carrying life insurance policies for which the entity is the beneficiary.

CF.label: Right-of-Use Asset Obtained in Exchange for Finance Lease Liability
CF.description: Amount of increase in right-of-use asset obtained in exchange for finance lease liability.

CF.label: Debt and Equity Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

CF.label: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments
CF.description: Amount of income (loss) for proportionate share of equity method investee's income (loss).

CF.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer from Held-to-Maturity, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment and Tax
CF.description: Amount, before tax and adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

CF.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Treasury Stock Reissued
CF.description: Value of treasury shares or units reissued. Excludes reissuance of shares or units in treasury for award under share-based payment arrangement.

CF.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Net
CF.description: Amount of asset acquired in excess of (less than) liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date. Excludes goodwill.

CF.label: Debt Securities, Realized Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Loans Receivable
CF.description: The net amount paid or received by the reporting entity associated with purchase (sale or collection) of loans receivable arising from the financing of goods and services.

CF.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Exercise of Option, Tax Benefit
CF.description: Amount of tax benefit from exercise of option under share-based payment arrangement.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Loans Held-for-investment
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with purchasing loans held for investment purposes during the period.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Marketable Securities
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the aggregate amount received by the entity through sale or maturity of marketable securities (held-to-maturity or available-for-sale) during the period.

CF.label: Financing Receivable, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Discount (Premium)
CF.description: Amount of discount (premium) attributable to other factors on financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration.

CF.label: PaymentsToAcquireEquitySecuritiesFvNi
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow to acquire investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as investing activity.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Federal Reserve Bank Stock
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from sale of Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

CF.label: Amortization
CF.description: The aggregate amount of recurring noncash expense charged against earnings in the period to allocate the cost of assets over their estimated remaining economic lives.

CF.label: Finance Lease, Interest Payment on Liability
CF.description: Amount of interest paid on finance lease liability.

CF.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer to Held-to-Maturity, Adjustment from AOCI for Amortization of Gain (Loss), before Tax
CF.description: Amount, before tax, of adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for amortization of gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

CF.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Investments
CF.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

CF.label: Amortization of Debt Discount (Premium)
CF.description: Amount of noncash expense included in interest expense to amortize debt discount and premium associated with the related debt instruments. Excludes amortization of financing costs. Alternate captions include noncash interest expense.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Treasury Stock
CF.description: The cash inflow from the issuance of an equity stock that has been previously reacquired by the entity.

CF.label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred
CF.description: Amount of consideration transferred, consisting of acquisition-date fair value of assets transferred by the acquirer, liabilities incurred by the acquirer, and equity interest issued by the acquirer.

CF.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
CF.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

CF.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Compensation Expense
CF.description: The amount of plan compensation cost recognized during the period.

CF.label: Repayments of Other Long-term Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other, maturing after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Dividends, Cash
CF.description: Amount of paid and unpaid cash dividends declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

CF.label: Other Depreciation and Amortization
CF.description: Amount of expense charged against earnings to allocate the cost of tangible and intangible assets over their remaining economic lives, classified as other.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Loans and Leases
CF.description: The net cash outflow or inflow for other changes, net, in the loan and lease balances held for investment purposes that are not separately disclosed. Includes cash payments and proceeds associated with (a) loans held-for-investment, (b) leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Loans and Leases Held-for-investment
CF.description: The net cash inflow from (a) sales of loans held-for-investment, (b) sales of leases held-for-investment, and (c) both. Includes proceeds from securitizations of loans.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Loans and Leases Held-for-investment
CF.description: The cash outflow from (a) purchases of loans held-for-investment, (b) purchases of leases held-for-investment, and (c) both.

CF.label: Proceeds from Other Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from debt classified as other.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Productive Assets
CF.description: The cash inflow from the sale of property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

CF.label: Provision for Other Losses
CF.description: Amount of expense related to other loss.

CF.label: Restricted Stock or Unit Expense
CF.description: Amount of noncash expense for award of restricted stock or unit under share-based payment arrangement.

CF.label: Dividends
CF.description: Amount of paid and unpaid cash, stock, and paid-in-kind (PIK) dividends declared, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred stock.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Productive Assets
CF.description: The net cash outflow or inflow from purchases, sales and disposals of property, plant and equipment and other productive assets, including intangibles.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Restricted Investments
CF.description: The cash outflow to acquire investments (not to include restricted cash) that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

CF.label: Restricted Cash
CF.description: Amount of cash restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other accounts with general characteristics of demand deposits.

CF.label: Transfer to Investments
CF.description: Value of investments transferred to the entity's investments in noncash transactions.

CF.label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Equity Interests Issued and Issuable
CF.description: Amount of equity interests of the acquirer, including instruments or interests issued or issuable in consideration for the business combination.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities and Other Operating Liabilities
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in accrued expenses, and obligations classified as other.

CF.label: Payments of Debt Issuance Costs
CF.description: The cash outflow paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance or Sale of Equity
CF.description: The cash inflow from the issuance of common stock, preferred stock, treasury stock, stock options, and other types of equity.

CF.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives
CF.description: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of derivative instruments, including options, swaps, futures, and forward contracts, held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

CF.label: Deferred Income Taxes and Tax Credits
CF.description: Amount of deferred income tax expense (benefit) and income tax credits.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Marketable Securities
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for purchase of marketable security.

CF.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, General Debt Obligations, Disclosures, Repayment and Penalties
CF.description: Amount of repayments and penalties incurred in the satisfaction or roll-over of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) advance.

CF.label: Impairment of Long-Lived Assets to be Disposed of
CF.description: The aggregate amount of write-downs for impairments recognized during the period for long-lived assets held for abandonment, exchange or sale.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Equity Method Investments
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of or advances to an equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.

CF.label: Proceeds from Stock Plans
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the stock plan during the period.

CF.label: Realized Investment Gains (Losses)
CF.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment.

CF.label: Gain on Sale of Investments
CF.description: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of an investment. A gain would be recognized when the sale price of the investment is greater than the carrying value of the investment. This element refers to the Gain included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Businesses and Interest in Affiliates
CF.description: The net cash outflow or inflow associated with the acquisition or sale of a business segment during the period.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Restricted Investments
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of investments that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions during the period.

CF.label: Transfer from Investments
CF.description: Value of investments transferred from the entity's investments in noncash transactions.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets for Financial Service Operations
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets utilized in financial service operations.

CF.label: Impairment of Long-Lived Assets Held-for-use
CF.description: Amount of impairment loss for long-lived asset held and used. Includes, but is not limited to, impairment loss for long-lived asset to be disposed of other than by sale.

CF.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
CF.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the parent.

CF.label: IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingLeaseLiability
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for operating lease.

CF.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer to Held-to-Maturity, Adjustment from AOCI for Amortization of Gain (Loss), after Tax
CF.description: Amount, after tax, of adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for amortization of gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Debt
CF.description: The cash inflow during the period from additional borrowings in aggregate debt. Includes proceeds from short-term and long-term debt.

CF.label: Employee Benefits and Share-based Compensation
CF.description: Amount of expense for employee benefit and equity-based compensation.

CF.label: Net Change Interest-bearing Deposits, Domestic
CF.description: The increase (decrease) in interest-bearing deposits domestic.

CF.label: Debt Securities, Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

CF.label: Gain (Loss) Related to Litigation Settlement
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in settlement of litigation and insurance claims. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Productive Assets
CF.description: The cash outflow for purchases of and capital improvements on property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance Initial Public Offering
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from entity's first offering of stock to the public.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR)
CF.description: The cash inflow from the sale of servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or its consolidated affiliates; or (2) by originating mortgage loans and then (a) transferring the loans to a Variable Interest Entity (VIE) in a transaction that meets the necessary transfer and classification requirements, or (b) transferring the loans in a transaction that meets the requirements for sale accounting.

CF.label: Fair Value, Option, Changes in Fair Value, Gain (Loss)
CF.description: For each line item in the statement of financial position, the amounts of gains and losses from fair value changes included in earnings.

CF.label: Financing Receivable, Reclassification to Held-for-sale
CF.description: Amount of financing receivable reclassified to held-for-sale.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Financing Receivable
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) from sale of financing receivable, including, but not limited to, lease receivable.

CF.label: Loss on Sale of Investments
CF.description: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of an investment. A loss would be recognized when the sale price of the investment is less than the carrying value of the investment. This element refers to the Loss included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Intangible Assets Acquired
CF.description: The amount of intangibles that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Wholly Owned Real Estate and Real Estate Acquired in Settlement of Loans
CF.description: The cash inflow from proceeds From Sales of Wholly Owned Real Estate and Real Estate Acquired in Settlement of Loans.

CF.label: Real Estate Owned, Valuation Allowance, Provision
CF.description: Amount of expense recognized in the income statement for a decrease in valuation of real estate owned (REO).

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Net Nonmonetary Assets Acquired (Liabilities Assumed)
CF.description: The net book value of a nonmonetary asset transferred or exchanged in connection with the acquisition of a business or asset in a noncash transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. Nonmonetary assets and liabilities are assets and liabilities that will not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the future.

CF.label: Other Noncash Income (Expense)
CF.description: Amount of income (expense) included in net income that results in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

CF.label: Payments for Repurchase of Equity
CF.description: The cash outflow to reacquire common and preferred stock.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Intangible Assets
CF.description: The cash outflow to acquire asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

CF.label: Proceeds from Loan and Lease Originations and Principal Collections
CF.description: Cash inflow related to a loan origination (the process when securing a mortgage for a piece of real property), lease origination, and principal collections.

CF.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

CF.label: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal
CF.description: Amount before tax of gain (loss) recognized on the sale or disposal of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties
CF.description: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of real estate or properties that were intended to be sold or held for capital appreciation or rental income. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

CF.label: Impairment of Intangible Assets (Excluding Goodwill)
CF.description: Amount of impairment loss for finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Loans from Federal Home Loan Banks
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in loans from another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

CF.label: Marketable Securities, Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security, including other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Other Long-term Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of long-term debt classified as other.

CF.label: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Including Option Exercised
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of shares under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, option exercised.

CF.label: Amortization of Debt Issuance Costs and Discounts
CF.description: Amount of amortization expense attributable to debt discount (premium) and debt issuance costs.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Payable
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount due for taxes based on the reporting entity's earnings or attributable to the entity's income earning process (business presence) within a given jurisdiction.

CF.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Other Investments
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the maturity (principal being due), prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Loans Held-for-sale
CF.description: The cash inflow from sale proceeds and collection of repayments from borrowers on loans classified as held-for-sale, including proceeds from loans sold through mortgage securitization; includes mortgages and other types of loans.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Other Investments
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale and maturity (principal being due) of other investments, prepayment and call (request of early payment) of other investments not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

CF.label: Repayments of Notes Payable
CF.description: The cash outflow for a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments, Net, Pretax
CF.description: Aggregate net gain (loss) on all derivative instruments recognized in earnings during the period, before tax effects.

CF.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
CF.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations including portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

CF.label: Income Tax Credits and Adjustments
CF.description: A credit or adjustment for government or taxing authority authorized decrease in taxes owed as a result of meeting certain tax policy conditions.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Debt
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow in aggregate debt due to repayments and proceeds from additional borrowings.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Long-term Debt and Capital Securities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt, finance lease obligation, and mandatorily redeemable capital security.

CF.label: Repayments of Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for short-term and long-term debt. Excludes payment of lease obligation.

CF.label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Investment Real Estate
CF.description: The net gain (loss) resulting from sales and other disposals of real estate owned for investment purposes.

CF.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Sold, Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
CF.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) from sale of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

CF.label: Net Change Noninterest-bearing Deposits, Domestic
CF.description: The increase (decrease) in domestic noninterest bearing deposits.

CF.label: Payments to Purchase Loans Held-for-sale
CF.description: The aggregate cash outflow used to purchase all loans that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

CF.label: Payment for Pension Benefits
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for pension benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes other postretirement benefit.

CF.label: Repayments of Other Short-term Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for the payment of debt classified as other, maturing within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Adjustments to Reconcile Net Income (Loss) to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
CF.description: Amount of expense (income); loss (gain); increase (decrease) in liability and (increase) decrease in asset used in operating activity; and cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, classified as other; in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

CF.label: Lease Obligation Incurred
CF.description: Amount of increase in lease obligation from new lease.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Other Investments
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) included in earnings for investments classified as other.

CF.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
CF.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation including the portion attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Federal Funds Sold
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from the fund lent to other financial institution arising from the excess in reserve deposited at Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirement. This borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest.

CF.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, before Tax, Parent
CF.description: Amount, before tax and after reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.

CF.label: Other Operating Activities, Cash Flow Statement
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity, classified as other, in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

CF.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses, Net of Cash Divested
CF.description: This element represents the cash inflow during the period from the sale of a component of the entity.

CF.label: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Investing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as investing activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as operating activities.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Debt and Equity Securities, FV-NI, Held-for-investment
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

CF.label: Cash Acquired in Excess of Payments to Acquire Business
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the acquisition of a business when the cash held by the acquired business exceeds the cash payments to acquire the business.

CF.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
CF.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation attributable to the parent. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Investments Acquired
CF.description: The amount of investments that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Proceeds from Equity Method Investment, Distribution, Return of Capital
CF.description: Amount of distribution received from equity method investee for return of investment, classified as investing activities. Excludes distribution for return on investment, classified as operating activities.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Common Stock, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from capital contributions to an entity associated with a dividend reinvestment plan.

CF.label: Proceeds from Other Short-term Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from short-term debt classified as other.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to vendors for goods and services received and the amount of obligations and expenses incurred but not paid.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Mortgage Loans Held-for-sale
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in value of mortgage loan held with intention to sell or be securitized in near future.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Fixed Assets Acquired
CF.description: The amount of fixed assets that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Operating Lease, Lease Income, Lease Payments
CF.description: Amount of operating lease income from lease payments paid and payable to lessor. Excludes variable lease payments not included in measurement of lease receivable.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Warrants
CF.description: The cash inflow from issuance of rights to purchase common shares at predetermined price (usually issued together with corporate debt).

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Equity Method Investments
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of equity method investments, which are investments in joint ventures and entities in which the entity has an equity ownership interest normally of 20 to 50 percent and exercises significant influence.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Demand Deposits
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow in the total of all demand deposits, including checking and negotiable order of withdrawal (NOW) accounts, classified as cash flows from financing activities.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Interest and Dividends Receivable
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount due to the entity in the form of unpaid interest and dividends.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Loans
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in loans classified as other.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Investments
CF.description: The net cash paid (received) associated with the acquisition or disposal of all investments, including securities and other assets.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Finance Receivables
CF.description: The cash outflow for the purchase of amounts due from customers, clients, lessees, borrowers, or others under the terms of its agreements therewith.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Investments
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of all investments (debt, security, other) during the period.

CF.label: Proceeds from Income Tax Refunds
CF.description: Amount of income tax refund received from tax jurisdiction.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Senior Long-term Debt
CF.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle, if longer).

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Investments
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale, maturity and collection of all investments such as debt, security and so forth during the period.

CF.label: Accretion Expense
CF.description: Amount recognized for the passage of time, typically for liabilities, that have been discounted to their net present values. Excludes accretion associated with asset retirement obligations.

CF.label: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Depreciation Expense on Property Subject to or Held-for-lease
CF.description: Amount of depreciation expense for lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Federal Reserve Bank Stock
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) from acquisition or sale of Federal Reserve Bank (FRB) stock.

CF.label: Pension Cost (Reversal of Cost)
CF.description: Amount of cost (reversal of cost) for pension benefits. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
CF.description: The net cash flow from purchases followed by sales of securities under terms of reverse repurchase agreements.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Finance Receivables
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Assets, Investing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of other assets recognized in investing activities.

CF.label: Profit (Loss) from Real Estate Operations
CF.description: The net cost of operation of other real estate (including provisions for real estate losses, rental income, and gains and losses on sales of real estate).

CF.label: Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Hedged Item in Fair Value Hedge
CF.description: Amount of the increase (decrease) in fair value of the hedged item in a fair value hedge recognized in the income statement.

CF.label: Equity Method Investment, Realized Gain (Loss) on Disposal
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of an equity method investment.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Assets and Asset Impairment Charges
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the sale price or salvage price and the book value of an asset that was sold or retired, and gain (loss) from the write down of assets from their carrying value to fair value.

CF.label: Proceeds, Issuance of Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Excluding Option Exercised
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from issuance of shares under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes option exercised.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Property Held-for-sale
CF.description: The cash inflow from the sale of formerly productive land held for sale, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

CF.label: Dividends, Common Stock, Stock
CF.description: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in stock.

CF.label: Proceeds from Equity Method Investment, Distribution
CF.description: Amount of distribution received from equity method investee for return on investment, classified as operating activities. Excludes distribution for return of investment, classified as investing activities.

CF.label: Equity Method Investment, Other than Temporary Impairment
CF.description: Amount of other-than-temporary decline in value that has been recognized against investment accounted for under equity method of accounting.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Finance Receivables
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in outstanding loans including accrued interest.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities that result from activities that generate operating income.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Other Liabilities Assumed
CF.description: Amount of liabilities, classified as other, assumed in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash or part noncash acquisition.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Payments for) Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Net
CF.description: The cash flow from the funds lent to and (borrowed from) other financial reporting institutions arising from excess or shortfall in reserve deposited at the Federal Reserve Bank to meet legal requirements. This lending and borrowing is usually contracted on an overnight basis at an agreed rate of interest. Also include cash outflow or inflow from investments purchased under the agreement to resell such investment.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less
CF.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.

CF.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Acquisition Through Foreclosure
CF.description: Amount of real estate investments acquired through foreclosure for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Consumer Loans
CF.description: The gains (losses) included in earning that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of consumer loans. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Receivable
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in income taxes receivable, which represents the amount due from tax authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes paid.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in prepaid expenses, and assets classified as other.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expense
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of outstanding money paid in advance for goods or services that bring economic benefits for future periods.

CF.label: Marketable Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Payments to) Noncontrolling Interests
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from (to) a noncontrolling interest. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Loans Held-for-sale
CF.description: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of loans (other than mortgage loans) that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

CF.label: Accounts Receivable, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
CF.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on accounts receivable.

CF.label: Repayments of Senior Debt
CF.description: The cash outflow for a long-term debt where the holder has highest claim on the entity's asset in case of bankruptcy or liquidation during the period.

CF.label: Restricted Stock, Value, Shares Issued Net of Tax Withholdings
CF.description: Value, after value of shares used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement, of restricted shares issued. Excludes cash used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation.

CF.label: Income (Loss) from Equity Method Investments, Net of Dividends or Distributions
CF.description: This element represents the undistributed income (or loss) of equity method investments, net of dividends or other distributions received from unconsolidated subsidiaries, certain corporate joint ventures, and certain noncontrolled corporations; such investments are accounted for under the equity method of accounting. This element excludes distributions that constitute a return of investment, which are classified as investing activities.

CF.label: IncomeTaxPaidFederalBeforeRefundReceived
CF.description: Amount, before income tax refund received, of cash paid to federal (national) tax jurisdiction for tax on income.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Deposits
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in deposit liabilities classified as other.

CF.label: Marketable Securities, Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss
CF.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Private Placement
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from entity's raising of capital via private rather than public placement.

CF.label: Proceeds from Notes Payable
CF.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

CF.label: Proceeds from Warrant Exercises
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from holders exercising their stock warrants.

CF.label: Early Repayment of Subordinated Debt
CF.description: The cash outflow from the repayment of long-term borrowing where a lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in case of liquidation of the entity's assets before its maturity.

CF.label: Goodwill, Translation and Purchase Accounting Adjustments
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from foreign currency translation and measurement period adjustments of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Equity Securities, FV-NI
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in other obligations or expenses incurred but not yet paid.

CF.label: Investment Income, Dividend
CF.description: Amount of dividend income on nonoperating securities.

CF.label: Mortgage Loan Related to Property Sales
CF.description: Mortgage loan related to property sales in noncash investing and financing activities.

CF.label: Payments for Legal Settlements
CF.description: The amount of cash paid for the settlement of litigation or for other legal issues during the period.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Mortgage Servicing Rights (MSR)
CF.description: The cash outflow to obtain servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or its consolidated affiliates; or (2) by originating mortgage loans and then (a) transferring the loans to a Variable Interest Entity (VIE) in a transaction that meets the necessary transfer and classification requirements, or (b) transferring the loans in a transaction that meets the requirements for sale accounting.

CF.label: Proceeds from Lines of Credit
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from contractual arrangement with the lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

CF.label: Proceeds, Financing Receivable, Previously Written Off, Recovery
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of financing receivable, previously written off.

CF.label: Debt Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

CF.label: Income (Loss) from Affordable Housing Projects, Equity Method Investments
CF.description: Amount of income tax credit and other income tax benefit generated by equity method investment under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Compensation
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the obligation created by employee agreements whereby earned compensation will be paid in the future.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to taxing authorities for taxes that are based on the reporting entity's earnings, net of amounts receivable from taxing authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes, and in deferred and other tax liabilities and assets.

CF.label: Investment Income, Net, Amortization of Discount and Premium
CF.description: Amount of accretion (amortization) of purchase discount (premium) on nonoperating securities.

CF.label: Money Market Funds, at Carrying Value
CF.description: Investment in short-term money-market instruments (such as commercial paper, banker's acceptances, repurchase agreements, government securities, certificates of deposit, and so forth) which are highly liquid (that is, readily convertible to known amounts of cash) and so near their maturity that they present an insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify as cash equivalents by definition. Original maturity means an original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

CF.label: Payments to Noncontrolling Interests
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow to a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but not limited to, reduction of noncontrolling interest ownership. Excludes dividends paid to the noncontrolling interest.

CF.label: Proceeds from Debt, Net of Issuance Costs
CF.description: The cash inflow from additional borrowings, net of cash paid to third parties in connection with debt origination.

CF.label: Proceeds from Noncontrolling Interests
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from a noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, purchase of additional shares or other increase in noncontrolling interest ownership.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Property, Plant, and Equipment
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow for the sale of long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

CF.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossNotPreviouslyRecorded
CF.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) with no credit loss previously recorded.

CF.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized and realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Securitization of Financial Assets
CF.description: A gain (loss) realized on a transfer, accounted for as a sale, of all or a portion of financial assets in which the transferor surrenders control and receives consideration other than a beneficial interest in the assets transferred. Reflects the amount of sales proceeds in excess of, or deficient from, the sum of the carrying amounts of transferred financial assets plus transaction costs.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Debt Securities, Trading
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

CF.label: Investment Income, Amortization of Premium
CF.description: Amount of amortization of purchase premium on nonoperating securities.

CF.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends
CF.description: Cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends to common shareholders, preferred shareholders and noncontrolling interests, generally out of earnings.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Limited Partnership Interests
CF.description: Cash outflow related to the acquisition or continued holding of limited partnership interests held for investment purposes.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Secured Debt
CF.description: The cash inflow from amounts received from issuance of long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt secured debt.

CF.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Repayments and Calls of Debt Securities, FV-NI, Held-for-investment
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with maturities (principal being due), repayments and calls (payments before maturities) of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Buildings
CF.description: The cash inflow from sale of buildings.

CF.label: Repayments of Bank Debt
CF.description: The cash outflow to settle a bank borrowing during the year.

CF.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities, Discontinued Operations
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activity attributable to discontinued operation. Operating activity includes, but is not limited to, transaction, adjustment, and change in value not defined as investing or financing activity.

CF.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate change on cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currency; attributable to continuing operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Stock in Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of equity in securities of subsidiaries or equity method investee.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Loans, Deferred Income
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in net unamortized loan origination fees and other fees that are collected at origination but recorded as income over the life of the loan.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) of Restricted Investments
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) associated with investments (not to include restricted cash) that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

CF.label: Loans Assumed
CF.description: The fair value of loans assumed in noncash investing or financing activities.

CF.label: Marketable Securities, Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss
CF.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Debt Assumed
CF.description: The amount of debt that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Divestiture, Amount of Consideration Received
CF.description: Amount of noncash consideration received for selling an asset or business through a noncash (or part noncash) transaction.

CF.label: Payments of Ordinary Dividends, Noncontrolling Interest
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow in the form of ordinary dividends provided by the non-wholly owned subsidiary to noncontrolling interests.

CF.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Mortgage Backed Securities (MBS)
CF.description: The cash inflow from the maturity (principal due), prepayment and call (request of early payment) of a loan financed by home mortgage payments classified as held to maturity.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Productive Assets
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of tangible or intangible assets used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.

CF.label: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
CF.description: Future cash outflow to pay for purchases of fixed assets that have occurred.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Other Financial Assets
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) on disposal of other assets utilized in financial service operations.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Savings Deposits
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow in the total of all savings account deposits, which may include passbook, statement savings accounts and money-market deposit accounts (MMDAs), classified as cash flows from financing activities.

CF.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Reclassification for Discontinuance, before Tax
CF.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for gain (loss) from discontinuance of cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

CF.label: Other Significant Noncash Transaction, Value of Consideration Given
CF.description: The value of the noncash (or part noncash) consideration given (for example, liability, equity) in a transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of a transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Payments for Repurchase of Other Equity
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow to reacquire equity classified as other.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Other Property, Plant, and Equipment
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow from the acquisition of or improvements to long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Trading Securities Held-for-investment
CF.description: The cash outflow to acquire securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes payments for trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

CF.label: Proceeds from Bank Debt
CF.description: The cash inflow from bank borrowing during the year.

CF.label: Proceeds from Limited Partnership Investments
CF.description: Cash inflow received as distributions, returns of capital, or sale proceeds from partnership interests held for investment purposes.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Notes Payable
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Mortgage-backed Securities (MBS), Available-for-sale
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from sale of investment in mortgage-backed security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

CF.label: Sale of Stock, Consideration Received on Transaction
CF.description: Cash received on stock transaction after deduction of issuance costs.

CF.label: Tangible Asset Impairment Charges
CF.description: The charge against earnings resulting from the aggregate write down of tangible assets from their carrying value to their fair value.

CF.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Credit), Gain (Loss) Due to Settlement and Curtailment
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit from settlement and curtailment.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Hedging Activity
CF.description: Gain (loss) incurred in hedging activities.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Repurchase of Debt Instrument
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) from the difference between the repurchase price of a debt instrument initially issued by the entity and the net carrying amount of the debt at the time of its repurchase.

CF.label: IncomeTaxPaidStateAndLocalBeforeRefundReceived
CF.description: Amount, before income tax refund received, of cash paid to state and local tax jurisdictions for tax on income.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Assets Held-for-sale
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in book value of long-lived assets that the reporting entity plans to sell within one year (or one business cycle).

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Derivative Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying value of derivative instruments reported as liabilities that are due to be disposed of within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

CF.label: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Financing Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow, not made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability up to amount recognized at acquisition date, including, but not limited to, measurement period adjustment and less amount paid soon after acquisition date.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Short-term Investments
CF.description: The net amount paid (received) by the reporting entity through acquisition or sale and maturities of short-term investments with an original maturity that is three months or less which qualify for treatment as an investing activity based on management's intention and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

CF.label: Proceeds from Principal Repayments on Loans and Leases Held-for-investment
CF.description: The cash inflow from repayments of the balance excluding interest (principal) on loans receivable and leases held for investment purposes.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Secured Debt
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes tax exempt secured debt.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Machinery and Equipment
CF.description: The cash inflow from sale of machinery and equipment.

CF.label: Repayments of Lines of Credit
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for payment of an obligation from a lender, including but not limited to, letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements.

CF.label: Repayments of Secured Debt
CF.description: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is wholly or partially secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt secured debt.

CF.label: Gains (Losses) on Sales of Credit Card Portfolio
CF.description: The gain (loss) resulting from the sale of credit card receivables (portfolios).

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Investment Income Receivable
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in investment income that has been earned but not yet received in cash.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Advance Payments by Borrowers for Taxes and Insurance
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in prepayments received from borrowers for taxes and insurance remitted to the appropriate tax authority or insurer on behalf of the borrower.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Derivative Assets
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying value of derivative instruments reported as assets that are due to be disposed of within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Derivative Assets and Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the net carrying value of derivative instruments reported as assets and liabilities that are due to be disposed of within one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer).

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Assets
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of assets used to generate operating income.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Receivables
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivables classified as other.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Payables to Broker-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations incurred arising from transactions with broker-dealers, such as amounts due on margin and unsettled cash transactions; includes payables to brokers, dealers and clearing organizations.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Trading Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of trading liabilities from the reporting entity's trading activities. This include liabilities resulting from sales of assets that the reporting entity does not own and revaluation losses.

CF.label: Maturities of Subordinated Debt
CF.description: The cash outflow for a long-term borrowing where lender is placed in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior) in case of liquidation of the entity's assets as it matures.

CF.label: Payments for Affordable Housing Programs
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for payment made by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) for Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessment required by Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

CF.label: Payments for Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with agreements to purchase and then resell securities to counterparties (reverse repurchase agreements).

CF.label: Proceeds from Sales of Assets, Investing Activities
CF.description: Aggregate cash proceeds received from a combination of transactions that are classified as investing activities in which assets, which may include one or more investments, are sold to third-party buyers. This element can be used by entities to aggregate proceeds from all asset sales that are classified as investing activities.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sales of Business, Affiliate and Productive Assets
CF.description: Aggregate cash proceeds received from a combination of transactions in which noncurrent assets are sold, which may include the sale of a business, an investment in an affiliate (including an equity method investee), property, plant and equipment and intangible assets. Excludes sales of trading, available-for-sale, and held-to-maturity securities.

CF.label: Debt and Equity Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension Benefits
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for pension benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit or defined contribution plans. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

CF.label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets Acquired
CF.description: Amount of increase in indefinite-lived asset acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation. Excludes goodwill.

CF.label: Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest
CF.description: The cash outflow during the period for redemption of redeemable noncontrolling interests.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Other Productive Assets
