CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for the purchase of or improvements to tangible or intangible assets, used to produce goods or deliver services, classified as other.

CF.label: Payment for Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree.

CF.label: Proceeds from Collection of Loans Receivable
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the collection, including prepayments, of loans receivable issued for financing of goods and services.

CF.label: Restricted Stock Award, Forfeitures
CF.description: The total value of forfeitures related to restricted stock awards forfeited during the period.

CF.label: Consideration Received for Beneficial Interest Obtained for Transferring Financial Asset
CF.description: Amount of beneficial interest received as consideration for transferring noncash financial asset. Includes, but is not limited to, trade receivable in securitization transaction.

CF.label: Dividend, Share-based Payment Arrangement
CF.description: Amount of paid and unpaid cash, stock, and paid-in-kind dividends declared for award under share-based payment arrangement.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) included in earnings for the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of interest rate derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Leased Assets, Net, Operating Leases
CF.description: The net gain (loss) arising from the lessor's sale of assets held- or available-for-lease under contractual arrangements classified as operating leases.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Financial Instruments Used in Operating Activities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate value of financial instruments used in operating activities, including trading securities, risk management instruments, and other short-term trading instruments.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Life Insurance Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) in life insurance liability balances during the period.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Accrued Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in other expenses incurred but not yet paid.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Current Assets
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in current assets classified as other.

CF.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Noncash Financial or Equity Instrument Consideration, Shares Issued
CF.description: The number of shares issued as [noncash or part noncash] consideration for a business or asset acquired. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Limited Partnership
CF.description: Net cash outflow or inflow from limited partnership investments held by the entity for investment purposes.

CF.label: Payments for Software
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the development, modification or acquisition of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Equipment on Lease
CF.description: The cash outflow for payments to acquire rented equipment which is recorded as an asset.

CF.label: Proceeds from Long-term Lines of Credit
CF.description: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with maturities due beyond one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Notes Receivable
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

CF.label: Repayment of Long-term Debt, Long-term Lease Obligation, and Capital Security
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for debt, mandatory redeemable security, and principal payment for finance lease obligation.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable and Other Operating Assets
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivables, and operating assets classified as other.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Employee Related Liabilities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedging Instruments
CF.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to the fair value of interest rate derivatives designated as fair value hedging instruments, as offset by the gain (loss) on the hedged item to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Loans to Federal Home Loan Banks
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) loans to another FHLBank.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Current Liabilities
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in current liabilities classified as other.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Receivables
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due within one year (or one operating cycle) from all parties, associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities.

CF.label: Loans Receivable Held-for-sale, Reconciliation to Cash Flow, Additions to Held-for-sale
CF.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of addition to financing receivable held for sale that is not part of disposal group.

CF.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, Unrealized Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, after Tax
CF.description: Amount, after tax, before reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option.

CF.label: Other Noncash Income
CF.description: Amount of income or gain included in net income that result in no cash inflow (outflow), classified as other.

CF.label: Other Real Estate, Covered, Valuation Adjustments
CF.description: Valuation adjustments made to other real estate covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

CF.label: Payments for Loans
CF.description: Cash payments for and related to principal collection on loans related to operating activities.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities
CF.description: The net cash outflow or inflow from derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Previous Acquisition
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow associated with the aggregate amount of adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

CF.label: Payments of Financing Costs
CF.description: The cash outflow for loan and debt issuance costs.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Long-term Debt and Capital Securities, Net
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from long-term debt, finance lease obligation, and mandatorily redeemable capital security.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Unsecured Debt
CF.description: The cash inflow from the issuance of long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes proceeds from tax exempt unsecured debt.

CF.label: Proceeds from Loans
CF.description: Cash received from principal payments made on loans related to operating activities.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Insurance Investments
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of insurance policy investment assets during the period.

CF.label: Proceeds from Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with agreements to purchase and then resell securities to counterparties (reverse repurchase agreements).

CF.label: Repayments of Debt and Lease Obligation
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for short-term and long-term debt and lease obligation.

CF.label: Amortization of Acquisition Costs
CF.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period that reflects the allocation of capitalized costs associated with acquisition of business. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

CF.label: FinancingReceivableTransferToHeldForSaleValuationAllowanceExpense
CF.description: Amount of expense for valuation allowance on financing receivable transferred to held-for-sale classification.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in amount due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Income Taxes Payable, Net of Income Taxes Receivable
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amounts payable to taxing authorities for taxes that are based on the reporting entity's earnings, net of amounts receivable from taxing authorities for refunds of overpayments or recoveries of income taxes.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Insurance Assets
CF.description: The increase (decrease) in the beginning and end of period in insurance industry assets which are classified as cash flows from operating activities.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Operating Capital
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in asset and (increase) decrease in liability, used in operating activity in reconciling net income to reflect cash provided by (used in) operating activity when indirect cash flow method is applied.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Liabilities
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent operating liabilities classified as other.

CF.label: Insured Event, Gain (Loss)
CF.description: Amount of excess (deficiency) of insurance recovery over the loss incurred from an insured event.

CF.label: Issuance of Stock and Warrants for Services or Claims
CF.description: Fair value of share-based compensation granted to nonemployees as payment for services rendered or acknowledged claims.

CF.label: Origination of Loans to Employee Stock Ownership Plans
CF.description: The cash outflow to finance the entity's defined contribution plan to acquire shares of the entity. The plan initially holds the shares in a suspense account, which is collateral for the loan. As the plan makes payment on the debt, the shares are released from the suspense account and become available to be allocated to participant accounts.

CF.label: Payment of Financing and Stock Issuance Costs
CF.description: The total of the cash outflow during the period which has been paid to third parties in connection with debt origination, which will be amortized over the remaining maturity period of the associated long-term debt and the cost incurred directly for the issuance of equity securities.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Deposit on Loan
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from resulting from payment, receipt or drawdown of cash deposit to guarantee a loan during the period.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Interest in Joint Venture
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the investment in or advances to an entity in which the reporting entity shares control of the entity with another party or group.

CF.label: Proceeds from Collection of Loans Held-for-sale
CF.description: The cash inflow from collection of repayments from borrowers on loans that are held with the intention to resell in the near future; includes mortgages and other types of loans.

CF.label: Proceeds from Interest Received
CF.description: Interest received on loans and other debt instruments during the current period.

CF.label: Proceeds from Repayment of Loans by Employee Stock Ownership Plans
CF.description: The cash inflow from the financed defined contribution plan to acquire shares of the entity. The plan initially holds the shares in a suspense account, which is collateral for the loan. As the plan makes payment on the debt, the shares are released from the suspense account and become available to be allocated to participant accounts.

CF.label: Repayments of Long-term Lines of Credit
CF.description: The cash outflow for the settlement of obligation drawn from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with maturities due beyond one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

CF.label: Dividends, Common Stock, Paid-in-kind
CF.description: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in payment-in-kind (PIK).

CF.label: Dividends, Paid-in-kind
CF.description: Amount of paid and unpaid paid-in-kind dividends (PIK) declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

CF.label: Employee Benefit and Share-based Payment Arrangement, Noncash
CF.description: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for employee benefits and share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, pension, other postretirement, postemployment and termination benefits.

CF.label: Foreign Currency Transaction Gain (Loss), Unrealized
CF.description: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from foreign currency transaction.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Taxes Payable
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of all taxes owed but not paid, including income, property and other taxes.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Broker-Dealer Related Receivables (Payables), Net
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables or payables that result from buying and selling securities for the firm's own account or from acting as an agent or intermediary in the sale of securities.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Receivables from Brokers-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due to the entity related to activities and operations with other broker dealers, and clearing organizations, including deposits.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Charges
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the value of expenditures made during the current reporting period for benefits that will be received over a period of years. Deferred charges differ from prepaid expenses in that they usually extend over a long period of time and may or may not be regularly recurring costs of operation.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposit Assets
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in moneys or securities given as security including, but not limited to, contract, escrow, or earnest money deposits, retainage (if applicable), deposits with clearing organizations and others, collateral, or margin deposits.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Noncurrent Assets
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in noncurrent assets classified as other.

CF.label: Net Change Interest and Noninterest-bearing Deposits, Domestic
CF.description: The increase (decrease) in domestic interest and noninterest bearing deposits.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Available-for-sale Securities, Short-term
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) through acquisition (sale) of short-term available-for-sale securities.

CF.label: Payments for Purchase of Securities, Operating Activities
CF.description: Cash paid to purchase debt and equity securities, classified as operating activities, during the period; includes trading securities and any other investments classified as operating.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Assets, Investing Activities
CF.description: Aggregate cash payments for a combination of transactions that are classified as investing activities in which assets, which may include securities, other types of investments, or productive assets, are purchased from third-party sellers. This element can be used by entities to aggregate payments for all asset purchases that are classified as investing activities.

CF.label: Payments to Purchase Mortgage Loans Held-for-sale
CF.description: The cash outflow used to purchase loans that are secured with real estate mortgage and are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

CF.label: Payments to Suppliers and Employees
CF.description: Cash payments to suppliers for goods and services provided and to employees for services provided.

CF.label: Proceeds from Collection of Finance Receivables
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the collection of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

CF.label: Proceeds from Fees Received
CF.description: Cash received for fees during the current period. This element excludes cash proceeds from license fees.

CF.label: Proceeds from Leases Held-for-investment
CF.description: The cash inflow from the sale of a lease held for investment, which may be a lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Short-term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
CF.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

CF.label: Proceeds from Securitizations of Consumer Loans
CF.description: The cash inflow from the securitization of receivables for loans to consumers. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

CF.label: Cost, Depreciation
CF.description: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of tangible asset over its useful life directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

CF.label: Debt Instrument, Increase (Decrease), Other, Net
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in debt instruments, classified as other.

CF.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Including Disposal Group and Discontinued Operations
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from effect of exchange rate change on cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; held in foreign currency; including, but not limited to, discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

CF.label: Gain on Business Interruption Insurance Recovery
CF.description: The net amount (to the extent disclosed within this portion of the income statement) by which an insurance settlement exceeds incremental costs incurred from the event causing an interruption of business, plus the insurance award for earnings lost from the event, such as a natural catastrophe, explosion or fire.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Cash Collateral for Borrowed Securities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of cash that is pledged as security when borrowing securities.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Revenue
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Notes Payable, Current
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in current portion (due within one year or one business cycle) of obligations evidenced by formal promissory notes.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Current Assets and Liabilities, Net
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in current operating assets after deduction of current operating liabilities classified as other.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Insurance
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for insurance that provides economic benefits in future periods.

CF.label: Payment to Acquire Life Insurance Policy, Operating Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for payment of premium on corporate-owned life insurance policy, classified as operating activities. Includes, but is not limited to, bank-owned life insurance policy.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
CF.description: The net cash outflow or inflow from derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Hedge, Investing Activities
CF.description: The cash outflow or inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Real Estate Partnership Investment, Net
CF.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from the sale or purchase of and distributions from real estate partnership investment during the period.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Lease Receivables
CF.description: The cash outflow for the purchase of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Leases Held-for-investment
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with purchasing leases held for investment purposes during an accounting period.

CF.label: Proceeds from Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities
CF.description: The cash inflow provided by derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

CF.label: ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefundStateAndLocal
CF.description: Amount of cash received from state and local tax jurisdictions for refund of tax on income.

CF.label: Proceeds from Lease Payment, Operating Activity
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from lease payment, classified as operating activity.

CF.label: Proceeds from Other Operating Activities
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from operating activity, classified as other.

CF.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Commercial Paper
CF.description: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from issuing (borrowing) and repaying commercial paper.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Lease Receivables
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent; excludes proceeds from sales-type lease transactions, which are classified as operating activities.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Receivables
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of receivables classified as other.

CF.label: Redemption Premium
CF.description: The excess of the (1) fair value of consideration transferred to the holders of a security in excess of (2) the carrying amount of the security reported on the registrant's balance sheet, which will be deducted from net earnings to derive net earnings available to common shareholders. This amount is generally an adjustment considered in the computation of earnings per share.

CF.label: Repayments of Medium-term Notes
CF.description: The cash outflow to pay off borrowing used to receive debt funding on a regular basis with maturities ranging from 5-10 years.

CF.label: Amortization of Deferred Sales Commissions
CF.description: The amount of expense recognized in the current period for the periodic realization of capitalized fees that were paid to salespeople, distributors, brokers, and agents at the time of the conclusion of the sale. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

CF.label: Business Acquisitions, Purchase Price Allocation, Year of Acquisition, Net Effect on Income
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in income before tax from accretion of discount (amortization of premium and intangible asset) in year of business combination when asset of acquired entity exceed 10 percent of consolidated assets.

CF.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Oil and Gas and Timber Property
CF.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of oil and gas property or timber property.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts and Other Receivables
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount due from customers for the credit sale of goods and services; includes accounts receivable and other types of receivables.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable and Other Operating Liabilities
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligations incurred but not paid, and operating obligations classified as other.

CF.label: Interest Costs Capitalized Adjustment
CF.description: Amount of interest costs capitalized disclosed as an adjusting item to interest costs incurred.

CF.label: Payments for Other Deposits
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for deposits classified as other.

CF.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Interest Earning Assets
CF.description: The net cash outflow or inflow for the increase (decrease) in other interest earning assets not separately disclosed.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Software
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition from vendors of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.

CF.label: Payments to Develop Software
CF.description: The cash outflow associated with the development or modification of software programs or applications for internal use (that is, not to be sold, leased or otherwise marketed to others) that qualify for capitalization.

CF.label: Proceeds from Lease Payment, Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Investing Activity
CF.description: Amount of cash inflow from principal payment received from sales-type and direct financing leases classified as investing activity.

CF.label: Proceeds from Repayment of Loans to Purchase Common Stock
CF.description: Cash inflow from repayment of loans for purchasing common stock.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Oil and Gas Property and Equipment
CF.description: The cash inflow to dispose of long-lived, physical assets and mineral interests in oil and gas properties used for normal oil and gas operations.

CF.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Real Estate Held-for-investment
CF.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of other real estate held for investment not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

CF.label: Proceeds from Securitizations of Loans Held-for-sale
CF.description: The cash inflow from securitizing loans held with the intention to resell in the near future.

CF.label: Cash and Securities Segregated under Securities Exchange Commission Regulation
CF.description: Cash and securities deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Cash Collateral for Loaned Securities
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of cash that is received as security when loaning securities.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due to Related Parties
CF.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of obligations to be paid to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entities' management; an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families; affiliates; or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Financial Instruments Used in Operating Activities
CF.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value of other financial instruments used in operating activities.

CF.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Policyholder Funds
CF.description: The change in other policyholder funds recorded on the balance sheet, which is needed to adjust net income to arrive at net cash flows provided by or used in operations.

CF.label: Notes Assumed
CF.description: The fair value of notes assumed in noncash investing or financing activities.

CF.label: PaymentsForPurchaseOfInvestmentOperatingActivity
CF.description: Amount of cash outflow for acquisition of investment, classified as operating activity. Includes, but is not limited to, funding, origination, drawdown, and participation in investment.

CF.label: Payments to Acquire Buildings
CF.description: The cash outflow for acquisition of buildings (properties) whether for investment or use.

CF.label: Proceeds from Collection of Mortgage Loans Held-for-sale
CF.description: The cash inflow from collection of repayments from borrowers on loans that are secured with real estate mortgages and are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

CF.label: Proceeds from Interest and Dividends Received
CF.description: Cash received for dividends and interest on the entity's equity and debt investments during the current period.

CF.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Medium-term Notes
CF.description: The cash inflow from a debt funding received on a regular basis with maturities ranging from 5-10 years.

unclassified.label: Entity Common Stock, Shares Outstanding
Entity Public Float
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of domestic federal statutory tax rate applicable to pretax income (loss).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation at Federal Statutory Income Tax Rate, Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of income tax expense or benefit for the period computed by applying the domestic federal statutory tax rates to pretax income from continuing operations.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after allocation of valuation allowances and deferred tax liability, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible differences and carryforwards, without jurisdictional netting.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Loss, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of unrealized loss in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Accumulated Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for 12 months or longer, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Accumulated Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for less than 12 months, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Gain, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for less than 12 months, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for more than 12 months, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Individually Evaluated for Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of financing receivable individually evaluated for credit loss. Excludes financing receivable collectively evaluated for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Individually Evaluated for Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable evaluated on individual basis. Excludes financing receivable evaluated on collective basis.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Collectively Evaluated for Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of financing receivable collectively evaluated for credit loss. Excludes financing receivable individually evaluated for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Collectively Evaluated for Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable evaluated on collective basis. Excludes financing receivable evaluated on individual basis.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Nonaccrual
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable on nonaccrual status. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Operating Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
unclassified.description: Weighted average discount rate for operating lease calculated at point in time.

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, Related Allowance
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit losses related to recorded investment.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax expense (benefit).

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, State and Local Income Taxes, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations applicable to state and local income tax expense (benefit), net of federal tax expense (benefit).

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Unrealized Loss Position

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease)
Deferred Tax Liabilities, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Year One
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Current Federal Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of current federal tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current national tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Unrealized Loss Position, Accumulated Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in unrealized loss position, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year One Through Five
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 5 Through 10
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in sixth through tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, Average Recorded Investment
unclassified.description: Average amount of investment of impaired financing receivables with related allowance for credit losses and without a related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences classified as other.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease due after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, Recorded Investment
unclassified.description: Amount of investment of impaired financing receivables with related allowance for credit losses and without a related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities
Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 10
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing after tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Current State and Local Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of current state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 5 Through 10
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in sixth through tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Modifications, Number of Contracts
unclassified.description: Number of financing receivables that have been modified by troubled debt restructurings.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year One Through Five
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Year One
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Adjustments, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other adjustments.

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Provision for Loan Losses
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from allowance for credit loss on financing receivable.

unclassified.label: Number of Reportable Segments
unclassified.description: Number of segments reported by the entity. A reportable segment is a component of an entity for which there is an accounting requirement to report separate financial information on that component in the entity's financial statements.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, Unpaid Principal Balance
unclassified.description: Amount of unpaid principal balance of impaired financing receivables with related allowance for credit losses and without related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 10
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing after tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from recovery.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Exempt Income, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Available-for-sale Securities
Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than Twelve Months, Fair Value
Financing Receivable, Troubled Debt Restructuring
unclassified.description: Accumulated amortized cost of financing receivable modified for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Twelve Months or Longer, Fair Value
Deferred State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, deferred regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Not Past Due
Available-for-sale Securities, Amortized Cost Basis
Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Four Years
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Three Years
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Two Years
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Available-for-sale Securities
Deferred Tax Liabilities, Property, Plant and Equipment
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Troubled Debt Restructuring, Postmodification
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable modified during period for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due, Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with Related Allowance, Recorded Investment
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in impaired financing receivables for which there is a related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Unrealized Losses on Available-for-Sale Securities, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Five Years
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Fair Value
Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Realized Gains
Impaired Financing Receivable, with No Related Allowance, Recorded Investment
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in impaired financing receivables for which there is no related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due Thereafter
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable letter-terms in excess of one year.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, New Issues
unclassified.description: Equity impact of the value of new stock issued during the period. Includes shares issued in an initial public offering or a secondary public offering.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, 90 Days or More Past Due, Still Accruing
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable 90 days or more past due and still accruing. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Exempt Income, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

unclassified.label: Dividends, Common Stock, Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Past Due
Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Realized Losses
Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, Interest Income, Accrual Method
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income recognized that the financing receivables (with related allowance for credit losses and without a related allowance for credit losses) were impaired.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Number
unclassified.description: Number of options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested options.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Unrealized Losses (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Unrealized Gains (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Troubled Debt Restructuring, Subsequent Default
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable with payment default in current period and modified within previous 12 months preceding payment default for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of unrecognized tax benefits.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Accumulated Unrecognized Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Accumulated Unrecognized Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrecognized gain on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period
unclassified.description: Number of share options (or share units) exercised during the current period.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Accumulated Loss
Fees and Commissions, Depositor Accounts (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Available-for-sale Securities, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Loss, before Tax
Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Gain, before Tax
Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Accumulated Loss
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average price at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance under the stock option plan.

unclassified.label: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Increase for Cost Recognition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Troubled Debt Restructuring, Subsequent Default, Number of Contracts
unclassified.description: Number of financing receivable contracts modified as troubled debt restructuring within previous 12 months, with subsequent payment default.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance
unclassified.description: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Related Parties
unclassified.description: For an unclassified balance sheet, reflects the carrying amount of unpaid loan amounts due from related parties at the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Aggregate Losses (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Banking Regulation, Total Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum total risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for operating lease having initial or remaining lease term in excess of one year to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum Tier 1 risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Securities, Net (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax assets for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Troubled Debt Restructuring, Premodification
unclassified.description: Amount, before troubled debt restructuring, of financing receivable to be modified.

unclassified.label: Number of Operating Segments
unclassified.description: Number of operating segments. An operating segment is a component of an enterprise: (a) that engages in business activities from which it may earn revenues and incur expenses (including revenues and expenses relating to transactions with other components of the same enterprise), (b) whose operating results are regularly reviewed by the enterprise's chief operating decision maker to make decisions about resources to be allocated to the segment and assess its performance, and (c) for which discrete financial information is available. An operating segment may engage in business activities for which it has yet to earn revenues, for example, start-up operations may be operating segments before earning revenues.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Actual
unclassified.description: Ratio of Tier 1 risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year One Through Five
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Accumulated Loss
Banking Regulation, Total Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Actual
unclassified.description: Ratio of total risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Leverage Capital Ratio, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum Tier 1 leverage capital to average assets required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Aggregate Losses (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Number
unclassified.description: The number of shares into which fully or partially vested stock options outstanding as of the balance sheet date can be currently converted under the option plan.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangements by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average price at which option holders acquired shares when converting their stock options into shares.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Year One
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Leverage Capital Ratio, Actual
unclassified.description: Ratio of Tier 1 capital to average assets as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Write-offs
unclassified.description: Amount of loans and leases that have been written off from both loan receivables and allowance reserve for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 5 Through 10
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in sixth through tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Aggregate Losses (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year One Through Five
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 10
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing after tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Related Parties, Additions
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in financing receivable from new loan. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Risk-Based Capital, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of Tier 1 risk-based capital as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Total Capital, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of total capital as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Nonaccrual, No Allowance
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable on nonaccrual status with no allowance for credit loss. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: The weighted-average price as of the balance sheet date at which grantees can acquire the shares reserved for issuance on vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable under the stock option plan.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Unrealized Loss Position, Number of Positions
unclassified.description: Number of investments in debt securities measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in unrealized loss position, without allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities, Continuing Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity attributable to continuing operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

unclassified.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities, Continuing Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity attributable to continuing operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

unclassified.label: Stock Repurchased During Period, Value
unclassified.description: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased during the period and has not been retired and is not held in treasury. Some state laws may mandate the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own stock and prescribe the accounting treatment therefore. This element is used when state law does not recognize treasury stock.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: Amount by which the current fair value of the underlying stock exceeds the exercise price of options outstanding.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 10
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing after tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after deferred tax asset, of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable differences without jurisdictional netting.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, after Year 5 Through 10
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in sixth through tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangements by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average per share amount at which grantees can acquire shares of common stock by exercise of options.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with Related Allowance, Unpaid Principal Balance
unclassified.description: Unpaid principal balance of impaired financing receivables for which there is a related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Recorded Investment, Equal to Greater than 90 Days Past Due (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Impaired Financing Receivable, with No Related Allowance, Unpaid Principal Balance
unclassified.description: Amount of unpaid principal balance of impaired financing receivables for which there is no related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Stock Options Exercised
unclassified.description: Value of stock issued as a result of the exercise of stock options.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Deferred Income
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred interest and fee income, unamortized costs incurred to originate loans and leases, unamortized loan commitments and loan syndication fees, and premiums over or discounts from face amounts of acquired loans. Excludes amounts for loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Leverage Capital, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of Tier 1 leverage capital as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossRecovery
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of increase in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from recovery. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in continuous unrealized loss position for less than 12 months.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Fair Value
