unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in continuous unrealized loss position for 12 months or longer.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Loss, Recovery of Bad Debts
unclassified.description: Amount of recovery of loans and lease receivables which had previously been fully or partially written-off as bad debts.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Realized Gain (Loss)
Defined Contribution Plan, Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of cost for defined contribution plan.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Recorded Investment, 30 to 59 Days Past Due (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Recorded Investment, 60 to 89 Days Past Due (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Banking Regulation, Tier One Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Well Capitalized, Minimum
unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum Tier 1 risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

unclassified.label: Treasury Stock, Value, Acquired, Cost Method
unclassified.description: Equity impact of the cost of common and preferred stock that were repurchased during the period. Recorded using the cost method.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Debt Maturities, Amortized Cost Basis (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Treasury Stock, Shares
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Enacted Tax Rate, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to increase (decrease) in the income tax rates.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Nonaccrual, Interest Income
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income on financing receivable on nonaccrual status.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Total Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Well Capitalized, Minimum
unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum total risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Unrealized Loss Position, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in unrealized loss position.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach). Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Other, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other nondeductible expenses.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Related Parties, Proceeds
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in financing receivable from proceeds for repayment of loan. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Accumulated Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in continuous loss position for 12 months or longer.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Accumulated Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in continuous loss position for less than 12 months.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period
unclassified.description: The number of shares under options that were cancelled during the reporting period as a result of occurrence of a terminating event specified in contractual agreements pertaining to the stock option plan.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Fair Value Disclosure (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: Amount of difference between fair value of the underlying shares reserved for issuance and exercise price of vested portions of options outstanding and currently exercisable.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Leverage Capital Ratio, Well Capitalized, Minimum
unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum Tier 1 leverage capital to average assets categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Rent Expense, Net
unclassified.description: Rental expense for the reporting period incurred under operating leases, including minimum and any contingent rent expense, net of related sublease income.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period, Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated difference between fair value of underlying shares on dates of exercise and exercise price on options exercised (or share units converted) into shares.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Other, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other nondeductible expenses.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Dividend Rate
unclassified.description: The estimated dividend rate (a percentage of the share price) to be paid (expected dividends) to holders of the underlying shares over the option's term.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Leasing Arrangements
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from leasing arrangements.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Rent Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of rent expense incurred for leased assets, including but not limited to, furniture and equipment, that is not directly or indirectly associated with the manufacture, sale or creation of a product or product line.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate
unclassified.description: The risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing an option on its own shares.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from intangible assets other than goodwill.

unclassified.label: NetFeeAmt
TtlFeeAmt
TtlOfferingAmt
Banking Regulation, Total Risk-Based Capital, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum total risk-based capital required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Loans Receivable, Net (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Banking Regulation, Tier One Risk-Based Capital, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum Tier 1 risk-based capital required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: The weighted average grant-date fair value of options granted during the reporting period as calculated by applying the disclosed option pricing methodology.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangements by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average price at which grantees could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to stock options that were terminated.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of cost not yet recognized for nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestNonaccrual
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable on nonaccrual status. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearOneOriginatedCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable originated in current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Troubled Debt Restructuring, Commitment to Lend
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment to lend additional funds to debtor experiencing financial difficulty for which creditor has modified terms of financing receivable.

unclassified.label: Shares Issued, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, after Forfeiture
unclassified.description: Value, after forfeiture, of shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: TtlOffsetAmt
FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearFourOriginatedThreeYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable originated three years prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearThreeOriginatedTwoYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable originated two years prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearTwoOriginatedFiscalYearBeforeCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest of financing receivable originated in fiscal year prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestOriginatedMoreThanFiveYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable originated more than five years prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearFiveOriginatedFourYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable originated four years prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with Related Allowance, Average Recorded Investment
unclassified.description: Amount of average investment of impaired financing receivables for which there is a related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Related Parties, Collections (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Related Party Deposit Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of deposits held by the entity for a related party (entity, shareholder, employee).

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Leverage Capital, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum Tier 1 leverage capital required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Mortgage Servicing Rights
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from mortgage servicing rights.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate
unclassified.description: The estimated measure of the percentage by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during a period. Volatility also may be defined as a probability-weighted measure of the dispersion of returns about the mean. The volatility of a share price is the standard deviation of the continuously compounded rates of return on the share over a specified period. That is the same as the standard deviation of the differences in the natural logarithms of the stock prices plus dividends, if any, over the period.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Aggregate Loss (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, without Single Maturity Date, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), without single maturity date and not allocated over maturity grouping.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with No Related Allowance, Average Recorded Investment
unclassified.description: Amount of average investment of impaired financing receivables for which there is no related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, before Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Stock Issued During Period, Shares, New Issues
unclassified.description: Number of new stock issued during the period.

unclassified.label: Treasury Stock, Shares, Acquired
unclassified.description: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period and are being held in treasury.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Aggregate Loss (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to tax credits. Including, but not limited to, research credit, foreign tax credit, investment tax credit, and other tax credits.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestRevolving
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable that can be withdrawn, repaid, and redrawn.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Unrealized Loss Position, Accumulated Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), in unrealized loss position.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, without Single Maturity Date, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), without single maturity date and not allocated over maturity grouping.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments
unclassified.description: The amount by which the fair value of an investment is less than the amortized cost basis or carrying amount of that investment at the balance sheet date and the decline in fair value is deemed to be other than temporary, before considering whether or not such amount is recognized in earnings or other comprehensive income.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Year Five, Originated, Four Years before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable originated four years prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Year One, Originated, Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable originated in current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Year Two, Originated, Fiscal Year before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable originated in fiscal year prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Year Four, Originated, Three Years before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable originated three years prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Year Three, Originated, Two Years before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable originated two years prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Aggregate Loss (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestModifiedPeriod
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable modified during period for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Originated, More than Five Years before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable originated more than five years prior to current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Stock Repurchased During Period, Shares
unclassified.description: Number of shares that have been repurchased during the period and have not been retired and are not held in treasury. Some state laws may govern the circumstances under which an entity may acquire its own stock and prescribe the accounting treatment therefore. This element is used when state law does not recognize treasury stock.

unclassified.label: Fees and Commissions, Fiduciary and Trust Activities (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Revolving
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable that can be withdrawn, repaid, and redrawn.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Unrealized Loss
Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accrued interest on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities Pledged as Collateral (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestNonaccrualNoAllowance
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable on nonaccrual status with no allowance for credit loss. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Unrealized Gain
Defined Contribution Plan, Employer Matching Contribution, Percent of Employees' Gross Pay
unclassified.description: Percentage of employees' gross pay for which the employer contributes a matching contribution to a defined contribution plan.

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Cumulative Effect of New Accounting Principle in Period of Adoption (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Share-based Compensation Cost
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from share-based compensation.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestOriginatedMoreThanFiveYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of financing receivable originated more than five years before current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Variable Lease, Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of variable lease cost, excluded from lease liability, recognized when obligation for payment is incurred for finance and operating leases.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearThreeOriginatedTwoYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of financing receivable originated two years before current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearFiveOriginatedFourYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of financing receivable originated four years before current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearFourOriginatedThreeYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of financing receivable originated three years before current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearTwoOriginatedFiscalYearBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of financing receivable originated in fiscal year before current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, Interest Lost on Nonaccrual Loans
unclassified.description: Reflects the amount of additional interest income that would have been recorded if impaired or nonperforming loans were instead current, in compliance with their original terms, and outstanding throughout the reporting period or since origination (if held for part of the period).

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Reclassification from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income, Current Period, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Unrealized Gains on Trading Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from unrealized gains on trading securities.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Number of Shares Available for Grant
unclassified.description: The difference between the maximum number of shares (or other type of equity) authorized for issuance under the plan (including the effects of amendments and adjustments), and the sum of: 1) the number of shares (or other type of equity) already issued upon exercise of options or other equity-based awards under the plan; and 2) shares (or other type of equity) reserved for issuance on granting of outstanding awards, net of cancellations and forfeitures, if applicable.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Accretable Yield
unclassified.description: Amount of the excess of a loan's cash flows expected to be collected over the investor's initial investment in acquired loans not accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Accretable Yield, Accretion
unclassified.description: Amount of accretion recognized for the excess of a loan's cash flows expected to be collected over the investor's initial investment in acquired loans not accounted for as debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Common Equity Tier One Risk-Based Capital, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of Common Equity Tier 1 risk-based capital as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestYearOneOriginatedCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of financing receivable originated in current fiscal year. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Short-term Lease, Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of short-term lease cost, excluding expense for lease with term of one month or less.

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Employer Discretionary Contribution Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of discretionary contributions made by an employer to a defined contribution plan.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Prepaid Expenses
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax consequences attributable to taxable temporary differences derived from prepaid expenses.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Enacted Tax Rate, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in the income tax rates.

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Mortgage Loans in Process of Foreclosure, Amount
unclassified.description: Recorded investment of consumer mortgage loan receivables secured by residential real estate properties for which formal foreclosure proceedings are in process.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period
unclassified.description: The number of grants made during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

unclassified.label: NonPeoNeoAvgCompActuallyPaidAmt
NonPeoNeoAvgTotalCompAmt
Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income and other comprehensive income. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Modifications, Number of Contracts (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Value
unclassified.description: Equity impact of the value of stock that has been repurchased and retired during the period. The excess of the purchase price over par value can be charged against retained earnings (once the excess is fully allocated to additional paid in capital).

unclassified.label: TotalShareholderRtnAmt
Dividends, Preferred Stock, Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash.

unclassified.label: Fees and Commissions, Other (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Expected Amortization, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for finite-lived intangible asset expected to be recognized in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Common Equity Tier One Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Actual
unclassified.description: Ratio of Common Equity Tier 1 risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Number of Shares Authorized
unclassified.description: Number of shares authorized for issuance under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Number of Positions
Deferred Tax Liabilities, Investments
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from investments (excludes investments in subsidiaries and equity method investments).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) in excess of (less than) expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Includes, but is not limited to, expense determined to be nondeductible upon grant or after for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification and Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Gross Liability
unclassified.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax, after reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

unclassified.label: TtlPrevslyPdAmt
Financing Receivables, Impaired, Troubled Debt Restructuring, Write-down
unclassified.description: Reflects the amount of the write-down related to a troubled debt restructuring.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: The weighted average fair value at grant date for nonvested equity-based awards issued during the period on other than stock (or unit) option plans (for example, phantom stock or unit plan, stock or unit appreciation rights plan, performance target plan).

unclassified.label: Stock Redeemed or Called During Period, Value
unclassified.description: Equity impact of the value of stock bought back by the entity at the exercise price or redemption price.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Recoveries of Bad Debts (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Banking Regulation, Total Risk-Based Capital, Well Capitalized, Minimum
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum total risk-based capital categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Employer Matching Contribution, Percent of Match
unclassified.description: Percentage employer matches of the employee's percentage contribution matched.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Held-to-maturity Securities, Unrecognized Holding Gain (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Impaired Financing Receivable, with No Related Allowance, Interest Income, Accrual Method
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income, recognized on accrual basis, on financing receivables that are recognized as impaired, for which there is no related allowance for credit losses.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible expenses.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Net of Forfeitures
unclassified.description: Value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards issued during the period, net of the stock value of such awards forfeited.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Gross Asset
unclassified.description: Fair value, before effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestRevolvingWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of financing receivable that can be withdrawn, repaid, and redrawn.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Reclassifications, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Risk-Based Capital, Well Capitalized, Minimum
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum Tier 1 risk-based capital categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of a valuation allowances, of deferred tax assets attributable to deductible tax credit carryforwards including, but not limited to, research, foreign, general business, alternative minimum tax, and other deductible tax credit carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation, Financing Activities
Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, General Debt Obligations, Disclosures, Collateral Pledged
unclassified.description: Amount of the collateral pledged in support of federal home loan bank advances outstanding.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, Interest Income, Cash Basis Method
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income recognized on a cash-basis method of accounting that the financing receivables (with related allowance for credit losses and without a related allowance for credit losses) were impaired.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with Related Allowance, Interest Income, Accrual Method
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income, recognized on accrual basis, on financing receivables, for which there is a related allowance for credit losses and are recognized as impaired.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Contributions by Employer
unclassified.description: Amount of contribution received by defined benefit plan from employer which increases plan assets.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, General Debt Obligations, Amount of Available, Unused Funds
unclassified.description: Amount of advances or credit lines available from the Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB).

unclassified.label: Derivative, Notional Amount
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Sublease Income
unclassified.description: Amount of sublease income excluding finance and operating lease expense.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Current Period Tax Positions
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions that have been or will be taken in current period tax return.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period
unclassified.description: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that vested during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from compensation and benefits costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Employee Compensation
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from employee compensation.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of asset segregated and restricted to provide benefit under defined benefit plan. Asset includes, but is not limited to, stock, bond, other investment, earning from investment, and contribution by employer and employee.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Modifications, Post-Modification Recorded Investment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Held-to-maturity Securities, Unrecognized Holding Loss (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Nonvested, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: Per share or unit weighted-average fair value of nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

unclassified.label: Unamortized Loan Commitment and Origination Fees and Unamortized Discounts or Premiums
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred fees paid by borrowers and unamortized costs incurred to originate loans and leases, unamortized loan commitments and loan syndication fees, and premiums over or discounts from face amounts of loans that are being amortized into income as an adjustment to yield. Excludes amounts for loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Accrued Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from accrued liabilities.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Operating Loss Carryforwards
unclassified.description: Amount of operating loss carryforward, before tax effects, available to reduce future taxable income under enacted tax laws.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion Recognized in Earnings, Net
Banking Regulation, Tier One Leverage Capital, Well Capitalized, Minimum
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum Tier 1 leverage capital categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Reduction Resulting from Lapse of Applicable Statute of Limitations
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from lapses of applicable statutes of limitations.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Net Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of pro forma income (loss) of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Notional Amount
unclassified.description: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payment on derivative.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits that Would Impact Effective Tax Rate
unclassified.description: The total amount of unrecognized tax benefits that, if recognized, would affect the effective tax rate.

unclassified.label: Dividends, Common Stock
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid common stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in cash, stock and payment-in-kind (PIK).

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Nonvested Award, Option, Cost Not yet Recognized, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of cost to be recognized for option under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Other, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other tax credits.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Maximum Borrowing Capacity
unclassified.description: Maximum borrowing capacity under the credit facility without consideration of any current restrictions on the amount that could be borrowed or the amounts currently outstanding under the facility.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Investments
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from investments (excludes investments in subsidiaries and equity method investments).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Life Insurance, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible life insurance expense.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification of gain (loss) from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax (expense) benefit for (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives Arising During Period, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), before reclassification adjustments, related to increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Available-for-sale Securities
Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Prior Period Tax Positions
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions taken in prior period tax returns.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible expenses.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeited in Period
unclassified.description: The number of equity-based payment instruments, excluding stock (or unit) options, that were forfeited during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: PeoActuallyPaidCompAmt
Affordable Housing Tax Credits and Other Tax Benefits, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount, before amortization expense, of income tax credit and other tax benefit generated by investment under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Accretable Yield, Additions
unclassified.description: Amount of additions to the excess of a loan's cash flows expected to be collected over the investor's initial investment in acquired loans not accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Change in Deferred Tax Assets Valuation Allowance, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to changes in the valuation allowance for deferred tax assets.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableModificationToTotalFinancingReceivablesExcludingAccruedInterestPercent
unclassified.description: Percentage, excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable modified during period for debtor experiencing financial difficulty to total financing receivables.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Modifications, Subsequent Default, Recorded Investment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Letters of Credit Outstanding, Amount
unclassified.description: The total amount of the contingent obligation under letters of credit outstanding as of the reporting date.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: The weighted average fair value as of grant date pertaining to an equity-based award plan other than a stock (or unit) option plan for which the grantee gained the right during the reporting period, by satisfying service and performance requirements, to receive or retain shares or units, other instruments, or cash in accordance with the terms of the arrangement.

unclassified.label: PeoTotalCompAmt
Deferred Tax Assets, Property, Plant and Equipment
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Interest Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of cost recognized for passage of time related to defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to nondeductible expense for share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Modifications, Pre-Modification Recorded Investment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Held-to-maturity Securities, Debt Maturities, Fair Value (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of gain (loss) for (increase) decrease in value of benefit obligation for change in actuarial assumptions and increase (decrease) in value of plan assets from experience different from that assumed of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Stock Repurchase Program, Number of Shares Authorized to be Repurchased
Treasury Stock Acquired, Average Cost Per Share
unclassified.description: Total cost of shares repurchased divided by the total number of shares repurchased.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation
Banking Regulation, Common Equity Tier One Risk-Based Capital, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum Common Equity Tier 1 risk-based capital required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Maximum Annual Contributions Per Employee, Percent
unclassified.description: Maximum percentage of employee gross pay the employee may contribute to a defined contribution plan.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Other, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other tax credits.

unclassified.label: Fees and Commissions, Mortgage Banking (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Reclassification Adjustment, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, after reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Weighted Average Interest Rate, at Point in Time
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of short-term debt outstanding calculated at point in time.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses Write-offs, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after recoveries, of loans and leases that have been written-off.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeitures, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: Weighted average fair value as of the grant date of equity-based award plans other than stock (unit) option plans that were not exercised or put into effect as a result of the occurrence of a terminating event.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Settlements with Taxing Authorities
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from settlements with taxing authorities.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Number of Positions
unclassified.description: Number of investments in debt securities measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for 12 months or longer, without an allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from asset measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank Advances
unclassified.description: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) advances to member financial institutions.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterest90DaysOrMorePastDueStillAccruing
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable 90 days or more past due and still accruing. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Held-to-maturity Securities, Debt Maturities, Net Carrying Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Accrued
unclassified.description: Amount accrued for interest on an underpayment of income taxes and penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of right to receive cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative liabilities.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Investment, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to investment tax credit.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment, Credit Losses Recognized in Earnings, Credit Losses on Debt Securities Held
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated credit loss recognized in earnings for debt security held for which portion of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) was recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI).

unclassified.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits. Also includes short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, General Debt Obligations, Maximum Amount Available
unclassified.description: Amount of maximum advances or credit lines available from the Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB).

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Modifications, Subsequent Default, Number of Contracts (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Sale of Securities Included in Net Income, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period
unclassified.description: Number of options or other stock instruments for which the right to exercise has lapsed under the terms of the plan agreements.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Provision for Loss, Gross (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage
unclassified.description: Contractual interest rate for funds borrowed, under the debt agreement.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Goodwill and Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from intangible assets including goodwill.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Collateral, Obligation to Return Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative assets.

unclassified.label: Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation, Operating Activities
Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Qualified Affordable Housing Project Investments, Commitment
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment and contingent commitment, including amount of delayed equity contribution, for investment that generates income tax credit and other income tax benefit under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, commitment and contingent commitment related to investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

unclassified.label: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost, Additions
unclassified.description: Amount of additions from purchases, assumption or transfer to contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payment, Due
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

unclassified.label: State and Local Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of current and deferred state and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current and deferred regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of asset recognized for present right to economic benefit.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Carrying Amount, Net
unclassified.description: The recorded balance, net of any applicable reductions (for example, unamortized accretable yield and allowance for loan losses). This relates to loans not accounted for debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that were acquired by completion of a transfer for which it is probable, at acquisition, that the investor will be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Derivatives
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from derivatives.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Service Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of cost for actuarial present value of benefits attributed to service rendered by employee for defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Weighted Average Discount Rate, Percent
unclassified.description: Weighted average discount rate for finance lease calculated at point in time.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestRevolvingConvertedToTermLoan
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of revolving financing receivable converted to term loan.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Other Reconciling Items, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation attributable to other reconciling item. Excludes state and local income tax expense (benefit), federal tax expense (benefit), statutory income tax expense (benefit) outside of country of domicile, tax credit, nondeductible expense, deduction, income tax settlement, income tax contingency, and cross-border tax law.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangements by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average price at which grantees could have acquired the underlying shares with respect to stock options of the plan that expired.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff, after Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount, after recovery, of writeoff of financing receivable, charged against allowance for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Share Price
unclassified.description: Price of a single share of a number of saleable stocks of a company.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Amortized Cost, before Other-than-temporary Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount, before other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) accretion, of investment in debt securities measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Payments for Repurchase of Warrants
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount paid by the entity to reacquire the right to purchase equity shares at a predetermined price, usually issued together with corporate debt.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period
unclassified.description: For presentations that combine terminations, the number of shares under options that were cancelled during the reporting period as a result of occurrence of a terminating event specified in contractual agreements pertaining to the stock option plan or that expired.

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Average Outstanding Amount
unclassified.description: For the form of debt having an initial term of less than one year or less than the normal operating cycle, if longer, average borrowings during the period.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Undiscounted Excess Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments in excess of discounted obligation for lease payments for finance lease.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Mortgage Loans (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Acquisitions

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, Alternative Minimum Tax

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Debt Issuance Costs

unclassified.label: Finite-lived Intangible Assets Acquired
