unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date.

unclassified.label: Held-to-maturity Securities, Unrecognized Holding Gain (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of gain (loss) for (increase) decrease in value of benefit obligation for change in actuarial assumptions and increase (decrease) in value of plan assets from experience different from that assumed of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Buildings and Improvements, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of building structures held for productive use including addition, improvement, or renovation to the structure, including, but not limited to, interior masonry, interior flooring, electrical, and plumbing.

unclassified.label: Collateral Already Posted, Aggregate Fair Value
unclassified.description: The aggregate fair value of assets that are already posted, at the end of the reporting period, as collateral for derivative instruments with credit-risk-related contingent features.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Actuarial Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from change in actuarial assumptions which (increases) decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Assumptions include, but are not limited to, interest, mortality, employee turnover, salary, and temporary deviation from substantive plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Weighted average rate for present value of future retirement benefits cash flows, used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Expected Long-term Rate of Return on Plan Assets
unclassified.description: Weighted average rate of return on plan assets, reflecting average rate of earnings expected on existing plan assets and expected contributions, used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Acquired with Deteriorated Credit Quality (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Loans Pledged as Collateral
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for reclassification of gain (loss) from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment, Credit Losses Recognized in Earnings, Additions, Additional Credit Losses
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in accumulated credit loss recognized in earnings for other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) of debt security held for which previous OTTI was recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI), investor does not intend to sell debt security, and it is not more likely than not that investor will be required to sell debt security before recovery of its amortized cost basis.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Net of Forfeitures
unclassified.description: Net number of share options (or share units) granted during the period.

unclassified.label: PeerGroupTotalShareholderRtnAmt
Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cumulative Changes in Net Gain (Loss) from Cash Flow Hedges, Effect Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Accumulated change, net of tax, in accumulated gains and losses from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges. Includes an entity's share of an equity investee's Increase or Decrease in deferred hedging gains or losses.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Accretable Yield, Reclassifications from Nonaccretable Difference
unclassified.description: Amount of increase of reclassification from nonaccretable difference to the excess of a loan's cash flows expected to be collected over the investor's initial investment in acquired loans not accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Gross Liability
unclassified.description: Fair value of liability associated with financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification of gain (loss) from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Shares Outstanding
unclassified.description: The number of shares reserved for issuance pertaining to the outstanding stock options as of the balance sheet date for all option plans in the customized range of exercise prices.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Restricted Stock Award, Gross
unclassified.description: Aggregate value of stock related to Restricted Stock Awards issued during the period.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Derivative Instruments
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from derivative instruments.

unclassified.label: Earnings Per Share, Basic and Diluted
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Investment, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to investment tax credit.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Maturity, without Single Maturity Date, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), without single maturity date and not allocated over maturity grouping.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Maturity, without Single Maturity Date, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) without single maturity date and not allocated over maturity grouping.

unclassified.label: Held-to-maturity Securities, Unrecognized Holding Loss (Deprecated 2018-01-31)

Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties and Interest Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for interest on an underpayment of income taxes and penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of allowance reserve for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Realized Gains (Losses), Sale Proceeds (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Number of Positions
unclassified.description: Number of investments in debt securities measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), in continuous unrealized loss position for less than 12 months, without an allowance for credit loss. Includes beneficial interest in securitized financial asset.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, after Year Five for Next Five Years
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in five fiscal years after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Return (Loss) on Plan Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of expected return (loss) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit, calculated based on expected long-term rate of return and market-related value of plan assets of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. unclassified.label: Loans Receivable, Net (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Acquired During Period, at Acquisition, at Fair Value

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Life Insurance, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to life insurance expense.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset Transfers Into Level 3
unclassified.description: Amount of transfer of financial instrument classified as an asset into level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Bank Servicing Fees (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Valuation Allowance, Deferred Tax Asset, Increase (Decrease), Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for a specified deferred tax asset.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Rolling within One Year, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next rolling fiscal year following latest fiscal year. unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Rolling after Five Through Ten Years, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security, measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in rolling sixth through tenth fiscal year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Rolling after One Through Five Years, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security, measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next rolling fiscal year through fifth year following latest fiscal year. unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Impairment Losses
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from estimated impairment losses.

unclassified.label: Deposit Liabilities Reclassified as Loans Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount of deposits held by the entity that have been reclassified as loan balances receivable, for example, but not limited to, overdrafts receivable.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Gross Asset
unclassified.description: Fair value of asset associated with financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossWriteoffAfterRecovery
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of decrease (increase) in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from writeoff (recovery). Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.description: Amortized cost of revolving financing receivable converted to term loan.

unclassified.description: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income of accumulated gain (loss) realized from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment, Credit Losses Recognized in Earnings, Additions, No Previous Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in accumulated credit loss recognized in earnings for other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) of debt security held for which no OTTI was previously recognized.

unclassified.description: Amount of other addition (reduction) in allowance reserve for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Rolling within One Year, Amortized Cost

unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing after rolling tenth fiscal year following latest fiscal year. unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Rolling after 10 Years, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing after rolling tenth fiscal year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Rolling after Five Through Ten Years, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security, measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in rolling sixth through tenth fiscal year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Rolling after One Through Five Years, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next rolling fiscal year through fifth year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations, Adjustment of Deferred Tax (Asset) Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) from continuing operations attributable to an adjustment of a deferred tax liability or asset for enacted changes in tax laws or rates or a change in the tax status of the entity.

unclassified.label: OCI, before Reclassifications, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount after tax, before reclassification adjustments, of other comprehensive income (loss), attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax and Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan, attributable to parent.

unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum Common Equity Tier 1 risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.description: Amount of pro forma revenue of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from postretirement benefits.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other Comprehensive Income
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from unrealized gains in other comprehensive income.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Funded (Unfunded) Status of Plan
unclassified.description: Amount of funded (unfunded) status of defined benefit plan, measured as difference between fair value of plan assets and benefit obligation. Includes, but is not limited to, overfunded (underfunded) status.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Expense (Benefit), Share-based Payment Arrangement, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes expense determined to be nondeductible upon grant or after for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from asset measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestModifiedSubsequentDefault
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable with payment default in current period and modified within previous 12 months preceding payment default for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestPurchasedWithCreditDeteriorationAllowanceForCreditLossAtAcquisitionDate
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss at acquisition date of financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestRevolvingConvertedToTermLoanWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of writeoff of revolving financing receivable converted to term loan.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Assets, Level 2 to Level 1 Transfers, Amount

unclassified.description: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as an asset out of level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Allowance for Credit Loss at Acquisition Date

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Shares Exercisable
unclassified.description: The number of shares reserved for issuance pertaining to the outstanding exercisable stock options as of the balance sheet date in the customized range of exercise prices for which the market and performance vesting condition has been satisfied.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Common Equity Tier One Risk-Based Capital, Well Capitalized, Minimum
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum Common Equity Tier 1 risk-based capital categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossMaturityAllocatedAndSingleMaturityDateAfterYear5Through10
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in sixth through tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Capital Loss Carryforwards
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible capital loss carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Amount at Purchase Price
unclassified.description: Amount at purchase price of financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Future Amortization Expense, Year One (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Future Amortization Expense, Year Two (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor for operating lease.

unclassified.label: Pledged Financial Instruments, Not Separately Reported, Securities
Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic and Diluted

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Outstanding Balance
unclassified.description: The undiscounted sum of all amounts, including amounts deemed principal, interest, fees, penalties, and other under the loan, owed to the investor at the reporting date, whether or not currently due and whether or not any such amounts have been written or charged off by the investor. unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Earnings Per Share, Basic
unclassified.description: Per basic share amount, after tax, of pro forma income (loss) of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Cash and Equivalents

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accrued interest on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossMaturityAllocatedAndSingleMaturityDateYearOne
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Deferred Income
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from deferred income.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Amount Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset. Includes derivative not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income tax contingencies. Includes, but not limited to, domestic tax contingency, foreign tax contingency, state and local tax contingency, and other contingencies.

unclassified.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Tax Benefit Realized from Exercise of Stock Options (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Increase
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss for financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Future Amortization Expense, Year Four (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Future Amortization Expense, Year Three (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Held-to-maturity Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Aggregate Losses (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in income tax contingencies. Including, but not limited to, domestic tax contingency, foreign tax contingency, state and local tax contingency, and other contingencies.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Nonperforming, Nonaccrual of Interest
unclassified.description: Reflects the carrying amount of loans deemed to be questionable as to collection on which no interest is continuing to be recognized.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax, Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Statutory Accounting Practices, Statutory Amount Available for Dividend Payments without Regulatory Approval
unclassified.description: Amount of dividends that can be declared or paid without approval of regulatory agency.

unclassified.label: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Balance
unclassified.description: Reflects the estimated amount of impairment as of the balance sheet date of recognized servicing assets that are being amortized in proportion to and over the period of estimated net servicing income or loss.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Acquired During Period, Cash Flows Expected to be Collected at Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of cash flows expected to be collected at acquisition of acquired loans not accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Class of Warrant or Right, Exercise Price of Warrants or Rights (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Transfers, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of transfer of financial instrument classified as an asset into (out of) level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Exercisable, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted average exercise price as of the balance sheet date for those equity-based payment arrangements exercisable and outstanding.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Option, Exercise Price Range, Outstanding, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: The weighted average price as of the balance sheet date at which grantees could acquire the underlying shares with respect to all outstanding stock options which are in the customized range of exercise prices.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Provision for Loss, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Available-for-sale, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Number of Positions (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Aggregate Losses (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Aggregate Losses (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other than Temporary Impairments
Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Earnings Per Share, Diluted
unclassified.description: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of pro forma income (loss) of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

unclassified.label: Cash Reserve Deposit Required and Made
unclassified.description: Cash deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers pursuant to SEC Regulations.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Employee Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from employee benefits, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Benefits Paid
unclassified.description: Amount of payment to participant of defined benefit plan which decreases benefit obligation. For pension plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, pension benefits and death benefits. For other postretirement plan, payment includes, but is not limited to, prescription drug benefits, health care benefits, life insurance benefits, and legal, educational and advisory services.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Amount Not Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value, after offset of derivative liability, of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, before offset against an obligation to return collateral under a master netting arrangement. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Cash Received from Exercise of Stock Options (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Future Amortization Expense, Year Five (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Held-to-maturity, Securities in Unrealized Loss Positions, Qualitative Disclosure, Number of Positions
unclassified.description: Number of investment positions in unrealized loss position for held-to-maturity security where cost exceeds fair value and its impairment is not other-than-temporary.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Remaining Borrowing Capacity
unclassified.description: Amount of borrowing capacity currently available under the credit facility (current borrowing capacity less the amount of borrowings outstanding).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after reclassification, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: OCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer from Held-to-Maturity, Gain (Loss), before Adjustment, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and before adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from transfer to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Outstanding, Number
unclassified.description: Number of fully vested and expected to vest options outstanding that can be converted into shares under option plan. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Dividend Reinvestment Plan
unclassified.description: Value of stock issued during the period from a dividend reinvestment plan (DRIP). A dividend reinvestment plan allows the holder of the stock to reinvest dividends paid to them by the entity on new issues of stock by the entity.

unclassified.label: Stock Repurchased and Retired During Period, Shares
unclassified.description: Number of shares that have been repurchased and retired during the period.

unclassified.label: Stockholders' Equity Note, Stock Split, Conversion Ratio
unclassified.description: Ratio applied to the conversion of stock split, for example but not limited to, one share converted to two or two shares converted to one.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Amount Not Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value, after offset of derivative asset, of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, elected not to be and before offset against a right to receive collateral under a master netting arrangement. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Net Liability Position, Aggregate Fair Value
unclassified.description: The aggregate fair value amounts of derivative instruments that contain credit-risk-related contingent features that are in a net liability position at the end of the reporting period. For nonderivative instruments that are designated and qualify as hedging instruments, the fair value amounts are the carrying value of the nonderivative hedging instrument, including the adjustment for the foreign currency transaction gain (loss) on that instrument.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Disclosure, Off-balance Sheet Risks, Amount, Liability
unclassified.description: The fair value of financial liabilities, which are not recognized in the financial statements (off-balance sheet) because they fail to meet some other criterion for recognition.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Acquired with Deteriorated Credit Quality (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Furniture and Fixtures, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of equipment commonly used in offices and stores that have no permanent connection to the structure of a building or utilities. Examples include, but are not limited to, desks, chairs, tables, and bookcases.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Related Parties, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in financing receivable. Excludes financing receivable covered under loss sharing agreement and net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Unused Commitments to Extend Credit
unclassified.description: Unused amount of commitments to extend credit to customers.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Decrease for Tax Withholding Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease to equity for grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Class of Warrant or Right, Number of Securities Called by Warrants or Rights
unclassified.description: Number of securities into which the class of warrant or right may be converted. For example, but not limited to, 500,000 warrants may be converted into 1,000,000 shares.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Purchases
unclassified.description: Amount of purchases of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Call Options and Warrants
unclassified.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of call options and warrants using the treasury stock method.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payment to be Received, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payment to be received by lessor for operating lease in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Loans Receivable Held-for-sale, Net, Not Part of Disposal Group, Mortgage (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Other Real Estate, Disposals
unclassified.description: Disposals of other real estate not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. This excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure.

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposit maturing in remainder of current fiscal year. Time deposit includes, but is not limited to, certificate of deposit.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Property, Plant, and Equipment
unclassified.description: Amount of property, plant, and equipment acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Acquired During Period, Contractually Required Payments Receivable at Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of contractually required payments receivable at acquisition of acquired loans not accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Goodwill and Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from intangible assets including goodwill.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Average Interest Rate, Year One
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) due in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Short-term (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestModifiedPast12Months
unclassified.description: Amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable 12 months after modification for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Sold, Realized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), including other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

unclassified.label: Investments, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of investment securities, including, but not limited to, marketable securities, derivative financial instruments, and investments accounted for under the equity method.

unclassified.label: Other Commitment
unclassified.description: Minimum amount of other commitment not otherwise specified in the taxonomy. Excludes commitments explicitly modeled in the taxonomy, including but not limited to, long-term and short-term purchase commitments, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, supply commitments, registration payment arrangements, leases, debt, product warranties, guarantees, environmental remediation obligations, and pensions.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI on Derivatives, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income of accumulated gain (loss) realized from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Reclassification from AOCI to Retained Earnings, Tax Effect
Available-for-sale Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Aggregate Losses (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Derivative, Collateral, Obligation to Return Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return securities collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative assets.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of right to receive securities collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative liabilities.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Average Interest Rate, Year Three
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) due in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Penalties and Interest Expense
unclassified.description: The sum of the amounts of estimated penalties and interest recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax, after reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Accretion of Redemption Discount
unclassified.description: The amount of accretion of the preferred stock redemption discount during the period.

unclassified.label: Tax Credit Carryforward, Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of the tax credit carryforward, before tax effects, available to reduce future taxable income under enacted tax laws.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Equity Securities, Amortized Cost Basis
Available-for-sale Securities, Change in Net Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss), Net of Tax (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Banking Regulation, Common Equity Tier One Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Well Capitalized, Minimum
unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum Common Equity Tier 1 risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

unclassified.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of increase (decrease) in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from net income (loss) and other comprehensive income (loss), attributable to noncontrolling interests. Excludes changes in equity resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Expense (Benefit), Share-based Payment Arrangement, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to expense for award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes expense determined to be nondeductible upon grant or after for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Fees and Commissions (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Held-to-maturity Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Less than 12 Months, Aggregate Loss (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Loss Contingency Accrual
unclassified.description: Amount of loss contingency liability.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Real Estate, Additions
unclassified.description: Additions of other real estate not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. This excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Restricted Stock Award, Gross
unclassified.description: Total number of shares issued during the period, including shares forfeited, as a result of Restricted Stock Awards.

unclassified.label: StockRepurchaseProgramNumberOfSharesAuthorizedToBeRepurchased
Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Accretable Yield, Reclassifications (to) from Nonaccretable Difference
unclassified.description: Amount of reclassification (to) from nonaccretable difference (from) to the excess of a loan's cash flows expected to be collected over the investor's initial investment in acquired loans not accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Class of Warrant or Right, Exercise Price of Warrants or Rights
unclassified.description: Exercise price per share or per unit of warrants or rights outstanding.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Compensation Expense
unclassified.description: The compensation expense recognized during the period pertaining to the deferred compensation arrangement.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Unrealized Losses on Trading Securities
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation,Other Reconciling Items, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of reported income tax benefit (expense) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to other reconciling items. Excludes state and local income tax expense (benefit), federal tax expense (benefit), statutory income tax expense (benefit) outside of country of domicile, tax credit, nondeductible expense, deduction, income tax settlement, income tax contingency, and cross-border tax law.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Branch of FHLB Bank, Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Rate of interest applicable on advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Average Interest Rate, Year Two
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) due in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Held-to-maturity Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, 12 Months or Longer, Aggregate Loss (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Held-to-maturity Securities, Continuous Unrealized Loss Position, Aggregate Loss (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Impaired Financing Receivable, with No Related Allowance, Interest Income, Cash Basis Method
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income, recognized on cash basis, on financing receivables, for which there is no related allowance for credit losses and are recognized as impaired.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI on Derivatives, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income of accumulated gain (loss) realized from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's deferred hedging gain (loss).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Gain (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Maximum Month-end Outstanding Amount
unclassified.description: For the form of debt having an initial term of less than one year or less than the normal operating cycle, if longer, maximum month-end borrowings during the period.

unclassified.label: Assets, Fair Value Disclosure, Nonrecurring (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer, Accretable Yield
unclassified.description: The aggregate excess of a loan's cash flows expected to be collected over the investor's initial investment in the loan. This relates to loans with deteriorating of credit quality since origination that were acquired by completion of a transfer for which it is probable, at acquisition, that the investor will be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Actual Allocation, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of actual investment allocation to total plan assets. Includes, but is not limited to, percentage on weighted-average basis if more than one plan.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Settlements
unclassified.description: Amount of settlement of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Goodwill and Intangible Asset Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss for finite- and indefinite-lived intangible assets, goodwill, and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Rolling within One Year, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in next rolling fiscal year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Impaired Financing Receivable, with Related Allowance, Interest Income, Cash Basis Method
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income on financing receivables, for which there is a related allowance for credit losses, recognized on a cash-basis method of accounting that the financing receivables were impaired.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Liability, Payments, Due Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payments for operating lease, due in next rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Amount Outstanding (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Commercial (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, before Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Nonvested, Number of Shares
unclassified.description: Number of non-vested options outstanding.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Treasury Stock Reissued
unclassified.description: Number of treasury shares or units reissued. Excludes reissuance of shares or units in treasury for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Credit Losses, Change in Method of Calculating Impairment (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Domestic
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible domestic operating loss carryforwards. Excludes state and local operating loss carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, State Taxes
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from state taxes.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Increase (Decrease) for Actual Return (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from actual return (loss) determined by change in fair value of plan assets adjusted for contributions, benefit payments, and other expenses.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Rate of Compensation Increase
unclassified.description: Weighted average rate increase of compensation, used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, pay-related defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Notional Amount
unclassified.description: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payments on the derivative asset.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Sales
unclassified.description: Amount of sale of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fees and Commissions, Credit and Debit Cards (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Finance Lease, Liability, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Amount at Par Value
unclassified.description: Amount at par value of financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Impaired, Accumulated Impairment Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated impairment loss for asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Rolling after Five Through Ten Years, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in sixth through tenth rolling fiscal year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Financial and Nonfinancial Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial and nonfinancial obligations.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax

unclassified.label: Extinguishment of Debt, Amount
unclassified.description: Gross amount of debt extinguished.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestModifiedAccumulated
unclassified.description: Accumulated amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable modified for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Purchase
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in financing receivable from purchase. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Guarantor Obligations, Current Carrying Value
unclassified.description: The current carrying amount of the liability for the freestanding or embedded guarantor's obligations under the guarantee or each group of similar guarantees.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Prior Year Income Taxes, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to revisions of previously reported income tax expense (benefit).

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, before Fees, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance and fees, of loans and leases receivable. Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, in Three Years
unclassified.description: Future rental payments receivable within the third year from the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, in Two Years
unclassified.description: Future rental payments receivable within the second year from the balance sheet date under an operating lease.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Thereafter
unclassified.description: Future minimum lease payments receivable under operating leases for periods greater than five years following the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit for reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, before Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI).

unclassified.label: Payments for Repurchase of Trust Preferred Securities
unclassified.description: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stocks issued by a business trust or other special purpose entity, mainly established by a bank holding entity, to third party investors. The trust's assets are deeply subordinated debentures of the bank holding entity. Most trust preferred securities are subject to a mandatory redemption upon the repayment of the debentures.

unclassified.label: Reclassification from Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income, Current Period, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustments of other comprehensive income (loss).

unclassified.label: Sale of Stock, Price Per Share
unclassified.description: Per share amount received by subsidiary or equity investee for each share of common stock issued or sold in the stock transaction.

unclassified.label: Sales-Type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, to be Received, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of right to receive securities collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against securities sold under agreement to repurchase.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: Weighted average grant-date fair value of options vested.

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Reporting Entity Involvement, Maximum Loss Exposure, Amount
unclassified.description: The reporting entity's maximum amount of exposure to loss as a result of its involvement with the Variable Interest Entity (VIE).

Business Combination, Acquired Receivable, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of receivable purchased without credit deterioration, acquired in business combination. Excludes purchased financial asset with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Capital Lease Obligations
unclassified.description: Amount equal to the present value (the principal) at the beginning of the lease term of minimum lease payments during the lease term (excluding that portion of the payments representing executory costs such as insurance, maintenance, and taxes to be paid by the lessor, together with any profit thereon) net of payments or other amounts applied to the principal through the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Interest Included in Payments
unclassified.description: Amount necessary to reduce net minimum lease payments to present value for capital leases.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Present Value of Net Minimum Payments
unclassified.description: Present value of minimum lease payments for capital leases net of executory costs, including amounts paid by the lessee to the lessor for insurance, maintenance and taxes.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt discount.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Expense from Stock Options Exercised
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax expense from write-off of the deferred tax asset related to deductible stock options at exercise.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Net Gains (Losses) (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Increase (Decrease) for Plan Amendment
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from change in terms of existing plan or initiation of new plan.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Number of Instruments Held
unclassified.description: The number of derivative instruments of a particular group held by the entity.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationTaxCreditEnergyRelatedPercent
unclassified.description: Percentage of reported income tax benefit (expense) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to energy-related tax credit.

unclassified.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Nonvested Awards, Total Compensation Cost Not yet Recognized, Period for Recognition (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Foreign Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of current and deferred foreign income tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Contract Termination
unclassified.description: Gain (loss) related to the termination of a contract between the parties. The termination may be due to many causes including early termination of a lease by a lessee, a breach of contract by one party, or a failure to perform.

unclassified.label: Hedged Asset, Fair Value Hedge
unclassified.description: Amount of asset hedged in fair value hedging relationship.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Conversion of Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of convertible preferred stock using the if-converted method.

unclassified.label: Marketable Securities, Equity Securities (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Adoption, Quantification (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Number of Businesses Acquired
unclassified.description: Number of businesses acquired in business combination.

unclassified.label: Other Asset Impairment Charges
unclassified.description: The charge against earnings resulting from the write down of long lived assets other than goodwill due to the difference between the carrying value and lower fair value.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Amortization, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Cost Recognized in Net Periodic Pension Cost, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Settlement and Curtailment Gain (Loss), before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of increase (decrease) to other comprehensive income from settlement and curtailment gain (loss) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Write-down of Securities, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for unrealized loss realized upon the write-down of available-for-sale securities.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment on Derivatives Included in Net Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Pledged Financial Instruments, Not Separately Reported, Loans Receivable, for Federal Home Loan Bank Debt
Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Other Changes in Fair Value
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) from changes in fair value classified as other for a contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

unclassified.label: Tax Adjustments, Settlements, and Unusual Provisions
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to previously recorded tax expense. Includes, but is not limited to, significant settlements of income tax disputes, and unusual tax positions or infrequent actions taken by the entity, including tax assessment reversal, and IRS tax settlement.
