unclassified.description: The aggregate fair value of additional assets that would be required to be posted as collateral for derivative instruments with credit-risk-related contingent features if the credit-risk-related contingent features were triggered at the end of the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Sold at Par Value
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with interest rate reset through auction process, sold at par value.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Assets, Cash and Cash Equivalents (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Liabilities Assumed (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Capitalized Computer Software, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Accounted for as Debt Securities, Accretable Yield
unclassified.description: The aggregate excess of a loan's cash flows expected to be collected over the investor's initial investment in the loan for loans accounted for as debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that were acquired by completion of a transfer for which it is probable, at acquisition, that the investor will be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable.

unclassified.label: Conversion of Stock, Amount Converted
unclassified.description: The value of the stock converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Cumulative Effect of Initial Adoption of New Accounting Principle (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Amortization of Gain (Loss), Next Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount included in accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for gain (loss) of defined benefit plan expected to be recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit for fiscal year following most recent annual statement of financial position.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, (Increase) Decrease for Settlement
unclassified.description: Amount of (increase) decrease to benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk for obligation and assets used to effect settlement. Includes, but is not limited to, lump-sum cash payment to participant in exchange for right to receive specified benefits, purchase of nonparticipating annuity contract and change from remeasurement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Not Offset, Policy Election Deduction
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from derivative asset.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in direct financing lease.

unclassified.label: Dividends, Preferred Stock, Stock
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in stock.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Cash Contributions to ESOP
unclassified.description: This item represents the amount of cash contributions during the period made by the entity to the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Unrealized Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized loss on investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

unclassified.label: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Upward Price Adjustment, Annual Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of gain from upward price adjustment on investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Maturities Summary, Fixed Rate
unclassified.description: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) advances which have fixed interest.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Recoveries (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Estimated Litigation Liability
unclassified.description: Aggregate carrying amount of the estimated litigation liability for known or estimated probable loss from litigation, which may include attorneys' fees and other litigation costs.

unclassified.label: Loans Receivable, Gross, Commercial, Construction (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Other Assets Acquired
unclassified.description: Amount of assets, classified as other, acquired in a noncash or part noncash acquisition.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Lease Revenue
unclassified.description: The total amount of revenue recognized for the period from operating leases, including minimum lease revenue, contingent revenue, percentage revenue and sublease revenue.

unclassified.label: Other Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of other income tax expense (benefit).

unclassified.label: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Portion Recognized in Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security, recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Payment for Debt Extinguishment or Debt Prepayment Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for cost from early extinguishment and prepayment of debt. Includes, but is not limited to, third-party cost, premium paid, and other fee paid to lender directly for debt extinguishment or debt prepayment. Excludes accrued interest.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Related Party Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for the payment of a long-term borrowing made from a related party where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Payments for Advances from Affiliates.

unclassified.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Amount Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of fund outstanding borrowed in form of security repurchase agreement for sale and repurchase of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Includes security sold under agreement to repurchase not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Number of Additional Shares Authorized
unclassified.description: Number of additional shares authorized for issuance under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Nonvested Options Forfeited, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value
unclassified.description: Weighted average grant-date fair value of non-vested options forfeited.

unclassified.label: Significant Change in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible, Amount of Unrecorded Benefit
unclassified.description: The amount of the unrecognized tax benefit of a position taken for which it is reasonably possible that the total amount thereof will significantly increase or decrease within twelve months of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Cash Collateral for Borrowed Securities
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of cash collateral held for borrowed securities, for which the cash is restricted as to withdrawal or usage.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Loss Reserves
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from loss reserves other than estimated credit losses.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Investment in Noncontrolled Affiliates
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from investments in unconsolidated subsidiaries and investments in other affiliates which are not controlled nor consolidated.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Prior Service Cost (Credit), before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for cost (credit) of benefit change attributable to participants' prior service from plan amendment or plan initiation of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit).

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in accumulated postretirement benefit obligation from one-percentage-point decrease in assumed health care cost trend rate.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of One Percentage Point Decrease on Service and Interest Cost Components
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in service and interest cost components of net periodic postretirement benefit cost from one-percentage-point decrease in assumed health care cost trend rate.

unclassified.description: Present value of lease payments not yet received by lessor and amount expected to be derived from underlying asset, following end of lease term, guaranteed by lessee or other third party unrelated to lessor, from direct financing lease.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Unguaranteed Residual Asset
unclassified.description: Present value expected to be derived from underlying asset, following end of lease term, not guaranteed by lessee or other third party unrelated to lessor.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Interest rate of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) to be Reclassified During Next 12 Months, Net
unclassified.description: The estimated net amount of unrealized gains or losses on interest rate cash flow hedges as of the balance sheet date expected to be reclassified to earnings within the next twelve months.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Derivative Liabilities, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of interest rate derivative liabilities, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized as liabilities.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Due, Future Minimum Sublease Rentals
unclassified.description: Contractually required future rental payments receivable on noncancelable subleasing arrangements.

Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Additions (Deductions) for Expenses (Recoveries)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the valuation allowance for impairment of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer from expenses (recoveries) recognized.

unclassified.description: Value of outstanding derivative securities that permit the holder the right to purchase securities (usually equity) from the issuer at a specified price.

unclassified.description: The amount of goodwill arising from a business combination that is expected to be deductible for tax purposes.

unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.description: Fair value of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and contract can be net settled by means outside contract or delivery of asset, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from derivative liability.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Prior Year Income Taxes, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to revisions of previously reported income tax expense.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Losses, Effect of Change in Method

Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Dividends, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for dividend.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Other, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other deductions.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Impairment Losses, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible impairment loss.

unclassified.label: Loans Receivable with Fixed Rates of Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of loan with fixed rate of interest.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Estimate of Possible Loss
unclassified.description: Reflects the estimated amount of loss from the specified contingency as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, before Reclassification Adjustment, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before reclassification adjustment, of tax (expense) benefit for (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income, Other, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in other comprehensive income, after tax, from changes classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment, Credit Losses Recognized in Earnings, Reductions, Cash Flows
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in accumulated credit loss recognized in earnings for other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) of debt security held from increase in cash flow expected to be collected and recognized over remaining life of security.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Loss, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent, Available-for-sale Securities
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in available-for-sale debt security, recognized in other comprehensive loss, attributable to parent entity.

unclassified.label: Participating Securities, Distributed and Undistributed Earnings (Loss), Basic
unclassified.description: Amount of earnings (loss) distributed and earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the basic earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Available-for-sale Securities, Equity
Real Estate Owned, Valuation Allowance, Amounts Applied
unclassified.description: Amount of the valuation allowance for real estate owned that was applied in the period against the carrying amount of real estate owned that was sold, written down or written off.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Risk-Weighted Assets, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of risk-weighted assets as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of 10 Percent Adverse Change in Prepayment Speed
unclassified.description: The hypothetical financial impact of a 10 percent adverse change of prepayment speed on the fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities) as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of 20 Percent Adverse Change in Prepayment Speed
unclassified.description: The hypothetical financial impact of a 20 percent adverse change of prepayment speed on the fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities) as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Exercisable, Weighted Average Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Weighted-average exercise price, at which grantee can acquire shares reserved for issuance, for fully vested and expected to vest exercisable or convertible options. Includes, but is not limited to, unvested options for which requisite service period has not been rendered but that are expected to vest based on achievement of performance condition, if forfeitures are recognized when they occur.

unclassified.label: Unrecorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of unrecorded obligation to transfer funds in future for fixed or minimum amount or quantity of product and service at fixed or minimum price. Includes, but is not limited to, lease not yet commenced and take-or-pay and throughput contracts.

unclassified.description: Amount of transactions with related party during the financial reporting period.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Collateral, Obligation to Return Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return securities collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against securities purchased under agreement to resell.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of liability associated with funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price.

unclassified.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Other Changes that Affect Balance
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value from changes classified as other for a contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate, Maximum
unclassified.description: The maximum risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing an option on its own shares.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercises in Period (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
ShareRepurchaseProgramExciseTax
unclassified.description: Amount of excise tax on share purchased under share repurchase plan. Includes, but is not limited to, repurchase of stock and unit of ownership.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Stock Ownership Plan
unclassified.description: Number of shares of capital stock issued (purchased by employees) in connection with an employee stock ownership plan.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tangible Capital Ratio, Actual
unclassified.description: Ratio of tangible capital to tangible assets as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposits maturing in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. Time deposits include, but are not limited to, certificates of deposits. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

Treasury Stock, Value, Acquired, Par Value Method

unclassified.label: Assets Held-in-trust
unclassified.description: The total amount of cash and securities held by third party trustees pursuant to terms of debt instruments or other agreements as of the date of each statement of financial position presented, which can be used by the trustee only to pay the noncurrent portion of specified obligations.

unclassified.label: Assets Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Repurchase Liability
unclassified.description: Amount, including accrued interest, to be repaid to counterparty to repurchase agreement when carrying amount or market value if higher, of security or other asset sold under repurchase agreement exceeds 10 percent of total assets.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Amortizable Intangible Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Financial Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of financial asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Accounted for as Debt Securities, Acquired During Period, at Acquisition, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value at acquisition of acquired loans accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Accretable Yield, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of the excess of a loan's cash flows expected to be collected over the investor's initial investment in acquired loans not accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Common Stock Dividends, Shares
unclassified.description: Number of shares of common stock issued as dividends during the period. Excludes stock splits.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of decrease in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from writeoff.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Accrued Interest, before Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of accrued interest on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossRecovery
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of increase in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from recovery.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestNonaccrual
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) on nonaccrual status.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Realized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Employee Bonuses
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from employee bonuses.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Health Care Cost Trend Rate Assumed for Next Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Payment for Settlement
unclassified.description: Amount of payment, which decreases plan assets of defined benefit plan, for irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk for obligation and assets used to effect settlement. Transaction constituting settlement includes, but is not limited to, making lump-sum cash payment to participant in exchange for their rights to receive specified benefits and purchasing nonparticipating annuity contract.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed, Collateral, Obligation to Return Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative assets, securities purchased under agreements to resell and securities borrowed.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of derivative assets, securities purchased under agreements to resell and securities borrowed. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Gain on Derivative
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of right to receive securities collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Deferred Selling Profit
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred selling profit from direct financing lease.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationCrossBorderTaxEffectPercent
unclassified.description: Percentage of reported income tax expense (benefit) from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to cross-border tax law.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Other, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other deductions.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Shares Contributed to ESOP
unclassified.description: This item represents the number of shares provided to the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) during the period.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings (Deprecated 2012-01-31)

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Maturities Summary, Floating Rate
unclassified.description: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLB) advances which have floating interest rates.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of lessee's undiscounted obligation for lease payment for finance lease due in next rolling 12 months following current statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling after Year Five

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Three

For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Payments, Due in Rolling Year Two

For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable (Deprecated 2012-01-31)

unclassified.label: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity
unclassified.description: The sum of the tax effects of all items occurring during the period that have been charged or credited directly to other comprehensive income or to related components of shareholders' equity.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Employee Stock Ownership Plan Dividend, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for dividend paid to employee stock ownership plan.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Meals and Entertainment, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible meals and entertainment expense.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) Reclassified to Earnings, Net
unclassified.description: The amount of net gains or losses on interest rate cash flow hedges reclassified during the period to earnings from accumulated other comprehensive income upon the hedged transaction affecting earnings.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit, Current
unclassified.description: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the current portion of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms before, as of and after the date of drawdowns on the line. Includes short-term obligations that would normally be classified as current liabilities but for which (a) postbalance sheet date issuance of a long term obligation to refinance the short term obligation on a long term basis, or (b) the enterprise has entered into a financing agreement that clearly permits the enterprise to refinance the short-term obligation on a long term basis and the following conditions are met (1) the agreement does not expire within 1 year and is not cancelable by the lender except for violation of an objectively determinable provision, (2) no violation exists at the BS date, and (3) the lender has entered into the financing agreement is expected to be financially capable of honoring the agreement.

unclassified.label: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), recognized in earnings and other comprehensive income (OCI).

unclassified.description: Capital conservation buffer percentage calculated as total risk-based capital ratio after deduction of minimum total risk-based capital ratio as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.description: Amount of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Includes, but is not limited to, one-time termination benefits, termination of an operating lease or other contract, consolidating or closing facilities, and relocating employees, and termination benefits associated with an ongoing benefit arrangement. Excludes expenses associated with special or contractual termination benefits, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases
unclassified.description: The net investment in direct financing leases as of the balance sheet date consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Revenue Recognized
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue recognized that was previously included in balance of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due.

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Credit Derivative, Maximum Exposure, Undiscounted
unclassified.description: Maximum potential amount of future undiscounted payments that could be required under the credit derivative, before reduction for potential recoveries under recourse or collateralization provisions.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of debt instrument payable, including, but not limited to, notes payable and loans payable.

unclassified.label: Debt Issuance Cost (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Deferred Other Tax Expense (Benefit)
unclassified.description: Amount of other deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations. For example, but not limited to, acquisition-date income tax benefits or expenses recognized from changes in the acquirer's valuation allowance for its previously existing deferred tax assets resulting from a business combination and adjustments to beginning-of-year balance of a valuation allowance because of a change in circumstance causing a change in judgment about the realizability of the related deferred tax asset in future periods.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Deferred Rent
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from deferred rent.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Amortization, Next Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of cost (credit) included in accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss expected to be recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit) for fiscal year following most recent annual statement of financial position.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Health Care Cost Trend Rate Assumed, Next Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Assumed rate, for next fiscal year, based on annual change in cost of health care cost benefits used to measure expected cost of benefits covered by defined benefit postretirement plan. Factors include, but are not limited to, estimate of health care inflation, change in health care utilization or delivery pattern, technological advances, and change in health status of participant. Excludes factors for change in composition of plan population by age and dependency status.

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Maximum Annual Contributions Per Employee, Amount
unclassified.description: Maximum amount the employee may contribute to a defined contribution plan.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) Recognized in Income, Ineffective Portion and Amount Excluded from Effectiveness Testing, Net
unclassified.description: The portion of gains and losses (net) on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments representing (a) the amount of the hedge ineffectiveness and (b) the amount, if any, excluded from the assessment of hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Interest Income
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income from net investment in direct financing lease.

unclassified.label: Distributed Earnings

Dividends declared in the current period do not include dividends declared in respect of prior-period unpaid cumulative dividends. Preferred dividends that are cumulative only if earned are deducted only to the extent that they are earned.

Pledged Financial Instruments, Not Separately Reported, Securities for Federal Home Loan Bank
Proceeds from Related Party Debt
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from a long-term borrowing made from related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Proceeds from Advances from Affiliates.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Equity
unclassified.description: The net cash inflow or outflow resulting from the entity's share transaction.

unclassified.label: Residual Value of Leased Asset
unclassified.description: Amount of residual asset covered by residual value guarantee. Excludes guarantee considered to be lease payments for lessor.

unclassified.label: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of 10 Percent Adverse Change in Discount Rate
unclassified.description: The hypothetical financial impact of a 10 percent adverse change of the discount rate on the fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities) as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of 20 Percent Adverse Change in Discount Rate
unclassified.description: The hypothetical financial impact of a 20 percent adverse change of the discount rate on the fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities) as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost, Disposals
unclassified.description: Amount conveyed to unrelated parties of contract to contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

unclassified.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) in the fair value of servicing assets that are subsequently measured at fair value.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate, Minimum
unclassified.description: The minimum risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing an option on its own shares.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Other
unclassified.description: Number of shares of stock issued attributable to transactions classified as other.

unclassified.label: Shares Issued, Shares, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
unclassified.description: Number of shares (or other type of equity) forfeited during the period.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tangible Capital, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of tangible capital as defined by regulatory framework.

Banking Regulation, Tier Two Risk-Based Capital, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of Tier 2 risk-based capital as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposits maturing in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. Time deposits include, but are not limited to, certificates of deposits. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Treasury Stock, Shares, Retired
unclassified.description: Number of shares of common and preferred stock retired from treasury during the period.

unclassified.label: Undistributed Earnings Allocated to Participating Securities (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties Accrued
unclassified.description: Amount of statutory penalties accrued for a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed by the entity, in its tax return.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from acquisitions.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Increase Resulting from Settlements with Taxing Authorities
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from settlements with taxing authorities.

Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Other than Temporary Impairment, Not Credit Loss, Net of Tax, Debt Securities
unclassified.description: Total of accumulated other comprehensive loss related to that portion of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) due to factors other than credit losses on debt securities categorized either as available-for-sale or held-to-maturity that an entity does not intend to sell and which it is not more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell before recovery of the amortized cost basis of the debt security. The amount represented by this item is net of tax, as applicable.

unclassified.label: Adjustments, Noncash Items, to Reconcile Net Income (Loss) to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities, Other (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Income Tax Deficiency from Share-based Compensation
Allowance for Loan and Lease Losses, Real Estate
unclassified.description: The reserve to cover probable credit losses related to specifically identified fixed maturity real estate loans as well as probable credit losses inherent in the remainder of that loan portfolio.

unclassified.label: AOCI before Tax, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of increase (decrease) in accumulated equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources, attributable to parent. Excludes net income (loss), and accumulated changes in equity from transactions resulting from investments by owners (distributions to owners).

unclassified.label: Assets Held-for-sale, Long Lived, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of assets classified as held for sale.

unclassified.label: Assumption for Fair Value of Assets or Liabilities that relate to Transferor's Continuing Involvement, Prepayment Speed
unclassified.description: Estimated rate of prepayment of principal on financial assets regardless of when the transfer occurred.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities and Held-to-maturity Securities
Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Equity Interests Issued and Issuable (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Pro Forma Information, Earnings or Loss of Acquiree since Acquisition Date, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of acquiree's earnings (loss) since acquisition date of business combination included in consolidated statement of income.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Minimum Payments to be Received
unclassified.description: Amount of remaining payments as of the balance sheet date that lessees are obligated to make or can be required to make under direct financing leases, including any guarantee of residual value and executory costs. The amount also includes any guaranteed rental payments by an unrelated third-party provided that are financially capable of making such payments.

unclassified.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities, Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activity attributable to discontinued operation. Investing activity includes, but is not limited to, making and collecting loan, acquiring and disposing of debt and equity instruments, property, plant, and equipment, and other productive assets.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Accretable Yield, Reclassifications to Nonaccretable Difference
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease from reclassification to nonaccretable difference of the excess of a loan's cash flows expected to be collected over the investor's initial investment in acquired loans not accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Provision for Loan Losses
unclassified.description: Amount of expense related to loan loss not accounted for as debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Conversion of Stock, Shares Converted
unclassified.description: The number of shares converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Conversion of Stock, Shares Issued
unclassified.description: The number of new shares issued in the conversion of stock in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Credit Risk Derivatives, at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value of credit risk derivative asset after deduction of credit risk derivative liability.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Gain (Loss), before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of unrealized gain (loss) in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Past Due
Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Sold, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), sold.

unclassified.label: Deferred Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred income and obligation to transfer product and service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Subject to Expiration
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards that are subject to expiration dates.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), after Tax (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Business Combination
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from business combination.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Estimated Future Employer Contributions in Current Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Accumulated Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Plan Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of plan asset for defined benefit plan with accumulated benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Equity Securities (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Target Plan Asset Allocations (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Derivative Asset, Fair Value, Gross Liability and Obligation to Return Cash, Offset
unclassified.description: Fair value of liability associated with financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, and obligation to return cash collateral under master netting arrangements.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed
unclassified.description: Amount, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of derivative assets, securities purchased under agreements to resell and securities borrowed. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed, Amount Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of derivative asset, security purchased under agreement to resell, and security borrowed. Includes asset not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Dilutive Securities, Effect on Basic Earnings Per Share, Dilutive Convertible Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to net income used for calculating diluted earnings per share (EPS), resulting from the assumed exercise of dilutive convertible securities excluding adjustments related to ESOP convertible preferred stock, stock options, and restrictive stock units.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal of Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of gain (loss) not previously recognized resulting from the disposal of a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Due to Related Parties
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Dividend, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for dividend.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Research, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to research tax credit.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Number of Committed-to-be-Released Shares
unclassified.description: The shares that, although not legally released, will be released by a future scheduled and committed debt service payment and will be allocated to employees for service rendered in the current accounting period. The ESOP documents typically define the period of service to which the shares relate. ESOP shares are released to compensate employees directly, to settle employer liabilities for other employee benefits, and to replace dividends on allocated shares that are used for debt service.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Excess, Actual
unclassified.description: Ratio of Tier 1 risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets exceeding minimum required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Hedge Liabilities
unclassified.description: Fair value of all derivative liabilities designated as fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Settlements
unclassified.description: Amount of settlements of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis with Unobservable Inputs
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial instrument classified as derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Option, Aggregate Differences, Loans and Long-term Receivables
unclassified.description: This item represents the difference between the aggregate fair value and the aggregate unpaid principal balance of loans and long-term receivables (other than securities categorized as trading, available-for-sale or held-to-maturity) that have contractual principal amounts and for which the fair value option has been elected.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Option, Loans Held as Assets, 90 Days or More Past Due
unclassified.description: This item represents the aggregate fair value of loans held as assets that are 90 days or more past due for which the fair value option has been elected.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Branch of FHLB Bank, Interest Rate, Range from (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Branch of FHLB Bank, Interest Rate, Range to (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Useful Life, Minimum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Gains (Losses) on Sales of Other Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income tax settlements. Including, but not limited to, domestic tax settlement, foreign tax settlement, state and local tax settlement, and other tax settlements.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Participating Nonvested Shares with Non-forfeitable Dividend Rights
unclassified.description: This element represents nonvested share-based payment awards that contain non-forfeitable rights to dividends or dividend equivalents (whether paid or unpaid). Basic and dilutive earnings per share are generally disclosed for such shares using the two-class method.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Money Market
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense on domestic money market demand account deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Litigation Settlement, Amount (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Revolving, Credit Card (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Gain (Loss) on Sales, Net
unclassified.description: Reflects the net positive or negative amount derived from subtracting from net proceeds of sale and the carrying amounts, net of allocated reserves, of financial assets transferred to third parties in transactions that qualify for sales treatment.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Loans in Process
unclassified.description: Amount of undisbursed portion of the loan receivable balance (loans in process). Excludes loans and leases covered under loss sharing agreements.

unclassified.label: Loans Payable
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Loans Receivable with Fixed Rates of Interest (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Decrease from Deconsolidation
unclassified.description: The amount of the reduction or elimination during the period of a noncontrolling interest resulting from the parent's loss of control and deconsolidation of the entity in which one or more outside parties had a noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Notes Receivable, Related Parties
Operating Leases, Rent Expense, Minimum Rentals
unclassified.description: This element represents the payments that the lessee is obligated to make or can be required to make in connection with a property under the terms of an agreement classified as an operating lease, excluding contingent rentals and a guarantee by the lessee of the lessor's debt and the lessee's obligation to pay (apart from the rental payments) executory costs such as insurance, maintenance, and taxes.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) before Reclassifications, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) before reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Transition Asset (Obligation), Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, before Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Gain (Loss) Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Restructuring Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of other expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses associated with a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Mortgage Servicing Rights
unclassified.description: The net cash outflow or inflow associated with acquisition or sale of mortgage servicing rights which is the net carrying value of capitalized servicing rights, which contractually entitle the servicer to receive fees and ancillary revenues for performing billing, collection, disbursement and recordkeeping services in connection with a mortgage portfolio. Rights may be obtained via (1) acquisition or assumption of a servicing obligation that does not relate to financial assets of the servicer or its consolidated affiliates; or (2) by originating mortgage loans and then (a) transferring the loans to a Variable Interest Entity (VIE) in a transaction that meets the necessary transfer and classification requirements, or (b) transferring the loans in a transaction that meets the requirements for sale accounting.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Other Real Estate
unclassified.description: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of other real estate investments held by the entity for investment purposes not otherwise defined in the taxonomy.

unclassified.label: Percentage of Interest-bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Savings
unclassified.description: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic savings deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Amount Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of fund outstanding loaned in form of security resale agreement for purchase and resale of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Includes security purchased under agreement to resell not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Securities Received as Collateral
unclassified.description: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the assets received as collateral against securities loaned to other broker-dealers. Borrowers of securities generally are required to provide collateral to the lenders of securities, commonly cash but sometimes other securities or standby letters of credit, with a value slightly higher than that of the securities borrowed. In instances where the entity is permitted to sell or re-pledge these securities, the entity reports the fair value of the collateral received and the related obligation to return the collateral as a liability.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeited in Period, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation, Shares Authorized under Stock Option Plans, Exercise Price Range, Outstanding Options, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Short-term Debt, Maximum Amount Outstanding During Period
unclassified.description: For the form of debt having an initial term of less than one year or less than the normal operating cycle, if longer, the maximum amount borrowed at any time during the period.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Issued for Services
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued in lieu of cash for services contributed to the entity. Number of shares includes, but is not limited to, shares issued for services contributed by vendors and founders.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Units
unclassified.description: Value of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).

unclassified.label: Stock Repurchase Program, Authorized Amount (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Time Deposit Maturities, after Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposits maturing after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. Time deposits include, but are not limited to, certificates of deposits. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposits maturing in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. Time deposits include, but are not limited to, certificates of deposits. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Undistributed Earnings (Loss) Allocated to Participating Securities, Diluted
unclassified.description: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the diluted earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Cash Flow Hedging Instruments
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) related to derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments, recorded in results of operations to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be ineffective.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Time Deposits
unclassified.description: The weighted average interest rate for domestic time deposit liabilities.
