APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Recognition and Exercise
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition and exercise of award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Doubtful Accounts Receivable, Charge-offs (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Amortization of ESOP Award
unclassified.description: Value of shares committed to be released under an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Assets Needed for Immediate Settlement, Aggregate Fair Value
unclassified.description: The aggregate fair value of assets needed to immediately settle the derivative instruments with credit-risk-related contingent features if the credit-risk-related contingent features were triggered at the end of the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Amount of Contingent Consideration, Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in value of liability in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination, including, but not limited to, difference arising upon settlement.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Pro Forma Information, Revenue of Acquiree since Acquisition Date, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of acquiree's revenue since acquisition date of business combination included in consolidated statement of income.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Deferred Income
unclassified.description: The remaining (unamortized) difference between the gross investment in a direct financing lease and the cost or carrying amount, if different, of the leased property as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Computer Software, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

unclassified.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, Period Increase (Decrease), Excluding Exchange Rate Effect
Cash and Securities Segregated under Federal and Other Regulations
unclassified.description: Amount of cash subject to withdrawal restrictions, restricted deposits held as compensating balances, and cash and securities segregated in compliance with regulations (such as cash deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers).

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Accounted for as Debt Securities, Carrying Amount, Net
unclassified.description: The recorded balance, net of any applicable reductions (for example, unamortized accretable yield and other-than-temporary impairments), for loans accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that were acquired by completion of a transfer for which it is probable, at acquisition, that the investor will be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Accounted for as Debt Securities, Outstanding Balance
unclassified.description: The undiscounted sum of all amounts, including amounts deemed principal, interest, fees, penalties, and other under the loan, owed to the investor at the reporting date, whether or not currently due and whether or not any such amounts have been written or charged off by the investor. This relates to loans accounted for as debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that were acquired by completion of a transfer for which it is probable, at acquisition, that the investor will be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable.

unclassified.label: Compensating Balance, Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of a specific compensating balance arrangement that is maintained under an agreement for a bank loan or future credit availability.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAndHeldToMaturityAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAmortizedCostExcludingAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossMaturityAllocatedAndSingleMaturityDateRollingAfter10Years
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing after rolling tenth fiscal year following current statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Weighted Average Yield, Maturity, after Year 10
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) maturing after tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Weighted Average Yield, Maturity, after Year 5 Through 10
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) maturing in sixth through tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Weighted Average Yield, Maturity, after Year One Through Five
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Weighted Average Yield, Maturity, Year One
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Plan Assets
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of assets held under deferred compensation agreements.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Amount of Unrecognized Deferred Tax Liability, Bad Debt Reserve for Tax Purposes of Qualified Lender
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability not recognized because of the exceptions to comprehensive recognition of deferred taxes related to bad debt reserve for tax purposes of a qualified lender.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amounts Recognized in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net Gain (Loss), before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Assets for Plan Benefits (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Employer Contributions, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of contribution expected to be received by defined benefit plan from employer in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes contribution previously paid by employer in current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Other Cost (Credit)
unclassified.description: Amount of defined benefit plan cost (credit), classified as other.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Target Allocation, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of target investment allocation to total plan assets. Includes, but is not limited to, percentage on weighted-average basis if more than one plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Debt Securities (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Derivative, Average Fixed Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Average fixed interest rate related to the group of interest rate derivatives.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Gross Asset and Right to Reclaim Cash, Offset
unclassified.description: Fair value of asset associated with financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, and right to receive cash collateral under master netting arrangements.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Loss on Derivative
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in the fair value of derivatives recognized in the income statement.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Net Hedge Ineffectiveness Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from the ineffectiveness of the hedge.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Assets
unclassified.description: Amount classified as other assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount classified as other liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Equity Securities, FV-NI, Realized Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of realized loss from sale of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI).

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Excess Tier One Leverage Capital Ratio, Actual
unclassified.description: Ratio of Tier 1 leverage capital to average assets exceeding minimum required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Assumptions, Risk Free Interest Rate (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value of Securities Received as Collateral that Can be Resold or Repledged
unclassified.description: Fair value of collateral permitted, by contact or custom, to be sold or re-pledged.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Right-of-Use Asset, Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of right-of-use asset from finance lease.

unclassified.label: Financial Assets Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a financial asset repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same financial asset at a date certain for a specified price. Includes repurchase-to-maturity transactions and liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: The aggregate fair value as of the balance sheet date of financial instruments and other positions owned by the entity including: (1) mortgages, mortgage-backed and asset backed securities; (2) US government and agency obligations; (3) state and municipal government obligations; (4) other sovereign government debt; (5) corporate obligations; (6) corporate equities; (7) principal investments; (8) derivative contracts; and (9) physical commodities. Includes both pledged and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: Financial Liabilities Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial obligations, including, but not limited to, debt instruments, derivative liabilities, federal funds purchased and sold under agreements to repurchase, securities loaned or sold under agreements to repurchase, financial instruments sold not yet purchased, guarantees, line of credit, loans and notes payable, servicing liability, and trading liabilities.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableModifiedPast12Months
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of financing receivable 12 months after modification for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sales of Mortgage Backed Securities (MBS)
unclassified.description: Net gain (loss) resulting from the sales of securitized, pay-through debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans (mortgages).

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Stock in Subsidiary
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of equity in securities of subsidiaries.

unclassified.label: Hedged Liability, Fair Value Hedge
unclassified.description: Amount of liability hedged in fair value hedging relationship.

unclassified.label: Interest and Fee Income, Other Loans
unclassified.description: Amount of interest and fee income from loans classified as other.

unclassified.label: Investment Advisory Fees (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Liabilities Assumed (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, Average Investment (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, Interest Income Recognized (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Loans Receivable with Variable Rates of Interest (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Noncontrolling Interest, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Net Increase or Decrease in balance of noncontrolling interest in the subsidiary during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Mortgage-backed Securities Held-to-maturity, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value of securitized, pay-through debt securities collateralized by real estate mortgage loans classified as held-to-maturity.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss), before Reclassification and Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

unclassified.label: OCI, Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Gain (Loss), Arising During Period, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), before reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment for Write-down of Securities Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated amortization of finite-lived intangible assets classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Sundry Liabilities
unclassified.description: The aggregate carrying amount, as of the balance sheets date, of obligations not otherwise itemized or categorized in the footnotes to the financial statements.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) loss on investments in available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities, recognized in other comprehensive loss.

unclassified.label: Percentage of Interest-bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Money Market
unclassified.description: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic money market demand account deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Prior Period Reclassification Adjustment
unclassified.description: The amount of a reclassification adjustment made to prior period financial statement amounts.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Consolidated Subsidiaries
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the deconsolidation of a previously consolidated subsidiary or the sale of investment in consolidated subsidiaries (generally greater than 50 percent).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Redeemable Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stock that is classified as callable.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Loan Originations
unclassified.description: Cash inflow associated with loan origination (the process when securing a mortgage for a piece of real property) or lease origination.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Redeemable Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: Cash inflows (outflows) from issuing and redeeming redeemable preferred stock; includes convertible and nonconvertible redeemable preferred stock.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Real Estate
unclassified.description: Cash received for the sale of real estate that is not part of an investing activity during the current period.

unclassified.label: Receivables, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of receivables, including, but not limited to, trade account receivables, note receivables, and loan receivables.

unclassified.label: Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Interest Income
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income from net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: Servicing Asset at Amortized Cost, Other Changes that Affect Balance, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of other increase (decrease) to contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Other Increases (Decreases) in Period
unclassified.description: The addition or reduction in the number of reserved shares that could potentially be issued under the option plan attributable to reasons other than grants, exercises, forfeitures, and expirations during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Award Vesting Rights, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of vesting of award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Shares Issued, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
unclassified.description: Value of forfeited shares issued under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tangible Capital, Minimum
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum tangible capital required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Tax Credit Carryforward, Valuation Allowance
unclassified.description: Amount of valuation allowance pertaining to the deferred tax asset representing potential future taxable deductions from tax credit carryforwards for which it is more likely than not that a tax benefit will not be realized.

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposits maturing in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. Time deposits include, but are not limited to, certificates of deposits. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposits maturing in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. Time deposits include, but are not limited to, certificates of deposits. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Trading Activity, Gains and Losses, Net (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Trading Securities, Unrealized Holding Loss
Transfer of Portfolio Loans and Leases to Held-for-sale (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Undistributed Earnings, Diluted
unclassified.description: The earnings that is allocated to common stock and participating securities to the extent that each security may share in earnings as if all of the earnings for the period had been distributed. Includes the adjustments resulting from the assumption that dilutive securities were converted, options or warrants were exercised, or that other shares were issued upon the satisfaction of certain conditions.

unclassified.label: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Deductions for Recoveries
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in the valuation allowance for impairment of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer from recoveries recognized.

unclassified.label: Write off of Deferred Debt Issuance Cost
unclassified.description: Write-off of amounts previously capitalized as debt issuance cost in an extinguishment of debt.

Acquired Finite-lived Intangible Asset, Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Acquisition Costs, Period Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of capitalized acquisition cost incurred during period and excluded from amortization for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Excludes exploration and development costs and capitalized interest.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on accounts receivable.

unclassified.label: Amount Available for Dividend Distribution without Affecting Capital Adequacy Requirements
unclassified.description: The amount of dividends that can be declared or paid without affecting the banking or savings institution's regulatory capital position.

unclassified.label: Assumption for Fair Value of Assets or Liabilities that relate to Transferor's Continuing Involvement, Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Discount rate which is used to value residual cash flows generated by financial assets of a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer regardless of when the transfer occurred.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Current
Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Intangible Assets Other than Goodwill (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Other Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Other Liabilities (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Hedged Item in Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Commitments, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of arrangements with third parties, including, but not limited to, operating lease arrangement and arrangement in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or services, or has agreed to commit resources to supply goods or services.

unclassified.label: Conversion of Stock, Amount Issued
unclassified.description: The value of the financial instrument issued [noncash or part noncash] in the conversion of stock. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Amount
unclassified.description: The value of the financial instrument(s) that the original debt is being converted into in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Redemption Price, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage price of original principal amount of debt at which debt can be redeemed by the issuer.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Accrued Interest Writeoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of accrued interest on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), recognized by reversing interest income.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Change in Present Value, Expense (Reversal)
Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Weighted Average Yield, Maturity, after Year 10
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), maturing after tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Weighted Average Yield, Maturity, after Year 5 Through 10
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), maturing in sixth through tenth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Weighted Average Yield, Maturity, after Year One Through Five
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Weighted Average Yield, Maturity, Year One
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Contributions by Employer
unclassified.description: Amount of contributions made by employer into fund established for purposes of making future disbursement to individual in accordance with deferred compensation arrangement.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Employer Contribution (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Not Subject to Expiration
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible operating loss carryforwards that are not subject to expiration dates.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, Foreign
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible foreign tax credit carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Contingencies
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from contingent liabilities.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Amortization of Transition Asset (Obligation)
unclassified.description: Amount of transition asset (obligation) recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Payment for Settlement
unclassified.description: Amount of payment, which decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan, for irrevocable action relieving primary responsibility for benefit obligation and eliminating risk for obligation and assets used to effect settlement. Transaction constituting settlement includes, but is not limited to, making lump-sum cash payment to participant in exchange for their rights to receive specified benefits and purchasing nonparticipating annuity contract. Excludes decreases to benefit obligation for remeasurement due to settlement.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Amortization of Prior Service Cost (Credit), Next Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount included in accumulated other comprehensive (income) loss for prior service cost (credit) expected to be recognized in net periodic benefit cost (credit) for fiscal year following most recent annual statement of financial position.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Funded Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of plan assets to benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Increase (Decrease) for Other Change
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from change, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deposits, Foreign
unclassified.description: The aggregate of all foreign interest-bearing and noninterest-bearing deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed, Collateral, Obligation to Return Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return securities collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against derivative assets, securities purchased under agreements to resell and securities borrowed.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain (Loss) Reclassification from Accumulated OCI to Income, Estimated Net Amount to be Transferred
unclassified.description: The estimated value of gains (losses), net anticipated to be transferred in the future from accumulated other comprehensive income into earnings.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Asset, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of derivative instrument not designated as hedging instrument and classified as an asset.

unclassified.label: Dividends Payable, Amount (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Employee Stock Ownership Plan Dividend, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for dividend paid to employee stock ownership plan.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Meals and Entertainment, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to meals and entertainment expense.

unclassified.label: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Downward Price Adjustment, Cumulative Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative loss from downward price adjustment on investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

unclassified.label: Equity Securities without Readily Determinable Fair Value, Impairment Loss, Cumulative Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative impairment loss on investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Total Risk-Based Capital Ratio, Excess, Actual
unclassified.description: Ratio of total risk-based capital to risk-weighted assets exceeding minimum required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: FDIC Indemnification Asset, Net Write Offs
unclassified.description: Amount, after recovery, of decrease to indemnification asset from writeoff of loan in loss sharing agreement with Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC).

unclassified.label: Fair Value Inputs, Prepayment Rate (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value of Securities Received as Collateral that Have Been Resold or Repledged
unclassified.description: Fair value of the collateral, or portion thereof, that has been re-pledged, delivered, or otherwise used.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Option, Changes in Fair Value, Gain (Loss) (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Financial Instruments, Owned and Pledged as Collateral, at Fair Value
Financing Receivable, after Deferred Income Offset (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestPurchase
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of increase in financing receivable from purchase. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableIndividuallyEvaluatedWithAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount of financing receivable with allowance for credit loss evaluated on individual basis. Excludes financing receivable evaluated on collective basis.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Useful Life (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction. Includes, but is not limited to, dividend deduction, deduction for dividend paid to employee stock ownership plan (ESOP), Medicare prescription drug benefit subsidy deduction, and other deductions.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Certificates of Deposit
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense on domestic certificates of deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Derivatives, at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of interest rate derivative assets, net of interest rate derivative liabilities, which includes all such derivative instruments in hedging and nonhedging relationships that are recognized on the balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Construction (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Loss Contingency Accrual, Provision
unclassified.description: Amount charged against operating income increasing loss contingency liability, after adjustments to reduce previously estimated charges.

unclassified.label: Merchant Discount Fees (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Foreclosure
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, from foreclosure.

unclassified.label: Net Realized and Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Trading Securities
Noncash Merger Related Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (income) related to the increase (decrease) in reserve for business combination costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, and other costs incurred to consummate the merger.

unclassified.label: Operating Lease, Liability, Current
unclassified.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from operating lease, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Transition Asset (Obligation), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, before Tax

Payments to Acquire Businesses and Interest in Affiliates

unclassified.label: Percentage of Interest-bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits
unclassified.description: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Principal Amount Outstanding of Loans Held-in-portfolio

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the deconsolidation of a previously consolidated subsidiary or sale of an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Dividends Received
unclassified.description: Dividends received on equity and other investments during the current period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Other Long-term Debt
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from other long-term debt.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Subordinated Short-term Debt
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from an obligation which places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior loan) in liquidation of the entity's assets scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle of the entity, if longer.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Additions
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in property, plant, and equipment from addition. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Owned, Valuation Allowance, Valuation Increase
unclassified.description: Amount of gain recognized in the income statement for an increase in valuation of real estate owned (REO).

unclassified.label: Secured Borrowings, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of financial assets loaned to entities in exchange for collateral and funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a financial asset repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same financial assets at a date certain for a specified price. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Collateral, Obligation to Return Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against securities purchased under agreement to resell.

unclassified.label: SegmentExpenditureAdditionToLongLivedAssets
unclassified.description: Amount of expenditure for addition to long-lived asset included in determination of segment asset by chief operating decision maker (CODM) or otherwise regularly provided to CODM. Long-lived asset excludes financial instrument, long-term customer relationship of financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition cost, and deferred tax asset.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Compensation Cost (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate, Maximum
unclassified.description: The estimated measure of the maximum percentage by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during a period. Volatility also may be defined as a probability-weighted measure of the dispersion of returns about the mean. The volatility of a share price is the standard deviation of the continuously compounded rates of return on the share over a specified period. That is the same as the standard deviation of the differences in the natural logarithms of the stock prices plus dividends, if any, over the period.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate, Minimum
unclassified.description: The estimated measure of the minimum percentage by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during a period. Volatility also may be defined as a probability-weighted measure of the dispersion of returns about the mean. The volatility of a share price is the standard deviation of the continuously compounded rates of return on the share over a specified period. That is the same as the standard deviation of the differences in the natural logarithms of the stock prices plus dividends, if any, over the period.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Purchase Price of Common Stock, Percent

Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Employee Benefit Plan

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tangible Capital Ratio, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum tangible capital to tangible assets required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Current Period Tax Positions
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from tax positions that have been or will be taken in current period tax return.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Income Tax Penalties Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for penalties related to a tax position claimed or expected to be claimed in the tax return.

unclassified.label: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Period Increase (Decrease)

unclassified.label: APIC, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Other, Increase for Cost Recognition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase to additional paid-in capital (APIC) for recognition of cost for award under share-based payment arrangement, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Assets Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Market Value
unclassified.description: Market value of assets sold under agreements to repurchase when the carrying amount (or market value, if higher than the carrying amount) of securities or other assets sold under repurchase agreements exceeds 10 percent of total assets.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Assumption, Date of Securitization or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement, Transferor's Continuing Involvement, Servicing Assets or Liabilities, Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Discount rate which is used to value residual cash flows generated by financial assets of the securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer for initial fair value measurement.

unclassified.label: Bad Debt Reserve, Tax Purpose of Qualified Lender
unclassified.description: Amount of bad debt reserves for tax purposes of qualified lenders excluded in calculating deferred taxes.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Lessee Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: The total charge for the use of long-lived depreciable assets subject to a lease meeting the criteria for capitalization.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Initial Direct Costs
unclassified.description: Remaining unamortized costs as of the balance sheet date that were essential to acquiring the lease, and that would not otherwise have been incurred without the lease agreement, including evaluating the lessee's credit condition, guarantees, and collateral and costs incurred negotiating, processing, and closing the lease agreement.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Unguaranteed Residual Values of Leased Property
unclassified.description: The estimate of the lease property's economic value at the end of the direct financing lease term excluding any amounts guaranteed by either the lessee or a third-party.

unclassified.label: Cash Divested from Deconsolidation
unclassified.description: Reduction in cash due to no longer including the former subsidiary's cash in the consolidated entity's cash.

unclassified.label: Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Fair Value Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Cost Method Investments, Fair Value Disclosure
Credit Risk Derivative Liabilities, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of credit risk derivative liability.

unclassified.label: Cumulative Effect on Retained Earnings, Tax (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount (Premium), Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt discount (premium).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAndHeldToMaturityCumulativeUnrecognizedGain
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative unrecognized gain on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Realized Loss, Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of realized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), excluding other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Deferred Costs
unclassified.description: The carrying amount of deferred costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from reserves and accruals.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Legal Settlements
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from the estimated loss from legal settlements.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from reserves and accruals.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Transition Asset (Obligation), before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Actuarial Gain (Loss), Immediate Recognition as Component in Net Periodic Benefit (Cost) Credit
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss), recognized immediately as component of net periodic benefit (cost) credit, for change in value of benefit obligation or plan assets from experience different from that assumed, change in actuarial assumption, or consequence of temporarily deviating from substantive plan. Includes, but is not limited to, amount in excess of 10 percent of greater of fair value of plan assets or benefit obligation.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Future Amortization of Transition Obligation (Asset) (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Equity Securities (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Contribution Plan, Administrative Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of administrative expense incurred by defined contribution plan.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset Designated as Hedging Instrument, Fair Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Derivative Credit Risk Valuation Adjustment, Derivative Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of credit risk valuation adjustment to derivative assets to properly reflect the credit quality of the counterparties.

unclassified.label: Derivative Credit Risk Valuation Adjustment, Derivative Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of credit risk valuation adjustment to derivative liabilities to properly reflect the credit quality of the entity.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Liability, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of derivative instrument not designated as hedging instrument and classified as a liability.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Noncontrolling Interest Income (Loss), Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to noncontrolling interest income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Deferred Shares, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of unearned shares held by the employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Risk-Based Capital, Excess, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of Tier 1 risk-based capital exceeding minimum required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Derivative Financial Instruments, Assets (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Dividend Rate (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value Hedges, Net
unclassified.description: Net fair value of all derivative instruments designated as fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Derivative Financial Instruments, Liabilities (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Transfers into Level 3
unclassified.description: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset) into level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Transfers out of Level 3
unclassified.description: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset) out of level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Option, Loans Held as Assets, Aggregate Difference
unclassified.description: For loans held as assets for which the fair value option has been elected, this item represents the difference between the aggregate fair value and the aggregate unpaid principal balance of those loans that are 90 days or more past due, in nonaccrual status, or both.

unclassified.label: Federal Funds Purchased, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of short term borrowing where a bank borrows, at the federal funds rate, from another bank.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Maturities Summary, Due in Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of advances from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments Owned and Pledged as Collateral, Amount Eligible to be Repledged by Counterparty
FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossPurchasedSeasonedLoan

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossLoanPurchased
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of increase in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from purchase of loan. Excludes financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration, loan acquired through business combination or acquisition, and net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Percent Past Due
unclassified.description: Percentage of financing receivable balance that is past due.

unclassified.label: Finite-lived Intangible Assets Acquired (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Goodwill, Subsequent Recognition of Deferred Tax Asset
unclassified.description: Amount of (increase) decrease from subsequent recognition of deferred tax asset for asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: HedgedAssetFairValueHedgePortfolioLayerMethodCumulativeIncreaseDecreaseExcludedFromAmortizedCost

unclassified.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations, Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of current tax expense (benefit) and deferred tax expense (benefit) pertaining to income (loss) from continuing operations and income (loss) from discontinued operations.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Intraperiod Tax Allocation
unclassified.description: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) for continuing operations, discontinued operations, other comprehensive income, and items charged (credited) directly to shareholders' equity.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Contingently Issuable Shares
unclassified.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of contingently issuable shares. Contingently issuable shares are those shares that are issuable for little or no cash contingent on certain conditions being met.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Time Deposit
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense on time deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Securities, Other US Government
unclassified.description: Interest income on securities issued by US government agencies not including US Treasury Securities.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Interest Rate at Period End
unclassified.description: The effective interest rate at the end of the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Interest Rate During Period

unclassified.label: Loan Restructuring, Trial Modifications, Amount

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Commitments to Purchase or Sell

unclassified.label: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Recognized in Earnings, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), recognized in earnings.

unclassified.description: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic time deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in property, plant, and equipment from disposition. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

unclassified.label: Reporting Unit, Percentage of Fair Value in Excess of Carrying Amount
unclassified.description: Percentage of fair value of reporting unit in excess of carrying amount.

unclassified.label: Restructuring Costs
unclassified.description: Amount, after cash payment, of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan. Excludes expenses related to a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

unclassified.label: Security Deposit
unclassified.description: The amount of an asset, typically cash, provided to a counterparty to provide certain assurance of performance by the entity pursuant to the terms of a written or oral agreement, such as a lease.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Deferred Tax Assets Noncurrent
Carrying Value of Securities Sold under Repurchase Agreements and Deposits Received for Securities Loaned
unclassified.description: Carrying value of securities sold under agreements to repurchase and deposits received for securities loaned.

unclassified.label: Cash Flow Hedge Derivative Instrument Assets at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of all asset derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Financing Activities, Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activity attributable to discontinued operation. Financing activity includes, but is not limited to, obtaining resource from owner and providing return on, and return of, their investment; borrowing money and repaying amount borrowed, or settling obligation; and obtaining and paying for other resource obtained from creditor on long-term credit.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Accounted for as Debt Securities, Acquired During Period, Contractually Required Payments Receivable at Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of contractually required payments receivable at acquisition of acquired loans accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Convertible Preferred Dividends, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: The after-tax amount of any dividends on convertible preferred stock.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage Rate Range, Minimum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAndHeldToMaturityAmortizedCostBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAndHeldToMaturityCumulativeUnrecognizedLoss
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative unrecognized loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Rolling after 10 Years, Weighted Average Yield
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), maturing after tenth rolling fiscal year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Rolling after Five Through Ten Years, Weighted Average Yield
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), maturing in sixth through tenth rolling fiscal year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Rolling after One Through Five Years, Weighted Average Yield
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), maturing in second through fifth rolling fiscal year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Maturity, Rolling within One Year, Weighted Average Yield
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), maturing in next rolling fiscal year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Realized Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Shares Issued
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued pursuant to the terms of a deferred compensation arrangement.

unclassified.label: Deferred Discounts, Finance Charges and Interest Included in Receivables
unclassified.description: Amount of unearned discount, finance charge, and interest included in face amount of receivable. Excludes cash or quantity discount or both.

unclassified.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Administration Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of administration expense of defined benefit plan which decreases plan assets. Excludes plan administration expense paid by employer.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, Prior Service Cost (Credit), after Reclassification Adjustment, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, after reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income from prior service cost (credit) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Business Combination
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in plan assets of defined benefit plan from business combination.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Debt Securities (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Employer, Related Party, Number of Shares
unclassified.description: Number of shares of employer stock in which defined benefit plan asset is invested. Includes, but is not limited to, stock issued or managed by related party of employer.

unclassified.label: Diluted Earnings Per Share Pro Forma
unclassified.description: Pro forma diluted earnings per share, which is commonly presented in initial public offerings.

unclassified.label: DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in direct financing lease.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period, before Income Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes gain (loss) on disposal and provision for gain (loss) until its disposal.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accounts, Notes and Loans Receivable, Net
unclassified.description: Amount classified as accounts, notes and loans receivable attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Cash and Cash Equivalents
unclassified.description: Amount classified as cash and cash equivalents attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Goodwill
unclassified.description: Amount classified as goodwill attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction. Includes, but is not limited to, dividend deduction, deduction for dividend paid to employee stock ownership plan (ESOP), Medicare prescription drug benefit subsidy deduction, and other deductions.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Equity in Earnings (Losses) of Unconsolidated Subsidiary, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to equity in earnings (loss) of unconsolidated subsidiaries exempt from income taxes.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Amortization, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to amortization.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income tax settlements. Including, but not limited to, domestic tax settlement, foreign tax settlement, state and local tax settlement, and other tax settlements.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Amount Capitalized
unclassified.description: Amount of cost capitalized for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Total Risk-Based Capital, Excess, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of total risk-based capital exceeding minimum required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Assets and Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in income from asset and liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Volatility Rate (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Purchases
unclassified.description: Amount of purchases of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Settlements
unclassified.description: Amount of settlements of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability, measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Fixed Rate, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) with fixed interest rate maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Maturities Summary, Due in Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of advances from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Maturities Summary, Due in Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of advances from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, State and Municipal Government Obligations, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in fixed income obligations issued by state and local governments and authorities. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossLoanPurchased
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss for financing receivable from purchased loan classified as other. Excludes financing receivable purchased with credit deterioration, purchased seasoned loan, loan acquired through business combination or acquisition, and net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Recorded Investment, 1 to 29 Days Past Due (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
FinancingReceivableSale
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in financing receivable from sale. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Fixtures and Equipment, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of fixtures and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, machinery, equipment, and engines.

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) asset representing future economic benefit from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Per Basic and Diluted Share
Income Tax Examination, Interest Accrued
unclassified.description: The amount of estimated interest accrued as of the balance sheet date arising from income tax examinations.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Interest Expense
unclassified.description: The amount of estimated interest recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Noncontrolling Interest Income (Loss), Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to noncontrolling interest income (loss) exempt from income taxes.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Repatriation of Foreign Earnings, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to repatriation of foreign earnings.

unclassified.label: Income Taxes Receivable, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying amount due within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from tax authorities as of the balance sheet date representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Payables under Repurchase Agreements
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the liability under agreements to repurchase securities that were sold.

unclassified.label: Insurance Recoveries
unclassified.description: The amount recovered from insurance. These recoveries reduce costs and losses that are reported as a separate line item under operating expenses.

unclassified.label: Insurance Settlements Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount due in settlement of a claim for reimbursement from an insurance company when the Company has suffered a loss covered under an insurance policy.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Checking
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense on domestic checking deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Notice of Withdrawal
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense on domestic notice of withdrawal demand deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Interest Payable, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of [accrued] interest payable on all forms of debt, including trade payables, that has been incurred and is unpaid. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Liability at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all interest rate derivative liabilities designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Asset at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative assets not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Liability at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative liabilities not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Rental Receivables, Net
unclassified.description: This element represents leveraged lease rentals receivable, net of that portion of the rental applicable to principal and interest on the nonrecourse debt.

unclassified.label: Liabilities, Fair Value Adjustment
unclassified.description: Amount of addition (reduction) to the amount at which a liability could be incurred (settled) in a current transaction between willing parties.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Commercial, Net of Deferred Income (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, End of Period, in Allowance for Loan Loss (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, End of Period, Not in Allowance for Loan Loss (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, Nonperforming, over 90 Days, Accrual of Interest (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
