Loss Contingency Accrual, Payments (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loss Contingency Accrual, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in loss contingency liability.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Range of Possible Loss, Minimum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Machinery and Equipment, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation of tangible personal property used to produce goods and services, including, but is not limited to, tools, dies and molds, computer and office equipment.

unclassified.label: Municipal Debt Securities, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Bonds or similar securities issued by state, city, or local governments or the agencies operated by state, city, or local governments which are short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

unclassified.label: Notes Payable, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of notes payable.

unclassified.label: Notional Amount of Cash Flow Hedge Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments and Tax, Parent

Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Transition Asset (Obligation), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Transition Asset (Obligation), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Other Real Estate, Improvements
unclassified.description: Improvements to other real estate not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations may also be included in real estate owned. This excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Available-for-sale Securities
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) loss on investment in available-for-sale debt security, recognized in other comprehensive loss.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent, Available-for-sale Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in available-for-sale debt security, recognized in other comprehensive loss, attributable to the parent entity.

unclassified.label: Participating Securities, Distributed and Undistributed Earnings (Loss), Diluted
unclassified.description: Amount of earnings (loss) distributed and earnings (loss) allocated to participating securities for the diluted earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under the two-class method.

unclassified.label: Payments for Restructuring
unclassified.description: Amount of cash payments made as the result of exit or disposal activities. Excludes payments associated with a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

unclassified.label: Percentage of Interest-bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Brokered
unclassified.description: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic brokered deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Percentage of Interest-bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Checking
unclassified.description: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic checking demand deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Prepaid Taxes
unclassified.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for income and other taxes that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Contributed Capital
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received by a corporation from a shareholder during the period.

Restricted Investments, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: The aggregate value of all restricted investments.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Current Period Gain Recognized
unclassified.description: The portion of the deferred gain that was recognized in the current period.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Net Book Value
unclassified.description: The net book value of the asset(s) sold in connection with the sale of the property to another party and lease back to the seller.

unclassified.label: Securities for Reverse Repurchase Agreements

unclassified.label: Security Owned and Pledged as Collateral, Associated Liabilities, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of liabilities arising from or related to a financial instrument held by the entity for its own account (proprietary securities) which has been pledged to counterparties.

unclassified.label: SecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of fund outstanding borrowed in form of security repurchase agreement for sale and repurchase of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Excludes security sold under agreement to repurchase not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.description: Amount of cost expensed and capitalized for award under share-based payment arrangement.

Fair Value Assumption, Date of Securitization or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement, Transferor's Continuing Involvement, Servicing Assets or Liabilities, Prepayment Speed
unclassified.description: Estimated rate of prepayment of principal on financial assets for initial fair value measurement.

unclassified.label: Banking Fees and Commissions (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Banking Regulation, Capital Conservation Buffer, Tier One Risk-Based Capital, Actual
unclassified.description: Capital conservation buffer percentage calculated as Tier 1 risk-based capital ratio after deduction of minimum Tier 1 risk-based capital ratio as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Acquired Receivables, Estimated Uncollectible
unclassified.description: Amount of estimated contractual cash flow not expected to be collected for receivable purchased without credit deterioration, acquired in business combination. Excludes purchased financial asset with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Liabilities, Long-term Debt
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Liabilities, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as other and current.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Income Statement, Amortization Expense
unclassified.description: The charge for the use of long-lived depreciable capital leased assets for the period.

unclassified.label: Cash Flow Hedge Derivative Instrument Liabilities at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of all liability derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Accounted for as Debt Securities, Accretable Yield, Disposals of Loans
unclassified.description: Sale or transfer of a loan during the period resulting in a reduction in the excess of a loan's cash flows expected to be collected over the investor's initial investment. This relates to loans accounted for as debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that was acquired by completion of a transfer for which it is probable, at acquisition, that the investor will be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Acquired During Period, Consumer, Contractually Required Payments Receivable at Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of contractually required payments receivable at acquisition of acquired consumer loans not accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Credit Risk Derivative Assets, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of credit risk derivative asset.

unclassified.label: Cumulative Effect of Prospective Application of New Accounting Principle (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Debt, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate at Period End (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Repurchase Amount
unclassified.description: Fair value amount of debt instrument that was repurchased.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossNotToSellBeforeRecoveryCreditLossPreviouslyRecordedExpenseReversal
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) with previously recorded allowance and not intended to be sold and not more likely than not will be required to sell before recovery of amortized cost basis.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossRecovery
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of increase in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from recovery.

unclassified.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred policy acquisition cost capitalized on contract remaining in force.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other Loss Carryforwards
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible loss carryforwards, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Other Tax Carryforwards
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible tax carryforwards, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost
unclassified.description: The amount as of the balance sheet date of the estimated future tax effects attributable to policy acquisition costs being expensed for tax purposes but capitalized in conformity with generally accepted accounting principles, which will reverse in future periods when amortization of such capitalized costs cannot be deducted for tax purposes.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Other Capitalized Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from capitalized costs classified as other.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Amount of Unrecognized Deferred Tax Liability, Undistributed Earnings of Foreign Subsidiaries
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability not recognized because of the exceptions to comprehensive recognition of deferred taxes related to undistributed earnings of foreign subsidiaries.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Weighted-Average Interest Crediting Rate
unclassified.description: Weighted-average interest crediting rate used to determine net periodic benefit cost of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, cash balance and other defined benefit plans with promised interest crediting rate.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Contributions by Plan Participants (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payment, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of benefit for defined benefit plan expected to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Employer Contributions, Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of contributions received and expected to be received by defined benefit plan from employer in current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Other (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Other, Range Maximum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Other, Range Minimum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Deposit Liabilities Reclassified as Loans Receivable (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Derivative Asset Not Designated as Hedging Instrument, Fair Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Derivative, Average Variable Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Average variable interest rate related to the group of interest rate derivatives.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Basis Spread on Variable Rate
unclassified.description: The percentage points added to the reference rate to compute the variable rate on the interest rate derivative.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Assets
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the asset arising from derivative instruments and hedging activities, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability Designated as Hedging Instrument, Fair Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Derivative Liability Not Designated as Hedging Instrument, Fair Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Not Offset, Policy Election Deduction
unclassified.description: Amount of derivative liability, security sold under agreement to repurchase, and security loaned, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from derivative liability, security sold under agreement to repurchase, and security loaned.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Net Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Trading Account Assets (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Liability, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income from liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of financial instrument classified as an asset measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Purchases
unclassified.description: Amount of purchases of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Option, Loans Held as Assets, 90 Days or More Past Due, Aggregate Difference
unclassified.description: For loans held as assets for which the fair value option has been elected, this item represents the difference between the aggregate fair value and the aggregate unpaid principal balance of those loans that are 90 days or more past due.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Option, Loans Held as Assets, Aggregate Amount in Nonaccrual Status, Aggregated Difference
unclassified.description: For loans held as assets for which the fair value option has been elected, this item represents the difference between the aggregate fair value and the aggregate unpaid principal balance of those loans that are in nonaccrual status.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Maturities Summary, in Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Par amount of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, US Government and Agency Obligations, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in debt obligations issued by the US government including short-term Treasury bills, medium-term Treasury notes, and long-term Treasury bonds, as well as debt issued by agencies. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestSale
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of decrease in financing receivable from sale. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Revolving, Converted to Term Loan During Period
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in term loan from conversion of revolving financing receivable.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of intangible assets.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) of interest rate cash flow hedge excluded from assessment of effectiveness and recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Investments, Excluding Other than Temporary Impairments
Goodwill, Translation Adjustments (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Hedged Liability, Fair Value Hedge, Cumulative Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in fair value of hedged liability in fair value hedge, attributable to hedged risk. Excludes cumulative basis adjustment related to foreign exchange risk.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Equity in Earnings (Losses) of Unconsolidated Subsidiary, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to equity in earnings (loss) of unconsolidated subsidiaries exempt from income taxes.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Related Party
Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Asset at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all interest rate derivative assets designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Land and Land Improvements
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation and depletion of real estate held for productive use and additions or improvements to real estate held for productive use, examples include, but are not limited to, walkways, driveways, fences, and parking lots. Excludes land held for sale.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Deferred Income
unclassified.description: The estimated portion of pretax income and investment tax credit remaining to be allocated to income over the lease term.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Investment in Leveraged Leases, Net
unclassified.description: The net investment in arrangements meeting the criteria for classification as leveraged leases including deferred taxes.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Residual Value of Leased Assets
unclassified.description: The estimate of the value of the leased asset at the end of the lease term.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Number of Plaintiffs
unclassified.description: Number of plaintiffs that have filed claims pertaining to a loss contingency.

unclassified.label: Marketable Securities, Restricted (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Noncontrolling Interest, Ownership Percentage by Parent
unclassified.description: The parent entity's interest in net assets of the subsidiary, expressed as a percentage.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Parent, Diluted
unclassified.description: The portion of profit or loss for the period, net of income taxes, which is attributable to the parent, and includes adjustments resulting from the assumption that dilutive convertible securities were converted, options or warrants were exercised, or that other shares were issued upon the satisfaction of certain conditions.

unclassified.label: Noninterest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Brokered
unclassified.description: Amount of noninterest-bearing domestic third-party deposits placed by or through the assistance of a deposit broker, also known as brokered deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Notes Payable to Bank
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, the carrying value as of the balance sheet date of notes payable to banks, excluding mortgage notes, initially due beyond one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer.

unclassified.label: Notional Amount of Fair Value Hedge Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Occupancy Costs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Origination of Notes Receivable from Related Parties
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for a loan, supported by a promissory note, granted to related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party; including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount before tax, after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, on foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to parent entity.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, Unrealized Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, Unrealized Gain (Loss) Arising During Period, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk on financial liability measured under fair value option.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for translation gain (loss) realized upon the sale or liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity and foreign currency hedges that are designated and qualified as hedging instruments for hedges of the foreign currency exposure of a net investment in a foreign operation.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Transition Asset (Obligation), Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Noncash Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense or loss included in net income that result in no cash flow, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Liability, Other Postretirement Defined Benefit Plan
unclassified.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit other postretirement plan. Excludes pension plan.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Loss, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, before Tax, Attributable to Parent Held-to-maturity Securities
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity debt security, recognized in other comprehensive loss, attributable to parent entity.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit for other than temporary impairment loss (OTTI) on investments in available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities, recognized in other comprehensive loss.

unclassified.label: Payments for Rent
unclassified.description: Cash payments to lessor's for use of assets under operating leases.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Additional Interest in Subsidiaries
unclassified.description: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of noncontrolling interest during the period.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Interest in Subsidiaries and Affiliates
unclassified.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of or advances to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, and joint venture or equity method investment) or the acquisition of an additional interest in a subsidiary (controlled entity).

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Mortgage-backed Securities (MBS), Available-for-sale
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for purchase of mortgage-backed security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Loans Pledged as Collateral, at Fair Value
Proceeds from Contributions from Parent
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from parent as a source of financing that is recorded as additional paid in capital.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Divestiture of Businesses and Interests in Affiliates
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the amount received from the sale of a business segment or subsidiary or sale of an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled during the period (for example, an unconsolidated subsidiary, affiliate, joint venture or equity method investment).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Recoveries of Loans Previously Charged off (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Property, Plant and Equipment, Transfers and Changes
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in property, plant, and equipment from reclassification, impairment, donation, and change classified as other. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Cost of Investment in Real Estate Sold
unclassified.description: Amount of real estate investments sold for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Other Deduction
unclassified.description: Amount of other deductions to real estate investments, excluding sales, for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Long-term Capital Lease Obligations
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for the obligation for a lease meeting the criteria for capitalization (with maturities exceeding one year or beyond the operating cycle of the entity, if longer).

unclassified.label: Retained Interest, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of interest continued to be held by a transferor after transferring financial assets to a third party.

unclassified.label: Revenue, Other Financial Services (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Segment Reporting Information, Intersegment Revenue (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Sale Leaseback Transaction, Deferred Gain, Gross
unclassified.description: The amount of the gain recorded in connection with the transaction involving the sale of property to another party and the lease of the property back to the seller to be recognized in future periods.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Deferred Gain, Net
unclassified.description: The portion of the gain that will be recorded as income or a reduction in rent expense in future periods less amounts recognized in the current period.

unclassified.label: Sale of Stock, Number of Shares Issued in Transaction
unclassified.description: The number of shares issued or sold by the subsidiary or equity method investee per stock transaction.

unclassified.label: Securities Borrowed, Amount Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of security borrowed from entity in exchange for collateral. Includes security borrowed not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Securities Borrowed, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of securities borrowed from entities in exchange for collateral. Includes assets elected not to be offset. Excludes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Securities Loaned and Securities Sold under Agreement to Repurchase, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral and funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Securities Loaned, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral. Includes liabilities elected not to be offset. Excludes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Not Offset, Policy Election Deduction
unclassified.description: Amount of fund outstanding borrowed in form of security repurchase agreement for sale and repurchase of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from security sold under agreement to repurchase.

unclassified.label: Securitization or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement, Financial Asset for which Transfer is Accounted as Sale, Gain (Loss) on Sale
unclassified.description: Reflects, by transferred financial asset type, the amount of sales proceeds in excess of or deficient from the sum of the carrying amounts of transferred financial assets plus transaction costs, including those transactions in which the seller/transferor has continuing involvement with the financial assets that have been transferred.

unclassified.label: Servicing Asset at Fair Value, Changes in Fair Value Resulting from Changes in Valuation Inputs
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value from changes in the inputs used to calculate the fair value of contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Exercise Price
unclassified.description: Agreed-upon price for the exchange of the underlying asset relating to the share-based payment award.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Exercisable, Intrinsic Value (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Short-term Debt, Weighted Average Interest Rate, over Time
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of short-term debt outstanding calculated over time.

unclassified.label: Supply Commitment, Remaining Minimum Amount Committed
unclassified.description: The floor amount as of the balance sheet date that the entity must expend to satisfy the terms of disclosed arrangements (excluding long-term commitments) in which the entity must commit resources to supply goods or services to one or more customers.

unclassified.label: Shares Granted, Value, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Forfeited
unclassified.description: Value of forfeited shares granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Value, Conversion of Convertible Securities, Net of Adjustments
unclassified.description: The net amount of stock issued during the period upon the conversion of convertible securities, net of adjustments (for example, to additional paid in capital) including the write-off of an equity component recognized to record the convertible debt instrument as two separate components - a debt component and an equity component. This item is meant to disclose the value of shares issued on conversion of convertible securities that were recorded as two separate (debt and equity) components.

unclassified.label: Tax Credit Carryforward, Deferred Tax Asset (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Change in Tax Rate, Deferred Tax Asset, Income Tax Expense
Time Deposits, Weighted Average Interest Rate, Maturities Year Five
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate for time deposits held by the entity with maturities greater than four years, but five years or less.

unclassified.label: Time Deposits, Weighted Average Interest Rate, Maturities Year Four
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate for time deposits held by the entity with maturities greater than three years, but four years or less.

unclassified.label: Time Deposits, Weighted Average Interest Rate, Maturities Year Three
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate for time deposits held by the entity with maturities greater than two years, but three years or less.

unclassified.label: Time Deposits, Weighted Average Interest Rate, Maturities Year Two
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate for time deposits held by the entity with maturities greater than one year, but two years or less.

unclassified.label: Trading Account Assets, Fair Value Disclosure (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Trading Securities, Realized Gain
Trading Securities, Unrealized Holding Gain
Transfer of Loans Held-for-sale to Portfolio Loans (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Unrealized Loss on Securities
SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Increase (Decrease) Adjustment
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves from adjustment.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Deduction
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves.

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Carrying Amount, Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Certificates of Deposit
unclassified.description: The weighted average interest rate for domestic certificates of deposit liabilities.

ProvisionsForEmployeeBenefits
PurchaseOfFinancialAssetsMeasuredAtFairValueThroughOtherComprehensiveIncomeClassifiedAsInvestingActivities
ReceivablesFromTaxesOtherThanIncomeTax
ReclassificationAdjustmentsOnHedgesOfNetInvestmentsInForeignOperationsBeforeTax
ReclassificationAdjustmentsOnHedgesOfNetInvestmentsInForeignOperationsNetOfTax
ReinsuranceContractsHeldThatAreLiabilities
RevenueFromRenderingOfServicesRelatedPartyTransactions
SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense
ShareOfOtherComprehensiveIncomeOfAssociatesAndJointVenturesAccountedForUsingEquityMethodBeforeTax
ShorttermDepositsNotClassifiedAsCashEquivalents
TaxBenefitArisingFromPreviouslyUnrecognisedTaxLossTaxCreditOrTemporaryDifferenceOfPriorPeriodUsedToReduceDeferredTaxExpense
TaxEffectOfTaxLosses
TransfersOutOfLevel1IntoLevel2OfFairValueHierarchyLiabilities
UndatedSubordinatedLiabilities
