Accounts Receivable, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of amount due from customers or clients for goods or services, including trade receivables, that have been delivered or sold in the normal course of business, and amounts due from others, including related parties.

unclassified.label: Accretion of Discount (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Other than Temporary Impairment, Not Credit Loss, Net of Tax, Held-to-maturity, Debt Securities
unclassified.description: Accumulated other comprehensive loss related to portion of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) due to factors other than credit losses on debt securities categorized as held-to-maturity that an entity does not intend to sell and which it is not more likely than not that the entity will be required to sell before recovery of the amortized cost basis of the debt security. The amount represented by this item is net of tax, as applicable.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting Information, Expenditures for Additions to Long-Lived Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
AssetsAverageOutstanding
unclassified.description: Average amount outstanding of interest-earning and noninterest-earning assets.

unclassified.label: Assets Held-for-sale, at Carrying Value (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Net Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of net assets (liabilities).

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Equity Securities, Gross Unrealized Gain
Available-for-sale Securities, Accumulated Gross Unrealized Gain (Loss), before Tax
Available-for-sale Securities, Transfers to Trading, Gains (Losses)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Liabilities, Other Liabilities (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of pro forma income (loss) from continuing operations of combined entity as if acquisition date of business combination occurred as of beginning of period.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Financial Assets
unclassified.description: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to financial assets acquired in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Assets, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as other and current.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Assets, Prepaid Expense and Other Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of prepaid expense and asset classified as other, acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Liabilities, Accounts Payable
unclassified.description: Amount of accounts payable assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Business Combination Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Deferred Tax Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax asset acquired in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Income Statement, Interest Expense
unclassified.description: The financing charge for leasing arrangements meeting the criteria for capitalization.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Accounted for as Debt Securities, Accretable Yield, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of the excess of a loan's cash flows expected to be collected over the investor's initial investment in acquired loans accounted for as debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Allowance for Loan Losses, Decreases
unclassified.description: Amount of reduction in the reserve for loans impairments as a result of current information and events which result in it being probable that estimated cash flows will be significantly higher than previously expected or because actual cash flows are significantly greater than cash flows previously expected for loans not accounted for as debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that was acquired by completion of a transfer for which it is probable, at acquisition, that the investor will be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans and Debt Securities Acquired in Transfer, Allowance for Credit Losses Due to Subsequent Impairment
unclassified.description: For loans and debt securities, 1) for which at acquisition it was probable that the investor would be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable, and 2) for which it is further probable that the investor will not be able to collect all cash flows expected at acquisition (plus any additional cash flows expected due to changes in estimate after acquisition), the allowance for credit losses recorded to reflect the impairment since acquisition.

unclassified.label: Construction Loan
unclassified.description: This element represents the carrying value of a short-term real estate loan to finance building costs. The funds are disbursed as needed or in accordance with a prearranged plan; generally, a portion of the funds is disbursed at inception and the remainder as construction progresses. The money is repaid on completion of the project, usually from the proceeds of a mortgage loan. The rate is normally higher than the prime rate, and there is usually an origination fee. The effective yield on these loans tends to be high, and the lender has a security interest in the real property. Note that there are separate concepts for the current and noncurrent portions of long-term construction loans.

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Convertible Preferred Stock, Shares Issued upon Conversion
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued for each share of convertible preferred stock that is converted.

unclassified.label: Cost-method Investments, Other than Temporary Impairment
Credit Card Receivables
unclassified.description: Amounts receivable from issuing a card to individuals or businesses that allows someone to make a purchase on borrowed money.

unclassified.label: Credit Derivative, Current Fair Value (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Customer Securities for which Entity has Right to Sell or Repledge, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of customer securities accepted as collateral by the entity that it is permitted by contract or custom to sell or re-pledge to counterparties as collateral.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Maturity, Rolling after Ten Years, Weighted Average Yield
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), maturing after tenth fiscal year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Purchase
unclassified.description: Amount of increase from purchase of debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Deconsolidation, Gain (Loss), Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from deconsolidation of subsidiary and derecognition of group of assets constituting transfer of business or nonprofit activity, excluding conveyance of oil and gas mineral rights and transfer of good or service in contract with customer.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Asset, Interest Carryforward
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible interest carryforward.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Deferred Gain on Sale Leaseback Transaction
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from a gain reported for tax purposes on sale and leaseback transactions in accordance with enacted tax laws.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Investment in Subsidiaries
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from the entity's investment in its wholly-owned subsidiaries.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Operating Loss Carryforwards, Foreign
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible foreign operating loss carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Compensated Absences
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from compensated absences (includes, but not limited to, sick and personal days).

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Restructuring Charges
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from restructuring reserve.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Undistributed Foreign Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from undistributed earnings of subsidiary and other recognized entity not within country of domicile. Includes, but is not limited to, other basis differences.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Assumptions Used Calculating Benefit Obligation, Weighted-Average Interest Crediting Rate
unclassified.description: Weighted-average interest crediting rate used to determine benefit obligation of defined benefit plan. Plan includes, but is not limited to, cash balance and other defined benefit plans with promised interest crediting rate.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Cost of Providing Special and Contractual Termination Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of cost of providing special or contractual termination benefits payable from defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Projected Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Plan Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of plan asset for defined benefit pension plan with projected benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

unclassified.label: Delinquent Amount at End of Period on Loans Managed and Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement
unclassified.description: This is the principal amount of loans (across all types of loans) that are overdue in payment by a set number of days.

unclassified.label: Deposits Received for Securities Loaned, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return cash received as collateral for security loaned to another party.

unclassified.label: Deposits, Retail
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount of all retail deposit accounts including demand accounts, savings accounts, and certificates of deposit.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Fair Value Hedge, Included in Effectiveness, Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on derivative instrument designated and qualifying as fair value hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Variable Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Variable interest rate in effect as of the balance sheet date related to the interest rate derivative.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: Amount classified as intangible assets, excluding goodwill, attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Effect on Retained Earnings (Accumulated Deficit) Due to Change in Measurement Date, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Employee-related Liabilities
unclassified.description: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Number of Suspense Shares
unclassified.description: Shares contributed to the ESOP that have not yet been released, committed to be released, or allocated to participant accounts. Suspense shares generally collateralize ESOP debt.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Weighted Average Purchase Price of Shares Purchased
unclassified.description: Weighted average purchase price of capital shares purchased through an employee stock ownership plan.

unclassified.label: Extraordinary Item, Gain (Loss), Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
FDIC Indemnification Asset, Disposals
unclassified.description: Amount of decreases to the indemnification asset due to disposals relating to loss sharing agreements with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC).

unclassified.label: Fair Value Inputs, Loss Severity (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Obligations, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value of obligations measured on a recurring basis.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Sales
unclassified.description: Amount of sales of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income for derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured at fair value using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Sales
unclassified.description: Amount of sales of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Option, Aggregate Differences, Long-term Debt Instruments
unclassified.description: This item represents the difference between the aggregate fair value and the aggregate unpaid principal balance of long-term debt instruments that have contractual principal amounts and for which the fair value option has been elected.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Maturities Summary, Due after Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of advances from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Maturities Summary, Due in Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of advances from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Maturities Summary, Due in Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of advances from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Maturities Summary, in Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Par amount of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Maturities Summary, in Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Par amount of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Weighted Average Interest Rate, Maturing in Next Twelve Rolling Months
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate on advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestChangeInMethodCreditLossExpenseReversal
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense (reversal of expense) on financing receivable from change in methodology. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestReclassificationToHeldForSale
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable reclassified to held-for-sale. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Nonaccrual, Percent Past Due
unclassified.description: Percentage of nonaccrual financing receivable balance outstanding that is past due.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Finite-lived Intangible Assets, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of assets, excluding financial assets, that lack physical substance, having a limited useful life.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Weighted-Average Useful Life (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Goodwill, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: Guaranty Fee Income (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) including portion attributable to noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, State and Local, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax settlement.

unclassified.label: Increase in Carrying Amount of Redeemable Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: Adjustment to retained earnings for the increase in carrying amount of redeemable preferred stock that is classified as temporary equity.

unclassified.label: Increase in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible
unclassified.description: Amount of increase reasonably possible in the next twelve months for the unrecognized tax benefit.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Conversion of Debt Securities
unclassified.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of convertible debt securities using the if-converted method.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Nonvested Shares with Forfeitable Dividends
unclassified.description: Number of additional shares included in diluted EPS for potentially dilutive effect of nonvested equity-based payment award containing forfeitable rights to dividends or dividend equivalents, whether paid or unpaid.

unclassified.label: Intangible Assets, Current
unclassified.description: The current portion of nonphysical assets, excluding financial assets, if these assets are classified into the current and noncurrent portions.

unclassified.label: Interest Costs Capitalized
unclassified.description: Amount of interest capitalized during the period.

unclassified.label: Investment Income, Amortization of Discount
unclassified.description: Amount of accretion of purchase discount on nonoperating securities.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Unused Capacity, Commitment Fee Percentage
unclassified.description: The fee, expressed as a percentage of the line of credit facility, for available but unused credit capacity under the credit facility.

unclassified.label: Lines of Credit, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of contractual arrangement with a lender under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Commercial, Governments (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount, Consumer (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Other, Allowance (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans Receivable Held-for-sale, Net, Not Part of Disposal Group, Other (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Loans Receivable Held-for-sale, Reconciliation to Cash Flow, Deductions from Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of deduction to financing receivable held for sale that is not part of disposal group.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Percentage Bearing Variable Interest, Percentage Rate
unclassified.description: The interest rate applicable to the portion of the carrying amount of long-term borrowings outstanding as of the balance sheet date, including current maturities, which accrues interest at a rate subject to change from time to time.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Percentage Bearing Fixed Interest, Amount
unclassified.description: The portion of the carrying amount of long-term borrowings outstanding as of the balance sheet date, including current maturities, which accrues interest at a set, unchanging rate.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Damages Awarded, Value
unclassified.description: Amount of damages awarded to the plaintiff in the legal matter.

unclassified.label: Maximum Potential Future Exposure on Credit Risk Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Commercial and Consumer, Net
unclassified.description: The balance represents the amount of loans that are secured by real estate mortgages, offset by the reserve to cover probable credit losses on the loan portfolio.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Write-down or Reserve, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of mortgage loan within investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, written down.

unclassified.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating, investing, and financing activities; attributable to discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Basic
unclassified.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities; of income (loss) from discontinued operations available to common shareholders.

unclassified.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Accounts Receivable Acquired
unclassified.description: The amount of accounts receivable that an Entity acquires in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as information about all investing and financing activities of an enterprise during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Liabilities Assumed (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Noninterest Expense Commission Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of fees incurred for commissions on mutual funds and insurance products.

unclassified.label: Notional Amount of Credit Risk Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Minimum Lease Revenue
unclassified.description: The total amount of lease revenue recognized for the period for which the lessee was obligated under leasing arrangements regardless of any other events or conditions. This amount excludes contingent revenue and sublease revenue.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Sublease Revenue
unclassified.description: The amount of revenue recognized for the period under subleasing arrangements.

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), Adjustments, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for adjustments from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, after Tax and Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option, attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for translation gain (loss) realized upon the sale or liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity and foreign currency hedges that are designated and qualified as hedging instruments for hedges of the foreign currency exposure of a net investment in a foreign operation.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, before Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Reclassification Adjustment of Noncredit Portion Included in Net Income, Availabe-for-sale Securities, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of reclassification adjustment for other than temporary impairment (OTTI) related to factors other than credit loss on a previously impaired investment in available-for-sale debt security.

unclassified.label: Participating Mortgage Loans, Mortgage Obligations, Amount
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount of the participating mortgage obligation at the end of the accounting period.

unclassified.label: Payments for Capital Improvements
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for acquisition of or capital improvements to properties held for investment (operating, managed, leased) or for use.

unclassified.label: Payments for Derivative Instrument, Investing Activities
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as investing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Payments for Hedge, Investing Activities
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Business Two, Net of Cash Acquired
unclassified.description: The cash outflow associated with a second acquisition of a business, net of the cash acquired from the purchase.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Restricted Certificates of Deposit
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from temporary investment with specific maturity and interest rate that are prohibited for current use.

unclassified.label: Payments to Fund Long-term Loans to Related Parties
unclassified.description: The cash outflow associated with extending a long-term loan to a related party. Alternate caption: Payments for Advances to Affiliates.

unclassified.label: Payments to Purchase Other Loans Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: The cash outflow used to purchase loans (other than mortgage loans) that are held with the intention to resell in the near future.

unclassified.label: Pledged Financial Instruments, Not Separately Reported, Other Debt Securities Available-for-sale or Held-for-investment
Premiums Earned, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums earned.

unclassified.label: Prepaid Pension Costs (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Pro Forma Weighted Average Shares Outstanding, Diluted
unclassified.description: The weighted average number of shares or units and dilutive common stock or unit equivalents outstanding in the calculation of proforma diluted earnings per share (earnings per unit), which is commonly presented in initial public offerings based on the terms of the offering.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Loan Originations (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Securities, Operating Activities
unclassified.description: Cash received from maturities, prepayments and calls of trading securities and other securities, classified as operating.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Other Deposits
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow for receipts of deposits classified as other.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Previous Acquisition
unclassified.description: Cash inflow representing an adjustment to the purchase price of a previous acquisition.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Property Subject to or Available for Operating Lease, Number of Units
unclassified.description: The number of units (items of property) under operating lease arrangements.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Improvements
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in real estate investments related to improvements for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Owned, Valuation Allowance, Component
unclassified.description: The valuation allowance loss on real estate owned or any impairment losses taken against real estate investments held for use or resale.

unclassified.label: Revenue, Remaining Performance Obligation, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of transaction price allocated to performance obligation that has not been recognized as revenue.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Write-down or Reserve, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of write-down or reserve recognized in the income statement on real estate investments for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Unguaranteed Residual Asset
unclassified.description: Present value expected to be derived from underlying asset following end of lease term not guaranteed by lessee or other third party unrelated to lessor.

unclassified.label: Secured Borrowings, Gross, Difference, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of secured borrowings in excess of (less than) the liability for repurchase agreements and securities lending transactions, before offset, included in offsetting disclosures.

unclassified.label: Securities Borrowed, Collateral, Obligation to Return Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return securities collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against securities borrowed.

unclassified.label: Securities Borrowed, Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of liability associated with securities borrowed from entities in exchange for collateral.

unclassified.label: Securities Loaned, Amount Offset Against Collateral
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of security loaned to entity in exchange for collateral. Includes security loaned not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Securities Loaned, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

unclassified.label: Securities Loaned, Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement and Assets other than Securities Transferred
unclassified.description: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of financial assets loaned to entities in exchange for collateral. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and financial assets transferred other than securities that qualify as secured borrowings.

unclassified.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

unclassified.label: SecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of fund outstanding borrowed in form of security repurchase agreement for sale and repurchase of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes security sold under agreement to repurchase not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting Information, Noninterest Income (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Segment Reporting Information, Revenue for Reportable Segment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instrument Other than Option, Nonvested, Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: Per share or unit weighted-average intrinsic value of nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Granted
unclassified.description: Net number of non-option equity instruments granted to participants.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Per Share Weighted Average Price of Shares Purchased
unclassified.description: Per share weighted-average price paid for shares purchased on open market for issuance under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Shares Purchased for Award
unclassified.description: Number of shares purchased for issuance under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Significant (Increase) Decrease in Unrecognized Tax Benefits is Reasonably Possible, Estimated Range of Change, Upper Bound (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Stockholders' Equity Note, Stock Split, Conversion Ratio (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Change in Tax Rate, Provisional Income Tax Expense (Benefit) (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Measurement Period Adjustment, Income Tax Expense (Benefit)
Temporary Equity, Accretion to Redemption Value, Adjustment
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease to net income for accretion of temporary equity to its redemption value to derive net income apportioned to common stockholders.

unclassified.label: TimeDepositLiabilityAboveUsInsuranceLimitMaturityOver12Months
unclassified.description: Amount of uninsured time deposit liability in excess of Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance limit or similar state deposit insurance regime in United States of America (US), with time remaining to mature over 12 months. Excludes time deposit that is otherwise uninsured.

unclassified.label: Time Deposits, Weighted Average Interest Rate, Maturities Year One
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate for time deposits held by the entity with maturities of one year or less.

unclassified.label: Troubled Debt Restructuring, Debtor, Subsequent Periods, Contingent Payments, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of restructured debt contingently payable based on the occurrence of future events or circumstances.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Gain on Securities
Variable Interest Entity, Qualitative or Quantitative Information, Ownership Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of the Variable Interest Entity's (VIE) voting interest owned by (or beneficial interest in) the reporting entity (directly or indirectly).

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Basic Shares Outstanding, Pro Forma
unclassified.description: The weighted average number of shares (units) outstanding in the calculation of pro forma basic earnings per share (earnings per unit), which is commonly presented in initial public offerings based on the terms of the offering.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Brokered
unclassified.description: The weighted average interest rate for domestic brokered deposit liabilities.
