Accelerated Share Repurchases, Settlement (Payment) or Receipt
unclassified.description: Amount of cash receipt from (payment to) bank; or stock received from (issuance to) bank in the settlement of the accelerated share repurchase agreement.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Amortization, Debt Issuance Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of debt issuance costs.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Dividends in Excess of Retained Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from dividends legally declared (or paid) in excess of retained earnings balance.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Split
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from a stock split in which per-share par value or stated value is not changed proportionately.

unclassified.label: Alternative Investment
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment other than investment in equity security, investment in debt security and equity method investment. Includes, but is not limited to, investment in certain entities that calculate net asset value per share. Example includes, but is not limited to, investment in hedge fund, venture capital fund, private equity fund, and real estate partnership or fund.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Deferred Charges
unclassified.description: The amount of amortization of deferred charges applied against earnings during the period.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Deferred Hedge Gains
unclassified.description: The amount of expense charged against earnings by an Entity to record deferred gains and losses on hedge instruments. Examples include gain on economic hedges, amortization of gain on designated fair value hedge and so forth.

unclassified.label: Amount Available for Dividend Distribution with Approval from Regulatory Agencies (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Ancillary Fee Income Generated by Servicing Financial Assets, Amount
unclassified.description: All amounts that are due to the servicer of a financial asset, excluding contractually specified servicing fees and late fees.

unclassified.label: Asset at Fair Value, Changes in Fair Value Resulting from Changes in Assumptions
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value from changes in the assumptions or model used to calculate the fair value of a contract to service financial assets under which the benefits of servicing are expected to more than adequately compensate the servicer.

unclassified.label: Asset-Backed Securities, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Investments in notes or bonds that are collateralized by a specific group of underlying assets owned by the issuer of the notes or bonds which are short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

unclassified.label: Assets Held-for-sale, Property, Plant and Equipment (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Amortized Cost, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Basic Earnings Per Share, Pro Forma
unclassified.description: Pro forma basic earnings per share or earnings per unit, which is commonly presented in initial public offerings based on the terms of the offering.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Deferred Taxes Asset (Liability), Net, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of tangible and intangible assets other than cash transferred by acquirer as part of consideration transferred in business combination. Includes, but is not limited to, business or subsidiary, or both, of acquirer transferred to former owner of acquiree.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Current Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Separately Recognized Transactions, Additional Disclosures, Acquisition Cost Expensed
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for acquisition-related cost incurred to effect business combination and recognized separately from acquisition of asset and assumption of liability. Includes, but is not limited to, finder's fee and advisory, legal, accounting, valuation, and other professional and consulting fees. Excludes integration, restructuring, and other post-combination costs; cost related to acquisition of asset; and acquisition-related cost for transaction with third party.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Step Acquisition, Equity Interest in Acquiree, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of equity in the acquiree held by the acquirer immediately before the acquisition date in a business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Step Acquisition, Equity Interest in Acquiree, Remeasurement Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of gain from remeasurement of acquisition-date fair value of equity interest in acquiree held by acquirer immediately before acquisition date in business combination achieved in stages.

unclassified.label: Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) Reclassified to Revenue, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Accounted for as Available-for-sale Debt Securities, Acquired, at Acquisition, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value at acquisition of acquired loans accounted for as available-for-sale debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Accounted for as Debt Securities, Accretable Yield, Reclassifications to Nonaccretable Difference
unclassified.description: Change in the estimate of cash flows expected to be collected, after acquisition of a loan, which results in a decrease in accretable yield (for example, as a result of an other-than-temporary impairment). This relates to loans accounted for as debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that was acquired by completion of a transfer for which it is probable, at acquisition, that the investor will be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Consumer, Outstanding Balance
unclassified.description: The undiscounted sum of all amounts, including amounts deemed principal, interest, fees, penalties, and other under the loan, owed to the investor at the reporting date, whether or not currently due and whether or not any such amounts have been written or charged off by the investor. This relates to consumer loans not accounted for as debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that were acquired by completion of a transfer for which it is probable, at acquisition, that the investor will be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans and Debt Securities Acquired in Transfer, with Related Allowance for Credit Losses Due to Subsequent Impairment
unclassified.description: The recorded amount of loans and debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that were acquired by completion of a transfer for which it was probable, at acquisition, that the investor would be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable. They are deemed to be impaired since the acquisition and an allowance for credit losses has been recorded. Disclosure is gross of the allowance.

unclassified.label: Closed Portfolio and Beneficial Interest, Last-of-Layer, Amortized Cost
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of closed portfolio of financial asset and beneficial interest secured by financial instrument, used to designate hedging relationship in which hedged item is expected to be outstanding for designated hedge period.

unclassified.label: Collateralized Financings
unclassified.description: The value of the collateral (typically cash) that the entity receives in a financing transaction in exchange for securities lent. This item represents a liability in the financial statements of the lender of the securities.

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two and Three
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in second and third fiscal years following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Cost-method Investments, Aggregate Carrying Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Cumulative Effect of Initial Adoption of FAS 159 (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Convertible, Conversion Price
unclassified.description: The price per share of the conversion feature embedded in the debt instrument.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Increase (Decrease), Net
unclassified.description: Net increase or decrease in the carrying amount of the debt instrument for the period.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Effective Percentage Rate Range, Maximum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Stated Percentage Rate Range, Maximum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Unamortized Premium
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt premium.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Not Previously Recorded
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), for which no credit loss was previously recorded.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Not to Sell before Recovery, Credit Loss, Previously Recorded, Expense (Reversal)
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), not intended to be sold and not more likely than not will be required to sell before recovery of amortized cost basis, with previously recorded allowance.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Allowance for Credit Loss at Acquisition Date
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss at acquisition date of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), purchased with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Transfer to Held-to-Maturity, Allowance for Credit Loss, Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of credit loss expense on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) transferred into held-to-maturity out of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, 90 Days or More Past Due, Still Accruing
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), 90 days or more past due and still accruing.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Maturity, Rolling after Five Through Ten Years, Weighted Average Yield
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), maturing in sixth through tenth rolling fiscal year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Maturity, Rolling after One Through Five Years, Weighted Average Yield
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), maturing in second through fifth rolling fiscal year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Maturity, Rolling within One Year, Weighted Average Yield
unclassified.description: Weighted average yield of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), maturing in next rolling fiscal year following latest fiscal year. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Realized Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of realized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Allocated Share-based Compensation Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense recognized from equity-based compensation arrangements (for example, shares of stock, unit, stock options or other equity instruments), awarded to key employees or individuals. Excludes amount related to plans that cover generally all employees (for example, but not limited to, qualified pension plans).

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Shares Authorized for Issuance
unclassified.description: The maximum number of shares authorized for issuance under the deferred compensation arrangement as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Liability, Current
unclassified.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for all deferred compensation arrangements payable within one year (or the operating cycle, if longer). Represents currently earned compensation under compensation arrangements that is not actually paid until a later date.

unclassified.label: Deferred Rent Credit
unclassified.description: Amount of excess of rental payment required by lease over rental income recognized.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Unrealized Currency Losses
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from unrealized losses on foreign currency transactions.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Capitalized Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from capitalized interest.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Amount of Unrecognized Deferred Tax Liability (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Employer, Related Party, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of employer security in which defined benefit plan asset is invested. Includes, but is not limited to, security issued or managed by related party of employer.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, (Increase) Decrease for Remeasurement due to Settlement
unclassified.description: Amount of (increase) decrease to benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from remeasurement due to settlement. Excludes decrease to benefit obligation for settlement payment.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Projected Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Projected Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of projected benefit obligation for defined benefit pension plan with projected benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Recognized Net (Gain) Loss Due to Settlements (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Contribution Plan, Maximum Annual Contribution Per Employee, Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed, Not Offset, Policy Election Deduction
unclassified.description: Amount of derivative asset, security purchased under agreement to resell, and security borrowed, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from derivative asset, security purchased under agreement to resell, and security borrowed.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Excluded Component, Gain (Loss), Recognized in Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from excluded component of derivative hedge, recognized in earnings. Excludes recognition under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Fair Value, Amount Offset Against Collateral, Net
unclassified.description: The net amount as of the balance sheet date of the fair value of derivative assets and derivative liabilities that in accordance with the entity's accounting policy were offset against collateral under a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement Deduction
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, not subject to a master netting arrangement, deducted from derivative liabilities.

unclassified.label: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseSecurityLoanedAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of derivative liability, security sold under agreement to repurchase, and security loaned. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes liability not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Lease Income
unclassified.description: Amount of lease income from variable lease payments, interest income on direct financing lease and after offset of loss recognized at commencement.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Residual Value of Leased Asset
unclassified.description: Amount of residual asset covered by residual value guarantee under direct financing lease. Excludes guarantee considered to be lease payments for lessor.

unclassified.label: Dividends, Stock
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid stock dividends declared for classes of stock, for example, but not limited to, common and preferred.

unclassified.label: Due from Correspondent Brokers
unclassified.description: Amount receivable from correspondent broker-dealer.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationCrossBorderOtherAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of reported income tax expense (benefit) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to cross-border tax law classified as other.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationCrossBorderOtherPercent
unclassified.description: Percentage of reported income tax expense (benefit) from difference to income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying statutory federal (national) income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to cross-border tax law classified as other.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Disposition of Business, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to disposition of a business not qualifying as a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Foreign, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign tax credit.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Aggregate Cost
unclassified.description: This element represents the aggregate cost of investments accounted for under the equity method of accounting.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Banking Regulation, Excess Tier One Leverage Capital, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of Tier 1 leverage capital exceeding minimum required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) Included in Investment Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Loans Receivable (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Servicing Rights (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value Disclosure, Off-balance Sheet Risks, Face Amount, Asset
unclassified.description: The face amount of financial assets, which are not recognized in the financial statements (off-balance sheet) because they fail to meet some other criterion for recognition.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Level 1 to level 2 Transfers, Amount (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Fair Value, Measured on Recurring Basis, Investments (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Issues
unclassified.description: Amount of issuances of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Maturities Summary, in Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Par amount of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Par Value
unclassified.description: Par amount of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank Advances, Weighted Average Interest Rate, Maturing in Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate on advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank maturing in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank Advances, Weighted Average Interest Rate, Maturing in Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate on advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Finance Lease, Liability, Current
unclassified.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as current.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableAccruedInterestModified
unclassified.description: Amount of accrued interest on financing receivable modified during period for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Amortization Expense, Rolling after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for assets, excluding financial assets and goodwill, lacking physical substance with a finite life expected to be recognized after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Purchase Accounting Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in finite-lived intangible asset from measurement period adjustment. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring, Net
unclassified.description: The amount of net gain (loss) reclassified into earnings in the period when cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

unclassified.label: Guarantees, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of guarantee, including, but not limited to, financial standby letter of credit, fair value guarantee, guarantee of collection of scheduled contractual cash flows from financial assets, and contracts that contingently require the guarantor to make payments or perform services.

unclassified.label: Impairment Charge on Reclassified Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss for long-lived asset reclassified from held-for-sale to held-and-used due to decision not to sell.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations and Disposal of Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Per Basic and Diluted Share
Income Tax Examination, Liability (Refund) Adjustment from Settlement with Taxing Authority
unclassified.description: The amount of the additional liability or refund received or expected based on a final settlement with a taxing authority.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Penalties Accrued
unclassified.description: The amount of estimated penalties accrued as of the balance sheet date arising from income tax examinations.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Penalties Expense
unclassified.description: The amount of estimated penalties recognized in the period arising from income tax examinations.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Credit, Foreign, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign tax credit.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the aggregate amount of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Customer Deposits
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the amount of customer money held in customer accounts, including security deposits, collateral for a current or future transactions, initial payment of the cost of acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value Adjustments on Other Assets (Liabilities) Carried at Fair Value under Fair Value Option
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in fair value adjustment on other assets (liabilities) carried at fair value under the fair value option on the statement of cash flows of Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).

unclassified.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Demand
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense on domestic demand deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Other Time Deposit
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense on domestic time deposit liabilities other than certificates of liabilities.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Other Domestic Deposits
unclassified.description: Amount of interest earned on US domestic deposits classified as other. Excludes money market accounts.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting Information, Interest Income or Expense, Net (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Fair Value
unclassified.description: The carrying amount (fair value) as of the balance sheet date of the transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (typically securitized receivables, generally not involved in the collection of principal) following transfer of significant portions of such financial instruments to other parties. Such interests could be ancillary cash flows and interest-only strips.

unclassified.label: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodElectedOtherIncomeTaxBenefit
unclassified.description: Amount of other income tax benefit generated by investment under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

unclassified.label: Investments in Affiliates, Subsidiaries, Associates, and Joint Ventures, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of investments in an entity not consolidated. Includes, but is not limited to, investments in an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership, an entity in which the reporting entity shares control of the entity with another party or group, an entity which the company has significant influence, but does not have control and subsidiaries that are not required to be consolidated and are accounted for using the equity or cost method.

unclassified.label: Land Available-for-sale
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in land held for sale.

unclassified.label: Late Fee Income Generated by Servicing Financial Assets, Amount
unclassified.description: All amounts that are due to the servicer of a financial asset as a result of the debt holder not meeting the monthly payment terms.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Income Statement, Income from Leveraged Leases
unclassified.description: Pretax lease income allocated in proportionate amounts from unearned income.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Commercial, Allowance (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Installment, Other (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount, Other (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans Payable to Bank
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of loans from a bank with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

unclassified.label: Loans Receivable, Gross, Mortgage Warehouse Lending (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
LongTermDebtAverageAmountOutstanding
unclassified.description: Average amount outstanding of long-term debt.

unclassified.label: Long-term Investments
unclassified.description: The total amount of investments that are intended to be held for an extended period of time (longer than one operating cycle).

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow reducing loss contingency liability.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, New Claims Filed, Number
unclassified.description: The total number of new claims filed pertaining to a loss contingency during the period.

unclassified.label: Loss on Contract Termination
unclassified.description: The loss recognized on termination of a contract.

unclassified.label: Mortgage Loan Related to Property Sales (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Payables Assumed
unclassified.description: The amount of payables that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Value of Assets Acquired (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Notes Payable, Related Parties
Notional Amount of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Other Derivatives Not Designated as Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Operating Costs and Expenses
unclassified.description: Generally recurring costs associated with normal operations except for the portion of these expenses which can be clearly related to production and included in cost of sales or services. Excludes Selling, General and Administrative Expense.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Origination and Purchases of Mortgage Banking Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Additional Capital
unclassified.description: Amount of additional paid-in capital (APIC) classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Finalization of Pension and Non-Pension Postretirement Plan Valuation, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Adjustment, Tax, Portion Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit), after reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to parent entity.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), Adjustments, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of adjustments from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), before Adjustments and Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and adjustments, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, after Tax and Reclassification Adjustment
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Derecognition, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for unrealized gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk, realized upon derecognition of financial liability measured under fair value option.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Derecognition, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for unrealized gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk, realized upon derecognition of financial liability measured under fair value option.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI, Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for translation gain (loss) realized upon the sale or liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity and foreign currency hedges that are designated and qualified as hedging instruments for hedges of the foreign currency exposure of a net investment in a foreign operation.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Investment Transferred from Available-for-sale to Equity Method, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) for reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for unrealized gain (loss) of investment classified as available-for-sale transferred to equity method.

unclassified.label: Other Real Estate, Covered, Disposals
unclassified.description: Disposals of other real estate covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

unclassified.label: Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss, Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Recognized in Other Comprehensive Loss, before Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI).

unclassified.label: Payments for Hedge, Financing Activities
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

unclassified.label: Payments of Capital Distribution
unclassified.description: Cash outflow to owners or shareholders, excluding ordinary dividends. Includes special dividends.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Mortgage Backed Securities (MBS) categorized as Held-to-maturity
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for the purchase of securities issued by a governmental agency or corporation (for example, GNMA or FHLMC) or by private issuers (for example, banks and mortgage banking enterprises) secured by and repaid from underlying mortgages, which were designated as held to maturity when acquired.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Real Estate Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: The cash outflow associated with the purchase of real estate held for investment purposes.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Short-term Investments
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

unclassified.label: Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Loans Pledged for Federal Home Loan Bank, at Fair Value
Pledged Financial Instruments, Not Separately Reported, Securities for Other Debt Facilities
Proceeds from Divestiture of Interest in Joint Venture
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the sale of an investment interest in a joint venture that the reporting entity has not previously accounted for using consolidation or the equity method of accounting.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Operating Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as operating activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as investing activities.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Preferred Stock, Preference Stock, and Warrants
unclassified.description: Proceeds from issuance of capital stock which provides for a specific dividend that is paid to the shareholders before any dividends to common stockholder, which takes precedence over common stockholders in the event of liquidation and from issuance of rights to purchase common shares at a predetermined price.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Other Equity
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from the issuance of equity classified as other.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repurchase of) Trust Preferred Securities
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from issuance of trust preferred securities, net of the cash outflow for repurchasing trust preferred securities, by a business trust or other special purpose entity, mainly established by a bank holding entity, to third party investors. The trust's assets are deeply subordinated debentures of the bank holding entity. Most trust preferred securities are subject to a mandatory redemption upon the repayment of the debentures.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Securities, Operating Activities
unclassified.description: Cash received from sale of investments in debt and equity securities, classified as operating activities, during the period; includes trading securities and any other investments classified as operating.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Securitizations of Loans Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the securitization of loans held for investment. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in property, plant, and equipment. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

unclassified.label: Quantifying Misstatement in Current Year Financial Statements, Amount
SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, of real estate investment by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate. Excludes real estate not held as investment or interest.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Investments, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of real estate owned for income production and capital accretion potential, not otherwise specified in the existing taxonomy. Such real estate excludes that which is occupied or used in the business, for entertainment purposes, or held in inventory for specific purposes.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Other Addition
unclassified.description: Amount of other additions excluding acquisition or improvement to real estate investments for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

unclassified.label: Real Estate, Write-down or Reserve, Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Related Party Transaction, Purchases from Related Party
unclassified.description: Purchases during the period (excluding transactions that are eliminated in consolidated or combined financial statements) with related party.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Short-term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from a repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

unclassified.label: Restructuring Reserve, Accrual Adjustment (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Revenue Not from Contract with Customer, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue that is not accounted for under Topic 606, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, Lease Payments to be Received, Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, Payments to be Received, Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in next rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Securities Loaned, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of right to receive securities collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against securities loaned.

unclassified.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Amount of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price, not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price, offset against a right to receive collateral.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting Information, Noninterest Expense (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Segment Reporting Information, Profit (Loss) (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Segment Reporting Information, Provision for Credit Losses (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Discount from Market Price, Purchase Date
unclassified.description: Discount rate from fair value on purchase date that participants pay for shares.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Outstanding, Number
unclassified.description: Number of equity instruments other than options outstanding, including both vested and non-vested instruments.

unclassified.label: Stock Dividends, Shares
unclassified.description: Number of shares of common and preferred stock issued as dividends during the period. Excludes stock splits.

unclassified.label: Development Stage Entities, Stock Issued, Shares, Issued for Cash (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Stock Splits
unclassified.description: Number of shares issued during the period as a result of a stock split.

unclassified.label: Subordinated Debt, Current
unclassified.description: The portion of the carrying value of subordinated debt as of the balance sheet date that is scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle, if longer. Subordinated debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Supplementary Leverage Ratio, Actual
unclassified.description: Ratio of Tier 1 risk-based capital to total leverage exposure as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Temporary Equity, Accretion to Redemption Value
unclassified.description: Value of accretion of temporary equity to its redemption value during the period.

unclassified.label: TimeDepositLiabilityAboveUsInsuranceLimitMaturityOverSixMonthsThroughTwelveMonths
unclassified.description: Amount of uninsured time deposit liability in excess of Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance limit or similar state deposit insurance regime in United States of America (US), with time remaining to mature over six through twelve months. Excludes time deposit that is otherwise uninsured.

unclassified.label: TimeDepositLiabilityAboveUsInsuranceLimitMaturityOverThreeMonthsThroughSixMonths
unclassified.description: Amount of uninsured time deposit liability in excess of Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance limit or similar state deposit insurance regime in United States of America (US), with time remaining to mature over three through six months. Excludes time deposit that is otherwise uninsured.

unclassified.label: TimeDepositLiabilityAboveUsInsuranceLimitMaturityThreeMonthsOrLess
unclassified.description: Amount of uninsured time deposit liability in excess of Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance limit or similar state deposit insurance regime in United States of America (US), with time remaining to mature in three months or less. Excludes time deposit that is otherwise uninsured.

unclassified.label: TimeDepositLiabilityUninsuredMaturityOverSixMonthsThroughTwelveMonths
unclassified.description: Amount of uninsured time deposit liability with time remaining to mature over six through twelve months. Excludes uninsured time deposit liability in excess of Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance limit or similar state deposit insurance regime in United States of America (US).

unclassified.label: TimeDepositLiabilityUninsuredMaturityOverThreeMonthsThroughSixMonths
unclassified.description: Amount of uninsured time deposit liability with time remaining to mature over three through six months. Excludes uninsured time deposit liability in excess of Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance limit or similar state deposit insurance regime in United States of America (US).

unclassified.label: TimeDepositLiabilityUninsuredMaturityThreeMonthsOrLess
unclassified.description: Amount of uninsured time deposit liability with time remaining to mature in three months or less. Excludes uninsured time deposit liability in excess of Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC) insurance limit or similar state deposit insurance regime in United States of America (US).

unclassified.label: Time Deposits, Weighted Average Interest Rate, Maturities Greater than Five Years
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate for time deposits held by the entity with maturities greater than five years.

unclassified.label: Trading Securities, Cost
Transfer of Financial Assets Accounted for as Sales, Amount Derecognized
unclassified.description: Amount of derecognized financial assets from transactions which comprise an initial transfer and an agreement entered into in contemplation of the initial transfer resulting in retention of substantially all of the exposure to the economic return throughout the term of the transaction, at the date of derecognition.

unclassified.label: Transfers Accounted for as Secured Borrowings, Associated Liabilities, Carrying Amount
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of liabilities associated with financial assets accounted for as secured borrowings recognized in the transferor's statement of financial position at the end of each period presented.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits Resulting in Net Operating Loss Carryforward (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Utilities Costs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves.

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Carrying Amount of Assets, Consolidated VIE (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Weighted Average Number of Shares, Contingently Issuable
unclassified.description: Shares issuable for little or no cash consideration upon the satisfaction of certain conditions (contingently issuable shares) are considered outstanding common shares and included in the computation of basic Earnings Per Share as of the date that all necessary conditions have been satisfied (in essence, when issuance of the shares is no longer contingent). Outstanding common shares that are contingently returnable (that is, subject to recall) are treated in the same manner as contingently issuable shares. Contingently issuable shares include shares that (a) will be issued in the future upon the satisfaction of specified conditions, (b) have been placed in escrow and all or part must be returned if specified conditions are not met, or (c) have been issued but the holder must return all or part if specified conditions are not met. The number of contingently issuable shares is determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that these shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Employee Stock Ownership Plan Shares Not Committed to be Released
unclassified.description: Number of employee stock ownership plan (ESOP) shares that have not been committed to be released determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that these shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Treasury Stock
unclassified.description: Number of shares of treasury stock determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that treasury shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period. Treasury stock is stock that the Entity has issued but subsequently reacquired.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Rate Domestic Deposit, Checking
unclassified.description: The weighted average interest rate for domestic checking deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: AccumulatedFairValueHedgeAdjustmentRemainingInStatementOfFinancialPositionForHedgedItemThatCeasedToBeAdjustedForHedgingGainsAndLossesLiabilities

unclassified.label: Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations, Net of Tax, Per Share, Diluted

Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Liabilities Incurred

Business Combination, Step Acquisition, Equity Interest in Acquiree, Remeasurement Gain (Loss), Net

unclassified.label: Capital Lease Obligations, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of capital lease obligation due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Allowance for Uncollectible Minimum Lease Payments
unclassified.description: The estimate of contractual payments on direct financing leases that are probable of not being collected as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Carrying Value of Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell and Deposits Paid for Securities Borrowed
unclassified.description: Carrying value of securities purchased under agreements to resell and deposits paid for securities borrowed.

unclassified.label: Cash Pass-through Reserve, Federal Home Loan Bank
unclassified.description: Amount of pass-through reserves deposited with Federal Reserve Banks from member institutions of Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).

unclassified.label: Cash Segregated under Other Regulations
unclassified.description: Cash deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers pursuant to regulations other than SEC Regulations and the Commodity Exchange Act.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Accretable Yield, Transfers to Loans Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: Amount of reduction, resulting from a reclassification to held-for-sale, in the excess of a loan's cash flows expected to be collected over the investor's initial investment in acquired loans not accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans and Debt Securities Acquired in Transfer, No Allowance Recorded and No Subsequent Impairment
unclassified.description: The recorded amount of loans and debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that were acquired by completion of a transfer for which it was probable, at acquisition, that the investor would be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable, but which are not deemed to be impaired since the acquisition by transfer. Therefore, no allowance for credit losses is recorded.

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four and Five
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in fourth and fifth fiscal years following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Contribution of Property
unclassified.description: Value of property contributed in noncash investing and financing activities.

unclassified.label: Convertible Debt
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying amount of debt identified as being convertible into another form of financial instrument (typically the entity's common stock) as of the balance sheet date, which originally required full repayment more than twelve months after issuance or greater than the normal operating cycle of the company.

unclassified.label: Cost of Real Estate Sales (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Costs and Expenses, Related Party
unclassified.description: Costs of sales and operating expenses for the period incurred from transactions with related parties.

unclassified.label: Cumulative Effect of Initial Adoption of FAS 158 (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Cumulative Effect on Retained Earnings, before Tax (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Debt Conversion, Original Debt, Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of the original debt being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Decrease, Forgiveness
unclassified.description: Decrease for amounts of indebtedness forgiven by the holder of the debt instrument.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Increase, Additional Borrowings (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Effective Percentage Rate Range, Minimum (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Interest Rate, Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Incremental percentage increase (decrease) in the stated rate on a debt instrument.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Periodic Payment
unclassified.description: Amount of the required periodic payments including both interest and principal payments.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Periodic Payment, Principal
unclassified.description: Amount of the required periodic payments applied to principal.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Increase
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and beneficial interest, purchased with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossSecuritiesSold
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of decrease in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from sale.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Amount at Par Value
unclassified.description: Amount at par value of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), purchased with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Accrued Interest, Writeoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of accrued interest on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) recognized by reversing interest income.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossPeriodIncreaseDecrease
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Transfer to Available-for-Sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of credit loss expense on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) transferred into available-for-sale out of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Distribution Paid
unclassified.description: Amount of distribution made to individual in accordance with deferred compensation arrangement.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, in Process Research and Development
unclassified.description: Amount, before allocation of valuation allowance, of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary difference from in-process research and development cost acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Unearned Premiums Reserve
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from the unearned premiums reserve.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income Minimum Pension Liability, after Tax (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Other Plan Assets (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Special and Contractual Termination Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in benefit obligation for benefits provided to employees payable from defined benefit plan or payable upon retirement.

unclassified.label: Deposits Paid for Securities Borrowed, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: This is the amount of cash advanced as security in return for borrowing securities from another party.

unclassified.label: Deposits with Clearing Organizations and Others, Securities
unclassified.description: The amount of securities on deposit with clearing organizations and other entities which provide services necessary to operations of the Company. This item would include, for instance, securities advanced as refundable collateral for securities borrowed.

unclassified.label: Deposits with Other Federal Home Loan Banks
unclassified.description: Amount of interest-bearing funds deposited into another Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).

unclassified.label: Continuing Involvement with Derecognized Transferred Financial Assets, Amount Outstanding
unclassified.description: Amount of transferred financial assets in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the assets underlying the transaction that have been derecognized. Continuing involvement includes, but is not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in transferred financial assets.

unclassified.label: DerivativeAssetSecurityPurchasedUnderAgreementToResellSecurityBorrowedAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of derivative asset, security purchased under agreement to resell, and security borrowed. Excludes asset not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: DerivativeAssetSecurityPurchasedUnderAgreementToResellSecurityBorrowedAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of derivative asset, security purchased under agreement to resell, and security borrowed. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes asset not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Liabilities
unclassified.description: Sum as of the balance sheet date of the (a) fair values of all liabilities resulting from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments, and (b) the carrying amounts of the liabilities arising from financial instruments or contracts used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), and which are expected to be extinguished or otherwise disposed of within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, net of the effects of master netting arrangements.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain Reclassified from Accumulated OCI into Income, Effective Portion
unclassified.description: The effective portion of gain reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income into income on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, Assets, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Aggregate fair value of all derivative assets designated as hedging instruments. Includes instruments designated as cash flow hedges, fair value hedges, and hedges of net investments in foreign operations.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Loss Recognized in Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned, offset against a right to receive collateral.

unclassified.label: Deteriorated Loans Transferred in, Debt Securities, Accreditable Yield, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) in accreditable yield (the excess of the loan's cash flows expected to be collected over the investor's initial investment in the loan) for the period.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share
unclassified.description: Per basic share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
unclassified.description: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of income (loss) from the day-to-day business activities of the discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Gain (Loss) from Disposal of Discontinued Operation
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) on gain (loss) not previously recognized resulting from the disposal of a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Not Discontinued Operation, Loss (Gain) on Write-down
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a disposal group. Excludes discontinued operations.

unclassified.label: Dividend Payments Restrictions Schedule, Statutory Capital and Surplus
unclassified.description: Amount of statutory capital and surplus computed using prescribed or permitted statutory accounting practice that can be distributed to stockholder as dividend payment.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Other, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other income tax contingencies.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Cash Used to Settle Award
unclassified.description: Aggregate cash paid by the entity during the period to settle equity instruments granted under equity-based payment arrangements.

unclassified.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Unrecognized Compensation Costs on Nonvested Awards (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Debt Structure, Direct Loan, Amount
unclassified.description: The amount reported as a liability as of the balance sheet date by the entity (the employer) of the loan made by a third-party lender directly to the ESOP.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Fair Value of Shares Subject to Repurchase Obligation
unclassified.description: Fair value of the shares allocated that are subject to a repurchase obligation.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Repurchase Obligation Amount
unclassified.description: An entity will typically disclose the amount of any repurchase obligation.

unclassified.label: Equity, Fair Value Adjustment
unclassified.description: Amount of addition (reduction) to the amount at which an instrument classified in shareholders' equity could be incurred (settled) in a current transaction between willing parties.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Amount Sold
unclassified.description: Amount of the entity's equity method investment which has been sold.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Concentration of Risk, Commitments
unclassified.description: Fair value of commitment subject to concentration of credit or market risk or both.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Disclosure, Off-balance Sheet Risks, Amount, Asset
unclassified.description: The fair value of financial assets, which are not recognized in the financial statements (off-balance sheet) because they fail to meet some other criterion for recognition.

Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Borrowings (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Trading Liabilities (Deprecated 2011-01-31)

Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Issuances

unclassified.description: Amount of purchases, (sales), issuances and (settlements) of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Transfers, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of transfers of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset) into (out of) level 3 of the fair value hierarchy.

Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Fixed Rate
unclassified.description: Par amount of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) with fixed interest rate.

Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Floating Rate, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) with floating interest rate maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Valuation Adjustments under Fair Value Option
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated increase (decrease) on advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) from fair value option adjustments.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Weighted Average Interest Rate, Maturing after Rolling Year Five
