For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Weighted Average Interest Rate, Maturing in Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate on advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Weighted Average Interest Rate, Maturing in Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate on advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Fees and Commissions, Correspondent Clearing (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Finance Lease, Liability, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Present value of lessee's discounted obligation for lease payments from finance lease, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Other, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of firm holdings in securities classified as other. Includes pledged and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Foreign Currency Translation
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Change in Present Value, Interest Income
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income on financing receivable from change in present value of expected cash flows attributable to passage of time. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Covered, before Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance, of finance receivable covered by loss sharing agreement.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestModifiedIncreaseDecreaseFromModification
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in amortized cost excluding accrued interest, of financing receivable modified for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestSaleAndReclassificationToHeldForSale
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of decrease from sale and reclassification to held-for-sale of financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableIndividuallyEvaluatedWithoutAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount of financing receivable without allowance for credit loss evaluated on individual basis. Excludes financing receivable evaluated on collective basis.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Transfer to Held-for-Sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Expense Reversal
unclassified.description: Amount of expense reversal of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable transferred to held-for-sale classification.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Customer Relationships, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before amortization, of finite-lived asset representing customer relationship acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Average Useful Life (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Gain (Loss) from Components Excluded from Assessment of Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness, Net

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Derivative Instruments Held for Trading Purposes, Net
unclassified.description: Aggregate net gain and losses (whether realized or unrealized) on all derivative instruments held for trading purposes whether or not settled physically.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Capital Leases, Net

unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of impairment loss from asset representing future economic benefit arising from other asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, that is not individually identified and separately recognized.

unclassified.label: Guaranty Liabilities
unclassified.description: This item represents a non-contingent liability for the fair value of an obligation to stand ready to perform over the term of a guaranty issued in the event that specified triggering events or conditions occur.

unclassified.label: Hedged Asset, Discontinued Fair Value Hedge, Cumulative Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in fair value of hedged asset in fair value hedge, attributable to hedged risk, remaining after discontinued hedge. Excludes cumulative basis adjustment related to foreign exchange risk.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations, Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) from a discontinued operation attributable to the noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, the income (loss) from operations during the phase-out period, gain (loss) on disposal, gain (loss) for reversal of write-down (write-down) to fair value, less cost to sell, and adjustments to a prior period gain (loss) on disposal.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Employee Stock Options
Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Equity Transactions
unclassified.description: The tax effect of an increase or decrease in contributed capital (for example, deductible expenditures reported as a reduction of the proceeds from issuing capital stock) during the period charged or credited directly to shareholders' equity.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Disposition of Business, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the disposition of a business not qualifying as a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Restructuring Charges, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible restructuring charges.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, State and Local, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in state and local income tax contingency.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Contract with Customer, Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Derivative Instruments, Not Designated as Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Increase (Decrease) in Undisbursed Loan Funds
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in undistributed cash for loans that have been granted but not entirely funded.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Accelerated Share Repurchase Agreements
unclassified.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of accelerated share repurchase agreements. An accelerated share repurchase program is a combination of transactions that permits an entity to purchase a targeted number of shares immediately with the final purchase price of those shares determined by an average market price over a fixed period of time.

unclassified.label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, Written off Related to Sale of Business Unit
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in indefinite-lived intangible asset from divestiture. Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Capital Securities
unclassified.description: Interest expense incurred during the reporting period on capital securities issued by the reporting entity.

unclassified.label: Interest on Convertible Debt, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of interest recognized on convertible debt instrument excluding interest on principal required to be paid in cash.

unclassified.label: Investment Income, Investment Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expenses related to the generation of investment income.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, at Cost
unclassified.description: Cost of the investment.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, Balance, Principal Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of principal of investment owned.

unclassified.label: Junior Subordinated Debenture Owed to Unconsolidated Subsidiary Trust, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: The noncurrent portion of the carrying value of junior subordinated long-term debt owed to unconsolidated subsidiary trusts as of the balance sheet date. Such debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets and was initially scheduled to be repaid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Finance Lease, Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Discount rate used by lessee to determine present value of finance lease payments.

unclassified.label: Lessee, Operating Lease, Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Discount rate used by lessee to determine present value of operating lease payments.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Lease Investment
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of leveraged lease investments which represent the aggregate amount of the estimated residual value of the lease assets and lease payments receivables, net of unearned and deferred income to be allocated over the lease term and non-recourse debt.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Balance Sheet, Investment in Leveraged Leases, Net
unclassified.description: The net investment in arrangements meeting the criteria to be classified as leveraged.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Income Statement, Income Tax Expense on Leveraged Leases
unclassified.description: The tax effect from the current year income from arrangements meeting the criteria for classification as a leveraged lease.

unclassified.label: Liability for Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense
unclassified.description: The amount needed to reflect the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims relating to insured events that have occurred on or before the balance sheet date, whether or not reported to the insurer at that date.

unclassified.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, before Reinsurance
unclassified.description: Amount, before effect of reinsurance, of present value of future benefit to be paid to or on behalf of policyholder and related expense less present value of future net premium receivable under insurance contract.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Average Outstanding Amount
unclassified.description: Average amount borrowed under the credit facility during the period.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Commitment Fee Percentage
unclassified.description: The fee, expressed as a percentage of the line of credit facility, for the line of credit facility regardless of whether the facility has been used.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Fair Value of Amount Outstanding
unclassified.description: Fair value of the amount outstanding under the credit facility.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Maximum Amount Outstanding During Period
unclassified.description: Maximum amount borrowed under the credit facility at any time during the period.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Maximum Month-end Outstanding Amount
unclassified.description: Maximum month-end amount borrowed under the credit facility during the period.

unclassified.label: Litigation Settlement, Amount Awarded from Other Party
unclassified.description: Amount awarded from other party in judgment or settlement of litigation.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Lease Financing (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Other, Net of Deferred Income (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Commercial and Industrial Loans (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Loans Receivable, Gross, Commercial, Development (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Loans Receivable Held-for-sale, Net, Not Part of Disposal Group, Commercial, Real Estate (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Year Five
unclassified.description: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Year Four
unclassified.description: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Year Three
unclassified.description: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Year Two
unclassified.description: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Repayments of Principal in Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirements, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable prices and dates maturing in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Rolling after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirements, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable prices and dates maturing after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirements, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable prices and dates maturing in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirements, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable prices and dates maturing in the fourth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirements, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable prices and dates maturing in the third rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Maturities, Repayments of Principal in Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirements, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable prices and dates maturing in the second rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Notes and Loans, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of all notes and loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

unclassified.label: Long-term Purchase Commitment, Amount
unclassified.description: The minimum amount the entity agreed to spend under the long-term purchase commitment.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Claims Settled, Number
unclassified.description: Number of claims settled.

unclassified.label: Loss on Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness
unclassified.description: The loss recognized in earnings during the reporting period representing the amount of the cash flow hedges' ineffectiveness.

unclassified.label: Margin Deposit Assets
unclassified.description: The amount of cash or securities placed with a broker or counterparty as security for a trading or derivatives securities position which was partially obtained with funds provided by the broker dealer.

unclassified.label: Marketable Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in marketable security, excluding other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Equity Issuance or Sale of Parent Equity Interest (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Number of Loans
Notes Issued
unclassified.description: The fair value of notes issued in noncash investing and financing activities.

unclassified.label: Notes Payable, Current
unclassified.description: Sum of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of the portions of long-term notes payable due within one year or the operating cycle if longer.

unclassified.label: Operating Lease, Variable Lease Income
unclassified.description: Amount of operating lease income from variable lease payments paid and payable to lessor, excluding amount included in measurement of lease receivable.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments receivable in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year ended for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable letter-terms in excess of one year.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments and Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and adjustments, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after adjustments, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, after Reclassification Adjustment, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Derecognition, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for unrealized gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk, realized upon derecognition of financial liability measured under fair value option.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Reclassification Adjustment Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Tax (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net Investment Hedge, Gain (Loss), before Reclassification and Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative designated and qualifying as net investment hedge.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Plan Amendments, Tax Effect
unclassified.description: Tax effect of plan amendments that occurred that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit cost.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Investment Transferred from Available-for-sale to Equity Method, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for unrealized gain (loss) of investment classified as available-for-sale transferred to equity method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Minimum Pension Liability Net Adjustment, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Derivatives Not Designated as Hedging Instruments Liabilities at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of all derivative liabilities not designated as a hedging instrument.

unclassified.label: Other Investment Not Readily Marketable, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Value of the other investment not readily marketable determined by management based upon fair value methods, including pricing of similar securities and valuation techniques, that was used to record the investment for financial reporting purposes.

unclassified.label: Other Long-term Debt, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt classified as other, payable within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Notes Payable
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term notes payable classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Real Estate, Covered, Additions
unclassified.description: Additions of other real estate covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

unclassified.label: Other Real Estate, Non Covered, Additions
unclassified.description: Additions of other real estate not covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

unclassified.label: Other Real Estate, Non Covered, Disposals
unclassified.description: Disposals of other real estate not covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

unclassified.label: Other Real Estate, Non Covered, Valuation Adjustments
unclassified.description: Valuation adjustments made to other real estate not covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Available-for-sale Securities
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in available-for-sale debt security, recognized in other comprehensive loss, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Loss, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent, Held-to-maturity Securities
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of amount of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity debt security, recognized in other comprehensive loss, attributable to parent entity.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Income Loss, Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Available-for-sale Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in available-for-sale debt security, recognized in other comprehensive loss.

unclassified.label: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Investing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow, made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability.

unclassified.label: Payments for Repurchase of Convertible Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: The cash outflow to reacquire preferred stock originally issued and identified as a security that can be exchanged for another type of financial security. This repurchased stock is held in treasury.

unclassified.label: Payments of Merger Related Costs, Financing Activities
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for financing costs associated with business combinations.

unclassified.label: Payments to Develop Real Estate Assets
unclassified.description: Payments to develop real estate assets is the process of adding improvements on or to a parcel of land. Such improvements may include drainage, utilities, subdividing, access, buildings, and any combination of these elements; and are generally classified as cash flow from investing activities.

unclassified.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Pension Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash
unclassified.description: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for pension benefits. Excludes other postretirement benefits.

unclassified.label: Percentage of Interest-bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Certificates of Deposit
unclassified.description: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic certificates of deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Percentage of Interest-bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Demand
unclassified.description: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic demand deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Pledged Assets, Not Separately Reported, Finance Receivables
Pledged Assets, Not Separately Reported, Other
Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Other Assets Pledged as Collateral, at Fair Value
Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Real Estate Pledged as Collateral, at Fair Value
Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Securities Pledged for Other Debt Obligations, at Fair Value
Pledged Financial Instruments, Not Separately Reported, Loans Receivable, for Other Arrangements
Pledged Financial Instruments, Not Separately Reported, Mortgage-Related Securities Available-for-sale or Held-for-investment
Preferred Stock, Amount of Preferred Dividends in Arrears
unclassified.description: Aggregate amount of cumulative preferred dividends in arrears.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock Conversions, Inducements
unclassified.description: The excess of (1) the fair value of all securities and other consideration transferred in transactions by the registrant to the holders of the convertible preferred stock over (2) the fair value of securities issuable pursuant to the original conversion terms, during the accounting period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Hedge, Investing Activities
unclassified.description: The cash inflow for a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either a cash flow hedge, fair value hedge, or hedge of a net investment in a foreign operation.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Convertible Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from issuance of preferred stocks identified as being convertible into another form of financial instrument, typically the entity's common stock.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Legal Settlements
unclassified.description: Cash received for the settlement of litigation during the current period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Lines of Credit
unclassified.description: The net cash inflow or cash outflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale and Maturity of Debt and Equity Securities, FV-NI, Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale, maturities, repayments and calls of securities classified as trading securities and held for investment purposes. Excludes proceeds from trading securities purchased and held principally for the purpose of selling them in the near term (thus held for only a short period of time).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Land Held-for-use
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the sale of land held for use; excludes sales of land held as inventory or investments.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of other assets as part of operating activities.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Short-term Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months but less than one year or one operating cycle (if the normal cycle is more than one year).

unclassified.label: Qualitative and Quantitative Information, Transferor's Continuing Involvement, Principal Amount Outstanding (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Other Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in real estate investments from acquisitions other than through foreclosure for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Convertible Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the repayment of a long-term debt instrument which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Subordinated Short-term Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for an obligation which places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment (senior loan) in liquidation of the entity's assets scheduled to be repaid within one year or in the normal operating cycle of the entity, if longer.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Unsecured Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow to repay long-term debt that is not secured by collateral. Excludes repayments of tax exempt unsecured debt.

unclassified.label: Restricted Stock, Shares Issued Net of Shares for Tax Withholdings
unclassified.description: Number, after shares used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation for award under share-based payment arrangement, of restricted shares issued. Excludes cash used to satisfy grantee's tax withholding obligation.

unclassified.label: Restructuring Reserve, Accrual Adjustment
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) which increases (decreases) the restructuring reserve from an adjustment to a previously accrued restructuring liability.

unclassified.label: Results of Operations, Income before Income Taxes
unclassified.description: Amount, before income tax expense (benefit), of result of operation in oil- and gas-producing activities. Excludes corporate overhead and interest costs.

unclassified.label: Revenue from Related Parties
Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, Lease Payments to be Received, after Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases after fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, Lease Payments to be Received, Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in third rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, Lease Payments to be Received, Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in second rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Lease Receivable, Payments to be Received, Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of undiscounted cash flows to be received by lessor for sales-type and direct financing leases in fourth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Sales-type and Direct Financing Leases, Profit (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of profit (loss) for sales-type lease and (loss) for direct financing lease recognized at commencement.

unclassified.label: Securities Owned Not Readily Marketable (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Fair Value of Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value of securities received as collateral against securities purchased under agreement to resell.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Not Offset, Policy Election Deduction
unclassified.description: Amount of fund outstanding loaned in form of security resale agreement for purchase and resale of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from security purchased under agreement to resell.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price, offset against an obligation to return collateral.

unclassified.label: Securities Sold, Not yet Purchased, Fair Value Disclosure (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
SecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseAverageAmountOutstanding
unclassified.description: Average amount outstanding of securities sold under agreements to repurchase.

unclassified.label: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of 10 Percent Adverse Change in Other Assumption
unclassified.description: The hypothetical financial impact of a 10 percent adverse change of the specified assumption on the fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities) as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of 20 Percent Adverse Change in Other Assumption
unclassified.description: The hypothetical financial impact of a 20 percent adverse change of the specified assumption on the fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities) as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Servicing Asset at Amortized Value, Other than Temporary Impairments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Servicing Assets and Servicing Liabilities at Fair Value, Assumptions Used to Estimate Fair Value, Expected Credit Losses
unclassified.description: Percentage of contractually collectible principal associated with a financial asset expected not to be collected due to default by the borrower.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Maximum Employee Subscription Rate
unclassified.description: The highest percentage of annual salary that an employee is permitted to utilize with respect to the plan.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Forfeitures and Expirations in Period, Weighted Average Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: The combined weighted average of the accumulated differences between the fair values on underlying shares and exercises prices to acquire such shares as of the grant date on options that were either forfeited or lapsed.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Vested and Expected to Vest, Exercisable, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Aggregate Intrinsic Value, Nonvested
unclassified.description: Intrinsic value of nonvested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

unclassified.label: Shares Held in Employee Stock Option Plan, Allocated
unclassified.description: Number of allocated shares held by the Employee Stock Option Plan at balance sheet date. Allocated shares are shares that have been assigned to individual participant accounts based on a known formula.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments Subject to Mandatory Redemption, Settlement Terms, Share Value, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount that would be paid, determined under the conditions specified in the contract, if the holder of the share has the right to redeem the shares.

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Percentage Bearing Variable Interest Rate
unclassified.description: The portion of the carrying amount of short-term borrowings outstanding as of the balance sheet date, which accrues interest at a rate subject to change from time to time.

unclassified.label: Stockholders' Equity, Other Shares
unclassified.description: Number of increase (decrease) in shares of stock classified as other.

unclassified.label: Trading Liabilities, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of liabilities pertaining to principal and customer trading transactions, or which may be incurred with the objective of generating a profit from short-term fluctuations in price as part of an entity's market-making, hedging and proprietary trading. Examples include, but are not limited to, short positions in securities, derivatives and commodities.

unclassified.label: US Government Agencies Securities, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Debt securities issued by a United States government agency such as Government National Mortgage Association (Ginnie Mae), Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corporation (Freddie Mac), and Federal National Mortgage Association (Fannie Mae), which are short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

unclassified.label: US Government Securities, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Debt (bills, notes or bonds) that are issued by the government of the United States which are short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

unclassified.label: Advances to Affiliate

unclassified.label: Affordable Housing Program Assessments
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) obligation for Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessment required by Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

unclassified.label: All Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Not Accounted for Using Income Recognition Model
unclassified.description: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of loans not accounted for as debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that were acquired by completion of a transfer, for which it was deemed probable at acquisition that the investor would be unable to collect all contractually required payments, and to which the income recognition total model was not applied.

unclassified.label: Allowance for Doubtful Accounts, Premiums and Other Receivables
unclassified.description: The valuation allowance as of the balance sheet date to reduce the gross amount of receivables to estimated net realizable value, which would be presented in parentheses on the face of the balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Amount of Ineffectiveness on Net Investment Hedges
unclassified.description: Gain (loss) on hedging derivative instrument or the foreign currency transaction gain (loss) on the nonderivative hedging instrument designated as a hedge of a net investment in foreign operations related to hedge ineffectiveness, which is included in earnings in the period.

unclassified.label: AOCI, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale with Allowance for Credit Loss, Cumulative Gain (Loss), after Tax

unclassified.label: AOCI Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Tax

unclassified.label: Area of Land

unclassified.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Accretion Expense

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Separately Recognized Transactions, Expenses and Losses Recognized

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Step Acquisition, Equity Interest in Acquiree, Fair Value

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Sales Type Leases, Deferred Income

unclassified.label: Capitalized Computer Software, Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization for capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

This form of debt can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder, and places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets.

unclassified.label: Cost, Depreciation and Amortization

unclassified.label: Cost of Property Repairs and Maintenance
