unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterestTransferToHeldToMaturityAllowanceForCreditLossExpenseReversal
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of reversal of credit loss expense on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) transferred out of available-for-sale into investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Amount at Purchase Price
unclassified.description: Amount at purchase price of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), purchased with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Transfer to Trading, Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings from transfer of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss for debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterest90DaysOrMorePastDueStillAccruing
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) 90 days or more past due and still accruing.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Nonaccrual, Interest Income
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), on nonaccrual status.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Trading, and Equity Securities, FV-NI, Cost
unclassified.description: Cost of investment in debt investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading) and investment in equity security with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI). Excludes equity method investment and investment in equity security without readily determinable fair value.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Unrealized Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Deconsolidation, Revaluation of Retained Investment, Gain (Loss), Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from remeasurement to fair value of retained investment in former subsidiary and group of assets constituting business or nonprofit activity deconsolidated and derecognized, excluding conveyance of oil and gas mineral rights and transfer of product or service in contract with customer.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Distributions Paid (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Deferred Compensation Cash-based Arrangements, Liability, Current and Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for deferred compensation arrangements. Represents currently earned compensation under cash arrangements (such as a profit-sharing plan, rabbi trust, and employee contract--excluding equity-based arrangements) that is not actually paid until a later date.

unclassified.label: Deferred Costs, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred cost, excluding capitalized cost related to contract with customer; classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Deferred Costs, Leasing, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of deferred initial direct cost for lease.

unclassified.label: Deferred Gain on Sale of Property
unclassified.description: Amount of gain on the sale of property that does not qualify for gain recognition as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Capitalized Software
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from capitalized software.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other Finite-Lived Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from long-lived assets other than property, plant, and equipment.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Unrealized Currency Transaction Gains
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from unrealized gains on foreign currency transactions.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Amount of Unrecognized Deferred Tax Liability, Undistributed Earnings of Domestic Subsidiaries
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability not recognized because of the exceptions to comprehensive recognition of deferred taxes related to undistributed earnings of domestic subsidiaries.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Benefit Obligation, (Increase) Decrease for Settlement and Curtailment
unclassified.description: Amount of (increase) decrease in accumulated benefit obligation of defined benefit plan from effects of settlement and curtailment.

unclassified.label: Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Minimum Pension Liability, before Tax (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Contributions by Plan Participant
unclassified.description: Amount of contributions received by defined benefit plan from participant which increase benefit obligation.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of Settlements and Curtailments on Accumulated Benefit Obligation (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Amortization of Transition Asset (Obligation), Next Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount included in accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) expected to be recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit for fiscal year following most recent annual statement of financial position.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Contributions in Current Fiscal Year (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Benefit Obligation (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Plan with Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Fair Value of Plan Assets (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of derivative assets, securities purchased under agreements to resell and securities borrowed, offset against an obligation to return collateral under a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Cost of Hedge
unclassified.description: The premium (cost) of a hedge, expensed during the period.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain Recognized in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Effective Portion (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Derivative Instruments in Hedges, Liabilities, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Aggregate fair value of all derivative liabilities designated as hedging instruments. Includes instruments designated as cash flow hedges, fair value hedges, and hedges of net investments in foreign operations.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Loss Recognized in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Effective Portion (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Derivative Liability, Fair Value, Net (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Derivative Liability, Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Securities Loaned, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of derivative liabilities, securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned. Includes liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Consideration
unclassified.description: Amount of consideration received or receivable for the disposal of assets and liabilities, including discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of other expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant, and Equipment, Net (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Dividends and Interest Paid
unclassified.description: The contractual amount of dividends (or interest on participating income bonds) that must be paid for the current period (for example, unpaid cumulative dividends).

unclassified.label: Dividend, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid cash dividends declared for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Due from Affiliates
Due from Officers or Stockholders
Due to Other Related Parties
Early Repayment of Senior Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for the extinguishment of long-term borrowing, with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, before its maturity.

unclassified.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash and Cash Equivalents, Continuing Operations
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Leases, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to lease expense.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Repatriation of Foreign Earnings, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the repatriation of foreign earnings.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, State and Local, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax contingency.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, State and Local, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to state and local income tax settlement.

unclassified.label: Development Stage Entities, Equity Issuance, Per Share Amount (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Difference Between Carrying Amount and Underlying Equity
unclassified.description: Difference between amount at which an investment accounted for under the equity method of accounting is carried (reported) on the balance sheet and amount of underlying equity in net assets the reporting Entity has in the investee.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Underlying Equity in Net Assets
unclassified.description: This item represents the entity's ownership percentage in the investee multiplied by the investee's total equity.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Adjustment of Warrants
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (income) related to adjustment to fair value of warrant liability.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) Included in Other Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Trading Revenue (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Fair Value, Estimate Not Practicable, Investments (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value Inputs, Comparability Adjustments (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Liability, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of financial instrument classified as a liability measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Federal Funds Sold and Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell Pledged as Collateral
unclassified.description: The fair value of federal funds sold and securities purchased under agreements to resell that serve as collateral for borrowings.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Discount
unclassified.description: Amount of unamortized discount on outstanding advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Fixed Rate, after Year One Through Five
unclassified.description: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) with fixed interest rate maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, after Year One Through Five
unclassified.description: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: FederalStateAndLocalIncomeTaxExpenseBenefitContinuingOperations
unclassified.description: Amount of current and deferred federal, state, and local tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from continuing operations. Includes, but is not limited to, current and deferred national, regional, territorial, and provincial tax expense (benefit) for non-US (United States of America) jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Fees and Commissions, Transfer Agent (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Finance Lease, Impairment Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss from right-of-use asset from finance lease.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments Owned and Pledged as Collateral, Amount Not Eligible to be Repledged by Counterparty
Financial Instruments, Owned, Principal Investments, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in private equity, mezzanine, venture capital, merchant banking, real estate and special situations investments. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: Financial Services Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossLoanSold
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of decrease in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from sale of loan. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestNonaccrualPercentPastDue
unclassified.description: Percentage of nonaccrual financing receivable, excluding accrued interest, that is outstanding and past due. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestTransferToHeldForInvestmentAllowanceForCreditLossExpense
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense on financing receivable transferred into held-for-investment out of held-for-sale classification. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestTransferToHeldForSaleAllowanceForCreditLossExpenseReversal
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of reversal of credit loss expense on financing receivable transferred out of held-for-investment into held-for-sale classification. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Percent Past Due (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
FinancingReceivablesBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossAverageAmountOutstanding
unclassified.description: Average amount outstanding, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivables.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) to be Reclassified During Next 12 Months
unclassified.description: The estimated net amount of unrealized gains or losses on foreign currency cash flow hedges at the reporting date expected to be reclassified to earnings within the next 12 months.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Three Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Two Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) from Components Excluded from Assessment of Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness, Net
unclassified.description: The net gain (loss) relating to components of the gain (loss) on the cash flow hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of cash flow hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in earnings in the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value of foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness
unclassified.description: The net gain (loss) recognized in earnings during the period due to the ineffectiveness on interest rate fair value hedges.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Extinguishment of Debt, before Write off of Debt Issuance Cost
unclassified.description: Reflects the difference between the fair value of payments made to legally extinguish a debt and its carrying value at that time. This item excludes the write-off of amounts previously capitalized as debt issuance costs.

unclassified.label: Gains (Losses) on Restructuring of Debt
unclassified.description: For a debtor, the aggregate gain (loss) recognized on the restructuring of payables arises from the difference between the book value of the debt before the restructuring and the fair value of the payments on the debt after restructuring is complete.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-Maturity, Fair Value, Maturity, Allocated and Single Maturity Date, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with single maturity date and allocated without single maturity date, maturing in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: ImpairmentLessorAssetUnderOperatingLease
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss for lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Per Basic Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Per Diluted Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Income (Loss) from Extraordinary Items, Net of Tax, Per Basic Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Income (Loss) from Extraordinary Items, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Depreciation, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible depreciation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Leases, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible lease expense.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Related Parties
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables to be collected from other entities that could exert significant influence over the reporting entity.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Hedged Item in Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) included in earnings related to the fair value of the hedged item in an interest rate fair value hedge, offset by the gain (loss) on the hedging instrument to the extent that the fair value hedge is determined to be effective.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Time Deposits
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in time deposits classified as other.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for pension and other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Receivables under Repurchase Agreements
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the total amount due the entity under agreements to sell and repurchase securities.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Time Deposits of $100,000 or more
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) in time deposits equal to or greater than $100,000 per account.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Equity Unit Purchase Agreements
unclassified.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of equity unit purchase agreements using the treasury stock method.

unclassified.label: Insurance Commissions
unclassified.description: The expense incurred by an insurance company to persons or entities for generating or placing insurance or investment contracts with the company, usually determined as a percentage of policy or contract premiums. Excludes advances or draws to be applied against commissions earned.

unclassified.label: Interest-bearing Domestic Deposit, Retail
unclassified.description: Amount of interest-bearing domestic retail deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Interest Costs, Including Allowance for Funds Used During Construction
unclassified.description: Amount of interest capitalized, including amount of allowance for funds used during construction.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Withdrawal Penalties
unclassified.description: Early withdrawal penalties on domestic deposits which discourage customer withdrawal prior to maturity.

unclassified.label: InterestIncomeFinancingReceivableBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income from financing receivable before allowance for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Securities, Operating, Tax Advantaged
unclassified.description: Amount of operating interest income, including amortization and accretion of premiums and discounts, on securities subject to tax benefits. Excludes operating interest income on securities exempt from state, federal and other income tax.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Derivative at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all interest rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Interest Receivable, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of noncurrent interest earned but not received. Also called accrued interest or accrued interest receivable.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Real Estate
unclassified.description: Amount of real estate project held for sale, held for development, and under development with intent to sell upon completion of project.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, Unrecognized Unrealized Depreciation
unclassified.description: This element represents the excess of the cost (face amount, notional amount) of an investment (security, contract) over its fair value which deficiency has not been recognized in earnings of the entity.

unclassified.label: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodElectedIncomeTaxCreditAndOtherIncomeTaxBenefitAfterAmortizationExpense
unclassified.description: Amount, after amortization expense, of income tax credit and other income tax benefit generated by investment under tax credit program elected to be accounted for using proportional amortization method. Includes, but is not limited to, investment under tax credit program not meeting condition for accounting under proportional amortization method.

unclassified.label: Investment-related Liabilities
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount of liabilities as of the balance sheet date for obligations incurred in connection with the entity's investments.

unclassified.label: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, at Fair Value
Junior Subordinated Notes, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of portion of long-term debt due within one year or the operating cycle if longer identified as Junior Subordinated Notes, which have a lower priority than senior instruments.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Balance Sheet, Investment in Leveraged Leases
unclassified.description: The net investment in arrangements meeting the criteria to be classified as leveraged excluding deferred taxes.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Net Investment in Leveraged Leases Disclosure, Deferred Taxes Arising from Leveraged Leases
unclassified.description: Taxes arising from arrangements meeting the criteria for classification as leveraged leases due to timing differences between accounting and tax income recognition.

unclassified.label: Liabilities of Assets Held-for-sale (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred Claims
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of expense (reversal of expense) for claims incurred and costs incurred in the claim settlement process.

unclassified.label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Net
unclassified.description: Liability as of the balance sheet date for amounts representing estimated cost of settling unpaid claims under the terms of the underlying insurance policies, less estimated reinsurance recoveries on such claims. This includes an estimate for claims which have been incurred but not reported. Claim adjustment expenses represent the costs estimated to be incurred in the settlement of unpaid claims.

unclassified.label: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value Method, Face Value
unclassified.description: Face value (death benefits) of the life insurance policies underlying the life settlement contracts accounted for under the fair value method.

unclassified.label: Life Settlement Contracts, Fair Value Method, Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: This item represents the gains or losses recognized and realized during the period on investments in life settlement contracts sold during the period.

unclassified.label: Life Settlement Contracts, Investment Method, Face Value
unclassified.description: Face value (death benefits) of the life insurance policies underlying the life settlement contracts accounted for under the investment method.

unclassified.label: Limited Liability Company or Limited Partnership, Members or Limited Partners, Ownership Interest
unclassified.description: Percentage investment held by members or limited partners of limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP).

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Commitment Fee Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the fee for available but unused credit capacity under the credit facility.

unclassified.label: Litigation Settlement, Gross (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Consumer, Net of Deferred Income (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Revolving, Other (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Amount, Commercial (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Consumer, Installment, Student Loans (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Loans Receivable, Basis Spread on Variable Rate
unclassified.description: Percentage added to reference rate used to compute variable rate on loan receivable.

unclassified.label: Loans Receivable Held-for-sale, Reconciliation to Cash Flow, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of increase (decrease) in financing receivable held for sale that is not part of disposal group.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal after Year Five
unclassified.description: Principal amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Current Maturities
unclassified.description: Amount, after deduction of unamortized premium (discount) and debt issuance cost, of long-term debt classified as current. Excludes lease obligation.

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Two and Three
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in second and third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Notes Payable, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of notes payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Percentage Bearing Variable Interest, Amount
unclassified.description: The portion of the carrying amount of long-term borrowings outstanding as of the balance sheet date, including current maturities, which accrues interest at a rate subject to change from time to time.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Carrying Value, Provision (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Loss Contingency, Claims Settled and Dismissed, Number
unclassified.description: The number of claims settled and dismissed during the period.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Damages Paid, Value
unclassified.description: Amount of damages paid to the plaintiff in the legal matter.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Number of Defendants
unclassified.description: Number of defendants named in a legal action.

unclassified.label: Loss on Derivative Instruments, Pretax
unclassified.description: Aggregate loss on all derivative instruments charged against earnings during the period, before tax effects.

unclassified.label: Loss on Discontinuation of Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring
unclassified.description: The amount of loss reclassified into earnings in the period when cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

unclassified.label: Loss on Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness
unclassified.description: Amount of recognized loss from the hedging ineffectiveness of a fair value hedge.

unclassified.label: Maturities of Senior Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for the settlement of long-term borrowing, with the highest claim on the assets of the entity in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, as it matures.

unclassified.label: Medium-term Notes
unclassified.description: Amount of debt instrument classified as medium-term.

unclassified.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Ownership Percentage by Noncontrolling Owners
unclassified.description: The equity interest of noncontrolling shareholders, partners or other equity holders in consolidated entity.

unclassified.label: Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Carrying Amount of Mortgages (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Face Amount of Mortgages
Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Interest Rate
Multiemployer Plan, Employer Contribution, Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of cost for employer contribution to multiemployer plan. Multiemployer plan includes, but is not limited to, pension plan determined to be individually significant and insignificant and other postretirement benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Net Asset Value Per Share
unclassified.description: Net asset value per share or per unit of investments in certain entities that calculate net asset value per share. Includes, but is not limited to, by unit, membership interest, or other ownership interest. Investment includes, but is not limited to, investment in certain hedge funds, venture capital funds, private equity funds, real estate partnerships or funds. Excludes fair value disclosure.

unclassified.label: Net Credit Loss on Loans Managed or Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement
unclassified.description: Amount of credit loss after recoveries for transferred financial assets that continue to be recognized in the statement of financial position.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Diluted
unclassified.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) from discontinued operations available to common shareholders.

unclassified.label: Net Investment in Direct Financing and Sales Type Leases
unclassified.description: The net amount due as of the balance sheet date consisting of: (a) minimum lease payments due on direct financing and sales-type leases, (b) unguaranteed residual value, and (c) any unamortized initial direct costs on direct financing leases; less: (i) executory costs, (ii) unearned income, and (iii) the accumulated allowance for uncollectible minimum lease payments.

unclassified.label: Net Investment Income
unclassified.description: Amount, after investment expense, of income earned from investments in securities and real estate. Includes, but is not limited to, real estate investment, policy loans, dividends, and interest. Excludes realized gain (loss) on investments.

unclassified.label: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Change on Diluted Earnings Per Share (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Change on Net Revenue (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Change on Operating Results (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Net Nonmonetary Assets Acquired (Liabilities Assumed) (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Noncontrolling Interest, Increase from Sale of Parent Equity Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in noncontrolling interest from sale of a portion of the parent's controlling interest.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amortized cost, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable classified as noncurrent. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: Notes Payable to Bank, Current
unclassified.description: Current portion of the total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer, on all notes payable to banks paid on an installment with long term maturities. This can include the amount of any loans from the applicant firm. This does not, however, include any mortgage balances.

unclassified.label: Notional Amount of Derivative Instruments Designated as Net Investment Hedges (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Foreign Currency Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Number of Credit Risk Derivatives Held
unclassified.description: Number of credit risk derivative instruments held.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Four and Five Years
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the fourth and fifth fiscal years following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Other Deferred Charges
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization of other deferred costs recognized in the income statement.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Available-for-sale Securities Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) in value of unsold investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), attributable to noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Effect of Change in Accounting Principle, before Taxes (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Effect of Change in Accounting Principle, Net of Taxes (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivatives Qualifying as Hedges, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments, of increase (decrease) in accumulated gain (loss) from derivative instruments designated and qualifying as the effective portion of cash flow hedges and an entity's share of an equity investee's increase (decrease) in deferred hedging gain (loss), attributable to noncontrolling interests.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Finalization of Pension and Non-Pension Postretirement Plan Valuation, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount after tax and reclassification adjustments of gain (loss) on foreign currency translation adjustments, foreign currency transactions designated and effective as economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity and intra-entity foreign currency transactions that are of a long-term-investment nature, attributable to noncontrolling interests.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Transaction and Translation Reclassification Adjustment Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), Adjustments, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of adjustments from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and after adjustments, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments, Tax, Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, after adjustments, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge, attributable to attributable to parent. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, before Tax, after Reclassification Adjustment
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, after reclassification adjustment, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Reclassification, Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Transition Asset (Obligation), Recognized in Net Periodic Benefit Cost, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, OTTI, after Tax and Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and adjustments, of increase (decrease) in other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity security, recognized in other comprehensive loss.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, OTTI, after Tax and Adjustments, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and adjustments, of increase (decrease) in other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity security, recognized in other comprehensive loss and attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: Other Deferred Compensation Arrangements, Liability, Current and Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of the liabilities for deferred compensation arrangements classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Deferred Costs, Net
unclassified.description: Net amount of other deferred costs capitalized at the end of the reporting period. Does not include deferred finance costs or deferred acquisition costs of insurance companies.

unclassified.label: Other Derivatives Not Designated as Hedging Instruments Assets at Fair Value (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other Loans Payable
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term loans payable classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Prepaid Expense, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for other costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Receivables, Net, Current
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance, of receivables classified as other, due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Significant Noncash Transaction, Value of Consideration Received
unclassified.description: The value of the noncash (or part noncash) consideration received in a transaction. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of a transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Participating Mortgage Loans, Participation Liabilities, Amount
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount of the participation liability at the end of the accounting period.

unclassified.label: Payables to Customers
Payments for Repurchase of Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: The cash outflow to reacquire callable preferred stock which is identified as being convertible to another type of financial security.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Receivables
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for the purchase of all receivables.

unclassified.label: Liability, Retirement and Postemployment Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits.

unclassified.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Plan, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension and other postretirement plans, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Mortgage-Related Securities Available-for-sale or Held-for-investment
Preferred Stock, Dividend Rate, Per-Dollar-Amount
unclassified.description: The amount per share used to calculated dividend payments on preferred stock.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Value, Subscriptions
unclassified.description: Amount of subscription received from investors who have been allocated nonredeemable preferred stock or preferred stock redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Collection of Long-term Loans to Related Parties
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with collection, whether partial or full, of long-term loans to a related party. Alternate caption: Proceeds from Advances to Affiliates.

unclassified.label: ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefundFederal
unclassified.description: Amount of cash received from federal tax jurisdiction for refund of tax on income. Includes, but is not limited to, national tax received for non-U.S. jurisdiction.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from issuance of callable preferred stock which is identified as being convertible to another type of financial security at the option of the issuer or the holder.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Finance Receivables
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale or collection of receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Loans Receivable
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale and collection of loans receivables arising from the financing of goods and services.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Investment Projects
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the sale of investment projects held by an entity in hopes of getting a future return or interest from it.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Short-term Investments
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Unsecured Lines of Credit
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from a contractual arrangement with the lender, including letter of credit, standby letter of credit and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a specific amount at any point in time with either short term or long term maturity that is uncollateralized (where debt is not backed by the pledge of collateral).

unclassified.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment; classified as other. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

unclassified.label: Purchase Commitment, Remaining Minimum Amount Committed
unclassified.description: Minimum amount to be expended to satisfy the terms of arrangements in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or services, excluding long-term purchase commitments or unconditional purchase obligations.

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation
unclassified.description: Minimum amount of purchase arrangement in which the entity has agreed to expend funds to procure goods or services from a supplier.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Investment Property, at Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of real estate investment property which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; and (7) other real estate investments.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Investments, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of real estate investments, net of accumulated depreciation, which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; (7) other real estate investments; (8) real estate joint ventures; and (9) unconsolidated real estate and other joint ventures not separately presented.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Taxes and Insurance
unclassified.description: The aggregate total of real estate taxes and insurance expense.

unclassified.label: Receivable with Imputed Interest, Discount
unclassified.description: Disclosure of the unamortized amount of the discount on the note or receivable which is deducted from the face amount of the receivable or loan. The discount or premium is the difference between the present value and the face amount.

unclassified.label: Reclassifications of Temporary to Permanent Equity
unclassified.description: The difference between the carrying amount of a financial instrument subject to a registration payment arrangement recorded as temporary equity prior to adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2 and the carrying amount reclassified to permanent equity upon the adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2. Recorded as a cumulative effect adjustment to the beginning balance of retained earnings. Does not apply to registration payment arrangements that are no longer outstanding upon adoption of FSP EITF 00-19-2.

unclassified.label: Recognition of Deferred Revenue
unclassified.description: The amount of previously reported deferred or unearned revenue that was recognized as revenue during the period. For cash flows, this element primarily pertains to amortization of deferred credits on long-term arrangements. As a noncash item, it is deducted from net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

unclassified.label: Reinsurance Recoverables, Including Reinsurance Premium Paid
unclassified.description: Amount, after valuation allowance, recoverable under reinsurance contracts including premium paid under reinsurance contracts. Examples include, but are not limited to, settled and unsettled claims, incurred but not reported losses, loss adjustment expense, premium paid, policy benefits and policy reserves.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Assumed Debt
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the repayments of a long-term debt originally issued by another party but is assumed by the entity.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Short-term Debt, Maturing in Three Months or Less
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from a repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment within three months.

unclassified.label: Restricted Cash and Investments
unclassified.description: Cash and investments whose use in whole or in part is restricted for the long-term, generally by contractual agreements or regulatory requirements. For use in an unclassified balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Restricted Investments, Current
unclassified.description: This element represents the current portion of investments which are not defined as or included in marketable (debt, equity, or other) securities that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Expected Cost (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Restructuring and Related Cost, Number of Positions Eliminated
unclassified.description: The number of positions eliminated during the period as a result of restructuring activities.

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Accelerated Depreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of accelerated depreciation charged against earnings associated with exit from or disposal of business activities or restructuring plan.

unclassified.label: Restructuring Reserve, Settled With Cash (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Sale Leaseback Transaction, Gross Proceeds (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Revenue, Net (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Sales-type Lease, Lease Income
unclassified.description: Amount of lease income from variable lease payments, interest income from net investment on sales-type lease, and profit (loss) recognized at commencement.

unclassified.label: Securities Borrowed, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of securities borrowed from entities in exchange for collateral, offset against an obligation to return collateral under a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Securities Failed-to-Deliver
unclassified.description: Amount receivable as the result of a fail-to-deliver. A fail-to-deliver is a securities sale to another broker-dealer that has not been delivered to buying broker-dealer by the close of business on the settlement date.

unclassified.label: Securities Loaned, Not Offset, Policy Election Deduction
unclassified.description: Amount of security loaned to entity in exchange for collateral, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from security loaned.

unclassified.label: Securities Loaned, Offset Against Collateral, Net of Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement, Policy Election
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of master netting arrangements, deduction of liabilities not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset, of securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral, offset against a right to receive collateral.

unclassified.label: Securities Received as Collateral, Amount Repledged and Sold
unclassified.description: The fair value of collateral received that has been sold or re-pledged and is owed to the debtor (transferor) upon settlement of the related contractual obligation under which it was received.

unclassified.label: Continuing Involvement with Continued to be Recognized Transferred Financial Assets, Amount Outstanding
unclassified.description: Amount of transferred financial assets in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the assets underlying the transaction that continue to be recognized in the statement of financial position. Includes, but is not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in transferred financial assets.

unclassified.label: SecurityBorrowedAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of security borrowed from entity in exchange for collateral. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes security borrowed not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Security Deposit Liability
unclassified.description: This element represents money paid in advance to protect the provider of a product or service, such as a lessor, against damage or nonpayment by the buyer or tenant (lessee) during the term of the agreement. Such damages may include physical damage to the property, theft of property, and other contractual breaches. Security deposits held may be interest or noninterest bearing.

unclassified.label: SecurityPurchasedUnderAgreementToResellAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of fund outstanding loaned in form of security resale agreement for purchase and resale of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Excludes security purchased under agreement to resell not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: SecurityPurchasedUnderAgreementToResellAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of fund outstanding loaned in form of security resale agreement for purchase and resale of identical or substantially same security at date certain for specified price. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes security purchased under agreement to resell not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting, Entity Consolidated Revenue (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Segment Reporting Information, Other Noninterest Expense (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Self Insurance Reserve
unclassified.description: Carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions) of accrued known and estimated losses incurred as of the balance sheet date for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property.

unclassified.label: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of Other than 10 or 20 Percent Adverse Change in Discount Rate, Percent
unclassified.description: A specified percentage variance in the discount rate assumption in the determination of fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities) as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of Other than 10 or 20 Percent Adverse Change in Prepayment Speed, Percent
unclassified.description: A specified percentage variance in the prepayment speed assumption in the determination of fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities).

unclassified.label: Servicing Assets and Servicing Liabilities at Fair Value, Assumptions Used to Estimate Fair Value, Weighted Average Life (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Servicing Fees (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Servicing Liability
unclassified.description: Aggregate amount of servicing liabilities that are subsequently measured at fair value and servicing liabilities that are subsequently measured using the amortization method.

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Accelerated Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of additional cost recognized for award under share-based payment arrangement from occurrence of event accelerating recognition of cost.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Forfeitures, Intrinsic Value, Amount Per Share
unclassified.description: Per share or unit weighted-average intrinsic value of award forfeited under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Share-based Liabilities Paid
unclassified.description: Amount of cash paid to settle liability for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Vested in Period, Intrinsic Value, Amount Per Share
unclassified.description: Per share or unit weighted-average intrinsic value of award vested under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Discount for Postvesting Restrictions
unclassified.description: Restrictions on equity-based instruments during the vesting period, such as the inability to transfer unvested awards, are not taken into account in estimating the fair value of the award. However, restrictions that remain in effect after an award is vested, such as the inability to transfer or hedge vested options or a prohibition on the sale of outstanding vested shares (or other type of equity) for a period of time, affect the estimate of an award's fair value.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Dividend Payments
unclassified.description: The estimated amount of dividends to be paid to holders of the underlying shares (expected dividends) over the option's term. Dividends are taken into account because payment of dividends to shareholders reduces the fair value of the underlying shares, and option holders generally do not receive dividends.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Forfeitures
unclassified.description: Number of shares under non-option equity instrument agreements that were cancelled as a result of occurrence of a terminating event.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Grants in Period, Grant Date Intrinsic Value
unclassified.description: The grant-date intrinsic value of options granted during the reporting period as calculated by applying the disclosed option pricing methodology.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Percentage of Outstanding Stock Maximum
unclassified.description: Maximum number of shares that may be issued in accordance with the plan as a proportion of outstanding capital stock.

unclassified.label: Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Valuation Method, Expected Volatility Rate
unclassified.description: The estimated measure of the percentage amount by which a share price is expected to fluctuate during the expected term of a nonvested share or option award issued to other than an employee.

unclassified.label: Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Valuation Method, Risk Free Interest Rate
unclassified.description: The risk-free interest rate assumption that is used in valuing a nonvested share or option award issued to other than an employee.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Aggregate Intrinsic Value, Vested
unclassified.description: Intrinsic value of vested award under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation, Shares Authorized under Stock Option Plans, Exercise Price Range, Exercisable Options, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Conversion of Units
unclassified.description: The number of shares issued during the period upon the conversion of units. An example of a convertible unit is an umbrella partnership real estate investment trust unit (UPREIT unit).

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the number of shares issued.

unclassified.label: Stock Issued During Period, Shares, Reverse Stock Splits
unclassified.description: Reduction in the number of shares during the period as a result of a reverse stock split.

unclassified.label: Tax Basis of Investments, Cost for Income Tax Purposes
unclassified.description: Amount of cost of investment for federal income tax purpose.

unclassified.label: Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Change in Tax Rate, Deferred Tax Liability, Income Tax Benefit
Tax Effect of Extraordinary Item, Gain (Loss) (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Threshold Percentage of Value Decline in Equity Securities to be considered Other than Temporary Impairment
unclassified.description: Threshold percentage by which investments in equity securities have declined in value to be considered other than temporary impairment (OTTI).

unclassified.label: Trading Securities, Equity, Cost
Trading Securities, Restricted
Transfer Investments (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Gain (Loss) on Derivative Used in Net Investment Hedge, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in fair value of net investment hedge.

unclassified.label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Insurance Proceeds
unclassified.description: Amount of insurance proceeds for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

unclassified.label: Variable Interest, Carrying Amount, Assets (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Variable Interest Entity, Carrying Amount of Liabilities, Consolidated VIE (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Weighted Average Interest Rate of Time Deposits, $100,000 or More, Three Months or Less
unclassified.description: The weighted average interest rate of domestic and foreign time deposits (including certificates of deposits, individual retirement accounts and open accounts) in denominations of $100,000 or more, with maturities of three months or less.

Accounts and Other Receivables, Net, Current
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance, receivable from customers, clients, or other third-parties, and receivables classified as other due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable from Securitization

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Noncurrent, Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss

unclassified.label: Accrual for Taxes Other than Income Taxes
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for real and property taxes.

unclassified.label: Accrued Employee Benefits
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations, excluding pension and other postretirement benefits, incurred through that date and payable for perquisites provided to employees pertaining to services received from them.

unclassified.label: Accrued Income Taxes, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the unpaid sum of the known and estimated amounts payable to satisfy all currently due domestic and foreign income tax obligations.

unclassified.label: Accrued Insurance
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable to insurance entities to mitigate potential loss from various risks or to satisfy a promise to provide certain coverage's to employees.

unclassified.label: Accrued Professional Fees
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for professional fees, such as for legal and accounting services received.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Comprehensive Income (Loss), after Adoption of New Accounting Principle (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment, Excluding Capital Leased Assets
unclassified.description: Cumulative amount of depreciation, depletion and amortization (related to property, plant and equipment, but not including land or leased assets).

unclassified.label: Acquired Finite-lived Intangible Asset, Residual Value
unclassified.description: Amount of residual value for finite-lived intangible asset acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.description: Value received from shareholder in nonredeemable preferred stock-related transaction in excess of par value, value contributed to entity and value received from other stock-related transaction. Includes, but is not limited to, preferred stock redeemable solely at option of issuer. Excludes common stock.

unclassified.label: Additions to Other Assets, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of significant additions in the period in other assets (current, noncurrent, or unclassified).

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Increase in Carrying Amount of Redeemable Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease (increase) in additional paid in capital (APIC) for the increase in carrying amount of redeemable preferred stock.

unclassified.label: Affordable Housing Program Obligation, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) obligation for Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessment required by Federal Home Loan Bank Act of 1932.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on financing receivable, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Leased Asset
unclassified.description: The expense charged against earnings for the periodic recognition of capitalized leases. This element may apply to energy companies that lease mineral producing properties and to other enterprises that capitalize property, plant, or equipment obtained through capital leases.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Value of Business Acquired (VOBA)
unclassified.description: The adjustment that represents the periodic charge against earnings to reduce the value of business acquired (VOBA) over the expected life of the underlying insurance contracts. VOBA reflects the estimated fair value of a life insurance business in force and represents the portion of the cost to acquire the business that is allocated to the value of the right to receive future cash flows from insurance contracts existing at the date of acquisition. Such value is the present value of the actuarially determined projected cash flows for the acquired policies. As a noncash expense, this element is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

unclassified.label: Dilutive Securities, Effect on Basic Earnings Per Share, ESOP Convertible Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to net income used for calculating diluted earnings per share (EPS), resulting from the assumed exercise of convertible preferred stock of an employee stock ownership plan (ESOP).

unclassified.label: Antidilutive Securities Excluded from Computation of Net Income, Per Outstanding Unit, Amount
unclassified.description: Securities (including those issuable pursuant to contingent stock agreements) that could potentially dilute basic net Income or Loss per outstanding limited partnership unit in the future and that were not included in the computation of diluted net income per limited partnership unit, because to do so would increase net income per unit amounts or decrease loss per unit amounts for the period presented.

unclassified.label: AssetAcquisitionConsiderationTransferred
unclassified.description: Amount of consideration transferred in asset acquisition. Includes, but is not limited to, cash, liability incurred by acquirer, and equity interest issued by acquirer.

unclassified.label: AssetAcquisitionConsiderationTransferredEquityInterestIssuedAndIssuable
unclassified.description: Amount of acquirer's equity interest issued and issuable as part of consideration transferred in asset acquisition.

unclassified.label: Asset Retirement Obligation
unclassified.description: The carrying amount of a liability for an asset retirement obligation. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement of a tangible long-lived asset that results from the acquisition, construction or development, or the normal operations of a long-lived asset, except for certain obligations of lessees.

unclassified.label: Assets Designated to Closed Block, Equity Securities, Available-for-sale, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of equity securities designated as available for sale, which are allocated to the segregated group of participating or dividend-paying policies and contracts identified as the closed block. Also a component of change in other comprehensive income in the period, which is reflected in the closed block disclosure.

unclassified.label: Assets Held-for-sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, Current, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of other assets held-for-sale that are not part of a disposal group, expected to be sold within a year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Assets, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Borrowings under Guaranteed Investment Agreements
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the sum of the obligations to contract holders to provide to them an agreed upon rate of return pursuant to the terms of the underlying contract. These contracts represent lending by the contract holders to the entity in return for a guaranteed (primarily fixed) interest rate until maturity, unless called earlier if the contracts provide that option to the contract holders (usually institutions). There is little or no insurance risk for the entity.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Rolling Year Four
