unclassified.description: Amount of increase in capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Computer Software, Impairments
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss for capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes capitalized cost for internal-use software.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization and accumulated impairment loss, of asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

unclassified.label: Cash and Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value, Including Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: For the entity and the disposal group, cash includes currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. It also includes other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits in that the Entity may deposit additional funds at any time and also effectively may withdraw funds at any time without prior notice or penalty. Cash equivalents, excluding items classified as marketable securities, include short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash, and so near their maturity that they present minimal risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months. Compensating balance arrangements that do not legally restrict the withdrawal or usage of cash amounts may be reported as Cash and Cash Equivalents, while legally restricted deposits held as compensating balances against borrowing arrangements, contracts entered into with others, or company statements of intention with regard to particular deposits are not generally reported as cash and cash equivalents.

unclassified.label: Cash, Cash Equivalents, Restricted Cash and Restricted Cash Equivalents, Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, and cash and cash equivalent restricted to withdrawal or usage; attributable to discontinued operation. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

Ceded Premiums Written, Property and Casualty (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Accounted for as Available-for-sale Debt Securities, Accretable Yield, Reclassifications from Nonaccretable Difference (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Acquired During Period, Commercial, at Acquisition, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value at acquisition of acquired commercial loans not accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Acquired During Period, Commercial, Contractually Required Payments Receivable at Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of contractually required payments receivable at acquisition of acquired commercial loans not accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Acquired During Period, Not Accounted for Using Income Recognition Model, at Acquisition
unclassified.description: The carrying amount as of the acquisition date of loans to which the income recognition total model was not applied. This relates to loans not accounted for as debt securities, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that were acquired by completion of a transfer, for which it was deemed probable at acquisition that the investor would be unable to collect all contractually required payments.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Provision for Loan Losses (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Collateral Securities Repledged, Delivered, or Used
unclassified.description: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of securities received as collateral from a counterparty that were re-pledged, sold, delivered or otherwise reused by the entity.

unclassified.label: Collateralized Agreements
unclassified.description: The total of collateralized agreements including securities purchased under agreements to resell (repos), borrowed securities, and secured demand notes.

unclassified.label: Commercial Paper, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Unsecured short-term debt instrument issued by corporations which are highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates. Generally, only investments with original maturities of three months or less qualify under that definition. Original maturity means original maturity to the entity holding the investment. For example, both a three-month US Treasury bill and a three-year Treasury note purchased three months from maturity qualify as cash equivalents. However, a Treasury note purchased three-years ago does not become a cash equivalent when its remaining maturity is three months.

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Including Additional Paid in Capital, Net of Discount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Common Stockholders' Equity (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Common Stocks, Including Additional Paid in Capital, Net of Discount
unclassified.description: Amount after discount on shares of par value plus amounts in excess of par value or issuance value for common stock held by shareholders. Includes common stock repurchased and held as treasury stock.

unclassified.label: Concentration Risk, Percentage (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Consolidation, Less than Wholly Owned Subsidiary, Parent Ownership Interest, Changes, Issuance of Equity by Subsidiary to Noncontrolling Interests
unclassified.description: Represents a sale (new stock issuance) by a subsidiary to noncontrolling interests (third parties, parties directly or indirectly unrelated to parent) during the period. The capital transaction by subsidiary does not result in a loss of control by the parent, but does effect a change in total (consolidated) equity attributable to the parent.

unclassified.label: Consolidation, Less than Wholly Owned Subsidiary, Parent Ownership Interest, Changes, Net
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period impacting the parent's ownership interest in a subsidiary as it relates to the total (consolidated) equity attributable to the parent. The changes to the parent's ownership interest in a subsidiary represented by this element did not arise in a deconsolidation of the subsidiary from the consolidated financial statements.

unclassified.label: Construction in Progress Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
unclassified.description: Future cash outflow to pay for construction in progress expenditures that have occurred.

unclassified.label: Construction Payable
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for the acquisition of merchandise, materials, supplies and services pertaining to construction projects such as a housing development or factory expansion not classified as trade payables.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss for right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Reclassified to Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time from transfer to receivable due to right to consideration becoming unconditional.

unclassified.label: Contractual Obligation, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of contractual obligation to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Conversion Gains and Losses on Foreign Investments
unclassified.description: Represents gains or losses resulting from transactions conducted in foreign currencies.

unclassified.label: Convertible Preferred Stock, Nonredeemable or Redeemable, Issuer Option, Value
unclassified.description: Value of outstanding nonredeemable convertible preferred stock or outstanding convertible preferred stock that is redeemable solely at the option of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Convertible Preferred Stock, Shares Issued (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Cost-method Investments, Realized Gain (Loss)
Cost of Goods and Services Sold
unclassified.description: The aggregate costs related to goods produced and sold and services rendered by an entity during the reporting period. This excludes costs incurred during the reporting period related to financial services rendered and other revenue generating activities.

unclassified.label: Cost, Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for allocation of cost of intangible asset over its useful life directly used in production of good and rendering of service.

unclassified.label: Cost of Reimbursable Expense (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Cost of Services (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Costs and Expenses
unclassified.description: Total costs of sales and operating expenses for the period.

unclassified.label: Credit Derivative, Purchased Credit Protection
unclassified.description: Amount of purchased credit protection expected to cover future payments under the credit risk derivative.

unclassified.label: Cumulative Effect on Retained Earnings, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Cumulative Translation Adjustment, Net of Tax, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) in cumulative translation adjustment before transfers included in determining net income.

unclassified.label: Customer Funds
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts received from and refundable to customers unless used by them to obtain goods and services from the entity.

unclassified.label: Customer Loyalty Program Liability, Current
unclassified.description: Value of deferred revenue or cost to provide products or services, which is expected to be recognized in income or incurred within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer, resulting from customer loyalty program. Excludes liability associated with frequent flier programs. Includes liability associated with customer loyalty programs for other businesses, for example, but is not limited to, hotels, supermarkets, credit card companies, automobile rental companies, and book sellers.

unclassified.label: Debt and Equity Securities, Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt and equity securities. Excludes other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Debt Default, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of outstanding long-term debt or borrowing associated with any securities or credit agreement for which there has been a default in principal, interest, sinking fund, or redemption provisions, or any breach of covenant that existed at the end of the period and subsequently has not been cured.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Conversion Ratio (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Redemption Price, Percentage of Principal Amount Redeemed
unclassified.description: Percentage of principal amount of debt redeemed.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), from recovery.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Allowance for Credit Loss, Securities Sold
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from sale.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Discount (Premium)
unclassified.description: Amount of discount (premium) attributable to other factors on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), purchased with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Allowance for Credit Loss, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Increase
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and beneficial interest, purchased with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Change in Method, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), from change in methodology.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Change in Present Value, Expense (Reversal)
Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Derivative, Cumulative Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of loss in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative hedging forecasted acquisition of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossCurrent
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestSale
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of decrease in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) from sale.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestTransferToAvailableForSaleAllowanceForCreditLossExpense
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of credit loss expense on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) transferred into available-for-sale out of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Amount at Purchase Price
unclassified.description: Amount at purchase price of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), purchased with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Sale
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease from sale of debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Transfer, Derivative Hedge, Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) of derivative hedging forecasted acquisition of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), transferred to investment in debt security measured at fair value with changes in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) and net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Realized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of realized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading). Excludes other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Trading and Available-for-sale
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Trading, Unrealized Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Cash Award Granted, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment made to pay deferred cash remuneration.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Fair Value of Shares Issued
unclassified.description: The total fair value of shares issued during the period under a deferred compensation arrangement.

unclassified.label: Deferred Compensation Share-based Arrangements, Liability, Current and Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Aggregate carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the liabilities for stock option plans and other equity-based compensation arrangements.

unclassified.label: Deferred Costs, Leasing, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of deferred initial direct cost for lease.

unclassified.label: Deferred Credits and Other Liabilities
unclassified.description: Total carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of unearned revenue or income, not otherwise specified in the taxonomy, which is expected to be taken into income in future periods and obligations not separately disclosed in the balance sheet (other liabilities).

unclassified.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Noncurrent, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs classified as noncurrent. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred (Gain) Loss on Discontinuation of Fair Value Hedge
unclassified.description: Amount as of the balance sheet date of the unamortized adjustment to the carrying value of an interest-bearing hedged item made under an effective fair value hedge that is amortized upon discontinuation of the fair value hedge.

unclassified.label: Deferred Income Taxes and Other Tax Receivable, Current
unclassified.description: Amount after allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences and other tax receivables expected to be realized or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Amortization Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense (reversal of expense) for deferred policy acquisition costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Capitalization
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred policy acquisition cost capitalized.

unclassified.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred policy acquisition cost.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Net, Current
Deferred Tax Assets, Net of Valuation Allowance, Current
Deferred Tax Assets, Regulatory Assets and Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences derived regulatory assets and liabilities.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Compensation and Benefits, Severance Payments
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from severance costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Asset Retirement Obligations
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from asset retirement obligations. An asset retirement obligation is a legal obligation associated with the disposal or retirement from service of a tangible long-lived asset.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Self Insurance
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from estimated losses under self insurance.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Warranty Reserves
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from warranty reserves.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Valuation Allowance, Current
Deferred Tax Liabilities, Net, Current
Deferred Tax Liabilities, Interests in Financial Assets Continued to be Held
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from interests in financial instruments continued to be held after sale or transfer of related financial instruments.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Regulatory Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from regulatory assets.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Cumulative Amount of Temporary Difference (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Deferred Taxes, Business Combination, Valuation Allowance, Available to Reduce Income Tax Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in valuation allowance for deferred tax asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation, or both, and reported as adjustment to income tax expense. Excludes change in valuation allowance within measurement period.

unclassified.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Pension Plan, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension plan, classified as current. Excludes other postretirement benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Liability, Defined Benefit Pension Plan, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for defined benefit pension plan, classified as noncurrent. Excludes other postretirement benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Accumulated Benefit Obligation, Increase (Decrease) for Plan Amendment
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in accumulated benefit obligation from change in existing term of defined benefit plan or initiation of new defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Actual Return (Loss) on Plan Assets Still Held
unclassified.description: Amount, measured using unobservable inputs, of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from actual return (loss) on assets still held.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Increase (Decrease) for Assets Transferred to (from) Plan
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan from assets transferred into (from) plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, before Adoption of FAS 158 Recognition Provisions, Accrued Benefit Liability (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, before Adoption of FAS 158 Recognition Provisions, Net Transition Obligations (Assets), Not yet Recognized (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount, measured using unobservable inputs, of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Cost of Providing Special or Contractual Termination Benefits Recognized During Period (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments, Next Rolling Twelve Months (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Benefit Obligation, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which (increases) decreases benefit obligation of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Contributions by Plan Participant
unclassified.description: Amount of contributions received by defined benefit plan from participant which increases plan assets.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Real Estate (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Real Estate, Range Maximum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Target Allocation Percentage of Assets, Real Estate, Range Minimum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Target Plan Asset Allocations Range Maximum (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Assets Transferred into (out of) Level 3
unclassified.description: Amount, measured using unobservable inputs, of increase (decrease) in plan assets of defined benefit plan, for assets transferred into (out of) Level 3 of fair value hierarchy. Includes, but is not limited to, transfer due to change in observability of significant inputs.

unclassified.label: Deposit Liabilities with Abnormal Terms
unclassified.description: Amount of deposits held by the entity on terms other than those available in the normal course of business.

unclassified.label: Deposit Liability, Current
unclassified.description: The current portion, due within one year or one operating cycle, if longer, of deposits held other than customer deposits.

unclassified.label: Depreciation and Amortization, Discontinued Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of deprecation and amortization expense attributable to property, plant and equipment and intangible assets of discontinued operations.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement Deduction
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, not subject to a master netting arrangement, deducted from derivative assets.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Fair Value, Gross Amount Not Offset Against Collateral, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Derivative, Floor Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Floor rate on an interest rate derivative such as an interest rate floor or collar. If market rates falls below the floor rate, a payment or receipt is triggered on the contract.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Higher Variable Interest Rate Range (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Derivative Liability, Current
unclassified.description: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial liability or contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled within one year or normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

unclassified.label: Derivative Liability, Number of Instruments Held
unclassified.description: The number of derivative instruments of a particular derivative liability or group of derivative liabilities held by the entity.

unclassified.label: DerivativeLiabilitySecuritySoldUnderAgreementToRepurchaseSecurityLoanedAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of derivative liability, security sold under agreement to repurchase, and security loaned. Excludes liability not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Lower Variable Interest Rate Range (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
DirectFinancingLeaseNetInvestmentInLeaseAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of net investment in direct financing lease.

unclassified.label: Direct Operating Communications Costs
unclassified.description: Communications costs incurred and are directly related to goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Direct Premiums Earned
unclassified.description: Amount, before premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums earned.

unclassified.label: Direct Premiums Earned, Property and Casualty (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Direct Premiums Written, Property and Casualty (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Discontinued Operation, Provision for Loss (Gain) on Disposal, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Intangible Assets, Net (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Interest Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Interest Income
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Long Lived Assets (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Operating Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of operating income (loss) attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Dividends, Preferred Stock, Paid-in-kind
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid preferred stock dividends declared with the form of settlement in payment-in-kind (PIK).

unclassified.label: Dividends Receivable
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of dividends declared but not received.

unclassified.label: Dividend, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Shares
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid stock dividends declared for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Due from Joint Ventures
Due to Affiliate
Due to Officers or Stockholders
Due to Related Parties, Current
Effect on Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) Due to Change in Measurement Date, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Disposition of Asset, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to disposition of asset. Includes, but is not limited to, intra-entity transfer of asset other than inventory.

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationGiltiAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to net controlled foreign corporation (CFC) tested income (NCTI) (formerly referred to as global intangible low-taxed income (GILTI)).

unclassified.label: EffectiveIncomeTaxRateReconciliationGiltiPercent
unclassified.description: Percentage of reported income tax expense from difference to expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rate to pretax income (loss) from continuing operation, attributable to net controlled foreign corporation (CFC) tested income (NCTI) (formerly referred to as global intangible low-taxed income (GILTI)).

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Restructuring Charges, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to restructuring charges.

unclassified.label: Employee-related Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Total of the carrying values as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable for obligations related to services received from employees, such as accrued salaries and bonuses, payroll taxes and fringe benefits. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Shares Expected to be Repurchased, Next Fiscal Period
unclassified.description: Number of shares to be repurchased in accordance with a policy to use treasury stock to satisfy share-award conversions.

unclassified.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Unrecognized Compensation Costs on Nonvested Awards, Weighted Average Period of Recognition (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Gain (Loss) on Transactions in Deferred Shares
unclassified.description: The difference between cost and fair value added or subtracted from paid-in capital, arising from contribution of shares to an ESOP or commitments-to-release ESOP shares.

unclassified.label: Equity, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value of the entity's equity.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Net Sales Proceeds (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Quoted Market Value
unclassified.description: This item represents the aggregate value of each identified investment accounted for under the equity method of accounting based on the quoted market price for those investments in common stock for which a quoted market price is available.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Estimated Insurance Recoveries
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of amounts expected to be recovered under the terms of insurance contracts.

unclassified.label: Extraordinary Item, Gain (Loss), Gross (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Fair Value, Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss), OCI
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from asset (liability) measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Federal Funds Sold and Securities Borrowed or Purchased under Agreements to Resell (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Fair Value Assumptions, Exercise Price (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value, Equity, Level 1 to Level 2 Transfers, Amount
Fair Value, Equity, Level 2 to Level 1 Transfers, Amount
Fair Value Inputs, Probability of Default (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) Included in Investment Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) Included in Other Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Federal Funds Purchased and Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Securities Sold, Not yet Purchased (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Fair Value, Net Asset (Liability)
unclassified.description: Fair value of asset after deduction of liability.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income from derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3).

unclassified.label: FederalFundsPurchasedAverageAmountOutstanding
unclassified.description: Average amount outstanding of federal funds purchased.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Floating Rate
unclassified.description: Par amount of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) with floating interest rate.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Floating Rate, Year One
unclassified.description: Par amount of advance made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) with floating interest rate maturing in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Maturities Summary, after Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Par amount of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) maturing after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Premium
unclassified.description: Amount of unearned premiums on outstanding advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Consolidated Obligations
unclassified.description: Amount of joint and several obligations consisting of consolidated obligation bonds and discount notes issued by Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks).

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Corporate Debt, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of firm holdings in corporate fixed income securities. Includes pledged and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Corporate Equities, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in corporate stocks (common and preferred), stock options, warrants and any other financial instrument which represents, or provides the ability to obtain, ownership rights in a corporation. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments, Owned, Mortgages, Mortgage-backed and Asset-backed Securities, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: The fair value as of the balance sheet date of firm holdings in mortgages, mortgage backed securities (investment instruments that represent ownership of an undivided interest in a group of mortgages, where principal and interest from the individual mortgages are used to pay investors' principal and interest on the mortgage backed security) and asset-backed securities that are primarily paid from the cash flows of a discrete pool of receivables or other financial assets (such as credit-card receivables), either fixed or revolving, that by their terms convert into cash within a finite time period. Includes both pledged (to counterparties as collateral for financing transactions) and unpledged holdings.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossForeignCurrencyTranslation
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) allowance for credit loss on financing receivable. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestRevolvingConvertedToTermLoanDuringPeriod
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of increase in term loan from conversion of revolving financing receivable.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableModifiedWeightedAverageInterestRateAfterModification
unclassified.description: Percentage, after modification, of weighted-average interest rate of financing receivable for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Customer Lists, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before amortization, of finite-lived asset representing customer list acquired in business combination, asset acquisition, and from joint venture formation.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Trademarks, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through registration of a trademark to gain or protect exclusive use of a business name, symbol or other device or style for a specified period of time.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) Reclassified to Earnings, Net
unclassified.description: The amount of net gains or losses on foreign currency cash flow hedges reclassified during the period to earnings from accumulated other comprehensive income upon the hedged transaction affecting earnings.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Exchange Rate, Translation (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Foreign Currency Exchange Rate, Translation
unclassified.description: Foreign exchange rate used to translate amounts denominated in functional currency to reporting currency.

unclassified.label: Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss)
Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals to be received by the seller-lessee for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Thereafter
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Five Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Four Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Discontinuation of Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring, Net
unclassified.description: The amount of net gain (loss) reclassified into earnings when interest rate cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

unclassified.label: Gain on Derivative Instruments, Pretax
unclassified.description: Aggregate gain on all derivative instruments recognized in earnings during the period, before tax effects.

unclassified.label: Gain on Discontinuation of Cash Flow Hedge Due to Forecasted Transaction Probable of Not Occurring
unclassified.description: The amount of gain reclassified into earnings in the period when cash flow hedge is discontinued because it is probable that the original forecasted transactions will not occur by the end of the original period or an additional two month time period.

unclassified.label: Gain on Fair Value Hedge Ineffectiveness
unclassified.description: Amount of gain recognized in the income statement from the hedging ineffectiveness of a fair value hedge.

unclassified.label: GovernmentAssistanceAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in income from government assistance.

unclassified.label: Gross Profit
unclassified.description: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

unclassified.label: Hedged Liability, Discontinued Fair Value Hedge, Cumulative Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in fair value of hedged liability in fair value hedge, attributable to hedged risk, remaining after discontinued hedge. Excludes cumulative basis adjustment related to foreign exchange risk.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Transfer to Trading, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings from transfer of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading). Includes other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI) previously recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Transfer to Trading, Unrealized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in earnings from transfer of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) to investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading).

unclassified.label: Hosting Arrangement, Service Contract, Implementation Cost, Capitalized, after Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of capitalized implementation cost from hosting arrangement that is service contract.

unclassified.label: Hosting Arrangement, Service Contract, Implementation Cost, Expense, Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization expense for capitalized implementation cost from hosting arrangement that is service contract.

unclassified.label: Impact of Restatement on Earnings Per Share, Basic (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Impact of Restatement on Earnings Per Share, Diluted (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Income Tax Effects Allocated Directly to Equity, Other
unclassified.description: The tax effect of items occurring during the period that have been charged or credited directly to components of shareholders' equity and are not otherwise defined.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Estimate of Possible Loss
unclassified.description: Estimated amount of loss resulting from an adverse tax position.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Disposition of Asset, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations, attributable to disposition of asset. Includes, but is not limited to, intra-entity transfer of asset other than inventory.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Charitable Contributions, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to nondeductible charitable contributions expense.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Other, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in other income tax contingencies.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Holiday, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income exempt from income tax because of a tax holiday.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Domestic, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to domestic income tax settlement.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) Cash Collateral from Counterparties
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of cash held either as collateral directly or provided to third parties associated with derivative instruments. Upon the occurrence of any specified triggering event or condition associated with the derivative, these amounts can be utilized to recover all or a portion of the amounts due or payable under the derivative.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) Due from Officers and Stockholders
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables to be collected from the reporting entity's executives and owners.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Receivable from Securitization
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed to the reporting entity by counterparties in securitized loan transactions.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Collateral Held under Securities Lending
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of assets, which may include but are not limited to cash and investments, received as collateral pertaining to securities loaned to a counterparty to the transaction. Includes the change during the period in any unrealized gain or loss on such investments.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Customer Advances
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of prepayments by customers for goods or services to be provided at a later date.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Leasing Fees
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred initial direct cost for lease.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the balance sheet value of capitalized sales costs that are associated with acquiring a new insurance customers.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Dividends Receivable
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in cash disbursements due from investments, representing the shareholders' portion of profits.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Hedged Item in Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Increase (Decrease) in Fair Value of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedging Instruments (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivables
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of the amounts due from borrowers for outstanding secured or unsecured loans evidenced by a note.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Expenses, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for other costs that provide economic benefits in future periods.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Reinsurance Premiums
unclassified.description: The change in prepaid reinsurance premiums recorded on the balance sheet, which is needed to adjust net income to arrive at net cash flows provided by or used in operations.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Taxes
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for income and other taxes that provide economic benefits in future periods.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Security Deposits
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in security deposits.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Equity Forward Agreements
unclassified.description: Additional shared included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of equity forward arrangements using the reverse treasury stock method.

unclassified.label: Incremental Common Shares Attributable to Dilutive Effect of Written Put Options
unclassified.description: Additional shares included in the calculation of diluted EPS as a result of the potentially dilutive effect of outstanding written put options using the reverse treasury stock method.

unclassified.label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, Acquired During Period (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Indefinite-Lived Trade Names
unclassified.description: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through registration of a trade name to gain or protect exclusive use thereof for a projected indefinite period of benefit.

unclassified.label: Indefinite-Lived Trademarks
unclassified.description: Carrying amount (original costs adjusted for previously recognized amortization and impairment) as of the balance sheet date for the rights acquired through registration of a trademark to gain or protect exclusive use of a business name, symbol or other device or style for a projected indefinite period of benefit.

unclassified.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Consumer
unclassified.description: Interest and fee income generated from consumer loans. Consumer loans are loans to individuals for household, family, and other personal expenditures. Such loans include residential mortgages, home equity lines-of-credit, automobiles and marine transport loans, credit card transactions, and others.

unclassified.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Foreign
unclassified.description: Interest and fee income generated by commercial and consumer loans, made by foreign branches of the reporting entity, which may include loans to foreign governments, foreign banks and other financial institutions, commercial and industrial entities, and citizens of not domiciled in the same country as the reporting entity.

unclassified.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Lease Financing
unclassified.description: Interest and fee income generated by direct lease financing which consists of an institution owning and leasing personal property for the use of its customers at the customers' specific request.

unclassified.label: Interest-bearing Foreign Deposit, Demand
unclassified.description: Amount of money in interest-bearing foreign accounts that entitle the depositor to withdraw funds at any time without prior notice, also known as demand deposits. Checking and negotiable order withdrawals (NOW) are the most common forms of demand deposits.

unclassified.label: Interest-bearing Foreign Deposit, Savings
unclassified.description: Amount of interest-bearing savings deposit liabilities in foreign banking offices.

unclassified.label: Interest-bearing Foreign Deposit, Time Deposits
unclassified.description: Amount of interest-bearing time deposits in foreign banking offices. Time deposits bear interest for a fixed, stated period of time and include certificate of deposits and individual retirement accounts.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Beneficial Interests Issued by Consolidated Variable Interest Entities
unclassified.description: Interest expense on beneficial interests issued by consolidated variable interest entities.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Commercial Paper
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense on commercial paper.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Foreign Deposits
unclassified.description: Interest expense on all foreign deposits.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Lessee, Assets under Capital Lease
unclassified.description: The amount, during the lease term, of each minimum [capital] lease payment allocated to interest expense so as to produce a constant periodic rate of interest on the remaining balance of the capital lease obligation.

unclassified.label: InterestIncomeHedgeBasisAdjustmentPortfolioLayerMethod
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in interest income for hedge basis adjustment from hedged layer exceeding outstanding amount of closed portfolio of financial asset or beneficial interest secured by financial instrument.

unclassified.label: InterestIncomeInterestEarningAsset
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income from interest-earning asset.

unclassified.label: Interest Income, Related Party
Interest Payable (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Interest Rate Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Derivative at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value of all derivatives designated as interest rate fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Land Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of parcels of land held for sale, and on which the entity has no intention or no further intention to perform construction activities.

unclassified.label: Inventory Write-down
unclassified.description: Amount of loss from reductions in inventory due to subsequent measurement adjustments, including, but not limited to, physical deterioration, obsolescence, or changes in price levels.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Financial Support to Investee Contractually Required, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of financial support committed by investment company to investee that is contractually required.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, Balance, Shares
unclassified.description: Number of shares of investment owned.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, Percent of Net Assets
unclassified.description: Percentage of investment owned to net assets.

unclassified.label: Investment Sold, Not yet Purchased, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of security sold but not yet purchased.

unclassified.label: Land Improvements
unclassified.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation and depletion of additions or improvements to real estate held for productive use. Examples include, but are not limited to, walkways, driveways, fences, and parking lots.

unclassified.label: Lease Deposit Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of liability for lease payments received, including variable lease payments, when collectability is not probable at commencement date for sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Assumptions and Judgments, Value of Underlying Asset, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount lessor expects from underlying asset following end of operating lease term.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received, Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor in next rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date for operating lease. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received, Rolling Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor in fourth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date for operating lease. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, after Reinsurance
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of reinsurance, of liability for future policy benefit.

unclassified.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits and Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount of policy reserves (provided for future obligations including unpaid claims and claims adjustment expenses) and policy benefits (liability for future policy benefits) as of the balance sheet date; grouped amount of all the liabilities associated with the company's insurance policies.

unclassified.label: Liability for Uncertainty in Income Taxes, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount recognized for uncertainty in income taxes classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid, Current Year (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid, Current Year
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of payments to settle claims incurred in the current period and related claims settlement costs.

unclassified.label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid, Prior Years (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid, Prior Years
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of payments to settle claims incurred in prior periods and related claims settlement costs.

unclassified.label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Gross (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred Claims (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred Claims Current Year (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Incurred Claims, Prior Years (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Limited Partners' Capital Account
unclassified.description: The amount of the limited partners' ownership interests.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Increase (Decrease), Net
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of the credit facility.

unclassified.label: Estimated Litigation Liability, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of reserve for known or estimated probable loss from litigation, which may include attorneys' fees and other litigation costs, which is expected to be paid within one year of the date of the statement of financial position.

unclassified.label: Litigation Settlement Interest
unclassified.description: Interest expense (income) directly attributable to an award in settlement of litigation.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Installment, Durable Goods (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Deferred Income, Commercial (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Fees Earned but Excluded from Yield
unclassified.description: Reflects the amount of fees recognized as income related to loan originations, commitments or servicing which are not included in interest income and that exceed 1 percent of the aggregate of total interest income and other income.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Impaired, Interest Income, Cash-Basis Method (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Amount, Consumer (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Amount, Other (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans Assumed (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Loans from Other Federal Home Loan Banks
unclassified.description: Amount of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) loans from another FHLBank.

unclassified.label: Loans Receivable, Gross, Commercial, Financial Institutions (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Loans Receivable, Gross, Commercial, Trade Financing (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Loans Receivable Held-for-sale, Net, Not Part of Disposal Group, Commercial and Industrial (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Long-Duration Contracts, Assumptions by Product and Guarantee, Volatility Rate
unclassified.description: Percentage rate that is indicative of an expected degree of movement against a base line index, and which is included in determining the amount of the specified guaranteed benefit obligation as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-Term Debt, Maturity, Year Four and Five
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt payable, sinking fund requirement, and other securities issued that are redeemable by holder at fixed or determinable price and date, maturing in fourth and fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Weighted Average Interest Rate, over Time
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate of long-term debt outstanding calculated over time.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency Accrual, Product Liability, Net
unclassified.description: Present value of the estimated aggregate accrual for damages arising from third-party use of the entity's product(s) or process(es) as of the balance sheet date (if the accrual qualifies for discounting).

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Claims Dismissed, Number
unclassified.description: Number of claims dismissed.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount of receivable related to a loss contingency accrual. For example, an insurance recovery receivable.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Related Receivable Carrying Value (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Loss Contingency, Receivable, Additions
unclassified.description: Amount of additions to receivables pertaining to a loss contingency.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Settlement Agreement, Consideration (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Management Fees Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Mandatorily Redeemable Preferred Stock, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of shares that an entity is required to redeem for cash or other assets at a fixed or determinable date or upon the occurrence of an event.

unclassified.label: Unsuccessful Business Combination Costs (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Thereafter
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due after the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Five Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the fifth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Four Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the fourth fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Next Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the next fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Three Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the third fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions, within Two Years
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing due in the second fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Minimum Net Capital Required for Entity
Minimum Net Worth Required for Compliance
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum net worth required for mortgage banking as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) of Consolidated Entities (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Write-down or Reserve, Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Net Change Contract Holders Funds
unclassified.description: The cash inflow or outflow for a segregated fund account during the period.

unclassified.label: Net Credit Losses During Period on Loans Managed or Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of Net Income (Loss) attributable to redeemable noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations Available to Common Shareholders, Diluted
unclassified.description: Amount, after deduction of tax, noncontrolling interests, dividends on preferred stock and participating securities, and addition from assumption of issuance of common shares for dilutive potential common shares; of income (loss) from continuing operations available to common shareholders.

unclassified.label: Net Increase (Decrease) in Advance Payments by Borrowers for Taxes and Insurance (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Derivative Instruments in Hedges, Net Investment in Foreign Operations, Assets, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of all derivative assets designated as hedges of net investment in foreign operations.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseExcludingAccruedInterestBeforeAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Intangible Assets Acquired (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Investments Acquired (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Noncash Financial or Equity Instrument Consideration, Warrants Issued
unclassified.description: The number of warrants issued as [noncash or part noncash] consideration for a business or asset acquired. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Other Assets Acquired (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Other Liabilities Assumed (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Noninterest Expense Distribution and Servicing Fees (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Noninterest Expense Offering Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for cost associated with issuance of security by investment company. Includes, but is not limited to, legal fee pertaining to share offered for sale, registration fee, underwriting, printing prospectus, and initial fee for listing on exchange.

unclassified.label: Nonoperating Gains (Losses)
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount of gains or losses resulting from nonoperating activities (for example, interest and dividend revenue, property, plant and equipment impairment loss, and so forth).

unclassified.label: Notes Receivable, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of an agreement for an unconditional promise by the maker to pay the holder a definite sum of money at a future date.

unclassified.label: Notes Reduction
unclassified.description: The value of notes retired (or transferred to another entity) in noncash investing or financing transactions.

unclassified.label: Notional Amount of Nonderivative Instruments
unclassified.description: Nominal or face amount used to calculate payments on a nonderivative instrument.

unclassified.label: Notional Amount of Nonderivative Instruments Designated as Net Investment Hedges (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Number of Countries in which Entity Operates
unclassified.description: The number of countries in which the entity operates as of balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Obligation to Return Securities Received as Collateral
unclassified.description: The fair value of collateral received by the entity associated with securities borrowed that must be returned if the counterparty fulfills its obligations. It appears on the balance sheet as a liability and has a corresponding asset that appears on the balance sheet called Securities Received as Collateral.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Two and Three Years
unclassified.description: Amount of required minimum rental payments for operating leases having an initial or remaining non-cancelable lease term in excess of one year due in the second and third fiscal years following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Other Accrued Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Assets Held-for-sale (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Other Cash Equivalents, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: Amount of short-term, highly liquid investments that are both readily convertible to known amounts of cash and so near their maturity that they present insignificant risk of changes in value because of changes in interest rates, classified as other. Excludes cash and cash equivalents within disposal group and discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Four and Five
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in fourth and fifth fiscal years following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Year Two and Three
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in second and third fiscal years following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Other Commitment, to be Paid, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of commitment classified as other to be paid in remainder of current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Pension and Other Postretirement Benefit Plans, Net Prior Service Costs Arising During Period ,Tax (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Other Comprehensive (Income) Loss, Defined Benefit Plan, after Tax and Reclassification Adjustment, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of (increase) decrease in accumulated other comprehensive income for defined benefit plan, attributable to noncontrolling interest.
