unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Foreign Currency Translation Reclassification Adjustment Realized upon Sale or Liquidation, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interests.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), before Adjustments, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and before adjustments, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net Investment Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassification, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification from accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for gain (loss) from derivative designated and qualifying as net investment hedge.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, OTTI, after Adjustments, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after adjustments, of tax (expense) benefit for increase (decrease) in other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity security, recognized in other comprehensive loss.

unclassified.label: Other Deferred Compensation Arrangements, Liability, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of the liabilities, classified as other, for deferred compensation arrangements payable within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Deferred Credits, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of unearned revenue or income classified as other, expected to be taken into income within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Derivatives Not Designated as Hedging Instruments at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Net fair value of all derivative instruments not designated as a hedging instrument.

unclassified.label: Other Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Continuing Operations
unclassified.description: Amount of other current and other deferred income tax expense (benefit) attributable to continuing operations.

unclassified.label: Other Liabilities, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of liabilities classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Notes Payable, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term notes classified as other, payable after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Marketable Securities, Current (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Other Marketable Securities, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Other Noncash Income Tax Expense
unclassified.description: The portion of the noncash component of income tax expense for the period other than the portion from the net change in the entity's deferred tax assets and liabilities.

unclassified.label: Other Nonrecurring Income
unclassified.description: Amount of other income that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

unclassified.label: Other Payments to Acquire Businesses
unclassified.description: The cash outflow associated with other payments to acquire businesses including deposit on pending acquisitions and preacquisition costs.

unclassified.label: Other Real Estate Owned, Measurement Input
unclassified.description: Value of input used to measure real estate owned by financial institution by financial institution which is not directly related to its business.

unclassified.label: Other Real Estate Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Other Receivables from Broker-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
unclassified.description: Amount of other receivables due from broker-dealers or clearing organizations.

unclassified.label: Other Tax Carryforward, Gross Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of other than temporary impairment loss (OTTI) on investments in available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities, recognized in other comprehensive loss and attributable to noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Loss, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Tax, Attributable to Parent, Held-to-maturity Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity debt security, recognized in other comprehensive loss, attributable to the parent entity.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Reclassification Adjustment of Noncredit Portion from Held-to-maturity to Available-for-sale Securities, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) related to factors other than credit loss transferred from held-to-maturity to available-for-sale securities.

unclassified.label: Participating Mortgage Loans, Extinguishment Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: States the amount of gain (loss) resulting from a participating loan extinguished before its due date.

unclassified.label: Payments for Brokerage Fees
unclassified.description: The amount of cash paid for brokerage fees during the current period. This element is intended to represent the brokerage fees paid by and between financial industry participants.

unclassified.label: Payments for Construction in Process
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from construction costs to date on capital projects that have not been completed and assets being constructed that are not ready to be placed into service.

unclassified.label: Payments for Deposits on Real Estate Acquisitions
unclassified.description: Cash outflow related to amounts given in advance to show or confirm an intention to complete an acquisition of land, buildings, other structures, or any item classified as real estate.

unclassified.label: Payments for Deposits with Other Institutions
unclassified.description: Cash paid to make deposits at other institutions during the period.

unclassified.label: Payments for Other Fees
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for fees classified as other.

unclassified.label: Payments for Leasing Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for initial direct cost of lease incurred by lessor, classified as investing activity.

unclassified.label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Claims Paid
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of payments to settle insured claims and pay costs incurred in the claims settlement process.

unclassified.label: Payments for Other Operating Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for operating activity, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Payments for Other Taxes
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for taxes classified as other.

unclassified.label: Payments for Postemployment Benefits
unclassified.description: Cash outflows for payments of postemployment benefits (such as severance pay and health insurance benefits) recognized during the period. Postemployment benefits are benefits paid to employees after employment but before retirement.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Other Real Estate Partnerships
unclassified.description: The net cash inflow or outflow from other real estate partnerships not otherwise defined in the taxonomy (buyouts, other agreements).

unclassified.label: Payments of Distributions to Affiliates
unclassified.description: The distributions of earnings to an entity that is affiliated with the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Long-term Investments
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for securities or other assets acquired, which qualify for treatment as an investing activity and are to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the long-term.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Other Loans and Leases Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow from purchases of loans and leases held-for-investment classified as other.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Trust Preferred Investments
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for the purchase of trust preferred securities, which possess characteristics of both equity and debt securities.

unclassified.label: Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Loans Pledged for Other Debt Obligations, at Fair Value
Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Other Debt Securities Available-for-sale or Held-for-investment
Pledged Financial Instruments, Not Separately Reported, Loans Receivable, for Repurchase Agreements
Pledged Financial Instruments, Not Separately Reported, Other Debt Securities Held-to-maturity
Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Direct
unclassified.description: Amount, before effect of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to provision for policy benefits and costs incurred.

unclassified.label: Postemployment Benefits Liability
unclassified.description: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the obligations recognized for the various benefits provided to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Additional Series, Par or Stated Value Per Share (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Preferred Stock, Additional Series, Shares Authorized (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Preferred Stock, Additional Series, Shares Issued (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
PreferredStockConvertibleConversionRatio
unclassified.description: Number of common shares issuable upon conversion for each share of preferred stock to be converted.

unclassified.label: PreferredStockConvertibleSharesIssuable
unclassified.description: Number of common shares issuable upon conversion of preferred stock.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Per Share Amounts of Preferred Dividends in Arrears
unclassified.description: Per share amount of cumulative preferred dividends in arrears.

unclassified.label: Premiums Receivable, Net
unclassified.description: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date due the entity from (a) agents and insureds, (b) uncollected premiums and (c) others, net of the allowance for doubtful accounts.

unclassified.label: Premiums Written, Net, Property and Casualty (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Prepaid Reinsurance Premiums
unclassified.description: The unexpired portion of premiums ceded on policies in force as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in next fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in third fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Prescription Drug Subsidy Receipt, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of prescription drug subsidy receipt expected in second fiscal year following current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Proceeds, Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Previously Written Off, Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), previously written off.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Collection of Notes Receivable
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with principal collections from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Collection of Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from collection on beneficial interest in securitization of receivables.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Deposits with Other Institutions
unclassified.description: Cash received from refund of deposits with other institutions during the period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
unclassified.description: The cash inflow provided by derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Hedge, Financing Activities
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from a financial contract that meets the hedge criteria as either cash flow hedge, fair value hedge or hedge of net investment in foreign operations.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Rents Received
unclassified.description: Cash received for rents during the current period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Related Party Debt
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from long-term debt by a related party. Related parties, include, but are not limited to, affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, and pension trusts.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Notes Receivable
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the proceeds from sale of notes receivable, as well as principal collections from a borrowing supported by a written promise to pay an obligation (note receivable).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale, Maturity and Collection of Short-term Investments
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from sales, maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, within the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the short-term.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from disposal of asset without physical form usually arising from contractual or other legal rights, excluding goodwill.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Interest in Corporate Unit
unclassified.description: The cash inflow resulting from the sale of an interest in a corporate unit during the period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Real Estate Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: Cash received from the sale of real estate that is held for investment, that is, it is part of an investing activity during the period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Securitizations of Credit Cards
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the securitization of credit card receivables. Securitization is the structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

unclassified.label: Proceeds of Other Loans and Leases Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from loans and leases held-for-investment, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross, Excluding Capital Leased Assets
unclassified.description: Gross amount of long-lived physical assets excluding assets held under lease agreements used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net, Excluding Capital Leased Assets
unclassified.description: Amount, net of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization, of long-lived physical assets excluding assets held under lease agreements used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of property, plant, and equipment; classified as other. Includes, but is not limited to, land and land improvement; building; machinery and equipment; furniture and fixture; and work of art, historical treasure, or similar asset classified as collection.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Owned, Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation from long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned. Excludes right-of-use asset from finance lease for flight asset.

unclassified.label: Provision for Lease Losses
Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Qualitative and Quantitative Information, Transferor's Continuing Involvement, Principal Amount Outstanding, Derecognized Amount (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Real Estate Investment Partnership Cost of Sales
unclassified.description: Amount of cost of sales related to investments in real estate partnerships and variable interest entities.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Investment Property, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of real estate investment property, net of accumulated depreciation, which may include the following: (1) land available-for-sale; (2) land available-for-development; (3) investments in building and building improvements; (4) tenant allowances; (5) developments in-process; (6) rental properties; and (7) other real estate investments.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Partnership Investment Subsidiaries, Net Income (Loss) before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of net income (loss) derived from real estate held for development and sale, and related investments.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Revenue, Net (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Real Estate Tax Expense
unclassified.description: A tax based on the assessed value of real estate by the local government. The tax is usually based on the value of property (including the land).

unclassified.label: RealizedGainLossInvestmentAndDerivativeOperatingTaxExpenseBenefit
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) from realized gain (loss) on investment and derivative, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

unclassified.label: Receivable with Imputed Interest, Effective Yield (Interest Rate)
unclassified.description: Yield on the receivable, on which interest has been imputed, as calculated from its issuance value or purchase price. The calculated effective interest rate considers factors such as the issued face value or price paid for the receivable, the time period between payments, and the time until maturity [full receipt] of the receivable.

unclassified.label: Receivables from Clearing Organizations
unclassified.description: Amount of right to receive cash and securities on deposit with clearing organizations. Clearing organizations perform post trade processing and trade comparisons among numerous broker-dealers and act as settlement agents between buying and selling broker-dealers.

unclassified.label: Reclassification to Unappropriated Retained Earnings (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of the recorded obligation to transfer funds in the future for fixed or minimum amounts or quantities of goods or services at fixed or minimum prices (for example, as in take-or-pay contracts or throughput contracts).

unclassified.label: Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock, Shares Issued (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Reimbursement Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Reinsurance Payable
unclassified.description: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the known and estimated amounts owed to insurers under reinsurance treaties or other arrangements.

unclassified.label: Reinsurance Receivables (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Reinsurance Recoverable for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount, after valuation allowance, recoverable under reinsurance contracts for losses reported to the ceding insurer but not yet paid and amounts expected for incurred losses and settlement expenses, which have not yet been reported to the ceding insurer.

unclassified.label: Related Party Transaction, Revenues from Transactions with Related Party (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Repayments of Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from a repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months. Includes repayments of short-term and long-term debt.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Long-term Loans from Vendors
unclassified.description: Cash outflows under financing arrangements with vendors (seller-financed debt), which had a maturity date at inception of more than one year (or more than one operating cycle, if longer); such debt may have arisen from purchases of property, plant and equipment or other productive assets.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Mandatory Redeemable Capital Securities
unclassified.description: The cash outflow related to equity securities that embody an unconditional obligation requiring the issuer to redeem the securities by transferring the assets at a specified or determinable date (or dates) that is (or are) initially more than one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date, or upon an event that is certain to occur beyond one year (or the normal operating cycle, if longer) from the issuance date.

unclassified.label: Repurchase Agreement Counterparty, Amount at Risk
unclassified.description: The amount at risk under repurchase agreements is defined as the excess of carrying amount (or market value, if higher than the carrying amount or if there is no carrying amount) of the securities or other assets sold under agreement to repurchase, including accrued interest plus any cash or other assets on deposit to secure the repurchase obligation, over the amount of the repurchase liability (adjusted for accrued interest).

unclassified.label: Resell Agreements, Period End Amounts Excluding Effects of Agreements Reported Net by Counterparty
unclassified.description: This is the total amount of resale agreements as of the reporting date. This is a gross amount (does not net agreement amounts by counterparty).

unclassified.label: Reserve for Losses and Loss Adjustment Expenses (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Restatement of Prior Year Income, Gross (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Restructuring and Related Cost, Expected Cost
unclassified.description: Amount expected to be recognized in earnings for the specified restructuring cost.

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Number of Positions Eliminated, Period Percent
unclassified.description: The number of positions eliminated during the period as a percentage of total positions eliminated during the period in connection with the restructuring plan(s).

unclassified.label: Restructuring Costs and Asset Impairment Charges
unclassified.description: Amount, after cash payment, of expenses associated with exit or disposal activities pursuant to an authorized plan and expenses resulting from the write-down of assets. Excludes expenses related to a business combination, a discontinued operation or an asset retirement obligation.

unclassified.label: Restructuring Reserve, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the accrual for restructuring costs.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Amount Due under Financing Arrangement
unclassified.description: The liability due as of the balance sheet date for leasebacks accounted for using the deposit method.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Annual Rental Payments
unclassified.description: The yearly payments due under the lease entered into in connection with the transaction involving the sale of property to another party and the lease of the property back to the seller.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Gross Proceeds, Investing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow before closing and debt issuance costs received by a seller-lessee in a sale-leaseback recognized in investing activities.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Monthly Rental Payments
unclassified.description: The amount of the monthly rental payments due under the lease entered into in connection with the transactions involving the sale of property to another party and the lease of the property back to the seller.

unclassified.label: Sale Leaseback Transaction, Net Proceeds, Investing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow after closing and debt issuance costs received by a seller-lessee in a sale-leaseback recognized in investing activities.

unclassified.label: Sale of Stock, Percentage of Ownership after Transaction
unclassified.description: Percentage of subsidiary's or equity investee's stock owned by parent company after stock transaction.

unclassified.label: Sales and Excise Tax Payable
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred through that date and payable for statutory sales and use taxes, including value added tax.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Initial Direct Cost Expense, Commencement
unclassified.description: Amount of sales-type lease initial direct cost recognized as expense at commencement date.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Interest Income, Lease Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income from lease receivable of sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Lease Receivable
unclassified.description: Present value of lease payments not yet received by lessor and amount expected to be derived from underlying asset, following end of lease term guaranteed by lessee or other third party unrelated to lessor, from sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Selling Profit (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of profit (loss) recognized at commencement from sales-type lease.

unclassified.label: Securities Borrowed, Collateral, Obligation to Return Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to return cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against securities borrowed.

unclassified.label: Securities Borrowed, Fair Value of Collateral
unclassified.description: Fair value of the securities received as collateral against securities borrowed.

unclassified.label: Securities Borrowed, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of securities borrowed from entities in exchange for collateral. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

unclassified.label: Securities Borrowed, Not Offset, Policy Election Deduction
unclassified.description: Amount of security borrowed from entity in exchange for collateral, subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement and not elected or qualified to offset, deducted from security borrowed.

unclassified.label: Securities Borrowed, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Amount of securities borrowed from entities in exchange for collateral, not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Securities Failed-to-Receive
unclassified.description: Amount payable as the result of fail-to-receive. A fail-to-receive is a securities purchase from another broker-dealer not received from the selling broker-dealer by the close of business on the settlement date.

unclassified.label: Securities Loaned, Collateral, Right to Reclaim Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of right to receive cash collateral under master netting arrangements that have not been offset against securities loaned.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Increase
unclassified.description: Amount of increase from purchase of security purchased under agreement to resell.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Amount of funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price, not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Securities Segregated under Other Regulations
unclassified.description: Fair value of securities deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers pursuant to regulations other than SEC Regulations and the Commodity Exchange Act.

unclassified.label: SecurityBorrowedAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of security borrowed from entity in exchange for collateral. Excludes security borrowed not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: SecurityLoanedAfterOffsetAndDeductionSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement and deduction of obligation to return financial collateral not offset and financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not offset, of security loaned to entity in exchange for collateral. Excludes security loaned not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: SecurityLoanedAfterOffsetSubjectToMasterNettingArrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of master netting arrangement, of security loaned to entity in exchange for collateral. Includes financial instrument subject to master netting arrangement not elected or qualified to offset. Excludes security loaned not subject to master netting arrangement or similar agreement.

unclassified.label: Security Owned and Sold, Not yet Purchased Fair Value, Security Sold, Not yet Purchased
unclassified.description: Fair value of financial instruments sold short by a broker-dealer for their own account (proprietary securities) for trading or investment purposes determined by management based upon quoted prices of a financial instrument with similar characteristics or on a valuation technique or model.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting Information, Amortization Expense (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Segment Reporting Information, Assets (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Segment Reporting, Segment Revenue (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Servicing Liability at Amortized Cost, Balance
unclassified.description: Amortized amount of contract to service financial assets under which estimated future revenues from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenue are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer for performing the servicing.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Discount from Market Price, Offering Date

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Grants in Period, Intrinsic Value, Amount Per Share
unclassified.description: Per share or unit weighted-average intrinsic value of award granted under share-based payment arrangement. Excludes share and unit options.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Maximum Number of Shares Per Employee

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Exercised
unclassified.description: Number of non-option equity instruments exercised by participants.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Forfeitures and Expirations
unclassified.description: Number of shares under non-option equity instrument agreements that were either cancelled or expired.

Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Period Increase (Decrease)

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Other Share Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Other than shares newly issued, the number of additional shares issued (for example, a stock split) or canceled (for example, to correct a share issuance), during the period under the plan.

unclassified.label: Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Quantity of Securities Issued
unclassified.description: The number of shares or units of entity securities issued in the transaction in which equity securities were issued to pay for goods or nonemployee services.

unclassified.label: Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Valuation Method, Expected Dividend Rate
unclassified.description: The estimated dividend rate (a percentage of the share price) to be paid (expected dividends) to holders of the underlying shares over the expected term of a nonvested share or option award issued to other than an employee.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Accelerated Vesting, Number
unclassified.description: Number of shares for which recognition of cost was accelerated for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Percentage Bearing Fixed Interest Rate
unclassified.description: The portion of the carrying amount of short-term borrowings outstanding as of the balance sheet date which accrues interest at a set, unchanging rate.

unclassified.label: Short-term Lease Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for short-term lease payment excluded from lease liability.

unclassified.label: Short-duration Insurance Contracts, Cumulative Paid Claims and Allocated Claim Adjustment Expense, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after reinsurance, of paid claims and allocated claim adjustment expense used in claims development for short-duration insurance contracts. Excludes unallocated claim adjustment expense.

unclassified.label: Short-duration Insurance Contracts, Incurred Claims and Allocated Claim Adjustment Expense, Net
unclassified.description: Undiscounted amount, after reinsurance, of incurred claims and allocated claim adjustment expense used in claims development for short-duration insurance contracts. Excludes unallocated claim adjustment expense.

unclassified.label: Trading Securities, Current (Deprecated 2014-01-31)

unclassified.label: Transfers of Financial Assets Accounted for as Sale, Initial Fair Value of Liabilities Incurred
unclassified.description: Represents the initial fair value recorded for liabilities incurred on transfer of financial assets in a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or a similar transfer which transaction is recognized as a sale of the transferred financial assets.

unclassified.label: Derivatives used in Net Investment Hedge, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of cumulative translation adjustment attributable to gain (loss) on foreign currency derivatives that are designated as, and are effective as, economic hedges of a net investment in a foreign entity.

unclassified.label: Treasury Stock, Retired, Par Value Method, Amount

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Foreign Currency Translation
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from foreign currency translation.

unclassified.label: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Sales and Disposals
unclassified.description: Reduction in valuation allowance of servicing assets based on sales and disposals.

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Net

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Nonconsolidated, Comparison of Carrying Amount of Assets and Liabilities to Maximum Loss Exposure

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Measure of Activity, Income or Loss before Tax

unclassified.label: Variable Lease, Payment

unclassified.label: Warrants Not Settleable in Cash, Fair Value Disclosure

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Interest Rate of Time Deposits, $100,000 or More, Six Months Through 12 Months

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Common Stock Subject to Repurchase or Cancellation

Accelerated Share Repurchases, Adjustment to Recorded Amount
unclassified.description: The adjustment needed to reconcile previously recorded amounts to the actual aggregate amount paid, whether in cash or other consideration, to acquire all of the shares purchased under an Accelerated Share Repurchase arrangement.

unclassified.label: Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accounts and financing receivable. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

unclassified.label: Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Accounts Payable, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of liabilities incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Accounts Payable, Other, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of obligations incurred classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Accounts Payable, Trade
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred (and for which invoices have typically been received) and payable to vendors for goods and services received that are used in an entity's business.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration from customer for product sold and service rendered in normal course of business, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Noncurrent, 90 Days or More Past Due, Still Accruing
unclassified.description: Amount of accounts receivable, classified as noncurrent, 90 days or more past due and still accruing.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Noncurrent, Accrued Interest, Writeoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of accrued interest on accounts receivable classified as noncurrent recognized by reversing interest income.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Related Parties, Current
Accretion Expense, Including Asset Retirement Obligations
unclassified.description: Amount of accretion expense, which includes, but is not limited to, accretion expense from asset retirement obligations, environmental remediation obligations, and other contingencies.

unclassified.label: Accrued Income Taxes, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the unpaid sum of the known and estimated amounts payable to satisfy all domestic and foreign income tax obligations due beyond one year or the operating cycle, whichever is longer. Alternate captions include income taxes payable, noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Accrued Insurance, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred through that date and payable to insurance entities to mitigate potential loss from various risks or to satisfy a promise to provide certain coverage's to employees. Used to reflect the current portion of the liabilities (due within one year or within the normal operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Accrued Salaries
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the obligations incurred through that date and payable for employees' services provided.

unclassified.label: Accrued Vacation
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of obligations incurred and payable for unused vacation time owed to employees based on the entity's vacation benefit given to its employees.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Amortization, Debt Issuance Costs, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of debt issuance costs classified as current.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Deferred Investment Tax Credit
unclassified.description: The noncurrent portion of the reserve for accumulated deferred investment tax credits as of the balance sheet date. This is the remaining investment credit, which will reduce the cost of services collected from ratepayers by a ratable portion over the investment's regulatory life.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization Expense, Property, Plant and Equipment, Current Charge (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Sale or Disposal of Property, Plant and Equipment (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Sale or Disposal of Property, Plant and Equipment
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in accumulated depreciation, depletion, and amortization of property, plant, and equipment from disposition.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Write-down of Property, Plant and Equipment (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), before Tax (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Financial Liability, Fair Value Option, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in instrument-specific credit risk of financial liability measured under fair value option.

unclassified.label: Acquired Finite-lived Intangible Assets, Weighted-Average Period before Renewal or Extension (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
AdditionalLiabilityLongDurationInsuranceGrossPremiumIncome
unclassified.description: Amount of gross premium income recognized for present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

unclassified.label: Additional Liability, Long-Duration Insurance, Interest Income (Expense)
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income (expense) for present value of total expected payment to policyholder in excess of present value of total expected assessment. Excludes benefit classified as market risk benefit or under provisions of Topic 815 on derivative and hedging.

unclassified.label: Adjustment for Long-term Intercompany Transactions, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of increase (decrease) in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) from gain (loss) on intra-entity foreign currency transaction that is considered to be long-term-investment with settlement not planned or anticipated in foreseeable future.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Equity Component of Convertible Debt
unclassified.description: Adjustment to additional paid in capital resulting from the recognition of convertible debt instruments as two separate components - a debt component and an equity component. This bifurcation may result in a basis difference associated with the liability component that represents a temporary difference for purposes of applying accounting for income taxes. The initial recognition of deferred taxes for the tax effect of that temporary difference is as an adjustment to additional paid in capital.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) to additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from changes in fair value of common and preferred stock issued to employee benefit trust but unearned.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Reallocation of Noncontrolling Interest (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Adjustments to Additional Paid in Capital, Stock Issued, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in additional paid in capital (APIC) resulting from issuance costs from a share-lending arrangement entered into, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing.

unclassified.label: Adjustments to Reconcile to Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations Attributable to Parent (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Administrative Fees Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for administrative fee from service provided, including, but not limited to, salary, rent, or overhead cost.

unclassified.label: Administrative Services Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Amortization of Below Market Lease
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization of acquired leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Deferred Leasing Fees
unclassified.description: This element represents the amortization of deferred leasing fees incurred by the lessor and amortized over the term of the lease. Such fees represent (a) costs to originate a lease incurred in transactions with independent third parties that (i) result directly from and are essential to acquire that lease and (ii) would not have been incurred had that leasing transaction not occurred and (b) certain costs directly related to specified activities performed by the lessor for that lease. Those activities are: evaluating the prospective lessee's financial condition; evaluating and recording guarantees, collateral, and other security arrangements; negotiating lease terms; preparing and processing lease documents; and closing the transaction.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Lease Incentives
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization of lease incentive costs incurred by the lessor for the benefit of the lessee.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Rate Deferral
unclassified.description: The periodic expense to reduce the value of the rate deferral asset that is created when utilities under bill customers during periods of rate increases by deferring rate increases. These customers eventually pay higher rates to repay the utility for the rate deferral.

unclassified.label: Amortization of Regulatory Asset
unclassified.description: The expense charged against earnings during the period to allocate the capitalized costs of regulatory assets over the periods expected to benefit from such costs.

unclassified.label: Amount Recognized in Income Due to Inflationary Accounting
unclassified.description: The amount that will be recognized through the income statement (as well as the impact on the other financial statements) as part of highly inflationary accounting.

unclassified.label: AociCashFlowHedgeReferenceRateReformIncreaseDecreaseAfterTax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of increase (decrease) to accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for receipt (payment) of compensation for modification of interest rate related to reference rate reform for cash flow hedge.

unclassified.label: AOCI Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in accumulated other comprehensive income.

unclassified.label: Application of Recognition Provisions of FAS 158, Effect on Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
AssetAcquisitionConsiderationTransferredOtherAssets
unclassified.description: Amount of tangible and intangible assets included as part of consideration transferred in asset acquisition, classified as other. Excludes cash.

unclassified.label: AssetAcquisitionContingentConsiderationLiability
unclassified.description: Amount of liability recognized from contingent consideration in asset acquisition.

unclassified.label: Asset Management Costs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Asset or Liability from Transfers of Financial Assets Having No Reasonable Estimate of Fair Value, at Carrying Value (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Asset Retirement Obligation, Liabilities Incurred
unclassified.description: Amount of asset retirement obligations incurred during the period.

unclassified.label: Asset Retirement Obligation, Liabilities Settled
unclassified.description: Amount of asset retirement obligations settled, or otherwise disposed of, during the period. This may include asset retirement obligations transferred to third parties associated with the sale of a long-lived asset.

unclassified.label: Assets Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, in Period of Disposition, Gain (Loss) on Disposition
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from disposal other than by sale of long-lived asset. Includes, but is not limited to, exchange or distribution to owner in spinoff.

unclassified.label: Assets Held-in-trust, Current
unclassified.description: The amount of cash, securities, or other assets held by a third-party trustee pursuant to the terms of an agreement which assets are available to be used by beneficiaries to that agreement only within the specific terms thereof and which agreement is expected to terminate within one year of the balance sheet date (or operating cycle, if longer) at which time the assets held-in-trust will be released or forfeited.

unclassified.label: Assets that Continue to be Recognized, Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement Assets and any Other Financial Assets Managed Together, Net Credit Losses During Period
unclassified.description: Amount of net credit losses charged off.

unclassified.label: Assets under Management, Average Balance
unclassified.description: The average carrying amount of assets managed during the period by the investment advisor on behalf of investors.

unclassified.label: Assumed Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense
unclassified.description: Liability as of the balance sheet date for the estimated ultimate cost of settling claims and claim adjustment expense relating to insured events that have occurred on or before the balance sheet date for those liabilities owed to another party as a result of assuming another insurer's primary obligation.

unclassified.label: Assumed Premiums Written
unclassified.description: Amount of written premiums assumed from other entities.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Assumption, Date of Securitization or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement, Transferor's Continuing Involvement, Servicing Assets or Liabilities, Weighted Average Life (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Auction Market Preferred Securities, Stock Series, Par Value Per Share
unclassified.description: The par value of the auction market preferred security.

unclassified.label: Auction Market Preferred Securities, Stock Series, Variable Interest Rate Earned
unclassified.description: The interest (or dividend) rates earned on action market preferred securities (on an annual basis or APY) for the period reported.

unclassified.label: Available-for-sale Securities, Gross Unrealized Loss (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Available-for-sale Securities, Noncurrent
Available-for-sale Securities, Restricted, Noncurrent (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Average Collected Cash Balances with Commercial Banks, Federal Home Loan Bank
unclassified.description: Average amount of collected cash balances with commercial banks the Federal Home Loan Banks (FHLBanks) maintain in return for certain services.

unclassified.label: Bank Acceptances Executed
unclassified.description: The amount of the financial institution's obligation to pay the holder of the customer's draft which the financial institution has guaranteed (i.e., Banker's Acceptance).

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Countercyclical Capital Buffer
unclassified.description: Countercyclical capital buffer percentage as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Global Systemically Important Bank (GSIB) Surcharge
unclassified.description: Global systemically important bank (GSIB) surcharge percentage as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Maximum Leverage Payout Ratio
unclassified.description: Maximum percentage of eligible retained income that can be paid out in distribution and discretionary bonus payment by global systemically important bank (GSIB) as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: BankingRegulationMortgageBankingNetWorthActual
unclassified.description: Amount of net worth for mortgage banking as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Supplementary Leverage Ratio, Capital Adequacy, Minimum
unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum Tier 1 risk-based capital to total leverage exposure required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Supplementary Leverage Ratio, Well Capitalized, Minimum
unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum Tier 1 risk-based capital to total leverage exposure categorized as well capitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tier One Leverage Capital Ratio, Significantly Undercapitalized, Minimum
unclassified.description: Ratio of minimum Tier 1 leverage capital to average assets categorized as significantly undercapitalized as defined by regulatory framework for prompt corrective action.

unclassified.label: Below Market Lease, Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

unclassified.label: Below Market Lease, Amortization Income, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization income for lease with finite life acquired as part of real property acquisition at below market lease rate expected to be recognized after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Below Market Lease, Amortization Income, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization income for lease with finite life acquired as part of real property acquisition at below market lease rate expected to be recognized in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Below Market Lease, Amortization Income, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization income for lease with finite life acquired as part of real property acquisition at below market lease rate expected to be recognized in remainder of current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Below Market Lease, Amortization Income, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization income for lease with finite life acquired as part of real property acquisition at below market lease rate expected to be recognized in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Below Market Lease, Amortization Income, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization income for lease with finite life acquired as part of real property acquisition at below market lease rate expected to be recognized in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Below Market Lease, Amortization Income, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization income for lease with finite life acquired as part of real property acquisition at below market lease rate expected to be recognized in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Below Market Lease, Amortization Income, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization income for lease with finite life acquired as part of real property acquisition at below market lease rate expected to be recognized in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Below Market Lease, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before amortization of leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

unclassified.label: Below Market Lease, Net
unclassified.description: Amount after amortization of leases acquired as part of a real property acquisition at below market lease rate with a finite life.

unclassified.label: Billed Contracts Receivable
unclassified.description: Amounts due for billed services rendered or to be rendered, actions taken or to be taken, or a promise to refrain from taking certain actions in accordance with the terms of a legally binding agreement between the Company and, at a minimum, one other party. An example would be amounts billed to customers under contracts or programs but not paid as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Bridge Loan
unclassified.description: Short-Term financing which is expected to be paid back relatively quickly, such as by a subsequent longer-term loan. Also called swing loan or bridge financing.

Business Acquisition, Cost of Acquired Entity, Other Noncash Consideration (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Preacquisition Contingency, Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Pro Forma Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Changes in Accounting and Extraordinary Items, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Assets, Asset to be Disposed of (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Liabilities, Accounts Payable (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Current Liabilities, Deferred Revenue (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Net Tangible Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Noncontrolling Interest (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Noncurrent Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Noncurrent Liabilities (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Property (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Purchase Price Allocation, Tangible Assets (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Acquisition, Revenue Reported by Acquired Entity for Last Annual Period
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue reported by acquiree in fiscal period prior to business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Acquisitions, Purchase Price Allocation, Subsequent Years, Remaining Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount of unamortized premium and intangible asset (unaccreted discount) remaining in year after business combination when total amount of remaining premium, intangible asset, and discount exceeds 30 percent of stockholders' equity.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Acquired Direct Financing Lease Receivable
unclassified.description: Amount of net investment in direct financing lease receivable acquired in business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Assets Arising from Contingencies, Amount Recognized
unclassified.description: Amount of asset arising from contingency in business combination, measured at acquisition-date fair value and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Assets Arising from Contingencies, Amount Recognized, Other than at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Amount of asset arising from contingency in business combination, measured at other than acquisition-date fair value and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Consideration Transferred, Including Equity Interest in Acquiree Held Prior to Combination
unclassified.description: Fair value at acquisition date of asset transferred, liability incurred, equity interest issued or issuable by acquirer, and equity interest in acquiree held by acquirer immediately before acquisition date in business combination achieved in stages. Includes, but is not limited to, instrument or interest issued or issuable by acquirer.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Amount, Contingent Assets and Liabilities, Recognized, Liability (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Amount of Contingent Consideration, Asset (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Change in Range of Outcomes, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Value, Low
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in minimum amount of estimate for undiscounted range of outcomes of liability in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Range of Outcomes, Value, High
unclassified.description: Maximum amount of estimate for undiscounted range of outcomes in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration Arrangements, Range of Outcomes, Value, Low
unclassified.description: Minimum amount of estimate for undiscounted range of outcomes in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Contingent Consideration, Liability, Measurement Input
unclassified.description: Value of input used to measure liability in contingent consideration arrangement in business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Indemnification Assets, Amount as of Acquisition Date
unclassified.description: Amount of indemnification asset recognized at acquisition date in business combination.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Liabilities Arising from Contingencies, Amount Recognized
unclassified.description: Amount of liability arising from contingency in business combination, measured at acquisition-date fair value and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Financial Liabilities
unclassified.description: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to financial liabilities assumed in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Contingent Liability
unclassified.description: Amount of preacquisition contingent liability assumed in business combination and recognized at acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Deferred Tax Assets, Current
Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Deferred Tax Liabilities Noncurrent
Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired, Goodwill, and Liabilities Assumed, Less Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of asset acquired in excess of (less than) liability assumed plus goodwill in business combination and recognized at acquisition date, less fair value of noncontrolling interest in acquiree at acquisition date when acquirer holds less than 100 percent of equity interest in acquiree.

unclassified.label: Business Combination, Separately Recognized Transactions, Revenues and Gains Recognized
unclassified.description: The revenues and gains recognized recorded for each transaction with the acquiree that is recognized separately from the acquisition of assets and assumptions of liabilities in the business combination.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Due in Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases due in the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Net Minimum Payments (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments, Net Minimum Payments
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments for capital leases net of executory costs, which include amounts paid by the lessee to the lessor for insurance, maintenance and taxes.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Rolling after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases after the fifth rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Future Minimum Payments Receivable, Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum lease payments to be received by the lessor for capital leases in the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Income Statement, Lease Revenue
unclassified.description: Total amount of lease revenue realized in the period on leasing arrangements.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Lessee Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Other Property, Plant, and Equipment, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before depreciation of leased long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale meeting the criteria for capitalization, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Lessee Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Other Property, Plant, and Equipment, Net
unclassified.description: Amount after depreciation of leased long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale meeting the criteria for capitalization, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Lessee Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Property, Plant, and Equipment Other, Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation on leased long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale meeting the criteria for capitalization, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Accumulated amortization of deferred income and initial direct costs pertaining to direct financing leases, which resulted from producing constant periodic rates of return on the net investments in the leases over their respective lease terms.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Direct Financing Leases, Executory Costs
unclassified.description: Estimated remaining costs to be incurred to service the direct financing lease, such as taxes, maintenance and insurance and the profit thereon, that are included in the minimum lease payments.

unclassified.label: Capital Leases, Net Investment in Sales Type Leases, Minimum Payments to be Received
unclassified.description: Amount of remaining payments as of the balance sheet date that lessees are obligated to make or can be required to make under sales-type leases, including any guarantee of residual value and executory costs. The amount also includes any guaranteed rental payments by an unrelated third-party provided that are financially capable of making such payments.

unclassified.label: Capital Units, Authorized
unclassified.description: Number of authorized capital units or capital shares. This element is relevant to issuers of face-amount certificates and registered investment companies.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Accumulated Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated impairment loss for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Contract Cost, Impairment Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss for asset recognized from cost incurred to obtain or fulfill contract with customer.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Costs, Asset Retirement Costs
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, depletion, amortization, and valuation allowance, of capitalized cost for asset retirement in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Capitalized Costs of Unproved Properties Excluded from Amortization, Cumulative
unclassified.description: Amount of capitalized cost excluded from amortization for investment in unproved property and development project for oil- and gas-producing activities accounted for under full cost method. Includes, but is not limited to, acquisition, exploration, and development costs for development project and capitalized interest.

unclassified.label: Cash Available for Distributions
unclassified.description: Amount of cash eligible for distribution to members or limited partners of limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP), subject to reserves to be maintained as defined in operating or partnership agreement, or in a credit facility agreement.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-04, Cash Dividends Paid to Registrant, 50 Percent or Less Owned Persons
unclassified.description: This element represents disclosure of the aggregate cash dividends paid to the entity by 50 percent or less owned persons accounted for using the equity method.

unclassified.label: Cash Flow Hedge Gain (Loss) Reclassified to Investment Income, Net (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Cash Flow Hedge Gain Reclassified to Investment Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Cash Flow Hedge Gain Reclassified to Other Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Cash Flow Hedge Loss Reclassified to Earnings (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Cash Flow Hedges Derivative Instruments at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Net fair value of all derivative instruments designated as cash flow hedging instruments, which is ordinarily reflected within other comprehensive income.

unclassified.label: Cash Flows Between Securitization or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement Special Purpose Entity (SPE) and Transferor, Proceeds from Newly Securitized Assets (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Cash Flows Between Transferor and Transferee, Servicing Fee Advances
unclassified.description: Cash flows between transferor and transferee in payment of service fees in advance, prior to or in contemplation of a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer in which the transferor will have continuing involvement with the transferred financial assets underlying the transaction (including, but not limited to, servicing, recourse, and restrictions on transferor's interests in the transferred financial assets).

unclassified.label: Cash Flows Between Transferor and Transferee, Beneficial Interest
unclassified.description: Cash flows between transferee and transferor in payment of the transferor's beneficial interest related to a securitization, asset-backed financing arrangement, or similar transfer in which the transferor has continuing involvement with the transferred financial assets underlying the transaction.

unclassified.label: CashHeldInForeignCurrency
unclassified.description: Amount of cash and cash equivalent, held in foreign currency. Cash includes, but is not limited to, currency on hand, demand deposit with financial institution, and account with general characteristic of demand deposit. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

unclassified.label: Cash Paid for Capitalized Interest (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Cash, Period Increase (Decrease)
Causes of Increase (Decrease) in Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Amount (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Ceded Premiums Written
unclassified.description: Amount of written premiums ceded to other entities.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Accounted for as Available-for-sale Debt Securities, Accretable Yield, Disposals of Loans (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Accounted for as Available-for-sale Debt Securities, Acquired During Period, Not Accounted for Using Income Recognition Model, at Acquisition, at Carrying Value
unclassified.description: The recorded value, at the acquisition date, of loans for which the income recognition model was not applied. This relates to loans accounted for as available-for-sale debt securities acquired during the period, with evidence of deterioration of credit quality since origination that were acquired by completion of a transfer for which it is probable, at acquisition, that the investor will be unable to collect all contractually required payments receivable.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Accounted for as Held-to-maturity Debt Securities, Accretable Yield, Disposals of Loans (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Accounted for as Held-to-maturity Debt Securities, Acquired During Period, at Acquisition, at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value at acquisition of acquired loans accounted for as held-to-maturity debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Accounted for as Held-to-maturity Debt Securities, Acquired During Period, Contractually Required Payments Receivable at Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of contractually required payments receivable at acquisition of acquired loans accounted for as held-to-maturity debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Acquired During Period, Commercial, Cash Flows Expected to be Collected at Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of cash flows expected to be collected at acquisition of acquired commercial loans not accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Acquired During Period, Consumer, Cash Flows Expected to be Collected at Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of cash flows expected to be collected at acquisition of acquired consumer loans not accounted for as debt securities with evidence of deterioration of credit quality.

unclassified.label: Certain Loans Acquired in Transfer Not Accounted for as Debt Securities, Allowance for Loan Losses, Decreases (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Class of Warrant or Right, Unissued
unclassified.description: The number of warrants or rights which entitle the entity to receive future services in exchange for the unvested, forfeitable warrants or rights.

unclassified.label: Clearing Fees Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Commissions Payable to Broker-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
unclassified.description: Amount payable to broker-dealers or clearing organizations for executing or clearing trades or orders.

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Discount on Shares
unclassified.description: Discount on common shares, or any unamortized balance thereof, shown separately as a deduction from the applicable account(s) as circumstances require.

unclassified.label: Common Stock Held by Subsidiary
