unclassified.description: Value of entity shares held by subsidiary, which are purchased for the purpose of granting the shares to senior employees as part of an employee stock option plan approved by the Entity's Board of Directors. Presented as a reduction of shareholders' equity at their cost to the subsidiary.

unclassified.label: Common Stock, Shares Subscribed but Unissued
unclassified.description: Number of unissued common shares allocated to investor for purchase on subscription basis.

unclassified.label: Comprehensive Income (Loss), Net of Federal Home Loan Bank Assessments, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity after Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) assessments from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources attributable to the reporting entity. Includes changes in equity except those resulting from investments by owners and distributions to owners. Excludes transactions directly or indirectly attributable to that ownership interest in subsidiary equity which is not attributable to the parent.

unclassified.label: Consolidation, Less than Wholly Owned Subsidiary, Parent Ownership Interest, Change Due to Net Income Attributable to Parent and Effects of Changes, Net
unclassified.description: This element represents the total net income attributable to the parent for the period and the effect of net changes during the period impacting the parent's ownership interest in a subsidiary as it relates to the total (consolidated) equity attributable to the parent. The changes to the parent's ownership interest in a subsidiary represented by this element did not result in a deconsolidation of the subsidiary from the consolidated financial statements.

unclassified.label: Construction Contractor, Receivable, Including Contract Retainage
unclassified.description: Amount of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer under long-term contract or program when right to consideration is unconditional, including amount withheld under retainage provision in contract.

unclassified.label: Contract Administration Expense (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Construction Contractor, Receivable, Excluding Contract Retainage, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer under long-term contract or program when right to consideration is unconditional, excluding amount withheld under retainage provision in contract, to be collected in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Construction Contractor, Receivable, Excluding Contract Retainage, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer under long-term contract or program when right to consideration is unconditional, excluding amount withheld under retainage provision in contract, to be collected in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Construction Contractor, Receivable, Excluding Contract Retainage, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer under long-term contract or program when right to consideration is unconditional, excluding amount withheld under retainage provision in contract, to be collected in next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Construction Contractor, Receivable, Excluding Contract Retainage, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer under long-term contract or program when right to consideration is unconditional, excluding amount withheld under retainage provision in contract, to be collected in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Construction Contractor, Receivable, Excluding Contract Retainage, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer under long-term contract or program when right to consideration is unconditional, excluding amount withheld under retainage provision in contract, to be collected in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Contract Receivable Retainage
unclassified.description: Amount billed to customers under long-term contracts or programs that have been withheld because of retainage provisions in a contract.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Allowance for Credit Loss, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in allowance for credit loss on right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Allowance for Credit Loss, Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, from recovery.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Allowance for Credit Loss, Writeoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, charged against allowance for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Credit Loss Expense (Reversal)
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (reversal of expense) for expected credit loss on right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, Cumulative Catch-up Adjustment to Revenue, Change in Estimate of Transaction Price
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in revenue recognized for cumulative catch-up adjustment from change in estimate of transaction price which increases (decreases) right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time. Includes, but is not limited to, change in assessment of whether estimate of variable consideration is constrained.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, before Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer, when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, before Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Asset, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right is conditioned on something other than passage of time, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Cumulative Catch-up Adjustment to Revenue, Change in Estimate of Transaction Price
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in revenue recognized for cumulative catch-up adjustment from change in estimate of transaction price which (increases) decreases obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due. Includes, but is not limited to, change in assessment of whether estimate of variable consideration is constrained.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Cumulative Catch-up Adjustment to Revenue, Change in Measure of Progress
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in revenue recognized for cumulative catch-up adjustment from change in measure of progress which (increases) decreases obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration from customer has been received or is due.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Liability, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of obligation to transfer good or service to customer for which consideration has been received or is receivable, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Receivable, before Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of right to consideration in exchange for good or service transferred to customer when right to consideration is unconditional.

unclassified.label: Contract with Customer, Refund Liability, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of liability for consideration received or receivable from customer which is not included in transaction price, when consideration is expected to be refunded to customer, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Contracts Receivable (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Contracts Receivable, Claims and Uncertain Amounts
unclassified.description: Amount of billed or unbilled claims or other similar items subject to uncertainty concerning their determination or ultimate realization under long-term contracts.

unclassified.label: Contracts Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Conversion of Stock, Amount Issued (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Convertible Debt, Fair Value Disclosures
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of borrowing which can be exchanged for a specified number of another security at the option of the issuer or the holder, for example, but not limited to, the entity's common stock.

unclassified.label: Convertible Preferred Stock, Par or Stated Value Per Share (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Convertible Preferred Stock, Shares Authorized (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Corporate Life Insurance Guaranteed Rate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Cost-method Investments, Aggregate Carrying Amount, Not Evaluated for Impairment
Cost of Goods Sold, Amortization (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Cost of Revenue
unclassified.description: The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Cost of Services, Excluding Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Cost of Services, Licenses and Maintenance Agreements (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Cumulative Dividends
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative cash dividends distributed to shareholders.

unclassified.label: Cumulative-Effect Adjustment, Application of Fair Value Option, Gross Gains (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Cumulative-Effect Adjustment, Application of Fair Value Option, Unrealized Gains, Recognized (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Cumulative-Effect Adjustment, Application of Fair Value Option, Unrealized Losses, Unrecognized (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Cumulative Effect of Change in Accounting Principle Presented on Income Statement, Net of Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Cumulative Effect of Initial Adoption of EITF Issue 08-3 (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Cumulative Effect on Retained Earnings, before Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Cumulative Effect on Retained Earnings, Tax (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Rate
unclassified.description: Dividend or interest rate associated with the financial instrument issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash or part noncash transaction. Noncash are transactions that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments. Part noncash refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments.

unclassified.label: Debt Conversion, Converted Instrument, Warrants or Options Issued
unclassified.description: The number of warrants issued in exchange for the original debt being converted in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Annual Principal Payment
unclassified.description: Amount of annual principal payment for debt instrument.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Beneficial Conversion Feature
unclassified.description: Amount of a favorable spread to a debt holder between the amount of debt being converted and the value of the securities received upon conversion. This is an embedded conversion feature of convertible debt issued that is in-the-money at the commitment date.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Convertible, Conversion Price (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Convertible, Effective Interest Rate (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Decrease, Repayments (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Fee Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the fee that accompanies borrowing money under the debt instrument.

unclassified.label: DebtInstrumentIssuedPrincipal
unclassified.description: Amount of principal of debt issued.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Periodic Payment, Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of the required periodic payments applied to interest.

unclassified.label: Debt Instrument, Principal Outstanding (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Debt Instrument, Unamortized Discount, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of debt discount to be amortized within one year or within the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Debt Issuance Costs Incurred During Noncash or Partial Noncash Transaction
unclassified.description: The amount of debt issuance costs that were incurred during a noncash or partial noncash transaction.

unclassified.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Line of Credit Arrangements, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs related to line of credit arrangements. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-Sale, Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Current
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accrued interest on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleAccruedInterestAfterAllowanceForCreditLossNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accrued interest on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Amortized Cost, Current
unclassified.description: Amortized cost of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as current.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterestNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleExcludingAccruedInterestPurchasedWithCreditDeteriorationAllowanceForCreditLossAtAcquisitionDate
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss at acquisition date of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) purchased with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTransferToHeldToMaturityAllowanceForCreditLossExpenseReversal
unclassified.description: Amount of reversal of credit loss expense on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) transferred out of available-for-sale into investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleTransferredFromHeldToMaturityAllowanceForCreditLossAccumulatedExpense
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated expense in retained earnings for allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale) from transfer of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Current
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading), classified as current.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityAllowanceForCreditLossExcludingAccruedInterestNoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding accrued interest, of allowance for credit loss on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Change in Present Value, Interest Income
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), from change in present value of expected cash flows, attributable to passage of time.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Derivative, Cumulative Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of gain in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative hedging forecasted acquisition of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Derivative, Cumulative Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) in accumulated other comprehensive income (AOCI) for derivative hedging forecasted acquisition of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity).

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestOriginatedMoreThanFiveYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) originated more than five years prior to current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestYearFiveOriginatedFourYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) originated four years prior to current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestYearFourOriginatedThreeYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) originated three years prior to current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestYearOneOriginatedCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) originated in current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestYearThreeOriginatedTwoYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) originated two years prior to current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityExcludingAccruedInterestYearTwoOriginatedFiscalYearBeforeCurrentFiscalYear
unclassified.description: Amount excluding accrued interest of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) originated in fiscal year prior to current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: DebtSecuritiesHeldToMaturityFairValueCurrent
unclassified.description: Fair value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Nonaccrual, No Allowance
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) on nonaccrual status with no allowance for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Originated, More than Five Years before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) originated more than five years prior to current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Year Five, Originated, Four Years before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) originated four years prior to current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Year One, Originated, Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) originated in current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Year Two, Originated, Fiscal Year before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) originated in fiscal year prior to current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Year Four, Originated, Three Years before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) originated three years prior to current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Year Three, Originated, Two Years before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) originated two years prior to current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Allowance for Credit Loss at Acquisition Date
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss at acquisition date of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), purchased with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Amount at Par Value
unclassified.description: Amount at par value of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), purchased with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Purchased with Credit Deterioration, Discount (Premium)
unclassified.description: Amount of discount (premium) attributable to other factors on investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), purchased with credit deterioration.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Unrealized Gain (Loss), Excluding Other-than-temporary Impairment
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) on investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity) and investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (trading). Excludes other-than-temporary impairment (OTTI).

unclassified.label: Debtor Reorganization Items, Write-off of Debt Issuance Costs and Debt Discounts
unclassified.description: Amount of write-off of debt issuance costs and debt discounts related to prepetition debt obligations.

unclassified.label: Decommissioning Fund Investments
unclassified.description: Decommission fund to pay for the costs of decontaminating and decommissioning of facilities through collection of revenues derived from utility assessments and government appropriations. Decommission fund investment for the process whereby a power station, at the end of its economic life, is taken permanently out of service and its site made available for other purposes. In the case of a nuclear station this comprises three different states of clearance. Immediately after the final closure, radioactive material such as nuclear fuel and operational waste is removed and the buildings surrounding the reactor shield are dismantled and finally the reactor itself is dismantled.

unclassified.label: Decrease in Restricted Cash
Deferred Compensation Arrangement with Individual, Cash Awards Granted, Amount (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Deferred Costs, Current
unclassified.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of deferred costs capitalized at the end of the reporting period that are expected to be charged against earnings within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Gross, Current
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs classified as current. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

unclassified.label: Debt Issuance Costs, Current, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs classified as current. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

unclassified.label: Debt Issuance Cost, Gross, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of debt issuance costs classified as noncurrent. Includes, but is not limited to, legal, accounting, underwriting, printing, and registration costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred Finance Costs, Own-share Lending Arrangement, Issuance Costs, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of issuance costs recognized in a share-lending arrangement entered into by the entity, in contemplation of a convertible debt offering or other financing, after deduction of accumulated amortization or the effects of subsequent adjustments.

unclassified.label: Deferred Gas Purchases, Current
unclassified.description: Current liabilities arising from deferral of gas to be purchased.

unclassified.label: Deferred Offering Costs
unclassified.description: Specific incremental costs directly attributable to a proposed or actual offering of securities which are deferred at the end of the reporting period.

unclassified.label: DeferredPolicyAcquisitionCostExperienceAdjustment
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for writeoff from unexpected insurance contract termination, charged against previously capitalized deferred policy acquisition cost.

unclassified.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Cost, Unrealized Investment Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized investment gain (loss) which decreases (increases) deferred policy acquisition cost.

unclassified.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Addition
unclassified.description: Amount of addition in deferred policy acquisition costs and present value of future profits from insurance contract acquired in business combination.

unclassified.label: Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Profits, Amortization (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Deferred Policy Acquisition Costs and Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of deferred policy acquisition costs and present value of future profits from insurance contract acquired in business combination.

unclassified.label: Deferred Purchased Power Costs
unclassified.description: Costs of power used for operations in prior periods that were expected to be recovered from customers in future periods.

unclassified.label: Deferred Rent Receivables, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of excess of rental income recognized over rental payment required by lease.

unclassified.label: Deferred Revenue, Additions
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred revenue recognized for transactions arising during the current reporting period. Deferred revenue is a liability as of the balance sheet date related to a revenue producing activity for which revenue has not yet been recognized. Generally, an Entity records deferred revenue when it receives consideration from a customer before achieving certain criteria that must be met for revenue to be recognized in conformity with GAAP.

unclassified.label: Deferred Revenue and Credits
unclassified.description: Total carrying amount of consideration received or receivable as of the balance sheet date representing potential earnings that were not as yet recognized as revenue or other forms of income in conformity with GAAP.

unclassified.label: Deferred Lease Income, after Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of deferred lease income. Includes, but is not limited to, amount paid in advance by lessee.

unclassified.label: Deferred Revenue, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in deferred revenue.

unclassified.label: Deferred Revenue, Revenue Recognized
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue recognized that was previously reported as deferred or unearned revenue.

unclassified.label: Deferred Sales Commission
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of advanced commission payments.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Gross, Current
Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Credit Carryforwards, Research
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible research tax credit carryforwards.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Policyholder Liabilities
unclassified.description: The tax effect as of the balance sheet date of the amount of the estimated future tax deductions arising from estimated policyholder reserves, which will be deductible from future taxable income when actual costs are incurred, and which can only be realized if sufficient tax-basis income is generated in future periods to enable the tax deduction to be taken.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Tax Deferred Expense, Reserves and Accruals, Returns and Allowances
unclassified.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from estimated returns and sales allowances.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Inventory
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax consequences attributable to taxable temporary differences derived from inventory.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Capitalized Patent Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from patent costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Deferred Expense, Capitalized Research and Development Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from research and development costs.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Gross, Current
Deferred Tax Liabilities, Gross, Noncurrent
Deferred Tax Liabilities, Net, Noncurrent
Deferred Tax Liabilities, Parent's Basis in Discontinued Operation
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from the entity's basis in a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Deferred Tax Liability Not Recognized, Amount of Unrecognized Deferred Tax Liability, Policyholders' Surplus
unclassified.description: Amount of deferred tax liability not recognized because of the exceptions to comprehensive recognition of deferred taxes related to a policyholders' surplus.

unclassified.label: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Defined Benefit Plan, Transition Asset (Obligation), after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of accumulated other comprehensive income (loss) for transition asset (obligation) of defined benefit plan, that has not been recognized in net periodic benefit (cost) credit.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, before Adoption of FAS 158 Recognition Provisions, Net (Gains) Losses, Not yet Recognized (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, before Adoption of FAS 158 Recognition Provisions, Net Prior Service Costs (Credits), Not yet Recognized (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Current Assets (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of Plan Amendment on Accumulated Benefit Obligation (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Effect of Plan Amendment on Net Periodic Benefit Cost (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments, Five Rolling Years Thereafter (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments, Rolling Year Four (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments, Rolling Year Three (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Expected Future Benefit Payments, Rolling Year Two (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Foreign Currency Exchange Rate Changes, Plan Assets (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Pension Plan with Projected Benefit Obligation in Excess of Plan Assets, Accumulated Benefit Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated benefit obligation for defined benefit pension plan with projected benefit obligation in excess of plan assets.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) plan assets of defined benefit plan.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Decrease for Sale
unclassified.description: Amount, measured using unobservable input, of decrease in plan asset of defined benefit plan from sale.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Decrease for Settlement
unclassified.description: Amount, measured using unobservable input, of decrease in plan asset of defined benefit plan from settlement of trade associated with underlying investment.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase for Purchase
unclassified.description: Amount, measured using unobservable input, of increase in plan asset of defined benefit plan from purchase.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Prescription Drug Benefit, Accumulated Postretirement Benefit Obligation, Decrease for Subsidy
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in accumulated postretirement benefit obligation for government subsidy related to prescription drug benefits attributed to past service.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Plan Assets Level 3 Reconciliation, Increase (Decrease) for Purchase, Sale, and Settlement
unclassified.description: Amount, measured using unobservable input, of increase (decrease) in plan asset of defined benefit plan from purchase, sale and settlement of trade associated with underlying investment.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Recognized Net Gain (Loss) Due to Settlements and Curtailments (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Defined Benefit Plan, Target Plan Asset Allocations Range Minimum (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Defined Contribution Plan, Increase (Decrease), Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in cost for defined contribution plan.

unclassified.label: Deposit Contracts, Liabilities
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of liabilities as of the balance sheet date pertaining to amounts received by the insurer or reinsurer from the insured (including a ceding company) under insurance or reinsurance contracts for which insurance risk is not transferred.

unclassified.label: Deposits Assets, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value of amounts transferred to third parties for security purposes that are expected to be returned or applied towards payment within one year or during the operating cycle, if shorter.

unclassified.label: Depreciation Expense (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Derecognized Assets, Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement Assets and any Other Financial Assets Managed Together, Delinquent Amount at End of Period
unclassified.description: Amount of transferred financial asset that is derecognized and other financial asset managed together with transferred financial asset, considered to be delinquent.

unclassified.label: Derecognized Assets, Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement Assets and any Other Financial Assets Managed Together, Net Credit Losses During Period
unclassified.description: Net credit losses are charge-offs and are based on total loans outstanding during the period.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Measurement Input
unclassified.description: Value of input used to measure derivative asset.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Number of Instruments Held
unclassified.description: The number of derivative instruments of a particular derivative asset or group of derivative assets held by the entity.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Securities Borrowed, Gross Including Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Amount, before effects of master netting arrangements, of derivative assets, securities purchased under agreements to resell and securities borrowed. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and elected not to be offset.

unclassified.label: Derivative Asset, Current
unclassified.description: Fair value, after the effects of master netting arrangements, of a financial asset or other contract with one or more underlyings, notional amount or payment provision or both, and the contract can be net settled by means outside the contract or delivery of an asset, expected to be settled within one year or normal operating cycle, if longer. Includes assets not subject to a master netting arrangement and not elected to be offset.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Average Cap Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Average cap rate on a group of interest rate derivatives, such as interest rate caps or collars. If market rates exceed the cap rate, a payment or receipt is triggered on the contract.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Average Floor Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Average floor rate on a group of interest rate derivatives, such as interest rate floor or collars. If market rates fall below the floor rate, a payment or receipt is triggered on the contract.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Cap Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Cap rate on an interest rate derivative such as an interest rate cap or collar. If market rates exceed the cap rate, a payment or receipt is triggered on the contract.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Cap Price
unclassified.description: The cap rate on a price risk derivative such as a cap or collar. A payment or receipt is triggered if the market rate exceeds the cap rate on the contract.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Cash Received on Hedge
unclassified.description: The amount of cash received during the period on settlement of a hedge.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Cost of Hedge Net of Cash Received
unclassified.description: The premium (cost) of a hedge, net of any cash received on settlement during the period.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Excluded Component, Gain, Recognized in Earnings
unclassified.description: Amount of gain from excluded component of derivative hedge, recognized in earnings. Excludes recognition under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Forward Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Stated rate on an interest rate forward or futures contract.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Higher Fixed Interest Rate Range (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Liabilities, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Fair value of liability arising from contracts that meet the criteria of being accounted for as derivative instruments, financial instrument or contract used to mitigate a specified risk (hedge), energy marketing activities (trading activities), expected to be settled after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Examples of energy marketing activities include, but are not limited to, trading of electricity, coal, natural gas and oil using financial instruments, including, but not limited to, forward contracts, options and swaps.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments and Hedges, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of the assets arising from derivative contracts and hedging activities, which are expected to be converted into cash or otherwise disposed of after a year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Gain Recognized in Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Derivative Instruments in Hedges, at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Aggregate net fair value of all derivative instruments designated as hedging instruments. Includes instruments designated as cash flow hedges, fair value hedges, and hedges of net investments in foreign operations.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments, Loss Reclassified from Accumulated OCI into Income, Effective Portion
unclassified.description: The effective portion of loss reclassified from accumulated other comprehensive income into income on derivative instruments designated and qualifying as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments Not Designated as Hedging Instruments, Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of realized and unrealized gain of derivative instruments not designated or qualifying as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Lower Fixed Interest Rate Range (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Derivative, Nonmonetary Notional Amount
unclassified.description: Nominal number of units used to calculate payment on derivative.

unclassified.label: Derivative, Swap Type, Fixed Price
unclassified.description: Fixed price related to the price risk swap derivative.

unclassified.label: Derivatives used in Net Investment Hedge, Gain (Loss), Reclassified to Earnings, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification from other comprehensive income (loss) to earnings from the sale or complete or substantially complete liquidation of an investment in a foreign entity.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on net investment in direct financing lease.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount of direct financing lease revenue.

unclassified.label: Direct Financing Lease, Variable Lease Income
unclassified.description: Amount of direct financing lease income from variable lease payments paid and payable to lessor, excluding amount included in measurement of lease receivable.

unclassified.label: Direct Operating Costs
unclassified.description: The aggregate direct operating costs incurred during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Direct Operating Maintenance Supplies Costs
unclassified.description: Costs of maintenance supplies used that are directly related to goods produced and sold, or services rendered, during the reporting period.

unclassified.label: Direct Premiums Written
unclassified.description: Amount, before premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums written.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Amount of Other Income (Loss) from Disposition of Discontinued Operations, before Income Tax (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Discontinued Operation, Gain (Loss) on Disposal of Discontinued Operation, Net of Tax, Per Diluted Share
unclassified.description: Per diluted share amount, after tax, of the gain (loss) on the disposal of discontinued operations.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax Effect of Income (Loss) from Discontinued Operation During Phase-out Period
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) attributable to income (loss) from operations classified as a discontinued operation. Excludes tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) on disposal and for provision for gain (loss) until disposal.

unclassified.label: Discontinued Operation, Tax (Expense) Benefit from Provision for (Gain) Loss on Disposal
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit on (gain) loss recognized for the (reversal of write-down) write-down to fair value, less cost to sell, of a discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accounts Payable and Accrued Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as accounts payable and accrued liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Accrued Income Tax Payable
unclassified.description: Amount classified as income tax obligations attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Assets, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount classified as assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of currency on hand, demand deposits with banks or financial institutions, and other kinds of accounts that have the general characteristics of demand deposits, held by a disposal group.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Deferred Tax Assets
unclassified.description: Amount classified as deferred tax assets attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Depreciation and Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of depreciation and amortization expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Goodwill (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Gross Profit (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of gross profit attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Operating Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of operating expense attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Other Income
unclassified.description: Amount of other income attributable to disposal group, including, but not limited to, discontinued operation.

unclassified.label: Distributions on Mandatorily Redeemable Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of distribution on mandatorily redeemable financial instrument issued in form of share classified as liability.

unclassified.label: Dividend Income, Securities, Operating, Tax Exempt
unclassified.description: Amount of operating dividend income on securities exempt from state, federal and other income tax.

unclassified.label: Dividend, Share-based Payment Arrangement, Paid-in-Kind
unclassified.description: Amount of paid and unpaid paid-in-kind dividends declared for award under share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Due from Affiliate, Current
Due from Employees
Due from Officers or Stockholders, Current
Due from Other Related Parties
Due from Related Parties, Noncurrent
Due to Affiliate, Current
Earnings Per Share, Basic, Distributed
unclassified.description: Dividends declared in the period and the contractual amount of dividends (or interest on participating income bonds) that must be paid per security.

unclassified.label: Earnings Per Share, Diluted, Distributed
unclassified.description: Dividends declared in the period and the contractual amount of dividends (or interest on participating income bonds) that must be paid per security, taking into account all dilutive potential common shares outstanding during the period.

unclassified.label: Effect of Exchange Rate on Cash
Effect on Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) Due to Change in Measurement Date, Tax (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Effect on Future Cash Flows, Amount
unclassified.description: The quantified amount of the future effect on cash flows.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Extraterritorial Income Exclusion, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and the expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for extraterritorial income exclusion.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Deduction, Medicare Prescription Drug Benefit, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to deduction for Medicare prescription drug benefit subsidy.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Nondeductible Expense, Depreciation, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to depreciation.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Repatriation Foreign Earnings, Jobs Creation Act of 2004, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to the temporary incentive for U.S. entities to repatriate accumulated foreign earnings under the American Jobs Creation Act of 2004.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Transition Tax on Accumulated Foreign Earnings, Percent
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Holiday, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to income exempt from income tax because of a tax holiday.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Domestic, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to domestic income tax settlement.

unclassified.label: Effects of Unrealized Holding Gain (Loss) on Present Value of Future Insurance Profits
unclassified.description: Amount of adjustment to reflect the effect that would have been recognized had the unrealized holding gain (loss) actually been realized on the present value of future insurance profits being amortized using the gross profit method and the present value of future profits recognized as a result of a purchase of an insurance entity holding long-duration contracts.

unclassified.label: Embedded Derivative, Fair Value of Embedded Derivative Asset
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives classified as an asset.

unclassified.label: Embedded Derivative, Fair Value of Embedded Derivative Liability
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives classified as a liability.

unclassified.label: Embedded Derivative, Fair Value of Embedded Derivative, Net
unclassified.description: Net fair value as of the balance sheet date of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives classified as assets, net of those classified as liabilities.

unclassified.label: Embedded Derivative, Gain on Embedded Derivative
unclassified.description: Increase in the fair value of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives included in earnings in the period.

unclassified.label: Embedded Derivative, Loss on Embedded Derivative
unclassified.description: Decrease in the fair value of the embedded derivative or group of embedded derivatives included in earnings in the period.

unclassified.label: Employee Service Share-based Compensation, Estimated Quantity of Shares to be Repurchased in Following Period, Minimum (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Debt Structure, Direct Loan, Employer Cash Payments Used for Debt Service
unclassified.description: The amount of cash provided by the employer through contributions or dividends that the ESOP used in the period to repay debt and interest on a third-party loan made directly to the ESOP.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Debt Structure, Employer Loan Guarantee
unclassified.description: Reflects the amount as of the balance sheet date of the employer's guarantee of debt repayment by the ESOP.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Deferred Shares
unclassified.description: Represents the carrying amount of shares held by the ESOP as of the balance sheet date in which no ESOP participant has a vested interest and no lender has a claim.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Dividends Paid to ESOP
unclassified.description: Dividends paid on stock held by an employee stock ownership plan.

unclassified.label: Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), Interest Payments from ESOP
unclassified.description: An entity often discloses the amount of interest paid by the ESOP to a lender.

unclassified.label: Disclosure on Geographic Areas, Long-Lived Assets in Entity's Country of Domicile (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Disclosure on Geographic Areas, Long-Lived Assets in Foreign Countries (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Disclosure on Geographic Areas, Revenue from External Customers Attributed to Entity's Country of Domicile (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Disclosure on Geographic Areas, Revenue from External Customers Attributed to Foreign Countries (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Entity-Wide Revenue, Major Customer, Percentage (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
EquityClassifiedWrittenCallOptionModificationEquityIssuanceIncreaseDecreaseInEquityAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in equity for freestanding written call option classified as equity from modification recognized as equity issuance cost. Includes, but is not limited to, exchange by issuer and holder. Excludes share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Equity Issued in Business Combination, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value of equity issued in a business combination.

unclassified.label: Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Current Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Current Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment Summarized Financial Information, Equity (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Liabilities and Equity (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Noncurrent Assets (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Noncurrent Liabilities (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Redeemable Preferred Stock (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Summarized Financial Information, Revenue (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Method Investment, Unrealized Intercompany Profit (Loss) Not Eliminated, Amount (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Equity Restrictions
unclassified.description: Disclosure of the amount of equity that is restricted to use by regulation or agreement.

unclassified.label: EquitySecuritiesFVNINoncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI), classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: EquitySecurityFvNiContractualSaleRestriction
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in equity security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in net income (FV-NI) subject to contractual sale restriction. Excludes investment in equity security by investment company for which discount for contractual sale restriction is applied.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tangible Capital, Excess, Actual
unclassified.description: Amount of tangible capital exceeding minimum required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Banking Regulation, Tangible Capital Ratio, Excess, Actual
unclassified.description: Ratio of tangible capital to tangible assets exceeding minimum required for capital adequacy as defined by regulatory framework.

unclassified.label: Excise Taxes Collected
unclassified.description: The excise taxes collected by a public utility and reported in revenues if the amount of excise taxes is equal to 1 percent or more of such total.

unclassified.label: Exploration Abandonment and Impairment Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment loss for oil and gas properties with unproved reserve in oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes, but is not limited to, previously capitalized cost of drilling exploratory well when proved reserve is not found or when there is substantial doubt about economic or operational viability of project.

unclassified.label: Extraordinary Item, Gain (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Extraordinary Item, Gain (Loss), Net of Tax, Attributable to Parent (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Fair Value, Asset (Liability), Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in income from asset (liability) measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Investment Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Fair Value, Assets Measured on Recurring Basis, Retained Interest (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Dividend Payments (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value Assumptions, Weighted Average Volatility Rate (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value, Concentration of Risk, Cash Surrender Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of cash surrender value of insurance policy subject to concentration of credit or market risk or both.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Concentration of Risk, Loans Receivable
unclassified.description: Fair value of loan receivable subject to concentration of credit or market risk or both.

unclassified.label: Fair Value Disclosure, Off-balance Sheet Risks, Amount (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Estimate Not Practicable, Commitments (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value Inputs, Discount for Lack of Marketability (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value Inputs, Long-term Revenue Growth Rate (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Percent Debt Securities
unclassified.description: The percentage of the total value of investments that are debt securities for a given category of investments for which net asset value per share is calculated.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Percent Domestic Equity Securities
unclassified.description: The percentage of the total value of investments that are domestic equity securities for a given category of investments for which net asset value per share is calculated.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Sale for Other than NAV, Amount (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Unobservable Input, Realized Gain (Loss) (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Unobservable Input, Unrealized Gain (Loss) (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Fair Value, Investments, Entities that Calculate Net Asset Value Per Share, Unobservable Input, Unrealized Gain (Loss), Included in Earnings, Net (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Change in Unrealized Gain (Loss) Included in Trading Revenue (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Commitments (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Income (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Gain (Loss) Included in Trading Revenue (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Fair Value, Liabilities Measured on Recurring Basis, Mandatorily Redeemable Preferred Stock (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Liability, Recurring Basis, Still Held, Unrealized Gain (Loss), OCI
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized gain (loss) recognized in other comprehensive income (OCI) from liability measured at fair value on recurring basis using unobservable input (level 3) and still held.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Asset and Liability, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2012-01-31)

Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Instruments Classified in Shareholders' Equity, Gain (Loss) Included in Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Instruments Classified in Shareholders' Equity, Period Increase (Decrease) (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Fair Value, Measurement with Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Recurring Basis, Instruments Classified in Shareholders' Equity, Purchases, (Sales), Issuances, (Settlements) (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Fair Value, Net Derivative Asset (Liability) Measured on Recurring Basis, Unobservable Inputs Reconciliation, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of financial instrument classified as a derivative asset (liability) after deduction of derivative liability (asset), measured using unobservable inputs that reflect the entity's own assumption about the assumptions market participants would use in pricing.

unclassified.label: Fair Value, Option, Disclosures Related to Election, Items Existing at Effective Date, Commitments (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Fair Value, Option, Ineligible Items, Carrying Amount
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of items included in each line item in the statement of financial position that are not eligible for the fair value option.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Affordable Housing Program, Principal Outstanding
unclassified.description: Principal amount outstanding of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) relating to the Affordable Housing Program (AHP).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Commitment Fees
unclassified.description: Amount of unearned commitment fees on advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Earlier of Contractual Maturity or Next Call Date, in Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Par amount of advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) with the earlier of contractual maturity or next call date within the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesIndexAmortizing
unclassified.description: Par amount of index amortizing advances made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Maturities Summary by Interest Rate Type (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Fixed Rate, after Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) with fixed interest rate maturing after fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advance, Maturity, Floating Rate, after Year One Through Five
unclassified.description: Amount of advance from Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) with floating interest rate maturing in second through fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Advances, Outstanding, Greater than One Billion Dollars Per Borrower, Percent
unclassified.description: Percentage of advances outstanding made and reported by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) that are in excess of one billion U.S. dollars per borrower to the total advances outstanding.

unclassified.label: FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesWeightedAverageInterestRateIndexAmortizing
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate on index amortizing advances made by Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank Assessments
unclassified.description: Amount of Affordable Housing Program (AHP) assessments and Congressionally mandated Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank) assessments.

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Leverage Ratio, Actual
unclassified.description: Leverage ratio of Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), calculated per regulations of the Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA).

unclassified.label: Federal Home Loan Bank, Regulatory Capital, Required
unclassified.description: Minimum amount of regulatory capital required for Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank), set by the Federal Housing Finance Agency (FHFA).

unclassified.label: FeeIncome
unclassified.description: Amount of fee income including, but not limited to, managerial assistance, servicing of investment, and origination and commitment fees.

unclassified.label: Financial Asset, Amortized Cost, Accrued Interest, after Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accrued interest on financial asset measured at amortized cost.

unclassified.label: Financial Instruments Sold, Not yet Purchased, Mortgages, Mortgage-backed and Asset-backed Securities
unclassified.description: Fair value of obligations arising from mortgages, mortgage-backed securities and asset-backed securities sold short.

unclassified.label: Financial Services Liabilities
unclassified.description: For entities that provide full or partial financing and servicing for customers supplementary to its major operations (such as a manufacturer or a homebuilder providing and servicing loans to buyers), represents the liabilities associated with such activities, including accounts payable and accrued liabilities.

unclassified.label: Financing Interest Expense
unclassified.description: This element represents interest incurred for borrowed money which was used to produce goods or render services.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossLoanSold
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in allowance for credit loss on financing receivable from sale of loan. Excludes net investment in lease.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossMaturityRollingAfterYear15
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable, maturing after fifteenth rolling fiscal year following current statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossMaturityRollingAfterYearFiveThoughFifteenYears
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable, maturing in sixth through fifteenth rolling fiscal year following current statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossMaturityRollingAfterYearOneThroughFiveYears
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable, maturing in second through fifth rolling fiscal year following current statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableBeforeAllowanceForCreditLossMaturityRollingWithinOneYear
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of financing receivable, maturing in next rolling fiscal year following current statement of financial position date. For interim and annual periods when interim period is reported on rolling approach.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Change in Present Value, Expense (Reversal)
Financing Receivable, Covered, after Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance, of finance receivable covered by loss sharing agreement.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Covered, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for finance receivable covered by loss sharing agreement.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableModifiedWeightedAverageInterestRateBeforeModification
unclassified.description: Percentage, before modification, of weighted-average interest rate of financing receivable for debtor experiencing financial difficulty.

unclassified.label: Financing Receivable, Nonaccrual, Percent Past Due (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Financing Receivable, Transfer to Held-for-Investment, Allowance for Credit Loss, Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for allowance for credit loss on financing receivable transferred to held-for-investment classification.

unclassified.label: FinancingReceivableTransferToHeldForInvestmentValuationAllowanceExpenseReversal
unclassified.description: Amount of expense reversal of valuation allowance on financing receivable transferred to held-for-investment classification.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Asset, Off-market Lease, Favorable, Gross
unclassified.description: This element represents the identifiable intangible asset established upon acquisition based on a favorable difference between the terms of an acquired lease and the current market terms for that lease at the acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Cost Incurred to Renew or Extend
unclassified.description: Amount of cost incurred and capitalized to renew or extend term of recognized finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Finite Lived Intangible Assets, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which increases (decreases) finite-lived intangible asset. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Translation Adjustments (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Finite-Lived Intangible Assets, Translation and Purchase Accounting Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in finite-lived intangible asset from foreign currency translation and measurement period adjustments. Excludes goodwill and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed.

unclassified.label: Finite-Lived Noncompete Agreements, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross carrying amount before accumulated amortization as of the balance sheet date of payments made to third parties in exchange for their agreement not to engage in specified competitive practices in specified geographic territories for a specified period of time.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Contract, Asset, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of asset contracts related to the exchange of different currencies, including, but not limited to, foreign currency options, forward contracts, and swaps.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Contracts, Liability, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of liability contracts related to the exchange of different currencies, including, but not limited to, foreign currency options, forward (delivery or nondelivery) contracts, and swaps entered into.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Exchange Rate, Remeasurement
unclassified.description: Foreign exchange rate used to remeasure amounts denominated in a currency other than functional currency into functional currency.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Asset at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative assets designated as foreign currency fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Liability at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative liabilities designated as foreign currency fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Foreign Financial Institutions, Mandated Reserve Amount
unclassified.description: The mandated reserve amounts required of branches of foreign institutions.

unclassified.label: Franchise Costs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Capital Lease Obligations, Noncurrent
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Deferred Income Tax Assets, Current
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Goodwill
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Other Postretirement Obligations
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Preferred Stock
Fresh-Start Adjustment, Increase (Decrease), Retained Earnings (Deficit)
Future Minimum Sublease Rentals, Sale Leaseback Transactions, Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of minimum sublease rentals for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing to be received by the seller-lessee in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Gain from Components Excluded from Assessment of Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness
unclassified.description: The gain relating to components of the gain (loss) on the cash flow hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of cash flow hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Gain from Components Excluded from Assessment of Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness
unclassified.description: Gain relating to components of the gain (loss) on the fair value hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) from Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Fair Value Hedge, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of net gain (loss) recognized in earnings when a hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as a fair value hedge.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) from Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) recognized in earnings when a hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as an interest rate fair value hedge.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Components Excluded from Assessment of Credit Risk Hedge Effectiveness
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) excluded from the assessment of hedge effectiveness for credit risk hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Components Excluded from Assessment of Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness
unclassified.description: The net gain (loss) included in earnings for the period relating to components of the gain (loss) on interest rate cash flow hedging instruments excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Components Excluded from Assessment of Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Effectiveness
unclassified.description: The net gain (loss) included in earnings for the period relating to components of the gain (loss) on interest rate fair value hedging instruments excluded from the assessment of fair value hedge effectiveness.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Condemnation
unclassified.description: The gain (loss) is the pre-tax difference between the net condemnation award and the entity's adjusted basis of the condemned property.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness
