unclassified.description: The net gain (loss) during the reporting period due to ineffectiveness in foreign currency cash flow hedges. Recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivatives Recorded in Earnings, Net
unclassified.description: Aggregate impact of foreign currency derivatives on earnings for the period. Includes impact of foreign currency cash flow hedge ineffectiveness and the ineffectiveness of fair value hedging derivatives and full change in fair value of the foreign currency derivatives not designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Derivatives, Net
unclassified.description: The aggregate net gain (loss) on price risk derivatives included in earnings in the period.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Previously Unissued Stock by Subsidiary or Equity Investee, Nonoperating Income
unclassified.description: The profit or loss on sales of previously unissued stock by subsidiaries or equity investees made to investors outside the consolidated group that is not reported as operating income. Represents the difference in the parent company's carrying amount of the equity interest in the subsidiary or equity investee immediately before and after the transaction.

unclassified.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties, before Applicable Income Taxes (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Gain on Cash Flow Hedge Ineffectiveness
unclassified.description: The gain recognized in earnings during the reporting period representing the amount of the cash flow hedges' ineffectiveness.

unclassified.label: Gain Recognized on Assets Transferred to Separate Account, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount of gain recognized during the reporting period on assets that were transferred into separate accounts.

unclassified.label: Gains (Losses) on Recourse Debt
Good Faith and Margin Deposits with Broker-Dealers
unclassified.description: Amount of right to receive cash and securities on deposit with broker-dealers to demonstrate an intention to complete a purchase (good faith deposit) and collateral deposited by counterparty to cover the credit risk assumed (margin deposit).

unclassified.label: Goodwill, Impaired, Adjustment to Initial Estimate Amount (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Gross Investment Income, Operating
unclassified.description: Amount, before investment expense, of income earned from investments in securities and real estate. Includes, but is not limited to, real estate investment, policy loans, dividends, and interest. Excludes realized gain (loss) on investments.

unclassified.label: Ground Leases, Net
unclassified.description: Net long-term land leases which are capitalized as part of real property.

unclassified.label: Liabilities for Guarantees on Long-Duration Contracts, Guaranteed Benefit Liability, Gross, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the liability for guaranteed minimum benefits on long-duration contracts.

unclassified.label: Health Care Organization, Allowance for Doubtful Accounts, Percentage of Accounts Receivable
unclassified.description: Ratio of the allowance for doubtful accounts to accounts receivable, expressed as a percentage, for health care organizations.

unclassified.label: Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Current
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), classified as current.

unclassified.label: Held-to-maturity Securities, Gross Gains, Derivatives (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Held-to-maturity Securities, Gross Gains (Losses), Derivatives (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Held-to-maturity Securities, Gross Losses, Derivatives (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Debt Securities, Held-to-maturity, Sold at Par Value
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in debt security measured at amortized cost (held-to-maturity), with interest rate reset through auction process, sold at par value.

unclassified.label: Hosting Arrangement, Service Contract, Implementation Cost, Capitalized, Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated amortization of capitalized implementation cost from hosting arrangement that is service contract.

unclassified.label: Hosting Arrangement, Service Contract, Implementation Cost, Capitalized, before Accumulated Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated amortization, of capitalized implementation cost from hosting arrangement that is service contract.

unclassified.label: Hybrid Instruments at Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of hybrid instruments.

unclassified.label: Impact of Restatement on Opening Retained Earnings, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Impaired Assets to be Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, Amount of Impairment Loss
unclassified.description: Loss recognized as a result of the initial and subsequent write-down of a long-lived asset's carrying amount to fair value.

unclassified.label: Impaired Assets to be Disposed of by Method Other than Sale, Carrying Value of Asset
unclassified.description: Amount of impaired long-lived asset to be disposed of other than by sale. Excludes long-lived asset held for sale and disposed of.

unclassified.label: Impairment Losses Related to Real Estate Partnerships
unclassified.description: Impairment losses measured as the amount by which the carrying amount of the business or real estate partnerships exceeds the fair value of the business or partnership.

unclassified.label: Impairment of Leasehold
unclassified.description: The adjustment to reduce the value of existing agreements that specify the lessee's rights to use the leased property. This expense is charged when the estimates of future profits generated by the leased property are reduced.

unclassified.label: Incentive from Lessor
unclassified.description: Amount of incentive received by lessee from lessor.

unclassified.label: Incentive to Lessee
unclassified.description: Amount of incentive granted by lessor to lessee.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest. Includes, but is not limited to, income (loss) from continuing operations, discontinued operations and equity method investments.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) before Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Interest Expense, Interest Income, Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interests, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of income (loss) from continuing operations, nonoperating income (expense) and income (loss) from equity method investments, before deduction of income tax expense (benefit) and income (loss) attributable to noncontrolling interest, and addition of interest income (expense).

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Operations before Extraordinary Items, Per Basic and Diluted Share (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Income (Loss) from Subsidiaries, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of income (loss) of subsidiary attributable to the parent entity.

unclassified.label: Income (Loss) from Subsidiaries, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) of subsidiary attributable to the parent entity.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Increase (Decrease) in Liability from Prior Year
unclassified.description: The amount the liability recorded for the income tax examination increased or decreased in the current year/accounting period.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Examination, Liability Recorded (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Income Tax (Expense) Benefit, Continuing Operations, Government Grants
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit from continuing operations attributable to government grants to the extent recognized as a reduction of income tax expense.

unclassified.label: Income Tax Expense (Benefit), Extraordinary Items (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Domestic, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in domestic income tax contingency.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Contingency, Foreign, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to increase (decrease) in foreign income tax contingency.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Foreign, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to foreign income tax settlement.

unclassified.label: Effective Income Tax Rate Reconciliation, Tax Settlement, Other, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of the difference between reported income tax expense (benefit) and expected income tax expense (benefit) computed by applying the domestic federal statutory income tax rates to pretax income (loss) from continuing operations attributable to other income tax settlements.

unclassified.label: Income Taxes Receivable, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying amount due after one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from tax authorities as of the balance sheet date representing refunds of overpayments or recoveries based on agreed-upon resolutions of disputes.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) Due from Affiliates
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in receivables to be collected from an entity that is controlling, under the control of, or within the same control group as the reporting entity by means of direct or indirect ownership.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) Due from Other Related Parties
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in receivables due from related parties classified as other.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts and Notes Receivable
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period of the sum of amounts due within one year (or one business cycle) from customers for the credit sale of goods and services; and from note holders for outstanding loans.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accounts Payable, Related Parties
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the obligations due for goods and services provided by the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries, subsidiaries of a common parent, an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entities' management, an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Accrued Salaries
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in accrued salaries.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Client Funds Held
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the carrying amount of client funds held and maintained in custodial and separate accounts, and which are owned by clients or contract holders.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits from Other Federal Home Loan Banks
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in interest-bearing deposits from another Federal Home Loan Bank (FHLBank).

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Deposits Outstanding
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in monies given as security or collateral for items acquired or borrowed on a temporary basis. Deposits may also be paid as initial payment of the cost of acquisition or for the right to enter into a contract or agreement.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Due from Other Related Parties, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in related party receivables classified as other, due within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Intangible Assets, Current
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in intangible assets (for example patents and licenses).

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Lease Acquisition Costs
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) in the balance of capitalized lease acquisition costs during the period. The cost usually covers a variety of administrative costs, such as the cost of obtaining a credit report, verifying insurance coverage, lease commission charges, checking the accuracy and completeness of the lease documentation, and entering the lease in data processing and accounting systems.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Loss and Loss Adjustment Expense Reserve (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Increase (Decrease) in Notes Receivable, Related Parties
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount owed to the reporting entity in the form of loans and obligations (generally evidenced by promissory notes) made to the following types of related parties: a parent company and its subsidiaries; subsidiaries of a common parent; an entity and trust for the benefit of employees, such as pension and profit-sharing trusts that are managed by or under the trusteeship of the entity's management, an entity and its principal owners, management, or member of their immediate families, affiliates, or other parties with the ability to exert significant influence.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Other Employee-Related Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in employer-related costs classified as other and current.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Postemployment Obligations
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the current portion of the liability that represents various benefits due to former or inactive employees, their beneficiaries, and covered dependents after employment but before retirement.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Obligation, Other Postretirement Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in obligation for other postretirement benefits. Includes, but is not limited to, defined benefit and defined contribution plans. Excludes pension benefits.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Pension Costs (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Increase (Decrease) in Prepaid Royalties
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of consideration paid in advance for royalties that provide economic benefits in future periods.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Reinsurance Recoverable
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the reporting period in the amount of benefits the ceding insurer expects to recover on insurance policies ceded to other insurance entities as of the balance sheet date for all guaranteed benefit types.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Cash and Investments
Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Investments for Operating Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in marketable securities and investments pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Cash for Operating Activities
Increase (Decrease) in Restructuring Reserve
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount (including both current and noncurrent portions of the accrual) of the liability pertaining to the exit from or disposal of business activities or restructuring pursuant to a duly authorized plan, excluding costs or losses pertaining to an entity newly acquired in a business combination and to asset retirement obligations.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Securities Lending Payable
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of the liability pertaining to obligations to return collateral that the entity received when it loaned securities to the counterparty to the transaction.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Self Insurance Reserve
unclassified.description: The increase (decrease) during the period in the carrying amount of accrued known and estimated losses incurred for which no insurance coverage exists, and for which a claim has been made or is probable of being asserted, typically arising from workmen's' compensation-type of incidents and personal injury to nonemployees from accidents on the entity's property.

unclassified.label: Increase (Decrease) in Unearned Premiums
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) unearned premiums written. Excludes portion of unearned premiums amortized into income.

unclassified.label: Increase in Restricted Cash
Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Net, Financial Guarantee
unclassified.description: Amount, after policies assumed or ceded, of provision for policy benefits and costs incurred for financial guarantee insurance contracts.

unclassified.label: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Net, Property, Casualty and Liability
unclassified.description: Amount, after effect of policies assumed or ceded, of expense related to provision for policy benefits and costs incurred for property and casualty insurance contracts.

unclassified.label: Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets, Translation and Purchase Accounting Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in indefinite-lived intangible asset from foreign currency translation and measurement period adjustments. Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: Induced Conversion of Convertible Debt Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for inducement to convert debt instrument representing fair value of security and other consideration transferred in excess of fair value of security and other consideration issuable pursuant to conversion privilege provided in terms of existing instrument.

unclassified.label: Insurance Receivable for Malpractice, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: The noncurrent portion of the receivable from insurance and similar arrangements for reimbursement and payment of malpractice claims and litigation costs.

unclassified.label: IntangibleAssetFiniteLivedAndCapitalizedCostSoftwareToBeSoldLeasedOrMarketedAfterAccumulatedAmortization
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated amortization, of finite-lived intangible asset and capitalized cost for software to be sold, leased, or marketed. Excludes goodwill.

unclassified.label: Intangible Assets Arising from Insurance Contracts Acquired in Business Combination, Estimated Amount Amortized, Year One (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Intangible Assets Arising from Insurance Contracts Acquired in Business Combination (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Intangible Assets Arising from Insurance Contracts Acquired in Business Combination, Amortization Expense, Next Twelve Months (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Intangible Assets Arising from Insurance Contracts Acquired in Business Combination, Amortization Expense, Year Two (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Intangible Assets Arising from Insurance Contracts Acquired in Business Combination, Estimated Amount Amortized, Year Two (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Intangible Assets Arising from Insurance Contracts Acquired in Business Combination, Period Increase (Decrease) (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Commercial and Residential, Real Estate
unclassified.description: Interest and fee income from commercial and residential real estate loans.

unclassified.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Commercial, Real Estate
unclassified.description: Interest and fee income generated from loans secured by commercial properties. Examples of properties commonly securing commercial real estate loans may include office buildings, apartment buildings, shopping centers, industrial property, and hotels.

unclassified.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Other Consumer
unclassified.description: Interest and fee income from other loans extended to individual consumers.

unclassified.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Real Estate Construction
unclassified.description: Interest and fee income from loans used for real estate development and construction costs. Such loans are referred to as "Construction" loans or mortgages.

unclassified.label: Interest and Fee Income, Loans, Trade Financing
unclassified.description: Interest and fee income generated by trade financing. Trade financing is a specialized area of commercial lending frequently used by businesses that engage in international activities. Such financing includes open account financing, sales on consignment, documentary collections, advances against collections, letters of credit, bankers' acceptances, factoring, and forfeiting.

unclassified.label: Interest and Fee Income, Nonmortgage Loans and Leases Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: Amount of interest and fee income earned from loans held-for-sale, including interest earned from direct financing and sales-type leases held-for-sale, but excluding mortgage loans held-for sale.

unclassified.label: Interest-bearing Deposits, at Carrying Value (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Interest-bearing Foreign Deposit, Brokered
unclassified.description: Amount of interest-bearing foreign third-party deposits placed by or through the assistance of a deposit broker, also known as brokered deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Interest-bearing Foreign Deposit, Certificates of Deposits
unclassified.description: Amount of interest-bearing certificates of deposit liabilities in foreign banking offices.

unclassified.label: Interest-bearing Foreign Deposit, Money Market
unclassified.description: Amount of interest-bearing money market demand account deposit liabilities in foreign banking offices.

unclassified.label: InterestBearingForeignDepositOtherTimeDeposits
unclassified.description: Amount of interest-bearing time deposit liabilities other than certificates of deposit in foreign banking offices.

unclassified.label: Interest-bearing Foreign Deposit, Retail
unclassified.description: Amount of interest-bearing retail deposit liabilities in foreign banking offices.

unclassified.label: InterestBearingLiabilitiesAverageAmountOutstanding
unclassified.description: Average amount outstanding of interest-bearing liabilities.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense, Debt, Excluding Amortization
unclassified.description: Represents the portion of interest incurred in the period on debt arrangements that was charged against earnings, excluding amortization of debt discount (premium) and financing costs.

unclassified.label: Interest Expense Domestic Deposit Liabilities, Retail
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense on domestic retail deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: InterestExpenseFederalFundsPurchasedIncreaseDecrease
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in interest expense on federal funds purchased.

unclassified.label: InterestExpenseTimeDepositIncreaseDecrease
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in interest expense on time deposit.

unclassified.label: Interest Income (Expense), Nonoperating, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income (expense) classified as nonoperating.

unclassified.label: InterestIncomeOperatingPaidInCash
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income from investment paid in cash, classified as operating.

unclassified.label: InterestIncomeShortTermInvestmentOther
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income from short-term investment classified as other.

unclassified.label: Interest Paid, Capitalized, Investing Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash paid for interest capitalized, classified as investing activity.

unclassified.label: Interest Portion of Minimum Lease Payments, Sale Leaseback Transactions
unclassified.description: Amount necessary to reduce minimum lease payments to present value for sale-leaseback transactions accounted for using the deposit method or as a financing.

unclassified.label: Interest Rate Fair Value Hedge Liability at Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value as of the balance sheet date of all derivative liabilities designated as interest rate fair value hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Buildings and Improvements
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of building structures held as inventory including any additions, improvements, or renovations to those structures.

unclassified.label: Inventory, Real Estate, Mortgage Loans Held in Inventory
unclassified.description: Represents mortgage loans held in inventory primarily for sale to others (third parties, businesses, legal entities) in the ordinary course of business.

unclassified.label: Investment Building and Building Improvements
unclassified.description: Aggregate of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of investments in building and building improvements.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Committed Capital
unclassified.description: Amount of funds committed to investment company from investors.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Distribution to Shareholders, Per Share
unclassified.description: Per share or unit amount of distribution to shareholders. Includes, but is not limited to, dividend and capital gain. Excludes distribution for tax return of capital.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Dividend Distribution
unclassified.description: Amount of dividend distribution from ordinary income and capital gain. Excludes distribution for tax return of capital.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Investment Income (Loss) from Operations, Per Share
unclassified.description: Per share or unit amount of investment income (loss) and realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Investment Income (Loss), Per Share
unclassified.description: Per-basic-share or unit amount, after investment expense, of dividend and interest investment income (loss) from investment held by investment company.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Investment Income (Loss) Ratio
unclassified.description: Percentage of investment income (loss) to average net assets.

unclassified.label: InvestmentCompanyPortfolioTurnover
unclassified.description: Percentage of lesser of purchase or sale of portfolio securities to average value of portfolio securities owned.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Tax Return of Capital Distribution
unclassified.description: Amount of distribution in excess of tax-basis earnings and profit of investment company.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Total Return
unclassified.description: Percentage increase (decrease) in fund net asset value, assuming reinvestment of dividends and capital gain distributions.

unclassified.label: Investment Company, Voluntary Fee Waived
unclassified.description: Amount of fee voluntarily waived by investment company.

unclassified.label: Investment in Physical Commodities
unclassified.description: Investments held in physical commodities, such as gold, silver, platinum, crude oil, coal, sugar, rice, wheat.

unclassified.label: InvestmentIncomeOperatingTaxExpenseBenefit
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) on investment income classified as operating. Excludes realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment.

unclassified.label: Investment Interest Rate
unclassified.description: Rate of interest on investment.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, Face Amount
unclassified.description: Nominal or face amount on the investment owned.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, Unrealized Appreciation (Depreciation), Net (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Investment Owned, Unrecognized Unrealized Appreciation
unclassified.description: This element represents the excess of the cost (face amount, notional amount) of an investment (security, contract) over its fair value which deficiency has not been recognized in earnings of the entity.

unclassified.label: Investment Owned, Unrecognized Unrealized Appreciation (Depreciation), Net
unclassified.description: This element represents the net excess or deficiency of the fair value of an investment (security, contract) over or under its cost (face amount, notional amount), respectively, which excess value or deficiency has not been recognized in earnings of the entity.

unclassified.label: InvestmentProgramProportionalAmortizationMethodAppliedNonIncomeTaxRelatedActivityAndOtherReturn
unclassified.description: Amount of income (loss) from non-income-tax-related activity and other return on investment under tax credit program accounted for using proportional amortization method, not recognized in income tax expense (benefit).

unclassified.label: Investment Sold, Not yet Purchased, Balance, Principal Amount
unclassified.description: For investments which are quantified by principal amount, principal balance held at close of period.

unclassified.label: Investment Sold, Not yet Purchased, Sale Proceeds
unclassified.description: The amount of proceeds received resulting from the short sale of a security.

unclassified.label: Investments and Cash
unclassified.description: Sum of investments and unrestricted cash as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Investments and Other Noncurrent Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of investments, and noncurrent assets classified as other.

unclassified.label: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, at Fair Value, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in the investments in and advances to affiliates.

unclassified.label: Investments in and Advances to Affiliates, Balance, Principal Amount
Investments Net Asset Value (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Items Included in Consolidated Statement of Financial Condition (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Junior Subordinated Debenture Owed to Unconsolidated Subsidiary Trust, Current
unclassified.description: The current portion of the carrying value of junior subordinated long-term debt owed to unconsolidated subsidiary trusts as of the balance sheet date. Such debt places a lender in a lien position behind debt having a higher priority of repayment in liquidation of the entity's assets and was initially scheduled to be repaid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle if longer.

unclassified.label: Land Subject to Ground Leases
unclassified.description: Area of land subject to a ground lease.

unclassified.label: Leasing Commissions Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of commissions expense incurred because the lessor of real estate obtained a lessee for a rental property through a real estate agent.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Lease Not yet Commenced, Assumption and Judgment, Value of Underlying Asset, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount lessor expects from underlying asset following end of operating lease term for lease that has not yet commenced.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received, after Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor in period after fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date for operating lease. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received, Rolling Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor in fifth rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date for operating lease. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received, Rolling Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor in third rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date for operating lease. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Lessor, Operating Lease, Payments to be Received, Rolling Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of lease payments to be received by lessor in second rolling twelve months following latest statement of financial position date for operating lease. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on rolling approach, from latest statement of financial position date.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Balance Sheet, Deferred Taxes Arising from Leveraged Leases
unclassified.description: The liability for taxes payable in the future as a result of temporary differences in treatment of certain items in the current year arising from the net investment in arrangements meeting the criteria for classification as a leveraged lease.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Income Statement, Investment Tax Credit Recognized on Leveraged Leases
unclassified.description: Amount of investment tax credit recognized as income.

unclassified.label: Leveraged Leases, Income (Loss)
unclassified.description: The total recognized during the period for income on leases meeting the criteria for classification as leveraged leases.

unclassified.label: Liabilities for Guarantees on Long-Duration Contracts, Benefits Paid (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Liabilities for Guarantees on Long-Duration Contracts, Guaranteed Benefit Liability, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount of expected guaranteed benefits in excess of the projected account balances for minimum guaranteed benefit contracts, as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Liabilities for Guarantees on Long-Duration Contracts, Incurred Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of guaranteed minimum benefit expense incurred for expected guaranteed minimum benefits in excess of projected account values.

unclassified.label: Liabilities for Guarantees on Long-Duration Contracts, Payment for Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow to policyholders and contract holders for guaranteed minimum benefit payments.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Amount classified as liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Liabilities, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount classified as liabilities attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of beyond one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Liabilities, Other than Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Aggregated carrying amounts of obligations as of the balance sheet date, excluding long-term debt, incurred as part of the normal operations that are expected to be paid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Alternate captions include Total Deferred Credits and Other Liabilities.

unclassified.label: Liabilities Related to Investment Contracts, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of liability related to investment contracts for example, but not limited to, guaranteed investment contract or annuities.

unclassified.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Early Contract Termination Fees
unclassified.description: The amount of early contract termination fees included in liabilities subject to compromise.

unclassified.label: Liabilities Subject to Compromise, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in liabilities subject to compromise.

unclassified.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Current Weighted-Average Discount Rate
unclassified.description: Current weighted-average discount rate used to measure liability for future policy benefit.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedFutureBenefitOriginalDiscountRateBeforeReinsuranceAfterCashFlowChange
unclassified.description: Amount, before effect of reinsurance and after current period update of cash flow assumption, of expected future benefit and expense component for liability for future policy benefit, discounted at original rate.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedFutureGrossPremiumDiscountedBeforeReinsurance
unclassified.description: Amount, before effect of reinsurance, of discounted balance for expected future gross premium component of liability for future policy benefit.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedFutureGrossPremiumUndiscountedBeforeReinsurance
unclassified.description: Amount, before effect of reinsurance, of undiscounted balance for expected future gross premium component of liability for future policy benefit.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedFuturePolicyBenefitBeforeReinsuranceAfterDiscountRateChange
unclassified.description: Amount, before effect of reinsurance and after current period update of cash flow assumption and discount rate change, of expected future policy benefit and expense component of liability for future policy benefit.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedFuturePolicyBenefitCumulativeIncreaseDecreaseFromCashFlowChange
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in expected future policy benefit and expense component for liability of future policy benefit from cash flow assumption change for future cash flows.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedFuturePolicyBenefitCumulativeIncreaseDecreaseOfActualVarianceFromExpectedExperience
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in expected future policy benefit and expense component for liability of future policy benefit from effect of variance from cash flow assumption change for actual experience.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedFuturePolicyBenefitInterestExpense
unclassified.description: Amount of interest expense for expected future policy benefit and expense component of liability for future policy benefit.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedFuturePolicyBenefitIssuance
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in expected future policy benefit and expense component of liability for future policy benefit from contract issuance.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedFuturePolicyBenefitOriginalDiscountRateBeforeCashFlowAndReinsurance
unclassified.description: Amount, before effect of reinsurance and current period update of cash flow assumption, of expected future policy benefit and expense component of liability for future policy benefit, discounted at original rate.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedFuturePolicyBenefitUndiscountedBeforeReinsurance
unclassified.description: Amount, before effect of reinsurance, of undiscounted balance for expected future policy benefit and expense component of liability for future policy benefit.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedNetPremiumBeforeReinsuranceAfterDiscountRateChange
unclassified.description: Amount, before effect of reinsurance and after current period update of cash flow assumption and discount rate change, of expected net premium component of liability for future policy benefit.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedNetPremiumCumulativeIncreaseDecreaseFromCashFlowChange
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in expected net premium component of liability for future policy benefit from cash flow assumption change for future cash flows.

unclassified.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Net Premium, Cumulative Increase (Decrease) of Actual Variance from Expected Experience
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative increase (decrease) in expected net premium component for liability of future policy benefit from effect of variance from cash flow assumption change for actual experience.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedNetPremiumInterestIncome
unclassified.description: Amount of interest income for expected net premium component of liability for future policy benefit.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedNetPremiumIssuance
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in expected net premium component of liability for future policy benefit from contract issuance.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedNetPremiumNetPremiumCollected
unclassified.description: Amount of premium collected from policyholder to fund expected benefit payment for expected net premium component of liability for future policy benefit.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitExpectedNetPremiumOriginalDiscountRateBeforeCashFlowAndReinsurance
unclassified.description: Amount, before effect of reinsurance and current period update of cash flow assumption, of expected net premium component of liability for future policy benefit, discounted at original rate.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitReinsuranceRecoverableAfterAllowance
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, recoverable under reinsurance of liability for future policy benefit.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitRemeasurementGainLoss
unclassified.description: Amount of remeasurement gain (loss) on liability for future policy benefit from application of revised benefit ratio as of contract issue. Includes, but is not limited to, remeasurement gain (loss) for annuitization insurance benefit, death and other insurance benefits, and traditional and limited-payment contracts.

unclassified.label: LiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitWeightedAverageInterestAccretionRate
unclassified.description: Original weighted-average discount rate at contract issue date used to measure liability for future policy benefit.

unclassified.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Disability and Accident Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events under disability and accident insurance contracts.

unclassified.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Individual and Group Annuities and Supplementary Contracts
unclassified.description: Amount of accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events under individual and group annuities and supplementary insurance contracts.

unclassified.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Life
unclassified.description: Amount of accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events under long-term life insurance contracts.

unclassified.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Other Contracts
unclassified.description: Amount of accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events under other insurance contracts.

unclassified.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefit, Expected Future Policy Benefit, Benefit Payment
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow to policyholder from benefit payment for expected future policy benefit and expense component of liability for future policy benefit.

unclassified.label: Liability for Future Policy Benefits, Period Expense (Income)
unclassified.description: Amount of expense (income) recognized due to changes in the accrued obligation to policyholders that relates to insured events.

unclassified.label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency gain (loss) which decreases (increases) the cost of settling unpaid claims after deduction of reinsurance recoveries. Includes, but is not limited to, claims which have been incurred but not reported.

unclassified.label: Liability for Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustment Expense, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount, after effects of reinsurance, of increase (decrease) in the liability for unpaid claims and claims adjustment expense.

unclassified.label: Life Settlement Contracts, Investment Method, Number of Contracts
unclassified.description: Number of life settlement contracts accounted for under the investment method.

unclassified.label: Limited Liability Company (LLC) or Limited Partnership (LP), Managing Member or General Partner, Ownership Interest
unclassified.description: Percentage investment held by the managing member or general partner of the limited liability company (LLC) or limited partnership (LP).

unclassified.label: Limited Liability Company (LLC) Members' Equity, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of ownership interest in a limited liability company (LLC), including portions attributable to both the parent and noncontrolling interests.

unclassified.label: Limited Partners' Contributed Capital
unclassified.description: The amount of capital contributed by the limited partners.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Assumed
unclassified.description: The fair value of line of credit assumed in noncash investing or financing activities.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Annual Principal Payment
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in debt under credit facility arrangement from principal payment.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Capacity Available for Trade Purchases
unclassified.description: The maximum amount of borrowing capacity under a line of credit that is available as of the balance sheet date for financing purchases of goods acquired for inventory or imminent delivery to a customer.

unclassified.label: Line of Credit Facility, Periodic Payment
unclassified.description: Amount of the required periodic payments of both interest and principal.

unclassified.label: Liquidation Basis of Accounting, Remeasurement, Gain (Loss) on Asset
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) from remeasurement of asset for change in carrying value under liquidation basis of accounting.

unclassified.label: Estimated Litigation Liability, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of estimated litigation liability for known or estimated probable loss from litigation, which may include attorneys' fees and other litigation costs, which is expected to be paid after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: LitigationSettlementLoss
unclassified.description: Amount of loss from litigation settlement for amount awarded to other party. Excludes claims within an insurance entity's normal claims settlement process.

unclassified.label: Loans and Leases Receivable, Consumer, Allowance (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Consumer, Installment, Student (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Foreign (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Foreign, Commercial (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Foreign, Net of Deferred Income (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Gross, Carrying Amount, Foreign (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Loans and Leases Receivable, Net Amount, Foreign (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Consumer, Home Equity Loans (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Loans Held-for-sale, Measurement Input
unclassified.description: Value of input used to measure loan, held for sale.

unclassified.label: Loans Payable, Fair Value Disclosure
unclassified.description: Fair value portion of contractual obligation to pay money on demand or on fixed or determinable dates.

unclassified.label: Loans Receivable, Gross, Commercial, Acquisition (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Loans Receivable Held-for-sale, Net, Not Part of Disposal Group, Consumer, Student (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Long-Duration Contracts, Assumptions by Product and Guarantee, Estimated Average Investment Yield
unclassified.description: Estimated average rate of return on investments which is included in the calculation of the amount of the specified guaranteed benefit obligation as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Long-Duration Contracts, Assumptions by Product and Guarantee, Lapse Rate
unclassified.description: Anticipated rate of future terminations of contracts in force as of the balance sheet date, which is included in determining the amount of the specified guaranteed benefit obligation as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Accounts and Financing Receivable, after Allowance for Credit Loss, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of accounts and financing receivables, classified as noncurrent. Includes, but is not limited to, notes and loan receivable.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Lease Obligation, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt and lease obligation, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt and Capital Lease Obligations, Maturities, Repayments of Principal Remainder of Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt and capital lease obligation maturing in the remainder of the fiscal year following the latest fiscal year ended.

unclassified.label: Long-term Debt, Components, Mortgage Loans (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Long-term Line of Credit, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the noncurrent portion of long-term obligations drawn from a line of credit, which is a bank's commitment to make loans up to a specific amount. Examples of items that might be included in the application of this element may consist of letters of credit, standby letters of credit, and revolving credit arrangements, under which borrowings can be made up to a maximum amount as of any point in time conditional on satisfaction of specified terms before, as of and after the date of drawdowns on the line. Includes short-term obligations that would normally be classified as current liabilities but for which (a) postbalance sheet date issuance of a long term obligation to refinance the short term obligation on a long term basis, or (b) the enterprise has entered into a financing agreement that clearly permits the enterprise to refinance the short-term obligation on a long term basis and the following conditions are met (1) the agreement does not expire within 1 year and is not cancelable by the lender except for violation of an objectively determinable provision, (2) no violation exists at the BS date, and (3) the lender has entered into the financing agreement is expected to be financially capable of honoring the agreement.

unclassified.label: Loans Payable, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of loans payable (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

unclassified.label: Long-term Commercial Paper
unclassified.description: Including the current and noncurrent portions, carrying value as of the balance sheet date of long-term unsecured obligations issued by corporations and other borrowers to investors (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer).

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Accrual, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of loss contingency liability expected to be resolved within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Loss Contingency, Receivable, Proceeds
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from the collection of receivables related to a loss contingency.

unclassified.label: Loss from Components Excluded from Assessment of Cash Flow Hedge Effectiveness
unclassified.description: The loss relating to components of the gain (loss) on the cash flow hedging instrument excluded from the assessment of cash flow hedge effectiveness. Recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Loss from Hedged Firm Commitment Not Qualifying as Fair Value Hedge
unclassified.description: Amount of loss recognized in earnings when a hedged firm commitment no longer qualifies as a fair value hedge.

unclassified.label: Loss on Contract Termination for Default
unclassified.description: The amount of the loss on termination of a contract for default.

unclassified.label: Loss Recognized on Assets Transferred to Separate Account, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount of loss recognized during the reporting period on assets that were transferred into separate accounts.

unclassified.label: Losses (Gains) on Sales of Assets and Asset Impairment Charges (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Maintenance Costs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Malpractice Loss Contingency, Insurance Recoveries
unclassified.description: Amount of insurance recoveries recognized from insurance and similar arrangements for reimbursement and payment of malpractice claims recognized during an accounting period.

unclassified.label: Management Fees, Incentive Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Marine Services Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Marketable Securities, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of investment in marketable security, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Marketable Securities, Fixed Maturities (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Members' Equity Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount of ownership interest in limited liability company (LLC) directly or indirectly attributable to noncontrolling interests.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Amount Represented by Preferred Stock
unclassified.description: The amount of noncontrolling interest in subsidiary represented by preferred securities issued by the subsidiary.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest, Change in Redemption Value
unclassified.description: Change in noncontrolling interest during the period as a result of a change in the redemption value of redeemable noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Limited Partnerships
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of the equity interests owned by noncontrolling partners of a limited partnership included in the entity's consolidated financial statements.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss) Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Limited Partnerships (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
SEC Schedule, 12-29, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Amortization of Premium
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in investment in mortgage loan on real estate by entity with substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate or interest in real estate, from amortization of premium.

unclassified.label: Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Collections of Principal
Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Maximum Interest Rate in Range (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Mortgage Loans on Real Estate, Minimum Interest Rate in Range (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Multiemployer Plan, Contributions by Employer (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Multiemployer Plan, Pension, Significant, Employer Contribution, Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of cost for employer contribution to multiemployer pension plan determined to be individually significant.

unclassified.label: Multiemployer Plan, Pension, Significant, Employer Contribution under Collective-Bargaining Arrangement to Total Employer Contribution, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of employer contribution required by collective-bargaining arrangement (CBA) to total employer contribution for multiemployer pension plan determined to be individually significant.

unclassified.label: Multiemployer Plan, Pension, Significant, Future Employer Contribution, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of cost for employer contribution required to be made in future period to multiemployer pension plan determined to be individually significant. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution required by collective-bargaining arrangement (CBA), statutory obligation, and other contractual obligation.

unclassified.label: Multiemployer Plan, Period Contributions (Deprecated 2017-01-31)
Multiemployer Plans, Withdrawal Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of the obligation recognized by withdrawing from a pension or postretirement benefit plan to which two or more unrelated employers contribute where assets contributed by one participating employer may be used to provide benefits to employees of other participating employers.

unclassified.label: Net Income (Loss) from Real Estate Investment Partnership, Attributable to Parent
unclassified.description: Amount of income (loss) from consolidated real estate investments attributed to parent.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, Net Investment in Foreign Operations, Liabilities, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Fair value of all derivative liabilities designated as hedges of net investment in foreign operations.

unclassified.label: Derivative Instruments in Hedges, Net Investment in Foreign Operations, Assets, Fair Value, Net
unclassified.description: Net fair value of all derivatives designated as hedges of net investment in foreign operations.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseAfterAllowanceForCreditLoss
unclassified.description: Amount, after allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseAllowanceForCreditLossRecovery
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, from recovery.

unclassified.label: Net Investment in Lease, Current
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as current.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseNonaccrual
unclassified.description: Amount of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, on nonaccrual status.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseNonaccrualNoAllowance
unclassified.description: Amount of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, on nonaccrual status with no allowance for credit loss.

unclassified.label: Net Investment in Lease, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance for credit loss, of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases, classified as noncurrent.

unclassified.label: Net Investment in Lease, Originated, More than Five Years before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases originated more than five years prior to current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Net Investment in Lease, Year Five, Originated, Four Years before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases originated four years prior to current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Net Investment in Lease, Year One, Originated, Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases originated in current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Net Investment in Lease, Year Two, Originated, Fiscal Year before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases originated in fiscal year prior to current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseOriginatedMoreThanFiveYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases originated more than five years before current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Net Investment in Lease, Year Four, Originated, Three Years before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases originated three years prior to current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Net Investment in Lease, Year Three, Originated, Two Years before Current Fiscal Year
unclassified.description: Amount of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases originated two years prior to current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseYearFiveOriginatedFourYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases originated four years before current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseYearFourOriginatedThreeYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases originated three years before current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseYearOneOriginatedCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases originated in current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseYearThreeOriginatedTwoYearsBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases originated two years before current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: NetInvestmentInLeaseYearTwoOriginatedFiscalYearBeforeCurrentFiscalYearWriteoff
unclassified.description: Amount of writeoff of net investment in sales-type and direct financing leases originated in fiscal year before current fiscal year.

unclassified.label: Net Rentable Area
unclassified.description: Net rentable area for properties owned.

unclassified.label: New Accounting Pronouncement or Change in Accounting Principle, Effect of Change on Basic Earnings Per Share (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Non Investment Assets Less Non Investment Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of noninvestment asset (liability) representing difference between aggregate value of investments, including, but not limited to, long and short positions, and net assets.

unclassified.label: Non-Recourse Debt
Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Employee Benefit Liabilities Assumed
unclassified.description: The amount of employee benefit liabilities that an Entity assumes in acquiring a business or in consideration for an asset received in a noncash (or part noncash) acquisition. Noncash is defined as transactions during a period that affect recognized assets or liabilities but that do not result in cash receipts or cash payments in the period. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Fixed Assets Acquired (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Interest Acquired
unclassified.description: The level of ownership or equity interest acquired in a noncash (or part noncash) transaction. "Part noncash" refers to that portion of the transaction not resulting in cash receipts or cash payments in the period.

unclassified.label: Noncash or Part Noncash Acquisition, Noncash Financial or Equity Instrument Consideration, Shares Issued (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Noncontrolling Interest in Net Income (Loss) Joint Venture Partners, Nonredeemable
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of income (loss) attributable to nonredeemable noncontrolling shareholder, unit holder, partner, or other equity holder of a joint venture.

unclassified.label: Noncontrolling Interest in Variable Interest Entity
unclassified.description: Portion of equity (net assets) in a variable interest entity (VIE) not attributable, directly or indirectly, to the parent entity. That is, this is the portion of equity in a VIE that is attributable to the noncontrolling interest (previously referred to as minority interest).

unclassified.label: Long-Lived Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of long-lived asset, excluding financial instrument, long-term customer relationship of financial institution, mortgage and other servicing rights, deferred policy acquisition cost, and deferred tax asset.

unclassified.label: Noninterest Expense Related to Performance Fees
unclassified.description: Incentive fees which are compensation paid to a trading advisor or to any practitioner who achieves investment results above a specified contractual level.

unclassified.label: Notional Amount of Foreign Currency Fair Value Hedge Derivatives (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Notional Amount of Net Investment Hedge Instruments (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Number of Foreign Currency Derivatives Held
unclassified.description: Number of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives held by the entity at the reporting date.

unclassified.label: Number of Properties Subject to Ground Leases
unclassified.description: Number of separate real estate development properties located on land subject to ground leases.

unclassified.label: Obligation with Joint and Several Liability Arrangement, Amount Recognized
unclassified.description: Amount of joint and several liability recognized in the balance sheet.

unclassified.label: OCI, Equity Method Investment, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI.

unclassified.label: OCI, Equity Method Investment, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax expense (benefit) allocated to other comprehensive income (loss) (OCI) for proportionate share of equity method investee's OCI.

unclassified.label: OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLossAfterReclassificationAdjustmentAndTaxParent
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate, attributable to parent.

unclassified.label: OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLossBeforeReclassificationAdjustmentAfterTax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and before reclassification adjustment, of unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.

unclassified.label: OciLiabilityForFuturePolicyBenefitGainLossBeforeReclassificationAdjustmentTax
unclassified.description: Amount, before reclassification adjustment, of tax expense (benefit) for unrealized gain (loss) from (increase) decrease in liability for future policy benefit from change in discount rate.

unclassified.label: Open Option Contracts Written, at Fair Value
Operating Lease, Initial Direct Cost Expense, over Term
unclassified.description: Amount of operating lease initial direct cost recognized as expense over lease term.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases, Income Statement, Initial Direct Costs
unclassified.description: Amount of incremental cost of lease that would not have been incurred if lease had not been obtained.

unclassified.label: Operating Leases of Lessee, Contingent Rentals, Basis Spread on Variable Rate
unclassified.description: The percentage points added to the reference rate to compute the variable rate on the lessee's operating lease.

unclassified.label: Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Strike Price (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Option Indexed to Issuer's Equity, Strike Price
unclassified.description: Exercise or strike price stated in the contract for options indexed to the issuer's equity shares.

unclassified.label: Other Accrued Liabilities, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of expenses incurred but not yet paid classified as other, due after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Adjustments for Noncash Items Included in Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Other Assets, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of current assets classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Effect of Change in Accounting Principle, Taxes (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification and Tax, Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax and reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying as cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Cash Flow Hedge, Gain (Loss), after Reclassification, before Tax, Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and after reclassification, of gain (loss) from derivative instrument designated and qualifying cash flow hedge included in assessment of hedge effectiveness, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments, before Tax, Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and after adjustments, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge, attributable to noncontrolling interest. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassification for sale and settlement, and amount recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments, before Tax, Parent
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax and after adjustments, of gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge, attributable to parent. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), after Adjustments, Tax, Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount, after adjustments, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge, attributable to noncontrolling interest. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassification for sale and settlement, and amount recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income (Loss), Derivative, Excluded Component, Increase (Decrease), before Adjustments, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before adjustments, of tax expense (benefit) for gain (loss) from increase (decrease) in value of excluded component of derivative designated and qualifying as hedge. Adjustments include, but are not limited to, reclassifications for sale and settlement, and amounts recognized under systematic and rational method.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Income, Reclassification Adjustment on Securities Included in Net Income, Tax (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, Adjustment from AOCI for Accretion of Noncredit Portion of OTTI, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive loss for accretion of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity security.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, OTTI, before Tax, after Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, after adjustments, of increase (decrease) in other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity security, recognized in other comprehensive loss.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Noncredit Portion of OTTI, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive loss for other than temporary impairment (OTTI) realized in earnings for investment in held-to-maturity security.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Noncredit Portion of OTTI, Sale, after Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive loss for other than temporary impairment (OTTI) realized upon sale of investment in held-to-maturity security.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Noncredit Portion of OTTI, Sale, Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit for reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive loss for other than temporary impairment (OTTI) realized upon sale of investment in held-to-maturity security.

unclassified.label: Other Cost of Services (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Other Deductions or Allowable Credits (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Other Employee-related Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of obligations incurred for employer-related costs classified as other, payable within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Employee-related Liabilities
unclassified.description: Amount of obligations incurred for employer-related costs classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Extraordinary Gain (Loss) (Deprecated 2019-01-31)
Other Indefinite-lived Intangible Assets
unclassified.description: Amount after impairment of indefinite-lived intangible assets classified as other. Excludes financial assets and goodwill.

unclassified.label: Other Inventory, Capitalized Costs, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before valuation and last-in first out (LIFO) reserves, of costs capitalized in inventory classified as other, expected to be sold, or consumed within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of long-term debt classified as other, payable after one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Nonrecurring Gain
unclassified.description: Amount of gain that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

unclassified.label: Other Nonrecurring (Income) Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of other expense (income) that is infrequent in occurrence or unusual in nature.

unclassified.label: Other Ownership Interests, Contributed Capital
unclassified.description: The amount of capital contributed by other unit holders.

unclassified.label: Other Payables to Broker-Dealers and Clearing Organizations
unclassified.description: Amount of other payables due to broker-dealers or clearing organizations.

unclassified.label: Other Postretirement Benefits Expense (Reversal of Expense), Noncash
unclassified.description: Amount of noncash expense (reversal of expense) for other postretirement benefits. Excludes pension benefits.

unclassified.label: Liability, Other Retirement Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of liability for retirement benefits, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Payment for Other Postretirement Benefits
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for other postretirement benefit. Includes, but is not limited to, employer contribution to fund plan asset and payment to retiree. Excludes pension benefit.

unclassified.label: Other Real Estate, Covered, Improvements
unclassified.description: Improvements made to other real estate covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

unclassified.label: Other Real Estate, Covered, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Change in carrying amount of other real estate covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed. The change includes for example, but is not limited to, additions, improvements, disposals and valuation adjustments.

unclassified.label: Other Real Estate, Non Covered, Improvements
unclassified.description: Improvements made to other real estate not covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed, including, but not limited to, real estate investments, real estate loans that qualify as investments in real estate, and premises that are no longer used in operations that may also be included in real estate owned. Excludes real estate assets taken in settlement of troubled loans through surrender or foreclosure by banks.

unclassified.label: Other Real Estate, Non Covered, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Change in carrying amount of other real estate not covered by loss sharing agreements not separately disclosed. The change includes for example, but is not limited to, additions, improvements, disposals and valuation adjustments.

unclassified.label: Other Receivables, Gross, Current
unclassified.description: Amount, before allowance, of receivables classified as other, due within one year or the operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Other Restricted Assets, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of current assets that are pledged or subject to withdrawal restrictions, classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Secured Financings
unclassified.description: Secured financing other than securities sold under agreements to repurchase and securities loaned.

unclassified.label: Other Selling and Marketing Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of selling and marketing expense classified as other.

unclassified.label: Other Tax Carryforward, Valuation Allowance (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Available-for-sale Securities, Portion Recognized in Earnings, Net, Qualitative Disclosures, Default Rate
unclassified.description: This item represents the default rate of the underlying assets in the security that was considered as one of the potential factors in reaching a conclusion that the available-for-sale investments are other than temporarily impaired and the amount of such impairment determined to be related to credit loss recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Held-to-maturity Securities, Portion Recognized in Earnings, Net, Qualitative Disclosures, Loan to Collateral Value
