unclassified.description: This item represents the loan to collateral ratio of the underlying assets in the security, represented as a percentage, which was considered as one of the potential factors in reaching a conclusion that the held-to-maturity investments are other than temporarily impaired and only the amount of impairment related to credit loss was recognized in earnings.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, before Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest
unclassified.description: Amount before tax of other than temporary impairment loss (OTTI) on investments in available-for-sale and held-to-maturity debt securities, recognized in other comprehensive loss and attributable to noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Net of Tax, Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Held-to-maturity Securities
unclassified.description: Amount after tax of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity debt security, recognized in other comprehensive income loss, attributable to noncontrolling interest.

unclassified.label: Other than Temporary Impairment Losses, Investments, Portion in Other Comprehensive Loss, Tax, Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest, Held-to-maturity Securities
unclassified.description: Amount of tax (expense) benefit of other than temporary impairment (OTTI) on investment in held-to-maturity debt security, recognized in other comprehensive loss.

unclassified.label: Other Comprehensive Loss, Held-to-maturity Security, Reclassification Adjustment from AOCI for Noncredit Portion of OTTI, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount, before tax, of reclassification adjustment from accumulated other comprehensive income for other than temporary impairment (OTTI) realized in earnings for investment in held-to-maturity security.

unclassified.label: Own-share Lending Arrangement, Counterparty Default, Period of Default, Expense
unclassified.description: The amount of default related expense recognized in earnings in the period in which the entity concludes it is probable that the counterparty (share borrower) to a share-lending arrangement will default.

unclassified.label: Paid-in-Kind Interest
unclassified.description: Interest paid other than in cash for example by issuing additional debt securities. As a noncash item, it is added to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method.

unclassified.label: Participating Mortgage Loans, Unamortized Debt Discount, Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of the related debt discount at the end of the accounting period.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Public Sale of Units Net of Offering Costs
unclassified.description: Amount, after offering cost, from issuance of new unit of limited partnership interest in public offering.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Return of Capital
unclassified.description: Total change in each class of partners' capital accounts during the year due to the return of partner's capital. That is, excess distributions over earnings to partners. All partners include general, limited and preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Account, Unit-based Payment Arrangement, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in partners' capital account for unit-based payment arrangement issued by partnership. Partner includes, but is not limited to, general, limited and preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Partners' Capital Allocated for Income Tax and Other Withdrawals
unclassified.description: Amount of partnership capital allocated for income tax and other withdrawals.

unclassified.label: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Operating Activities
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow, not made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability exceeding amount recognized at acquisition date. Includes, but is not limited to, measurement period adjustment and less amount paid soon after acquisition date.

unclassified.label: Payments for Advance to Affiliate
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from advancing money to an affiliate (an entity that is related but not strictly controlled by the entity).

unclassified.label: Payments for Derivative Instrument, Financing Activities
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for derivative instruments during the period, which are classified as financing activities, excluding those designated as hedging instruments.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Deposits on Real Estate Acquisitions
unclassified.description: Net cash outflow or inflow from the amount given in advance to show intention to complete the acquisition piece of land, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Derivatives (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Payments for (Proceeds from) Held-to-maturity Securities, Short-term
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow (inflow) through acquisition (sale) of short-term held-to-maturity securities.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Long-term Investments
unclassified.description: The net amount paid (received) by the reporting entity through acquisition or sale and maturities of long-term investments which qualify for treatment as an investing activity based on management's intention and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle. Includes cash flows from securities classified as trading securities that were acquired for reasons other than sale in the long-term.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Policy Loans
unclassified.description: Net amount paid or received by the entity associated with issuance or collection of loans made to policy holders, principally secured by the benefits under the policy.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Real Estate Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: The net amount paid or received by the reporting entity associated with the purchase (sale) of real estate held for investment, as opposed to operating, purposes.

unclassified.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Tenant Allowance
unclassified.description: Net cash outflow or inflow from monetary allowance granted by the landlord to a tenant to entice tenant to move into landlords building which will enable the tenant to prepare the leased premises for tenants occupancy.

unclassified.label: Payments for Purchase of Other Assets
unclassified.description: Amount of cash paid to purchase other assets as part of operating activities.

unclassified.label: Payments for Repurchase of Initial Public Offering
unclassified.description: The cash outflow associated with the repurchase of amount received from entity's first offering of stock to the public.

unclassified.label: Payments for Tenant Improvements
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow for cost of leasehold improvement to premises leased to tenant incurred by lessor, classified as investing activity.

unclassified.label: Payments for Time Deposits
unclassified.description: Cash paid to customers who withdraw money in checking and similar accounts at a financial institution.

unclassified.label: Payments for Underwriting Expense
unclassified.description: Cash paid for expenses incurred during underwriting activities (the process to review insurance applications, evaluate risks, accept or reject applications, and determine the premiums to be charged) for insurance companies.

unclassified.label: Payments of Debt Restructuring Costs
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for cost incurred in the modification of term of existing debt agreement in order for the entity to achieve some advantage.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Held-for-sale Real Estate
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land held for sale, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it, and so forth.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Land
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the acquisition of real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excludes land acquired for use by the owner.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Land Held-for-use
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for acquisition of land for use; excludes purchases of land held as inventory or as investments.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Notes Receivable
unclassified.description: The cash outflow to acquire an agreement for an unconditional promise by the maker to pay the entity (holder) a definite sum of money at a future date. Such amount may include accrued interest receivable in accordance with the terms of the note. The note also may contain provisions including a discount or premium, payable on demand, secured, or unsecured, interest bearing or noninterest bearing, among myriad other features and characteristics.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Projects
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the amount invested for projects in hopes of getting a future return or interest from it.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Real Estate
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the acquisition of a piece of land, anything permanently fixed to it, including buildings, structures on it and so forth; includes real estate intended to generate income for the owner; excludes real estate acquired for use by the owner.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Residential Real Estate
unclassified.description: The cash outflow from the acquisition of residential property intended to generate income for the owner.

unclassified.label: Payments to Acquire Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables
unclassified.description: The cash outflow for the purchase of a retained interest in a receivable securitized via a structured process whereby interests in loans and other receivables are packaged, underwritten, and sold in the form of asset-backed securities.

unclassified.label: Payments to Employees
unclassified.description: Payments of cash to employees, including wages and salaries, during the current period.

unclassified.label: Liability, Pension and Other Postretirement and Postemployment Benefits, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of liability, recognized in statement of financial position, for pension, other postretirement and postemployment benefits, classified as current.

unclassified.label: Percentage of Debt Hedged by Interest Rate Derivatives
unclassified.description: Percentage of an entity's outstanding debt that is designated as a hedged item in cash flow, fair value, or net investment hedge.

unclassified.label: Percentage of Interest-bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Notice of Withdrawal
unclassified.description: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic notice of withdrawal demand deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Percentage of Interest-bearing Domestic Deposits to Deposits, Other Time Deposit
unclassified.description: Percentage of interest-bearing domestic time deposit liabilities other than certificates of deposit liabilities to total deposit liabilities.

unclassified.label: Pledged Assets, Not Separately Reported, Nonsecuritized Investments
Pledged Assets, Not Separately Reported, Real Estate
Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Other, on Statement of Financial Position, at Fair Value
Pledged Assets Separately Reported, Securities Pledged under Letter of Credit Facilities, at Fair Value
Pledged Financial Instruments, Not Separately Reported, Mortgage-Related Securities Held-to-maturity
Policyholder Account Balance
unclassified.description: Amount due to policyholder. Includes, but is not limited to, unpaid policy dividend, retrospective refund, and undistributed earnings on participating business. Excludes future policy benefit and claim expense.

unclassified.label: Preconfirmation, Retained Earnings (Deficit)
Preferred Stock, Additional Series, Liquidation Preference Per Share (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Preferred Stock, Additional Series, Shares, Outstanding (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Preferred Stock, Capital Shares Reserved for Future Issuance
unclassified.description: Aggregate number of nonredeemable preferred shares reserved for future issuance.

unclassified.label: Preferred Stock, Dividend (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Preferred Stock Dividends, Shares
unclassified.description: Number of shares of preferred stock issued as dividends during the period. Excludes stock splits.

unclassified.label: Preferred Units, Contributed Capital
unclassified.description: The amount of capital contributed by the preferred partners.

unclassified.label: Preferred Units, Issued
unclassified.description: The number of preferred units issued.

unclassified.label: Preferred Units, Outstanding
unclassified.description: The number of preferred units outstanding.

unclassified.label: Premiums Earned, Net, Property and Casualty
unclassified.description: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of property and casualty premiums earned.

unclassified.label: Premium Receivable, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: The carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the estimated valuation allowance to reduce gross premiums receivable to net realizable value.

unclassified.label: Premiums Receivable, Gain (Loss) on Sale of Receivables
unclassified.description: The aggregate amount of gains or losses on transfers of premium receivables reported as sales by an insurance entity.

unclassified.label: Premiums Receivable, Gross
unclassified.description: Gross amount, as of the balance sheet date, due the entity from (a) agents and insureds, (b) uncollected premiums and (c) others, before deducting the allowance for doubtful accounts.

unclassified.label: Premiums Receivable, Proceeds from Sale of Receivables
unclassified.description: The amount of proceeds from the transfer of premium receivables reported as sales by an insurance entity.

unclassified.label: Premiums Written, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount of direct and assumed premiums written.

unclassified.label: Premiums Written, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after premiums ceded to other entities and premiums assumed by the entity, of premiums written.

unclassified.label: Prepaid Expense (Deprecated 2009-01-31)
Prepaid Expense and Other Assets, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits in future periods, and amount of other assets that are expected to be realized or consumed after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Prepaid Expense, Current
unclassified.description: Amount of asset related to consideration paid in advance for costs that provide economic benefits within a future period of one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Defined Benefit Plan, Prescription Drug Benefit, Net Periodic Postretirement Benefit Cost, (Increase) Decrease for Subsidy
unclassified.description: Amount of (increase) decrease in net periodic benefit cost from government subsidy for prescription drug benefits.

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profit, Experience Adjustment
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for writeoff from unexpected insurance contract termination, charged against previously capitalized present value of future profit of insurance contract acquired in business combination.

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Year One
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during next fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Present Value of Future Insurance Profits, Expected Amortization, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization for present value of future profits of insurance contract acquired in business combination expected to be recognized during second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Proceeds, Debt Securities, Available-for-sale, Previously Written Off, Recovery
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from recovery of investment in debt security measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale), previously written off.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Collection of Advance to Affiliate
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the collection of money previously advanced to an entity that is related to it but not strictly controlled.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Collection of Other Loans Held-for-sale
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from collection of repayments from borrowers on loans that are held with the intention to resell in the near future; includes loans that are not mortgages.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Collection of Other Receivables
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from the collection of receivables classified as other.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Collection of Retained Interest in Securitized Receivables categorized as Available-for-sale
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from collection on beneficial interest in securitization of loan receivable measured at fair value with change in fair value recognized in other comprehensive income (available-for-sale).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Commissions Received
unclassified.description: Cash received for commissions during the current period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Convertible Debt
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the issuance of a long-term debt instrument which can be exchanged for a specified amount of another security, typically the entity's common stock, at the option of the issuer or the holder.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Deposits from Customers
unclassified.description: Cash received from customers for deposits on goods or services during the period; excludes deposits with other institutions and time deposits, which pertain to financial services entities.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Commercial Paper
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from borrowing by issuing commercial paper.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Issuance of Financial Services Obligations
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from a long-term borrowing issued by the entity involved in financial services operations.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Long-term Capital Lease Obligations
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from proceeds received from lessor related to a long-term capital lease obligation.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Maturities, Prepayments and Calls of Long-term Investments
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from maturities, prepayments, calls and collections of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Partnership Contribution
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the capital received in cash from a partner in a partnership during the period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Collection of (Payments to Fund) Long-term Loans to Related Parties
unclassified.description: The cash inflow or outflow associated with long-term loans for related parties where one party can exercise control or significant influence over another party, including affiliates, owners or officers and their immediate families, pension trusts, and so forth. Alternate caption: Proceeds from (Payments for) Advances to Affiliates.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Real Estate and Real Estate Joint Ventures
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the sale of real estate held-for-investment and real estate joint ventures.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Debt, Maturing in More than Three Months
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from a borrowing net of the cash outflow from repayment of a borrowing having initial term of repayment of more than three months. Includes long-term debt and short-term debt.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from (Repayments of) Restricted Cash, Financing Activities
Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Other Receivables
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale and collection of receivables classified as other.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale and Collection of Receivables
unclassified.description: The cash inflow associated with the proceeds from sale and collection of receivables during the period.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Land Held-for-investment
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from the sale of land held for investment; excludes sales of land held as inventory or productive use.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Sale of Long-term Investments
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from sales of all investments, including securities and other assets, having ready marketability and intended by management to be liquidated, if necessary, beyond the current operating cycle.

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Secured Notes Payable
unclassified.description: The cash inflow from borrowings supported by a written promise to pay an obligation that is collateralized (backed by pledge, mortgage or other lien in the entity's assets).

unclassified.label: Proceeds from Time Deposits Accepted
unclassified.description: Cash received from customers who deposit money in checking and similar accounts at a financial institution.

unclassified.label: Product Liability Contingency, Loss Exposure Not Accrued, High Estimate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Product Liability Contingency, Loss Exposure Not Accrued, Low Estimate (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Product Liability Contingency, Recovery from Third Party of Environmental Remediation Cost (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Production Costs, Period Cost
unclassified.description: Amount of capitalized production cost incurred during period for oil- and gas-producing activities. Includes cost incurred to operate and maintain well and related equipment and facility.

unclassified.label: Property Management Fee Revenue
unclassified.description: The amount of revenue derived from managing real estate properties.

unclassified.label: PropertyPlantAndEquipmentExcludingLessorAssetUnderOperatingLeaseAccumulatedDepreciation
unclassified.description: Amount, excluding lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease, of accumulated amortization, depreciation, depletion for physical asset used in normal conduct of business to create and distribute product and service.

unclassified.label: PropertyPlantAndEquipmentExcludingLessorAssetUnderOperatingLeaseBeforeAccumulatedDepreciation
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation and excluding lessor's underlying asset for which right to use has been conveyed to lessee under operating lease, of physical asset used in normal conduct of business to create and distribute product and service.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Owned, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation, of long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned. Excludes right-of-use asset from finance lease for flight asset.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Owned, Net
unclassified.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation, of long-lived, depreciable flight asset owned. Excludes right-of-use asset from finance lease for flight asset.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Salvage Value, Percentage
unclassified.description: Stated as a percentage, the estimated or actual value of the asset at the end of its useful life or when it is no longer serviceable (cannot be used for its original purpose) divided by its [historical] capitalized cost.

unclassified.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Useful Life, Average (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Provision for Loss on Contracts
unclassified.description: Cumulative provision for contract losses not offset against related costs accumulated on the balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Approved Equity Capital Structure, Percentage
unclassified.description: Percentage of public utility's approved equity to capital, including debt and equity.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amount of Acquisition Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount of acquisition adjustments included in property, plant and equipment (PPE) for utilities.

unclassified.label: Public Utilities, Requested Rate Increase (Decrease), Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of public utility's requested rate increase (decrease) with regulatory agency.

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Five
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in fifth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four and Five
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in fourth and fifth fiscal years following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Four
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in fourth fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two and Three
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in second and third fiscal years following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Two
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in second fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Purchase Obligation, to be Paid, Year Three
unclassified.description: Amount of purchase arrangement to be paid in third fiscal year following current fiscal year. Includes, but is not limited to, recorded and unrecorded purchase obligations, long-term purchase commitment, and short-term purchase commitment. Excludes interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported from current statement of financial position date (rolling approach).

unclassified.label: Purchase Options, Land
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of an option or options to acquire real property.

unclassified.label: Qualitative and Quantitative Information, Transferor's Continuing Involvement, Arrangements of Financial Support, Amount
unclassified.description: The transferor's maximum amount of exposure to loss as a result of its continuing involvement in transferred financial assets.

unclassified.label: Ratio of Indebtedness to Net Capital
unclassified.description: Indebtedness divided by net capital.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Assets Held for Development and Sale
unclassified.description: For banks, the total amount of real estate assets held for development and sale.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule III, Real Estate, Federal Income Tax Basis
Real Estate Held for Development and Sale
unclassified.description: For banks, amount of real estate assets held for development or sale by the consolidated entity.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Held for Development and Sale, Net
unclassified.description: For banks, amount of real estate assets held for development or sale, net of associated liabilities.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Inventory, Capitalized Interest Costs Incurred
unclassified.description: The amount of interest capitalized to an operative builder's inventory during the period.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Inventory, Capitalized Interest Costs, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in capitalized interest costs in real estate inventory.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Investment Partnership Revenue
unclassified.description: Amount of revenue recognized from investments in real estate partnerships and variable interest entities.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Investment Property, Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: The cumulative amount of depreciation for real estate property held for investment purposes.

unclassified.label: Real Estate Owned, Accumulated Depreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation for real estate owned (REO).

unclassified.label: Real Estate Owned, Amount of Loss at Acquisition (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Real Estate Owned, Amount of Loss at Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of reduction to fair value of loan related to real estate owned (REO) at time of acquisition.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-28, Real Estate Companies, Investment in Real Estate, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) before accumulated depreciation of real estate investments for entities with a substantial portion of business acquiring and holding investment real estate.

unclassified.label: RealizedAndUnrealizedGainLossInvestmentAndDerivativeOperatingTaxExpenseBenefit
unclassified.description: Amount of income tax expense (benefit) from realized and unrealized gain (loss) on investment and derivative, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

unclassified.label: RealizedGainLossInvestmentAndDerivativeOperatingAfterTax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of realized gain (loss) on investment and derivative, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

unclassified.label: Realized Gain (Loss) on Marketable Securities and Cost Method Investments, Excluding Other than Temporary Impairments, and Other Investments (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Realized Gain (Loss) on Marketable Securities, Cost Method Investments, and Other Investments
Receivable with Imputed Interest, Net Amount
unclassified.description: The receivable or note face amount less the unamortized discount or premium.

unclassified.label: Receivable with Imputed Interest, Premium
unclassified.description: Disclosure of the unamortized amount of the premium on the note or receivable which is added to the face amount of the receivable or loan. The discount or premium is defined as the difference between the present value and the face amount.

unclassified.label: Receivables from Customers
unclassified.description: Amount due from customers for fees and charges arising from transactions related to the entity's brokerage activities and operations.

unclassified.label: Accounts and Financing Receivables, Held-for-Sale
unclassified.description: Amount, before valuation allowance, of accounts and financing receivables held for sale.

unclassified.label: Receivables Held-for-sale, Net Amount (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Receivables, Net, Current
unclassified.description: The total amount due to the entity within one year of the balance sheet date (or one operating cycle, if longer) from outside sources, including trade accounts receivable, notes and loans receivable, as well as any other types of receivables, net of allowances established for the purpose of reducing such receivables to an amount that approximates their net realizable value.

unclassified.label: Receivables with Imputed Interest, Amortization Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of amortization of the discount or premium on the note or receivable which was the result of the determination of present value in cash or noncash transactions, recognized in the statement of operations for the period.

unclassified.label: Reclamation and Mine Shutdown Provision
unclassified.description: Adjustment of the mine reclamation or mine shutdown liability account that is made when estimates of future costs are changed.

unclassified.label: Recorded Unconditional Purchase Obligation, Nonfinancial Assets Pledged as Security, Value
unclassified.description: The value of assets other than financial instruments pledged to provide security to a suppler under a recorded unconditional purchase obligation arrangement.

unclassified.label: Recovery of Direct Costs
unclassified.description: Return of or reimbursements received in relation to direct costs and expenses previously paid or incurred.

unclassified.label: Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock, Redemption Price Per Share (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock, Shares Outstanding (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Redeemable Convertible Preferred Stock, Value, Excluding Additional Paid in Capital (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Carrying Amount
unclassified.description: As of the reporting date, the aggregate carrying amount of all noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. This item includes noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) regardless of the type of equity interest (common, preferred, other) including all potential organizational (legal) forms of the investee entity.

unclassified.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Fair Value
unclassified.description: The aggregate fair value as of the reporting date of all noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. This item includes noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) regardless of the type of equity interest (common, preferred, other) including all potential organizational (legal) forms of the investee entity.

unclassified.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Preferred, Carrying Amount
unclassified.description: As of the reporting date, the carrying amount of noncontrolling interests which are redeemable by the (parent) entity (1) at a fixed or determinable price on a fixed or determinable date, (2) at the option of the holder of the noncontrolling interest, or (3) upon occurrence of an event that is not solely within the control of the (parent) entity. The noncontrolling interest holder's ownership (or holders' ownership) may be in the form of preferred shares (regardless of class), preferred partnership units (regardless of class), preferential membership interests, or any other form of preferred equity regardless of investee entity legal form.

unclassified.label: Redeemable Noncontrolling Interest, Equity, Redemption Value
unclassified.description: Redemption value, as if currently redeemable, of redeemable noncontrolling interest classified as temporary equity and the election has been made to accrete changes in redemption value to the earliest redemption date.

unclassified.label: Redeemable Preferred Stock, Redemption Price Per Share (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Redeemable Preferred Stock, Shares Issued (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Redeemable Preferred Stock, Shares Outstanding (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Redeemable Preferred Stock, Value, Excluding Additional Paid in Capital (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Reductions in Other Assets, Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of significant reductions in the period of other assets (current, noncurrent, or unclassified).

unclassified.label: Registration Payment Arrangement, Maximum Potential Consideration
unclassified.description: Describes the maximum potential amount of consideration, undiscounted, that could be transferred under the registration payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Regulatory Assets
unclassified.description: The amount for the individual regulatory asset as itemized in a table of regulatory assets as of the end of the period.

unclassified.label: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Assumed and Ceded
unclassified.description: Amount of recovery (expense) related to provision for policy benefits and costs incurred for policies assumed and ceded.

unclassified.label: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Assumed
unclassified.description: Amount of policy benefits and costs incurred for policies assumed.

unclassified.label: Policyholder Benefits and Claims Incurred, Ceded
unclassified.description: Amount of reduction of provision for policy benefits and costs incurred for policies ceded.

unclassified.label: Reinsurance Recoverables, Incurred but Not Reported Claims
unclassified.description: Estimated amount after valuation allowance of reinsurance recoverables, due from reinsurers for incurred claims not yet reported, and claims settlement expenses.

unclassified.label: Reinsurance Recoverable, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on reinsurance recoverable.

unclassified.label: Reinsurance Recoverable for Paid and Unpaid Claims and Claims Adjustments
unclassified.description: Amount, after valuation allowance, recoverable under reinsurance contracts. Examples include, but are not limited to, settled and unsettled claims, incurred but not reported losses, loss adjustment expense, policy benefits and policy reserves. Excludes premiums paid under reinsurance contracts.

unclassified.label: Reinsurance Recoverables on Paid Losses, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before valuation allowance of reinsurance recoverables on paid losses.

unclassified.label: Reinsurance Recoverables on Unpaid Losses (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Reinsurance Recoverables on Unpaid Losses, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount before valuation allowance of reinsurance recoverables for losses reported to the ceding insurer but not yet paid, and for amounts expected based upon statistical projections and other measures of incurred losses and loss settlement expenses which have not yet been reported to the ceding insurer.

unclassified.label: Reinsurance Retention Policy, Amount Retained
Reinsurance Retention Policy, Excess Retention, Amount Reinsured
Related Party Costs
Related Party Transaction, Other Revenues from Transactions with Related Party
Related Party Transaction, Selling, General and Administrative Expenses from Transactions with Related Party
Repayments of Accounts Receivable Securitization
unclassified.description: Repayments of securitizations of receivables treated as collateralized borrowings, which are classified as financing transactions.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Commercial Paper
unclassified.description: The cash outflow due to repaying amounts borrowed by issuing commercial paper.

unclassified.label: Repayments of Financial Services Obligations (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Reporting Unit, Amount of Fair Value in Excess of Carrying Amount
unclassified.description: Amount of fair value of reporting unit in excess of carrying amount.

unclassified.label: Reporting Unit, Zero or Negative Carrying Amount, Amount of Allocated Goodwill
unclassified.description: Amount of goodwill allocated to reporting unit with zero or negative amount of net assets.

unclassified.label: Repurchase Agreement Counterparty, Weighted Average Maturity of Agreements (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Resale Agreement Counterparty, Weighted Average Maturity of Agreements (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Resale Agreements, Interest Income Amount (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Research and Development Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of expense for research and development. Includes, but is not limited to, cost for computer software product to be sold, leased, or otherwise marketed and writeoff of research and development assets acquired in transaction other than business combination or joint venture formation or both. Excludes write-down of intangible asset acquired in business combination or from joint venture formation or both, used in research and development activity.

unclassified.label: Restricted Cash Equivalents
unclassified.description: Amount of cash equivalent restricted as to withdrawal or usage. Cash equivalent includes, but is not limited to, short-term, highly liquid investment that is both readily convertible to known amount of cash and so near maturity that it presents insignificant risk of change in value because of change in interest rate.

unclassified.label: Restricted Stock Award, Forfeitures, Dividends
unclassified.description: The value of dividends forfeited related to restricted stock awards forfeited.

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Cost Incurred to Date (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Restructuring and Related Cost, Cost Incurred to Date
unclassified.description: Amount of costs incurred to date for the specified restructuring cost.

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Expected Cost Remaining (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Restructuring and Related Cost, Expected Cost Remaining
unclassified.description: Amount of expected cost remaining for the specified restructuring cost.

unclassified.label: Restructuring and Related Cost, Incurred Cost
unclassified.description: Discloses the amount charged against the accrued restructuring reserves, or earnings if not previously accrued, during the period for the specified type of restructuring cost.

unclassified.label: Restructuring Reserve, Settled Without Cash (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Restructuring Reserve, Settled without Cash (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Restructuring Reserve, Settled without Cash
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in the reserve for full or partial settlement through consideration other than cash.

unclassified.label: Restructuring Reserve, Foreign Currency Translation Gain (Loss)
unclassified.description: Amount of foreign currency translation gain (loss) which decreases (increases) the restructuring reserve.

unclassified.label: Restructuring, Settlement and Impairment Provisions
unclassified.description: Amount of restructuring charges, remediation cost, and asset impairment loss.

unclassified.label: Results of Operations, Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, and Valuation Provisions
unclassified.description: Amount of depreciation, depletion, amortization, and valuation provision charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Results of Operations, Impairment of Oil and Gas Properties
unclassified.description: Amount of impairment for oil and gas properties charged to expense in oil- and gas-producing activities.

unclassified.label: Retail Land Sales, Improvement Revenue, Prior Sales (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Retainage Deposit
unclassified.description: The amount of assets, typically cash, provided to suppliers of goods in advance of receipt and acceptance, or services (such as research facilities, lawyers or consultants), which is held by such parties until the entity either effects full payment (including applying the retainer) or obtains release from liability.

unclassified.label: Retained Earnings, Correction of Error, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Retained Earnings, Cumulative Effect of Change in Accounting Principle, before Tax (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Retained Earnings, Cumulative Effect of Change in Accounting Principle, Net of Tax (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Retained Earnings, Undistributed Earnings from Equity Method Investees
unclassified.description: Amount of consolidated retained earnings that represent undistributed (not yet received) earnings from 50 percent or less owned persons accounted for by the equity method (equity method investees).

unclassified.label: Revenue from Administrative Services (Deprecated 2013-01-31)

Sale Leaseback Transaction, Rent Expense

unclassified.label: Sale of Stock, Consideration Received Per Transaction

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Interest Income, Unguaranteed Residual Asset

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Net Investment in Lease, Allowance for Credit Loss

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Residual Value of Leased Asset
unclassified.description: Amount of residual asset covered by residual value guarantee under sales-type lease. Excludes guarantee considered to be lease payments for lessor.

unclassified.label: Sales-type Lease, Variable Lease Income
unclassified.description: Amount of sales-type lease income from variable lease payments paid and payable to lessor, excluding amount included in measurement of lease receivable.

unclassified.label: Schedule of Insured Financial Obligations with Credit Deterioration, Insured Contractual Payments Outstanding
unclassified.description: This element represents the amount of insured contractual payments outstanding on the underlying insured obligations for financial guarantee insurance contracts presented in the context of each surveillance grouping or category used by management to monitor and track potential deterioration in the credit worthiness of the insured party's ability to meet its financial obligations related to the contracts underlying financial guarantee insurance contracts the entity has issued.

unclassified.label: Secured Debt, Other
unclassified.description: Amount of collateralized debt obligations classified as other.

unclassified.label: SecuritiesBorrowedAllowanceForCreditLossRecovery
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in allowance for credit loss on security borrowed, from recovery.

unclassified.label: Securities Borrowed, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement Deduction
unclassified.description: Amount of securities borrowed from entities in exchange for collateral, not subject to a master netting arrangement, deducted from securities borrowed.

unclassified.label: Securities Loaned, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement
unclassified.description: Amount of securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral, not subject to a master netting arrangement.

unclassified.label: Securities Loaned, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement Deduction
unclassified.description: Amount of securities loaned to entities in exchange for collateral, not subject to a master netting arrangement, deducted from securities loaned.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Allowance for Credit Loss
unclassified.description: Amount of allowance for credit loss on security purchased under agreement to resell.

unclassified.label: SecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToResellDecrease
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease from sale of security purchased under agreement to resell.

unclassified.label: Securities Purchased under Agreements to Resell, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement Deduction
unclassified.description: Amount of funds outstanding loaned in the form of a security resale agreement between the entity and another party for the purchase and resale of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price, not subject to a master netting arrangement, deducted from securities purchased under agreements to resell.

unclassified.label: Securities Received as Collateral, Amount Foreclosed
unclassified.description: The fair value of collateral received that was taken through foreclosure due to default by the original transferor in lieu of collection of the secured receivable.

unclassified.label: Securities Reserve Deposit Required and Made
unclassified.description: Securities deposited in a special reserve account for the exclusive benefit of customers pursuant to SEC Regulations.

unclassified.label: Securities Sold under Agreements to Repurchase, Not Subject to Master Netting Arrangement Deduction
unclassified.description: Amount of funds outstanding borrowed in the form of a security repurchase agreement between the entity and another party for the sale and repurchase of identical or substantially the same securities at a date certain for a specified price, not subject to a master netting arrangement, deducted from securities sold under agreements to repurchase.

unclassified.label: Assets that Continue to be Recognized, Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement Assets and any Other Financial Assets Managed Together, Average Balance During Period (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Assets that Continue to be Recognized, Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement Assets and any Other Financial Assets Managed Together, Delinquent Amount at End of Period
unclassified.description: Amount of transferred financial asset that continues to be recognized and other financial asset managed together with transferred financial asset, considered to be delinquent.

unclassified.label: Assets that Continue to be Recognized, Securitized or Asset-backed Financing Arrangement Assets and any Other Financial Assets Managed Together, Net Credit Losses During Period (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Security Owned Not Readily Marketable, Fair Value
unclassified.description: Value of the not readily marketable security or category which has been determined by management based upon fair value methods, including pricing of similar securities and valuation techniques and is included in the schedule of financial condition or the balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Segment Reporting, Entity Consolidated Assets (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Segment Reporting Information, Depreciation, Depletion, and Amortization Expense (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Segment Reporting Information, Equity in Net Income of Equity Method Investees of Segment (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Segment Reporting Information, Expenditures for Additions to Long-Lived Assets (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Segment Reporting Information, Extraordinary Items (Deprecated 2011-01-31)

Segment Reporting Information, Interest Income (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Segment Reporting Information, Operating Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Segment Reporting, Segment Assets (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Segment Reporting, Segment Operating Profit (Loss) (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Selling Expense
unclassified.description: Expenses recognized in the period that are directly related to the selling and distribution of products or services.

unclassified.label: Senior Notes, Current
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the portion of long-term notes having the highest claim on the assets of the issuer in case of bankruptcy or liquidation, due within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer. Senior note holders are paid off in full before any payments are made to debt holders having a lesser priority of repayment.

unclassified.label: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of 10 Percent Adverse Change in Expected Credit Losses
unclassified.description: The hypothetical financial impact of a 10 percent adverse change of the expected credit losses, including expected static pool losses, on the fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities) as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of 20 Percent Adverse Change in Expected Credit Losses
unclassified.description: The hypothetical financial impact of a 20 percent adverse change of the expected credit, including expected static pool losses, on the fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities) as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Sensitivity Analysis of Fair Value, Transferor's Interests in Transferred Financial Assets, Impact of Other than 10 or 20 Percent Adverse Change in Discount Rate
unclassified.description: The hypothetical financial impact of a specified adverse percentage change in discount rate on the fair value of transferor's interests in transferred financial assets (including any servicing assets or servicing liabilities) as of the balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: SeparateAccountLiabilityBenefitPayment
unclassified.description: Amount of cash outflow to separate account policyholder from benefit payment.

unclassified.label: SeparateAccountLiabilityIncreaseDecreaseFromInvestedPerformance
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in separate account liability from performance of investment.

unclassified.label: SeparateAccountLiabilityIncreaseDecreaseFromOtherChange
unclassified.description: Amount increase (decrease) in separate account liability from change, classified as other.

unclassified.label: SeparateAccountLiabilityPolicyCharge
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in separate account liability from policy charge.

unclassified.label: Separate Account, Liability, Premium and Deposit
unclassified.description: Amount of cash inflow to separate account liability from premium and deposit from cash received.

unclassified.label: Separate Account, Liability, Surrender and Withdrawal
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in separate account liability from contract redemption and withdrawal of funds.

unclassified.label: Separate Accounts, Asset (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Servicing Asset, Measurement Input
unclassified.description: Value of input used to measure servicing asset.

unclassified.label: Servicing Liability at Amortized Cost, Amortization
unclassified.description: Amount of amortization of contract to service financial assets under which estimated future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer for performing the servicing.

unclassified.label: Servicing Liability at Amortized Cost, Other Increase (Decrease) in Obligation
unclassified.description: Amount of other increase (decrease) to contract to service financial assets under which estimated future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer for performing the servicing.

unclassified.label: Servicing Liability at Amortized Cost, Additions
unclassified.description: Amount of additions from purchases, assumption or transfer to contract to service financial assets under which estimated future revenues from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenue are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer for performing the servicing.

unclassified.label: Servicing Liability at Amortized Cost, Disposals
unclassified.description: Amount conveyed to unrelated parties of contract to service financial assets under which estimated future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer for performing the servicing.

unclassified.label: Servicing Liability at Fair Value, Additions
unclassified.description: The value of new servicing liabilities, that are subsequently measured at fair value, acquired or created during the current period through assumptions of servicing obligations and servicing obligations that result from transfers of financial assets.

unclassified.label: Servicing Liability at Fair Value, Amount
unclassified.description: Fair value of a liability representing servicing arrangements under which the estimated future revenue from contractually specified servicing fees, late charges, and other ancillary revenues are not expected to adequately compensate the servicer.

unclassified.label: Settlement Liabilities, Current
unclassified.description: Amounts payable for money transfers, money orders, and consumer payment service arrangements. Settlement liabilities include amounts payable to intermediaries for global payment transfers.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Converted in Period (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Equity Instruments Other than Options, Weighted Average Grant Date Fair Value, Period Increase (Decrease) (Deprecated 2013-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Term, Maximum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Fair Value Assumptions, Expected Term, Minimum (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Non-Option Equity Instruments, Expirations
unclassified.description: Number of shares under non-option equity instrument agreements for which rights to exercise lapsed.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Other Share Increase (Decrease) in Period, Weighted Average Exercise Price (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Share-based Compensation Arrangement by Share-based Payment Award, Options, Outstanding, Period Increase (Decrease), Weighted Average Exercise Price

unclassified.label: Share-based Payment Arrangement, Plan Modification, Incremental Cost
unclassified.description: An excess of the fair value of the modified award over the fair value of the award immediately before the modification.

unclassified.label: Share-based Compensation, Shares Authorized under Stock Option Plans, Exercise Price Range, Exercisable Options, Weighted Average Exercise Price (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Compensation, Shares Authorized under Stock Option Plans, Exercise Price Range, Outstanding Options, Weighted Average Exercise Price, Beginning Balance (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Compensation, Shares Authorized under Stock Option Plans, Exercise Price Range, Outstanding Options, Weighted Average Remaining Contractual Term (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Share-based Goods and Nonemployee Services Transaction, Stockholders' Equity
unclassified.description: The amount by which stockholders' equity was increased by the transaction in which equity securities were issued to pay for goods or nonemployee services.

unclassified.label: ShareRepurchaseProgramExciseTaxPayable

unclassified.label: Short-term Debt, Refinanced, Amount

unclassified.label: Short-term Non-bank Loans and Notes Payable
unclassified.description: Amount of borrowings from a creditor other than a bank with a maturity within one year or operating cycle, if longer.

unclassified.label: Short-duration Insurance Contracts, Historical Claims Duration, Year Nine
unclassified.description: Percentage of average annual payout, after reinsurance, in the ninth year after a claim is incurred, beginning with the earliest accident year disclosed for short-duration insurance contracts.

unclassified.description: Percentage of average annual payout, after reinsurance, in the first year after a claim is incurred, beginning with the earliest accident year disclosed for short-duration insurance contracts.

unclassified.description: Percentage of average annual payout, after reinsurance, in the seventh year after a claim is incurred, beginning with the earliest accident year disclosed for short-duration insurance contracts.

unclassified.description: Percentage of average annual payout, after reinsurance, in the sixth year after a claim is incurred, beginning with the earliest accident year disclosed for short-duration insurance contracts.

unclassified.label: Short-duration Insurance Contracts, Historical Claims Duration, Year Ten
unclassified.description: Percentage of average annual payout, after reinsurance, in the tenth year after a claim is incurred, beginning with the earliest accident year disclosed for short-duration insurance contracts.

unclassified.label: Short-duration Insurance Contracts, Historical Claims Duration, Year Three
unclassified.description: Percentage of average annual payout, after reinsurance, in the third year after a claim is incurred, beginning with the earliest accident year disclosed for short-duration insurance contracts.

unclassified.label: Short-duration Insurance Contracts, Historical Claims Duration, Year Two

unclassified.description: Amount of liability for unallocated claim adjustment expense for short-duration insurance contracts.

Statutory Accounting Practices, Portion of Excess Retained Earnings Not Taxed
unclassified.description: The amount of retained earnings as of the balance sheet date in excess of statutory unassigned surplus on which no income tax provisions have been made.

unclassified.label: Statutory Accounting Practices, Statutory to GAAP, Amount of Reconciling Item
unclassified.description: The amount of the specified reconciling item as of the balance sheet date reconciling the financial statements which use generally accepted accounting principles and the statutory financial statements which use statutory accounting practices prescribed or permitted by the state or country in which the filing is made.

unclassified.label: Statutory Capital and Surplus Applying National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Practices
unclassified.description: Amount of statutory capital and surplus computed using statutory accounting practices prescribed by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners.

Development Stage Entities, Stock Issued, Value, Issued for Cash (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
Development Stage Entities, Stock Issued, Value, Issued for Noncash Consideration (Deprecated 2015-01-31)
StockOptionDownRoundFeatureDecreaseInNetIncomeLossToCommonShareholderAmount
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in net income available to common shareholder for down round feature triggered for stock option classified as equity. Excludes share-based payment arrangement.

unclassified.label: Stock Option, Exercise Price, Increase
unclassified.description: Per share increase in exercise price of option. Excludes change due to standard antidilution provision and option granted under share-based payment arrangement.

Subsidiary or Equity Method Investee, Cumulative Proceeds Received on All Transactions
unclassified.description: Cumulative amount of cash and other consideration received by subsidiary or equity method investee in exchange for shares or stock issued or sold. Include amounts of cash received, fair value of non-cash assets received, fair value of liabilities assumed, and fair value of any other forms of consideration.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-18, Supplemental Information, Property-Casualty Insurance Underwriters, Reserve for Unpaid Claim and Claim Adjustment Expense
unclassified.description: Amount of reserve, policy claim payable and loss expense incurred by property-casualty insurance underwriter.

unclassified.label: Supplemental Unemployment Benefits
unclassified.description: Liability for benefits due terminated employees.

unclassified.label: Tax Basis of Investments, Gross, Unrealized Appreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative increase in investment from unrealized gain when value exceeds cost for federal income tax purpose.

unclassified.label: Tax Basis of Investments, Gross, Unrealized Depreciation
unclassified.description: Amount of cumulative decrease in investment from unrealized loss when cost for federal income tax purpose exceeds value.

Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Change in Tax Rate, Existing Income Tax Expense (Benefit) (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Existing Undistributed Accumulated Earnings of Foreign Subsidiary (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Incomplete Accounting, Provisional Undistributed Accumulated Earnings of Foreign Subsidiary (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, Transition Tax for Accumulated Foreign Earnings, Income Tax Expense
Temporary Equity, Carrying Amount, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Change in the value of each type or class of stock classified as temporary equity during the period. The redemption requirement does not constitute an unconditional obligation that will be settled in a variable number of shares constituting a monetary value predominantly indexed to (a) a fixed monetary amount known at inception, (b) an amount inversely correlated with the residual value of the entity, or (c) an amount determined by reference to something other than the fair value of issuer's stock. Does not include mandatorily redeemable stock. The exception is if redemption is required upon liquidation or termination of the reporting entity.

unclassified.label: Temporary Equity, Liquidation Preference
unclassified.description: The aggregate liquidation preference (or restrictions) of stock classified as temporary equity that has a preference in involuntary liquidation considerably in excess of the par or stated value of the shares. The liquidation preference is the difference between the preference in liquidation and the par or stated values of the share. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. If convertible, the issuer does not control the actions or events necessary to issue the maximum number of shares that could be required to be delivered under the conversion option if the holder exercises the option to convert the stock to another class of equity. If the security is a warrant or a rights issue, the warrant or rights issue is considered to be temporary equity if the issuer cannot demonstrate that it would be able to deliver upon the exercise of the option by the holder in all cases. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Temporary Equity, Net Income
unclassified.description: The portion of net income or loss attributable to temporary equity interest.

unclassified.label: Temporary Equity, Other Changes
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in temporary equity from changes classified as other.

unclassified.label: Temporary Equity, Redemption Value (Deprecated 2014-01-31)
Temporary Equity, Par Value
unclassified.description: Carrying amount of the par value of temporary equity outstanding. Temporary equity is a security with redemption features that are outside the control of the issuer, is not classified as an asset or liability in conformity with GAAP, and is not mandatorily redeemable. Includes any type of security that is redeemable at a fixed or determinable price or on a fixed or determinable date or dates, is redeemable at the option of the holder, or has conditions for redemption which are not solely within the control of the issuer. Includes stock with put option held by ESOP and stock redeemable by holder only in the event of a change in control of the issuer.

unclassified.label: Tenant Improvements
unclassified.description: Carrying amount as of the balance sheet date of improvements having a life longer than one year that were made for the benefit of one or more tenants.

unclassified.label: Time Deposit Maturities, after Next Rolling Twelve Months
unclassified.description: Amount of time deposits maturing after the next rolling twelve months following the latest balance sheet. Time deposits include, but are not limited to, certificates of deposits. For interim and annual periods when interim periods are reported on a rolling approach, from latest balance sheet date.

unclassified.label: Accounts Receivable, Held-for-Sale, Not Part of Disposal Group, after Valuation Allowance
unclassified.description: Amount, after valuation allowance, of accounts receivable held for sale and not part of disposal group.

unclassified.label: Trading Securities, Other (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Trading Securities, Short-term Investments, Amortized Cost (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
Transfer of Financial Assets Accounted for as Sales, Fair Value of Derecognized Assets
unclassified.description: Fair value of derecognized financial assets from transactions which comprise an initial transfer and an agreement entered into in contemplation of the initial transfer resulting in retention of substantially all of the exposure to the economic return throughout the term of the transaction.

unclassified.label: Translation Adjustment Functional to Reporting Currency, Net of Tax, Period Increase (Decrease)
unclassified.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in cumulative translation adjustment, after tax, from translating foreign currency financial statements into the reporting currency.

unclassified.label: Treasury Stock Reissued at Lower than Repurchase Price
unclassified.description: In cases when treasury stock is reissued at a price lower than the cost to repurchase, the excess difference between the selling price and cost to repurchase is charged against retained earnings (assuming that all APIC arising from treasury stock transactions has first been exhausted).

unclassified.label: Troubled Debt Restructuring, Debtor, Current Period, Gain (Loss) on Restructuring, Net of Tax
unclassified.description: For a debtor, the aggregate gain (loss) recognized on the restructuring of payables, after the impact of income tax expense or benefit, arising from the difference between the book value of the debt before the restructuring and the fair value of the payments on the debt after restructuring is complete.

unclassified.label: Trustee Fees
unclassified.description: Fees charged annually for the professional services of a trustee, usually quoted as a percentage of the funds being managed. The fee for appointing an offshore Trustee is included in the trust price.

unclassified.label: Unamortized Loan Commitment and Origination Fees and Unamortized Discounts or Premiums, Other (Deprecated 2016-01-31)
Unbilled Contracts Receivable
unclassified.description: Unbilled amounts due for services rendered or to be rendered, actions taken or to be taken, or a promise to refrain from taking certain actions in accordance with the terms of a legally binding agreement between the entity and, at a minimum, one other party. An example would be amounts associated with contracts or programs where the recognized revenue for performance thereunder exceeds the amounts billed under the terms thereof as of the date of the balance sheet.

unclassified.label: Undistributed Discontinued Operation Earnings (Loss), Allocation to Participating Securities, Basic
unclassified.description: Amount of undistributed earnings (loss) from discontinued operations allocated to participating securities for basic earnings (loss) per share or per unit calculation under two-class method.

unclassified.label: UnrealizedGainLossInvestmentAndDerivativeOperatingAfterTax
unclassified.description: Amount, after tax, of unrealized gain (loss) from investment and derivative, classified as operating. Investment includes, but is not limited to, debt and equity securities, security sold short, real estate, and commodity.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Derivatives and Commodity Contracts
unclassified.description: The net change in the difference between the fair value and the carrying value, or in the comparative fair values, of open derivatives, commodity, or energy contracts, held at each balance sheet date, that was included in earnings for the period.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Foreign Currency Derivatives, Net, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of net unrealized gain (loss) related to the change in fair value of foreign currency exchange rate derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments. Recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Hybrid Instrument, Net
unclassified.description: Amount of the unrealized gain (loss) in earnings for the period from the increase (decrease) in fair value on hybrid instruments measured at fair value.

unclassified.label: Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Interest Rate Cash Flow Hedges, Pretax, Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income (Loss) (Deprecated 2011-01-31)
Unrealized Gain (Loss) on Price Risk Cash Flow Derivatives, before Tax

unclassified.label: Unrealized Loss on Price Risk Cash Flow Derivatives, before Tax
unclassified.description: Amount of unrealized loss related to the decrease in fair value of price risk derivatives designated as cash flow hedging instruments recorded in accumulated other comprehensive income in the period, before taxes, to the extent that the cash flow hedge is determined to be effective.

unclassified.label: Unrecognized Tax Benefits, Decrease Resulting from Acquisition
unclassified.description: Amount of decrease in unrecognized tax benefits resulting from acquisitions.

unclassified.label: Unsecured Long-term Debt, Noncurrent
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of uncollateralized debt obligation (with maturities initially due after one year or beyond the operating cycle if longer), excluding current portion.

unclassified.label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Loss, Gross
unclassified.description: Amount, before deduction of insurance proceeds, of loss recognized in the income statement for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

unclassified.label: Unusual or Infrequent Item, or Both, Net of Insurance Proceeds
unclassified.description: Amount, after deduction of insurance proceeds, of loss recognized in the income statement for an event or transaction that is unusual in nature or infrequent in occurrence, or both.

unclassified.label: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Disposals
unclassified.description: Reduction in valuation allowance of servicing assets based on disposal of the related asset.

unclassified.label: Valuation Allowance for Impairment of Recognized Servicing Assets, Sales
unclassified.description: Reduction in valuation allowance of servicing assets based on sale of the related asset.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Additions, Charge to Other Account
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves from charge to accounts other than cost and expense.

unclassified.label: SEC Schedule, 12-09, Valuation Allowances and Reserves, Business Acquired
unclassified.description: Amount of increase in valuation and qualifying accounts and reserves from business combination.

Variable Interest Entity, Consolidated, Liabilities, No Recourse (Deprecated 2020-01-31)
Variable Interest Entity, Financial or Other Support, Amount
unclassified.description: The amount of financial or other support the reporting entity has provided (explicitly or implicitly) to the Variable Interest Entity (VIE) that it was not previously contractually required to provide or that the reporting entity intends to provide, including, for example, situations in which the reporting entity assisted the VIE in obtaining another type of support.

unclassified.label: Variable Interest Entity, Unavailability of Information, Number of Entities
unclassified.description: Number of Variable Interest Entities (VIE) or potential VIEs for which the necessary information is unable to be obtained to: (1) determine whether the legal entity is a VIE, (2) determine whether it (the reporting entity) is the VIE's primary beneficiary, or (3) perform the accounting required to consolidate the VIE for which it is determined that it (the reporting entity) is the primary beneficiary.

unclassified.label: VariationMarginPayableDerivative
unclassified.description: Amount of payable for negative price movement on derivative.

unclassified.label: VariationMarginReceivableDerivative
unclassified.description: Amount of receivable from positive price movement on derivative.

unclassified.label: Venture Capital Gain (Loss), Net
unclassified.description: Amount of gain (loss) on venture capital activities. Includes venture capital revenue, fair value adjustments, interest and dividends, investment gain (loss) and fee or other income from venture capital activities.

unclassified.label: Warehouse Agreement Borrowings
unclassified.description: Carrying value as of the balance sheet date of the outstanding short-term borrowings under a revolving line of credit used by mortgage bankers to finance the origination or purchase of loans.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Interest Rate of Time Deposits, $100,000 or More, after 12 Months
unclassified.description: The weighted average interest rate of domestic and foreign time deposits (including certificates of deposits, individual retirement accounts and open accounts) in denominations of $100,000 or more, with maturities of greater than twelve months.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Interest Rate on Overdrawn Demand Deposit
unclassified.description: Weighted average interest rate on overdrawn demand deposit.

unclassified.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic and Diluted (Deprecated 2012-01-31)
Workers' Compensation Discount, Percent
unclassified.description: Percent discount applied to worker's compensation reserve liability to reduce the reserve to present value.
